detailed_descriptions.en: THE END OF THE ARKS, THE GENESIS OF A NEW SAGA. Plunge through the icy heart of darkness as you reunite with old legends, while rekindling hope for the next generation. ARK: Lost Colony bridges the gap between Extinction and ARK 2 with the most ambitious narrative experience in the franchise's history. Your journey returns you to the beginning: Arat Prime, the site of humanity’s final stand. You awaken in the Necrocene - a brutal, post-Cataclysmic era where the Earth’s southern pole has been plunged into eternal night. Buried within the deep snow, the metropolis of the Lost Colony clings to existence beneath energy shields, powered by the radioactive warmth of Red Element. Survival here is an act of defiance against nature itself. This unnatural heat source keeps the Colony alive... only by repelling the Reseed Protocol, ensuring the Earth remains broken so that the Lost King may rule his corrupt kingdom. Caught between the tyrannical order of the Lost King and the creeping, violet corruption of an old enemy, you must navigate a world of gothic horror and advanced science. From the jagged craters of the Tundra to the bioluminescent canopy of the Twilight Forest, and into the depths of the Lost City itself, every inch of the map tells a story of survival at any cost. The future of your survival begins here and now on Arat Prime -- step forth and claim it! CINEMATIC SAGA: Experience explosive MAPPA anime scenes starring Michelle Yeoh and UE5 Metahuman cinematics with Madeleine Madden, Auli'i Cravalho, and Karl Urban. Endure neural taunts from the Lost King (Keith David), while uncovering fully voiced lore from Diana Altaras (Katee Sackhoff) and Rockwell (David Tennant). 13+ NEW CREATURES: Bond with the frame-shifting Ossidon, telekinetic Aureliax, and evolving fox familiars. Survive feral Neophytes and Revenant swarms, or command the laser-wielding Gloon and the colossal Gigadesmodus flying fortress. THRALL MASTERY: Infiltrate the hierarchy by earning the trust of Thralls or forcing their submission via raids. Equip them with weaponry, automate base logistics, or assume direct control via neural link to pilot them as expendable avatars of war. A WORLD OF EXTREMES: From shadow-drenched avenues of the gothic metropolis and the radioactive ruin of the crashed Aberrant ARK, navigate 7 distinct biomes of the Lost King’s dominion. GOTHIC ENGINEERING: Wield forbidden tools like the Fabricated Crossbow, Tek Spear, and Cursed Weaponry that allow dual traits. Revolutionize strongholds with Base Templates and TEK Bunkers, or forge masterpieces at the War Bench while clad in Arctic Armor. THE ASCENT: Evolve through Wayfarer, Beastmaster, and Utility skillpaths, unlocking 70+ skills. Weaken the King’s grip via 3 dynamic Outpost types to secure Sigils, opening the gates to his citadel for a final confrontation. Enhance your journey with the Lost Colony Expansion Pass, granting instant access to the Lost Colony Expansion Pack & these exclusive bonuses: Fantastic Tame - Elderclaw: A forest guardian draped in protective blossoms that blends apex strength with the spirit of the wild. Command living vines to armor the beast or entangle aggressors in a crushing grip. Fantastic Tame - Drakelings: Miniature dragons that serve as steadfast shoulder pets and versatile living weapons. Collect all four seasonal variations to master their distinct powers: Spring for vitality, Summer for resistance, Autumn for harvest yields, and Winter for mitigation.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 方舟的終結，新傳奇的開端。深入冰冷黑暗的中心，與古老的傳奇重聚，同時為下一代點燃希望之火。 《方舟：失落殖民地》以系列史上最雄心勃勃的敘事體驗，連結了《方舟：滅絕》和《方舟2》。你的旅程將帶你回到起點： 阿拉特主星，人類最後的抵抗之地。你醒來時已身處死寂紀元──殘酷的災變後時代，地球南極陷入永夜。失落殖民地的都市被埋沒在厚厚的積雪下，靠著能量護盾勉強維持生存，能量來源是紅色元素的放射性熱量。在這裡生存本身就是對大自然的挑戰。這種非自然的熱源維持著殖民地的生命……但代價是阻止「重新播種協議」的實施，確保地球破碎不堪，以便失落之王能夠統治他腐敗的王國。 你身陷於暴君失落之王的統治和宿敵陰魂不散的腐化勢力之間，必須在一個充滿哥德式恐怖和尖端科技的世界中艱難求生。從苔原崎嶇的隕石坑到暮光森林生物發光的樹冠，再到失落之城的深處，地圖上的每一寸土地都訴說著不惜一切代價求生的故事。 你的未來，就此在阿拉特主星開啟－勇敢前行，奪取屬於你的命運！ 主要特色 電影級劇情： 體驗由楊紫瓊主演的MAPPA動畫，以及由瑪德琳·麥登、奧莉伊·卡瓦洛和卡爾·厄本主演的虛幻引擎5超人類過場動畫。忍受失落之王（基斯大衛飾）和洛克威爾（大衛田納特飾）的神經嘲諷，同時聆聽戴安娜阿爾塔拉斯（凱蒂薩克霍夫飾）的全程語音解說。 超過 13 種全新生物： 與能夠穿越時空的奧西頓、擁有念動力的奧雷利亞克斯以及不斷進化的狐狸夥伴建立聯繫。在兇猛的新兵和亡靈大軍的圍攻下生存下來，或者指揮揮舞激光的格隆和巨型飛行堡壘吉加德斯莫杜斯。 奴隸掌控： 透過贏得奴隸的信任或透過突襲迫使他們臣服來滲透奴隸等級制度。為他們配備武器，自動化基地後勤，或透過神經連接直接控制他們，將他們作為戰爭中可消耗的化身。 一個充滿極端環境的世界： 從哥德式都市陰暗的街道到墜毀的畸變方舟的放射性廢墟，探索失落之王領地的 7 個截然不同的生物群落。 哥德式工程： 使用諸如鍛造弩、泰克長矛和詛咒武器等禁忌工具，賦予它們雙重特性。利用基地模板和泰克地堡革新要塞，或身著極地盔甲在戰爭工作台上打造傑作。 飛升： 透過遊俠、馴獸師和實用技能路線不斷進化，解鎖超過70種技能。利用三種動態前哨站削弱國王的控制，奪取符文，打開通往其城堡的大門，進行最終決戰。 購買失落殖民地擴展通行證，即可立即獲得失落殖民地擴展包及以下專屬獎勵，進一步提升您的冒險之旅： 神奇馴服 - 遠古之爪： 一位身披守護之花的森林守護者，兼具巔峰之力與野性之魂。駕馭活藤蔓為巨獸披上鎧甲，或以致命的纏繞束縛侵略者。 奇幻馴服 - 幼龍： 這些迷你龍既可作為忠實的肩寵，也可作為用途廣泛的活體武器。收集全部四種季節變體，掌握它們各自獨特的能力：春季活力充沛，夏季抵抗力強健，秋季豐收豐饒，冬季則能有效減傷。
detailed_descriptions.ja: アークの終焉、新たなサーガの始まり 。氷に閉ざされた闇の中心へと突き進み、古き伝説と再会し、次世代への希望を再び灯しましょう。ARK: Lost Colony は、シリーズ史上最も野心的な物語体験によって、Extinction と ARK 2 の間の橋渡しをします。旅は始まりへと戻ります。人類最後の抵抗の地、Arat Prime です。あなたは、地球の南極が永遠の夜に陥った、残酷な大異変後の時代、Necrocene で目覚めます。深い雪に埋もれた Lost Colony の大都市は、Red Element の放射能熱によって駆動されるエネルギーシールドの下で生き延びています。ここで生き残ることは、自然そのものへの抵抗行為です。この不自然な熱源こそがコロニーの生存を支えている… なぜなら、それはリシード・プロトコルを阻止することによってのみ可能であり、地球は破壊されたままであり、ロスト・キングが堕落した王国を統治し続けるためなのだ。 ロスト・キングの圧制的な秩序と、忍び寄る宿敵の紫に染まる腐敗の間で、プレイヤーはゴシックホラーと先進科学が交錯する世界を生き抜かなければならない。ツンドラのギザギザのクレーターから、黄昏の森の生物発光する樹冠、そしてロスト・シティの奥深くまで、マップの隅々まで、あらゆる犠牲を払って生き延びる物語が描かれている。 あなたのサバイバルの未来は、今、ここ、Arat Primeから始まる。踏み出し、その手に掴み取ろう！ 主な特徴 シネマティック・サーガ：ミシェル・ヨー主演のMAPPAアニメシーンと、マデレーン・マッデン、アウリイ・クラヴァーリョ、カール・アーバンによるUE5メタヒューマン・シネマティクスを体感せよ。ロスト・キング（キース・デイヴィッド）の神経を逆なでする挑発に耐えながら、ダイアナ・アルタラス（ケイティー・サッコフ）とロックウェル（デイヴィッド・テナント）によるフルボイスのストーリーを解き明かせ。 13体以上の新クリーチャー： フレームシフト能力を持つオシドン、テレキネシス能力を持つオーレリアックス、そして進化するキツネの使い魔たちと絆を深めましょう。凶暴なネオファイトやレヴナントの群れから生き延び、レーザー兵器を操るグローンや巨大な空飛ぶ要塞ギガデスモドゥスを指揮しましょう。 スロールマスター： スロールの信頼を得るか、襲撃で服従を強いることで、階層構造に潜入しましょう。武器を装備させ、基地の兵站を自動化したり、ニューラルリンクを介して直接制御し、使い捨ての戦争の化身として操ることもできます。 極限の世界： ゴシック様式のメトロポリスの影に覆われた大通りから、墜落したAberrant ARKの放射能汚染された廃墟まで、失われた王の支配する7つの異なるバイオームを探索せよ。 ゴシックエンジニアリング： ファブリケイテッドクロスボウ、TEKスピア、そして二重特性を可能にする呪われた武器といった禁断の道具を操れ。拠点テンプレートとTEKバンカーで要塞を刷新し、アークティックアーマーを身にまといウォーベンチで傑作を鍛造せよ。 上昇： ウェイファーラー、ビーストマスター、ユーティリティのスキルパスを経て進化し、70以上のスキルをアンロック。3種類のダイナミックなアウトポストタイプで王の支配を弱め、印章を確保し、城塞への門を開き、最終決戦に備えよ。 ロストコロニー拡張パスで旅をさらに充実させましょう。ロストコロニー拡張パックへの即時アクセスと、以下の限定ボーナスが手に入ります。 素晴らしいテイム - エルダークロー： 守護の花をまとった森の守護者。極限の力と野生の精神を融合させています。生きた蔓を操り、獣を鎧にしたり、侵略者を圧倒的な力で捕らえたりできます。 素晴らしいテイム - ドレイクリング： 頼れる肩のペットとして、また万能の生体武器として活躍する小型ドラゴン。4つの季節のバリエーションをすべて集めて、それぞれの力を使いこなしましょう。春は生命力、夏は抵抗力、秋は豊穣、冬は鎮圧力。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 아크의 종말, 새로운 사가의 시작 . 얼음처럼 차가운 어둠의 심장부로 뛰어들어 옛 전설들과 재회하고, 다음 세대를 위한 희망을 되살리세요. ARK: Lost Colony는 Extinction과 ARK 2 사이의 간극을 메우는 시리즈 역사상 가장 야심찬 스토리텔링 경험을 선사합니다. 당신의 여정은 인류 최후의 항전이 펼쳐졌던 아라트 프라임, 시작점으로 돌아갑니다. 당신은 대재앙 이후 지구 남극이 영원한 밤에 잠긴 잔혹한 시대, 네크로센에서 깨어납니다. 깊은 눈 속에 묻힌 로스트 콜로니의 대도시는 붉은 원소의 방사능 열에 의해 유지되는 에너지 보호막 아래 위태롭게 버티고 있습니다. 이곳에서의 생존은 자연에 대한 저항입니다. 이 비정상적인 열원은 지구를 파괴하고 잃어버린 왕이 타락한 왕국을 다스릴 수 있도록 하는 리시드 프로토콜을 막아내야만 콜로니를 유지할 수 있습니다. 폭압적인 잃어버린 왕의 지배와 스며드는 보라색의 오랜 적의 타락 사이에 갇힌 당신은 고딕 호러와 첨단 과학이 공존하는 세계를 헤쳐나가야 합니다. 툰드라의 울퉁불퉁한 분화구부터 황혼의 숲의 생물 발광하는 숲, 그리고 잃어버린 도시의 깊은 곳까지, 지도의 모든 구석구석에는 어떤 대가를 치르더라도 살아남아야 하는 이야기가 담겨 있습니다. 당신의 생존은 바로 지금, 아라트 프라임에서 시작됩니다. 앞으로 나아가 이 땅을 쟁취하세요! 주요 특징 시네마틱 사가: 미셸 예오 주연의 폭발적인 MAPPA 애니메이션 장면과 매들린 매든, 아울리이 크라발리오, 칼 어반 주연의 UE5 메타휴먼 시네마틱을 경험하세요. 잃어버린 왕(키스 데이비드)의 신경 조롱을 견뎌내고, 다이애나 알타라스(케이티 새크호프)와 록웰(데이비드 테넌트)의 음성 더빙된 이야기를 밝혀내세요. 13종 이상의 새로운 생물: 형태를 자유자재로 바꾸는 오시돈, 염력을 사용하는 아우렐리아스, 그리고 진화하는 여우 소환수와 유대감을 형성하세요. 사나운 네오파이트와 레버넌트 떼의 공격에서 살아남거나, 레이저를 휘두르는 글룬과 거대한 비행 요새 기가데스모두스를 지휘하세요. 노예 지배: 노예들의 신뢰를 얻거나 습격을 통해 복종을 강요하여 계층 구조에 침투하세요. 노예들에게 무기를 장착하고, 기지 물류를 자동화하거나, 신경 연결을 통해 직접 조종하여 전쟁의 소모품 아바타로 활용하세요. 극한의 세계: 고딕 양식의 대도시의 그림자 드리운 거리부터 추락한 이형 아크의 방사능 폐허까지, 잃어버린 왕의 지배하에 있는 7가지 독특한 생태계를 탐험하세요. 고딕 공학: 금지된 도구인 제작 석궁, 테크 창, 저주받은 무기를 사용하여 이중 특성을 활용하세요. 기지 템플릿과 테크 벙커로 ​​요새를 혁신하거나, 북극 갑옷을 입고 전쟁 작업대에서 걸작을 제작하세요. 승천: 방랑자, 야수 조련사, 유틸리티 스킬 경로를 통해 진화하고 70개 이상의 스킬을 해제하세요. 3가지 유형의 역동적인 전초 기지를 활용하여 왕의 지배력을 약화시키고 문장을 확보하여 최후의 결전을 위한 성채의 문을 여세요. 로스트 콜로니 확장 패스로 여정을 더욱 풍성하게 만드세요. 로스트 콜로니 확장팩과 다음과 같은 특별 보너스를 즉시 이용할 수 있습니다. 환상적인 길들이기 - 엘더클로: 보호의 꽃으로 뒤덮인 숲의 수호자로, 최고의 힘과 야생의 정신을 겸비했습니다. 살아있는 덩굴을 조종하여 짐승을 갑옷처럼 만들거나 공격자를 강력한 움켜쥐도록 하세요. 환상적인 길들이기 - 드라클링: 어깨에 얹어 키우기 좋은 작은 용이자 다재다능한 살아있는 무기입니다. 계절별로 다른 네 종류의 드라클링을 모두 모아 각기 다른 능력을 익히세요. 봄에는 활력, 여름에는 저항력, 가을에는 수확량 증가, 겨울에는 피해 감소 능력을 제공합니다.

games.name: ARK: Survival Ascended
games.short_description: ARK is reimagined from the ground-up into the next-generation of video game technology with Unreal Engine 5! Form a tribe, tame & breed hundreds of unique dinosaurs and primeval creatures, explore, craft, build, and fight your way to the top of the food-chain. Your new world awaits!

descriptions.en: ARK is reimagined from the ground-up into the next-generation of video game technology with Unreal Engine 5! Form a tribe, tame & breed hundreds of unique dinosaurs and primeval creatures, explore, craft, build, and fight your way to the top of the food-chain. Your new world awaits!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 《方舟》採用虛幻引擎 5 重新設計，並融入了下一代電子遊戲技術！組成一個部落, 馴養和繁殖數百種恐龍和其他原始生物，探索、製作、建造，並一路進發至食物鏈的頂端. 快來加入這場新的冒險吧!
descriptions.ja: ARKは、Unreal Engine 5を使用したこの次世代のビデオゲームテクノロジーのゼロから再考されます。部族を形成し、何百ものユニークな恐竜と原始の生き物を飼いならし、繁殖させ、食物鎖の頂上までの道を探索、工芸、建設し、戦います。あなたの新しい世界が待っています！
descriptions.ko: Ark는 Unreal Engine 5를 사용 하여이 차세대 비디오 게임 기술에서 처음부터 다시 상상됩니다! 부족을 형성하고 길들인 수백 개의 독특한 공룡과 원시 생물을 형성하고 식품 체인의 꼭대기로가는 길을 탐험, 공예, 건축 및 싸우십시오. 당신의 새로운 세계가 기다리고 있습니다!

detailed_descriptions.en: Respawn into a new dinosaur survival experience beyond your wildest dreams… as ARK is reimagined from the ground-up into the next-generation of videogame technology with Unreal Engine 5! You awake on a mysterious island, your senses overwhelmed by the blinding sunlight and brilliant colors bouncing off every surface around you, the azure waters of a verdant Island lapping at your bare feet. A deep roar echoes from the misty jungle, jolting you into action, and you stand up – not afraid, but intrigued. Are you ready to form a tribe, tame and breed hundreds of species of dinosaurs and other primeval creatures, explore, craft, build, and fight your way to the top of the food-chain? Your new world awaits… step through the looking-glass and join it! FEATURES ARK: Survival Ascended has completely recreated and redesigned the artwork and worlds of ARK to take advantage of the latest in videogame technology, Unreal Engine 5, using high-end graphics features such as fully dynamic Global Illumination (“Lumen”), so that light bounces realistically off of surfaces and provides realistic reflections, and advanced mesh streaming (“Nanite”) of hundreds of millions of triangles for extreme detail. Advanced new physics systems such as dynamic water so that every creature creates waves, ripples, splashes, and bubbles as they move through fluids, and fully interactive physical foliage where every blade of grass, bush, and tree reacts to characters, explosions, projectiles, and physics objects. Knock down a tree, and see it crash into other trees and disturb all the foliage on its way down to smacking into the grass below! Detect an enemy moving sneakily through the grass as it shifts and sways in response to their presence. Demolish a building and watch the pieces break apart realistically, interacting with the grass and water as they fall. ARK: Survival Ascended includes access to all of ARK’s worlds, including Scorched Earth, Aberration, Extinction, ARK Genesis Part 1, ARK Genesis Part 2, and more. The Island, Scorched Earth, Aberration and The Center are released now, Extinction will be released on December 16 , with the subsequent expansion worlds to be added at no additional cost on a regular basis. The definitive survival experience returns better than ever: design your Survivor, form a tribe, and tame, train, breed & ride dinosaurs within a living ecosystem. Watch your food, water, temperature, and weather patterns. Slowly expand outwards as you harvest, build structures, farm crops, customize your visual designs, and proceed to explore to uncover the true nature of The Island and the worlds beyond. Thorough Quality of Life revamps in every area: redesigned User Interfaces, dynamic navigation for intelligent creature pathfinding, Wild Babies, Photo Mode, new Camera systems, new Map system, Tracking System, new Structures and Items, new Creatures, and much more. Cross-Platform Modding: Download & play new custom content created by players, including new maps, creatures, items, and game modes, through a dedicated mod collection directly within the game! Enjoy an endless stream of new ARK content as the creativity and talent of the community is fully unleashed for the first time ever across gaming platforms! Cross-Platform Multiplayer: form your online tribe across different gaming platforms as you work together to survive and thrive on the ARK! Supports public online multiplayer for up to 70 players, private-session multiplayer for up to 8 players, and local split-screen for 2 players.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 進入一場全新的恐龍生存體驗，這一切將超越您最狂野的幻想……《方舟》采用虛幻引擎 5 重新設計，並融入了下一代電子遊戲技術！您會在一個神秘的小島上醒來，刺眼的陽光和絢麗的色彩將使你目不暇接. 蔚藍的海水拍打著您赤裸的雙腳。迷霧叢林中回蕩的低沈吼叫讓你猛然驚醒，你站了起來--卻不是因為害怕，而是因為好奇。你准備好組建一個部落，馴養和繁殖數百種恐龍和其他原始生物，探索、制作、建造，並一路進發至食物鏈的頂端了嗎？一場新的冒險在等待著你......不要再猶豫了,快來加入這個世界吧！ 遊戲特色 ● 《方舟：生存飛升》重新構思了ARK的藝術設計和遊戲世界，采用了最新的虛幻引擎5遊戲技術，包括高端圖形功能技術，例如全局動態照明（Lumen），使光線在物體表面形成逼真的反射效果，以及由數億個三角形組成的高級網格流技術（Nanite），以呈現出極致的細節。 ● 遊戲還采用了全新的物理系統，例如動態水體，使每個生物在液體中移動時都會産生波浪、漣漪、飛濺和氣泡，同時還有完全交互式的物理植被，每片草、灌木和樹都會對角色、爆炸、抛射物和物理物體做出反應。你甚至可以砍倒一棵樹，看著它撞向其他樹木，並在砸向下方草地的途中擾亂所有樹葉。你甚至可以通過觀察草叢的動向來確定偷偷移動的敵人的位置——因為草叢會隨著敵人而移動搖擺。當你拆毀一棟建築時，可以看到碎片更真實地四分五裂，並在落下時與草地和水體發生交互。 ● 通過《方舟：生存飛升》可以訪問所有方舟世界，包括焦土、畸變、滅絕、創世紀1、ARK 創世紀第二部分等等。孤島地圖現已發布，後續擴展地圖將定期免費添加。 ● 這次的終極生存體驗將開啓更加精彩的新篇章：自定義你的幸存者，組建一個部落，在一個真實的生態系統中馴化、訓練、繁衍和駕馭各種恐龍。你需要時刻關注食物、水源、溫度和天氣變化。在采集、建造建築、種植農作物、自定義遊戲世界的過程中，慢慢擴張領土，探索並揭開孤島及其他世界的真面目。 ● 在遊戲體驗的各個方面都進行了更徹底的改進：重新設計的用戶界面，智能生物尋路的動態導航，野生恐龍寶寶，照片模式，新的相機系統，新的地圖系統，追蹤系統，全新的建築、物品和生物等等。 ● 跨平台模組：您可以直接在遊戲中通過專門的模組浏覽器 下載並暢玩由其他玩家創造的新內容，包括新地圖、生物、物品以及遊戲模式！隨著社群的創造力和才能首次在各個平台上得到充分釋放，您將源源不斷地享受到有關方舟新玩法！ ● 跨平台多人遊戲：與不同遊戲平台上的其他玩家一起組建在線部落，共同在方舟的世界中生存和發展！ ● 遊戲支持多達70名玩家的公共在線多人遊戲，最多可容納8名玩家的私人遊戲，以及2至4名玩家的本地分屏模式。
detailed_descriptions.ja: あなたの最もワイルドな夢を超えた新しい恐竜のサバイバルエクスペリエンスへのリスポーン... arkがゼロから再考され、Unreal Engine 5を使用してビデオゲームテクノロジーの次世代に再考されます！あなたは神秘的な島で目を覚まし、あなたの感覚は目がくらむような日光とあなたの周りのあらゆる表面から跳ね返る輝かしい色に圧倒され、あなたの素足で緑豊かな島の飾りの水が跳ねます。霧のジャングルから深いro音が響き渡り、あなたを行動に巻き込んで、あなたは立ち上がっています - 恐れず、興味をそそられます。何百種類もの恐竜やその他の原始生き物を飼いならし、繁殖させ、食物鎖の頂上までの道を探索、工芸、構築し、戦う準備はできていますか？あなたの新しい世界が待っています...見た目を踏みにじり、それに参加してください！ 特徴 ARK：サバイバルアセンデンドは、完全に動的なグローバル照明（「ルーメン」）などのハイエンドグラフィック機能を使用して、最新のビデオゲームテクノロジーであるUnreal Engine 5を利用するために、アートワークと世界のARKの世界を完全に再現し、再設計しました。現実的にオフサーフェスを跳ね返し、現実的な反射を提供し、数億個の三角形の高度なメッシュストリーミング（「ナナイト」）を提供します。 動的な水などの高度な新しい物理システムは、すべてのクリーチャーが液体を移動するときに波、波紋、スプラッシュ、泡を作成するようにし、草、茂み、木のすべての刃がキャラクター、爆発、発射体、草、茂み、木の刃が反応する完全にインタラクティブな物理的葉を作り出すようにします。および物理オブジェクト。木をノックダウンして、それが他の木に衝突し、その途中ですべての葉を邪魔して下の草にぶつかるのを見てください！敵が存在に応じてシフトして揺れながら、敵をこっそり移動していることを検出します。建物を破壊して、草や水が落ちると草や水とやり取りするのを見て、作品が現実的にバラバラになっているのを見ます。 ARK：サバイバルアセンデッドには、焦げた地球、異常、絶滅、アークジェネシスパート1、アークジェネシスパート2などを含むすべての箱舟の世界へのアクセスが含まれます。島は現在リリースされており、その後の拡張世界は定期的に追加費用なしで追加されます。 決定的なサバイバルエクスペリエンスは、これまで以上に戻ってきます。生存者を設計し、部族を形成し、飼いならされた、列車、繁殖、繁殖、生態系内で恐竜を育てます。あなたの食べ物、水、温度、天候のパターンを見てください。収穫時にゆっくりと外側に拡大し、構造を構築し、農作物を構築し、視覚デザインをカスタマイズし、島とその向こうの世界の真の性質を明らかにするために探索します。 すべてのエリアでの徹底的な生活の質の刷新：再設計されたユーザーインターフェイス、インテリジェントクリーチャーパスファインディングのための動的ナビゲーション、野生の赤ちゃん、写真モード、新しいカメラシステム、新しいマップシステム、追跡システム、新しい構造とアイテム、新しいクリーチャーなど。 クロスプラットフォーム改造：ゲーム内で直接専用の新しいMod-Bowserを介して、新しいマップ、クリーチャー、アイテム、ゲームモードなど、プレイヤーが作成した新しいカスタムコンテンツをダウンロードして再生します！コミュニティの創造性と才能は、ゲームプラットフォーム全体で初めて完全に解き放たれるため、新しい箱舟のコンテンツの無限のストリームをお楽しみください！ クロスプラットフォームマルチプレイヤー：さまざまなゲームプラットフォームでオンライン部族を形成し、協力して箱舟で生き残り、繁栄します！ 最大70人のプレーヤーのパブリックオンラインマルチプレイヤー、最大8人のプレイヤーのプライベートセッションマルチプレイヤー、2人のプレーヤーのローカルスプリットスクリーンをサポートします。
detailed_descriptions.ko: ARK가 Unreal Engine 5를 사용하여 다음 세대의 비디오 게임 기술로 다시 상상하면서 ARK가 가장 큰 꿈을 넘어 새로운 공룡 생존 경험으로 부활하십시오! 당신은 신비한 섬에서 깨어 있습니다. 당신의 감각은 눈부신 햇빛과 당신 주변의 모든 표면에서 튀는 눈부신 색상, 맨발로 랩핑하는 귀여운 섬의 푸른 물에 압도됩니다. 안개가 자욱한 정글에서 깊은 포효가 울려 퍼져서 당신을 실천하고, 당신은 일어 서서 두려워하지 않고 흥미 롭습니다. 당신은 부족을 형성하고, 길들여서 수백 종의 공룡과 다른 원시 생물을 길들일 준비가되어 있습니까? 식품 체인의 꼭대기로가는 길을 탐험하고, 공예, 만들고, 싸우고 싸울 준비가 되셨습니까? 당신의 새로운 세상은 기다리고 있습니다.… 보이는 유리를 밟아 가입하십시오! 특징 ARK : Survival Costed는 Ark의 아트 워크와 세계를 완전히 재현하고 재 설계하여 최신 비디오 게임 기술 인 Unreal Engine 5를 활용하여 완전 다이나믹 글로벌 조명 (“루멘”)과 같은 고급 그래픽 기능을 사용하여 빛을 발했습니다. 현실적으로 외부 표면을 바운스하고 현실적인 반사와 극단적 인 세부 사항을 위해 수억 개의 삼각형의 고급 메쉬 스트리밍 ( ""나이트"")을 제공합니다. 다이내믹 워터와 같은 고급 새로운 물리 시스템을 통해 모든 생물체는 체액을 통과 할 때 파도, 잔물결, 튀김 및 거품을 생성하고 잔디, 부시 및 나무의 모든 칼날이 캐릭터, 폭발, 발사체, 발사체에 반응하는 완전히 대화식 물리적 단풍을 만듭니다. 그리고 물리 물체. 나무를 무너 뜨리고 다른 나무에 충돌하고 아래의 잔디에 닿는 길에 모든 단풍을 방해하십시오! 그들의 존재에 대한 반응으로 이동하고 흔들리면서 잔디를 통해 몰래 움직이는 적을 감지하십시오. 건물을 철거하고 조각이 현실적으로 부러지는 것을 지켜 보면서 잔디와 물이 쓰러지면서 상호 작용합니다. ARK : 생존은 타오르는 지구, 수차, 멸종, Ark Genesis Part 1, Ark Genesis Part 2 등을 포함한 모든 Ark의 세계에 대한 접근을 포함합니다. 이 섬은 현재 출시되며, 후속 확장 세계는 정기적으로 추가 비용없이 추가 될 수 있습니다. 결정적인 생존 경험은 생존자를 설계하고, 부족을 형성하고, 길들인, 기차, 번식, 번식 및 타는 공룡을 살아있는 생태계 내에서 더 많이 돌아옵니다. 음식, 물, 온도 및 날씨 패턴을보십시오. 수확, 구조물, 농작물을 구축하고 시각적 디자인을 사용자 정의하고 섬의 진정한 본질을 발견하기 위해 진행하면서 바깥쪽으로 천천히 확장하십시오. 철저한 삶의 질은 모든 영역에서 개조됩니다. 사용자 인터페이스 재 설계, 지능형 생물 경로 변형, 야생 아기, 사진 모드, 새로운 카메라 시스템, 새로운지도 시스템, 추적 시스템, 새로운 구조 및 품목, 새로운 생물 등을위한 동적 탐색. 크로스 플랫폼 모딩 : 게임 내에서 전용 새로운 모드 바이저를 통해 새로운지도, 생물, 아이템 및 게임 모드를 포함하여 플레이어가 만든 새로운 사용자 정의 콘텐츠를 다운로드하고 재생하십시오! 게임 플랫폼에서 처음으로 커뮤니티의 창의성과 재능이 완전히 풀리기 때문에 끝없는 새로운 방주 컨텐츠를 즐기십시오! 크로스 플랫폼 멀티 플레이어 : 서로 다른 게임 플랫폼에서 온라인 부족을 형성하여 Ark에서 살아남고 번성하십시오! 최대 70 명의 플레이어에 대한 공개 온라인 멀티 플레이어, 최대 8 명의 플레이어를위한 개인 세션 멀티 플레이어, 2 명의 플레이어 용으로 현지 분할 화면을 지원합니다.

games.name: ARK: Survival Evolved
games.short_description: Stranded on the shores of a mysterious island, you must learn to survive. Use your cunning to kill or tame the primeval creatures roaming the land, and encounter other players to survive, dominate... and escape!

descriptions.en: Stranded on the shores of a mysterious island, you must learn to survive. Use your cunning to kill or tame the primeval creatures roaming the land, and encounter other players to survive, dominate... and escape!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 由虛幻4引擎打造的一款多人線上生存競技網遊，在一個超高自由度的開放世界裡，可以體驗採集、製造、打獵、收穫、建造、研究以及馴服恐龍等超多自由內容，感受酷熱白晝、冰冷夜晚的動態天氣系統以及饑餓口渴等現實中的生存挑戰，還要面對其它生存者的威脅，合作生存還是競技廝殺，由你決定！
descriptions.ja: Stranded on the shores of a mysterious island, you must learn to survive. Use your cunning to kill or tame the primeval creatures roaming the land, and encounter other players to survive, dominate... and escape!
descriptions.ko: Stranded on the shores of a mysterious island, you must learn to survive. Use your cunning to kill or tame the primeval creatures roaming the land, and encounter other players to survive, dominate... and escape!

detailed_descriptions.en: As a man or woman stranded naked, freezing and starving on the shores of a mysterious island called ARK, you must hunt, harvest resources, craft items, grow crops, research technologies, and build shelters to withstand the elements. Use your cunning and resources to kill or tame & breed the leviathan dinosaurs and other primeval creatures roaming the land, and team up with or prey on hundreds of other players to survive, dominate... and escape! Dinosaurs, Creatures, & Breeding! -- over 100+ creatures can be tamed using a challenging capture-&-affinity process, involving weakening a feral creature to knock it unconscious, and then nursing it back to health with appropriate food. Once tamed, you can issue commands to your tames, which it may follow depending on how well you’ve tamed and trained it. Tames, which can continue to level-up and consume food, can also carry Inventory and Equipment such as Armor, carry prey back to your settlement depending on their strength, and larger tames can be ridden and directly controlled! Fly a Pterodactyl over the snow-capped mountains, lift allies over enemy walls, race through the jungle with a pack of Raptors, tromp through an enemy base along a gigantic brontosaurus, or chase down prey on the back of a raging T-Rex! Take part in a dynamic ecosystem life-cycle with its own predator & prey hierarchies, where you are just one creature among many species struggling for dominance and survival. Tames can also be mated with the opposite gender, to selectively breed successive generations using a trait system based on recombinant genetic inheritance. This process includes both egg-based incubation and mammalian gestation lifecycles! Or put more simply, raise babies! You must eat and drink to survive, with different kinds of plants & meat having different nutritional properties, including human meat. Ensuring a supply of fresh water to your home and inventory is a pressing concern. All physical actions come at a cost of food and water, long-distance travel is fraught with subsistence peril! Inventory weight makes you move slower, and the day/night cycle along with randomized weather patterns add another layer of challenge by altering the temperature of the environment, causing you to hunger or thirst more quickly. Build a fire or shelter, and craft a large variety of customizable clothing & armors, to help protect yourself against locational damage & extreme temperatures using the dynamic indoor/outdoor insulation calculation system! By chopping down forests full of trees and mining metal and other precious resources, you can craft the parts to build massive multi-leveled structures composed of complex snap-linked parts, including ramps, beams, pillars, windows, doors, gates, remote gates, trapdoors, water pipes, faucets, generators, wires and all manner of electrical devices, and ladders among many other types. Structures have a load system to fall apart if enough support has been destroyed, so reinforcing your buildings is important. All structures and items can be painted to customize the look of your home, as well as placing dynamically per-pixel paintable signs, textual billboards, and other decorative objects. Shelter reduces the extremes of weather and provides security for yourself and your stash! Weapons, clothing & armor gear can also be painted to express your own visual style. Pick seeds from the wild vegetation around you, plant them in plots that you lay down, water them and nurture them with fertilizer (everything poops after consuming calories, which can then be composted, and some fertilizer is better than others). Tend to your crops and they will grow to produce delicious and rare fruits, which can also be used to cook a plethora of logical recipes and make useful tonics! Explore to find the rarest of plant seeds that have the most powerful properties! Vegetarians & vegans can flourish, and it will be possible to master and conquer the ARK in a non-violent manner! By bringing sufficient rare sacrificial items to special Summon locations, you can capture the attention of the one of the ARK’s god-like mythical creatures, who will arrive for battle. These gargantuan monstrosities provide an end-game goal for the most experienced groups of players and their armies of tames, and will yield extremely valuable progression items if they are defeated. Create a Tribe and add your friends to it, and all your tames can be commanded by and allied to anyone in your Tribe. Your Tribe will also be able to respawn at any of your home spawn points. Promote members to Tribe Admins to reduce the burden of management. Distribute key items and pass-codes to provide access your shared village! All items are crafted from Blueprints that have variable statistics and qualities, and require corresponding resources. More remote and harsh locales across the ARK tend to have better resources, including the tallest mountains, darkest caves, and depths of the ocean! Level-Up your player character by gaining experience through performance actions, Level-Up your tames, and learn new "Engrams" to be able to craft Items from memory without the use of blueprints, even if you die! Customize the underlying physical look of your character with hair, eye, and skin tones, along with an array of body proportion modifiers. As you explore the vast ARK, you'll find clues left by other Survivors who have made the ARK their home in ages past, in the form of collectible detailed 3D "Explorer Notes". By uncovering all of these, you can begin to piece together the true nature of the ARK, and discover its purpose! Everything you craft has durability and will wear-out from extended use if not repaired, and when you leave the game, your character remains sleeping in the persistent world. Your inventory physically exists in boxes or on your character in the world. Everything can be looted & stolen, so to achieve security you must build-up, team-up, or have tames to guard your stash. Death is permanent, and you can even knock out, capture, and force-feed other players to use them for your own purposes, such as extracting their blood to for transfusions, harvesting their fecal matter to use as fertilizer, or using them as food for your carnivorous tames! The mysterious ARK is a formidable and imposing environment, composed of many natural and unnatural structures, above-ground, below-ground, and underwater. By fully exploring its secrets, you’ll find the most exotic procedurally randomized creatures and rare blueprints. Also to be found are Explorer Notes that are dynamically updated into the game, written by previous human denizens of the ARK from across the millennia, creatively detailing the creatures and backstory of the ARK and its creatures. Fully develop your in-game ARK-map through exploration, write custom points of interest onto it, and craft a Compass or GPS coordinates to aid exploring with other players, whom you can communicate with via proximity text & voice chat, or long-distance radio. Construct & draw in-game signs for other players to help them or lead them astray... And yet.. how do you ultimately challenge the Creators and Conquer the ARK? A definitive end-game is planned. On the 100+ player servers, your character, everything you built, and your tames, stay in-game even when you leave. You can even physically travel your character and items between the network of ARK's by accessing the Obelisks and uploading (or downloading) your data from the Steam Economy! A galaxy of ARKs, each slightly different than the previous, to leave your mark on and conquer, one at a time -- special official ARKs will be unveiled on the World-map for limited times in singular themed events with corresponding limited-run items! Furthermore, you can now design or randomize your own unique 'Procedurally Generated ARKs', for infinite replayability and endless surprises. You can play single-player local games, and bring your character and items between unofficial player-hosted servers, back and forth from singleplayer to multiplayer. Mod the game, with full Steam Workshop support and customized Unreal Engine 4 editor. See how we built our ARK using our maps and assets as an example. Host your own server and configure your ARK precisely to your liking. We want to see what you create! The over-the-top hyper real imagery of the ARK its creatures is brought to expressive life using a highly-customized Unreal Engine 4, with fully dynamic lighting & global illumination, weather systems (rain, fog, snow, etc) & true-to-life volumetric cloud simulation, and the latest in advanced DirectX11 and DirectX12 rendering techniques. Music by award-winning composer of "Ori and the Blind Forest", Gareth Coker!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 孤身一人蘇醒在空曠的海岸邊，發現自己身處一個充滿恐龍的神秘島嶼“ARK”，你身無寸縷，饑寒交迫，你必須學會打獵、獲取資源，製作物品，種植莊稼，發展科技，建立庇護所，從而讓你可以在這個世界中存活下去。同時，你也可以利用技巧殺死或者馴服、繁殖、騎乘那些生活在這片島嶼上的洪荒巨獸。你也可以與上百人建成部落，互相侵略，生存...以及逃離這片孤島！ 馴服，訓練，繁殖 & 在活生生的生態中騎乘恐龍 恐龍，生物，以及繁殖！ 遊戲中提供了超過50種不同類別的原始生物可供玩家馴服。遊戲採用了一套征服-保護的馴養機制，玩家需要先擊暈恐龍來弱化並馴服他們，然後照顧他們直到恢復健康。一旦完成馴服，它將成為你最忠實的夥伴，你可以給他們下達命令，而他們也會根據你馴服和訓練的方式的不同做出不同的回饋。寵物會不斷升級和消耗食物，還可以運送物資和裝備道具。遊戲還提供了獨具特色的繁殖系統，玩家可以擇優選擇寵物去培育最佳屬性，也可以簡單點，直接生養一個恐龍寶寶！你可以騎著翼龍飛躍雪山之巔，帶領著迅猛龍群沖過危險密佈的叢林，或者騎著霸王龍四處追捕落荒而逃的敵人！快來體驗這個這個充滿活力的即時生態圈吧，在捕食者與被捕食者的殘酷等級階層中找到屬於你的位置。 食物，水源，溫度及天氣 食物和水是生存下去的必備要素。遊戲中擁有許多不同種類的食物，不同食物也會有不同的營養價值（甚至還有人肉！）所有的行動都會消耗食物和水，長距離的旅行更是會持續性的消耗這些物品。攜帶物品的重量會影響你的行動速度，日夜轉換和天氣狀況也會影響你周圍的環境，，使你更加容易饑餓與口渴。製作衣服、建立庇護所並利用火去對抗當地惡劣、多變的環境，保護自己。 收割，建造房屋，繪製 伐木、採礦、採集各種物資，成為一代生產大師。利用你的雙手、工作臺和機床去製作越來越複雜和強力的裝備。利用組裝式的部件去建造你的大型基地，從茅草到木頭到石頭再到鋼鐵，各種材料隨你選擇。你還可以利用噴繪定制你的專屬基地，放置可以寫字的公告板宣誓你的領地。武器、衣服、護甲等也都可以被塗上不同顏色來顯示你的個性和與眾不同的品味。 種植，耕種，以及生長 通過從野外植物上採集種子，你可以將其種植在你的住處，澆灌並對其施肥（任何消耗卡路里而生成的糞便都可以使用，有的糞便還更高一等。。）你所種植的植物可以中出美味並稀有的水果，也可以使用來按照配方來製造補藥。去開拓並尋找稀有並強大的種子吧！植物的茁壯成長也能使你不用暴力在方舟中也成一霸。 召喚最終生命體 你可以攜帶聖物去島上特殊的召喚地點喚醒方舟中的神秘生物，這些神秘生物都有強大的攻擊性，他們為遊戲中最強大的部落和寵物提供了終極的成就和目標，一旦擊殺他們，這些部落和寵物也將收穫豐富的獎勵。 部落系統 與你的朋友們一起創建一個部落，這樣你所有所馴化的生物也都可以被你盟友所運用。你的部落同盟也可以通過你家中復活點進行復活。同時，將你的部落盟友提升至更高的級別可以使你免去些管理上的重擔。將關鍵物品及暗號分配出去來建設你的部落吧。 角色扮演式的成長體系 所有物品都需依照藍圖來進行製作——藍圖有著多樣的資料統計和品質，並會對資源有著一定要求。更加偏遠及殘酷的位置擁有者更上乘的資源：包括最高的山脈，最黑的洞穴，最深的海洋！你可以通過各種行為來升級你的角色，升級你所馴化的生物，或學習新的“記憶印記”來不用藍圖便製造物品。你還可以通過角色的頭髮，眼睛以及膚色來個性化自己。 超硬核的遊戲模式 任何你製作的物品都有個耐久度，如果不對其進行修復便會耗盡。當你離開遊戲時，你的角色會在這永久運行的世界中陷入沉睡。你的物品會被安置在貨箱中或角色的身上。任何事物可以被撿起，偷竊；因此，你必須建起一定的安全措施，或建造建築，或安排生物看守。死亡是永久的，同時，你也可以被打暈，抓捕，並強迫其他玩家食用；還可以對其抽血，將其糞便用以施肥，甚至將其作為你寵物的食料！ 探索及發現 方舟的神秘性在它令人敬畏又極其壯觀的環境，包含了眾多自然及非自然的世界構造，地上地下及水下的龐大世界。一旦你對這個世界進行了相應的探索，你會發現你的探索日記會及時的在遊戲中更新。這些日記是由ARK世界中的先人所寫，詳細的記錄著各種生物以及ARK這個世界的背景故事。拓展你的ARK日記，記錄下你感興趣的地點，甚至可以製作出羅盤或GPS來給其他玩家來提供幫助。你在遊戲中可以與其他玩家進行文字或語音聊天，亦或長距離的無線方式。繪製屬於你的標誌牌來引導或迷惑其他的玩家...以及...到了最後，你如何來對抗這個ARK世界的造世主？一個明確的遊戲結局早已被安排好。 龐大世界的永恆觀及超級宇宙觀 在超過100個角色伺服器上，你的角色，你所建造的所有建築，你所馴化的生物，將會在你離開遊戲時依舊存在。在Steam中，你可以通過連接方尖碑並上傳（或下載）你的數據來將你的角色及物品在ARK的網路裡進行轉移！每一個方舟的世界將會不同於上一個，你可以留下你在這片土地上的足跡並踏上征途--特殊的官方ARK主題將會在特定有限的時間內在世界地圖中顯示出來，同時還會產生多樣的限時物品！ Steam平臺mod支援 你可以選擇遊玩單人遊戲，並將你在非官方伺服器上的角色物品帶入多人遊戲模式。對在Steam上對遊戲添加mod可以對虛擬引擎4的編輯器進行個性化。你可以看我們們是如何利用自己的地圖來創造出ARK世界來作為一個範例。主導你的伺服器並創建屬於你自己的ARK吧，我們十分期待你能創造出多麼別樣的世界！ 高端次時代視覺體驗 在特別定制的虛擬引擎4的説明下，方舟將世界內各種生物的影像注入了新的生命，使它們在遊戲中栩栩如生，並同時包含了全動態亮度及世界照明，天氣系統，（雨，霧，雪，等等），如同現實般的類比雲彩體積的系統，以及最新版DirectX11和DirectX12 渲染技術。遊戲內的音樂由“Ori and the Blind Fores” 創作者，獲獎作曲家Gareth Coker完成!

Level-Up your player character by gaining experience through performance actions, Level-Up your tames, and learn new "Engrams" to be able to craft Items from memory without the use of blueprints, even if you die! Customize the underlying physical look of your character with hair, eye, and skin tones, along with an array of body proportion modifiers. As you explore the vast ARK, you'll find clues left by other Survivors who have made the ARK their home in ages past, in the form of collectible detailed 3D "Explorer Notes". By uncovering all of these, you can begin to piece together the true nature of the ARK, and discover its purpose! Everything you craft has durability and will wear-out from extended use if not repaired, and when you leave the game, your character remains sleeping in the persistent world. Your inventory physically exists in boxes or on your character in the world. Everything can be looted & stolen, so to achieve security you must build-up, team-up, or have tames to guard your stash. Death is permanent, and you can even knock out, capture, and force-feed other players to use them for your own purposes, such as extracting their blood to for transfusions, harvesting their fecal matter to use as fertilizer, or using them as food for your carnivorous tames! The mysterious ARK is a formidable and imposing environment, composed of many natural and unnatural structures, above-ground, below-ground, and underwater. By fully exploring its secrets, you’ll find the most exotic procedurally randomized creatures and rare blueprints. Also to be found are Explorer Notes that are dynamically updated into the game, written by previous human denizens of the ARK from across the millennia, creatively detailing the creatures and backstory of the ARK and its creatures. Fully develop your in-game ARK-map through exploration, write custom points of interest onto it, and craft a Compass or GPS coordinates to aid exploring with other players, whom you can communicate with via proximity text & voice chat, or long-distance radio. Construct & draw in-game signs for other players to help them or lead them astray... And yet.. how do you ultimately challenge the Creators and Conquer the ARK? A definitive end-game is planned. On the 100+ player servers, your character, everything you built, and your tames, stay in-game even when you leave. You can even physically travel your character and items between the network of ARK's by accessing the Obelisks and uploading (or downloading) your data from the Steam Economy! A galaxy of ARKs, each slightly different than the previous, to leave your mark on and conquer, one at a time -- special official ARKs will be unveiled on the World-map for limited times in singular themed events with corresponding limited-run items! Furthermore, you can now design or randomize your own unique 'Procedurally Generated ARKs', for infinite replayability and endless surprises. You can play single-player local games, and bring your character and items between unofficial player-hosted servers, back and forth from singleplayer to multiplayer. Mod the game, with full Steam Workshop support and customized Unreal Engine 4 editor. See how we built our ARK using our maps and assets as an example. Host your own server and configure your ARK precisely to your liking. We want to see what you create! The over-the-top hyper real imagery of the ARK its creatures is brought to expressive life using a highly-customized Unreal Engine 4, with fully dynamic lighting & global illumination, weather systems (rain, fog, snow, etc) & true-to-life volumetric cloud simulation, and the latest in advanced DirectX11 and DirectX12 rendering techniques. Music by award-winning composer of "Ori and the Blind Forest", Gareth Coker!

games.name: Assassin's Creed Mirage
games.short_description: Become a deadly Master Assassin in this action-adventure game. Explore the streets of ninth-century Baghdad through the eyes of Basim. Take down your targets while seeking justice as part of the Hidden Ones.

descriptions.en: Become a deadly Master Assassin in this action-adventure game. Explore the streets of ninth-century Baghdad through the eyes of Basim. Take down your targets while seeking justice as part of the Hidden Ones.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 在動作冒險遊戲中成為致命的刺客大師。透過貝辛姆的視角，探索九世紀巴格達的街道。作為「無形者」的一員，在尋求正義的同時擊倒你的目標。
descriptions.ja: このアクションアドベンチャーで危険なマスターアサシンとなれ。バシムの視点で9世紀のバグダッドを探索しよう。「隠れし者」の一員として正義を求め、ターゲットを始末せよ。
descriptions.ko: 액션 어드벤처 게임 속 마스터 암살자가 되어보세요. 바심이 되어 9세기의 바그다드 길거리를 직접 느껴보세요. 감추어진 존재의 일원으로서 표적을 암살하고 정의를 실현하세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: VALLEY OF MEMORY Enjoy 6 hours of new gameplay in Valley of Memory, a free major update that expands Basim’s story and introduces the breathtaking new region of AlUla, with gameplay improvements across the full game. THE ULTIMATE ASSASSIN Become the most versatile and resourceful Assassin in franchise history. Parkour seamlessly through the city and leverage the largest assortment of tools to date. Get contracts and upgrades at the Assassin’s bureaus, collect vital clues, and stealthily take down targets with more visceral assassinations than ever before. A TRIBUTE TO AN ORIGINAL Experience a modern take on the iconic features and gameplay that have defined the franchise. Journey to Alamut, the legendary home of the Assassins who laid the foundations of the Creed, in this heartfelt homage to the game that started it all. AN IMMERSIVE, REACTIVE CITY Explore an incredibly dense and vibrant city whose inhabitants react to your every move. Uncover the secrets of four unique districts, from the industrial Karkh to the lush gardens of the Round City. Discover surprising world events and interact with historical figures that shaped the Golden Age of Baghdad. A POWERFUL COMING-OF-AGE STORY Follow Basim’s journey in this tightly crafted, narrative-driven action-adventure experience. Witness his transformation from a defiant young thief to a Master Assassin as he meets allies, mentors, and foes who shape his destiny.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 記憶之谷 在「記憶之谷」中享受 6 小時的全新遊戲內容，這是一項擴展了貝辛姆故事的免費大型更新，不僅帶來了令人驚嘆的全新地區「埃爾奧拉」，更對整體遊戲進行了改善。 終極刺客 成為系列作史上最多才多藝、足智多謀的刺客。在城市中流暢跑酷，善加運用至今為止最多樣化的工具。從刺客據點取得合約和升級，蒐集重要線索，透過有史以來最發自本能的暗殺手法悄悄解決目標。 致敬系列起源 體驗經過當代視角詮釋、形塑系列作的經典功能與遊戲內容。前往「阿拉穆特」，親臨奠定教條的刺客傳奇家園，展開致敬開創這系列作品的旅程。 栩栩如生、回應行動的城市 探索認識這座極為豐富生動的城市，看看居民們對你的一舉一動會做出什麼反應。從卡赫的工業景觀到圓城的蓊鬱庭園，發掘隱藏在四大獨特地區背後的祕辛。探索驚奇的世界事件，並與塑造巴格達黃金時代的歷史人物互動。 動人的成長故事 在精心打造的敘事型動作冒險中，跟隨貝辛姆的腳步踏上旅程。見證他從叛逆的年輕盜賊成長為刺客大師的過程，並遇見決定他命運的盟友、導師以及敵人。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 記憶の谷 6時間もの新たなゲームプレイが楽しめる無料の大型アップデート「記憶の谷」では、バシムの新たな物語と息をのむほど美しい新エリア、アルウラが新たに追加されるほか、本編のゲームプレイ改善も実装予定。 究極のアサシン シリーズ史上最も多才にして機略に富んだアサシンとなれ。街中をフリーランでシームレスに駆け抜け、かつてないほど豊富な道具を使いこなそう。アサシンの支部で依頼の受注をし、重要な手がかりをかき集めて、今まで以上に直感的な暗殺でターゲットを影から始末せよ。 シリーズ原点へのオマージュ シリーズを決定づけたシステムとゲームプレイを最新技術で体験せよ。シリーズ原点へのオマージュが込められた本作で、信条の基礎を築いたアサシンたちの伝説的な故郷「アラムート」へ旅しよう。 臨場感に満ちた、プレイヤーに反応する都市 プレイヤーのあらゆる行動に反応する群衆がひしめき合う街を探索しよう。工業の盛んなカルフから緑豊かな庭園のある円形都市まで、4つの特徴的な地区に眠る秘密を解き明かせ。驚きに満ちた出来事を目撃し、バグダッドの黄金時代を築いた歴史的人物と交流しよう。 壮大な成長物語 細部まで練られた物語主導のアクションアドベンチャーで、バシムの旅路を辿ろう。バシムの運命を形作るのは、仲間や師、敵との出会い。素行が悪い青年がマスターアサシンへと成長していく姿を見届けよ。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 기억의 계곡 무료 대형 업데이트 '기억의 계곡'에서 6시간 이상의 새로운 게임 플레이를 즐겨 보세요. 확장된 바심의 이야기와 숨막히도록 아름다운 알울라의 풍경, 전반적인 게임플레이 개선을 경험하실 수 있습니다. 궁극의 암살자 시리즈 역사상 가장 다재다능하고 명석한 암살자로 활약할 수 있습니다! 매끄러운 동작의 파쿠르로 도시를 누비고, 역대 가장 다양한 종류의 도구를 적극 활용하세요. 감추어진 존재의 지부에서 계약과 업그레이드를 이용하고, 중요한 단서를 수집하고, 그 어느 때보다 더욱 본능적인 암살로 표적을 은밀하게 처치하세요. 시리즈의 기원에 바치는 헌사 시리즈에서 선보였던 상징적인 특징과 게임플레이를 현대적인 감각으로 다시 한번 느껴보세요. 암살자들의 고향 알라무트로 떠나세요. 알라무트는 암살단의 기반을 다진 곳으로 이 모든 여정의 출발이었던 게임에 대한 경의를 담고 있습니다. 몰입감과 생동감이 넘치는 도시 주변 사람들이 여러분의 일거수일투족에 반응하는 분주하고 활기찬 도시를 탐험하세요. 선진화된 카흐부터 원형 도시의 무성한 정원에 이르기까지 네 가지의 독특한 지역에 잠든 비밀을 밝혀내야 합니다. 세계의 놀라운 사건들을 확인하고 바그다드의 황금기를 이끈 역사 속 인물들과 교류하세요. 인상 깊은 성장 스토리 짜임새 있고 서사 중심으로 진행되는 액션 어드벤처 경험 속에서 바심의 여정을 시작해보세요. 어렸을 때는 반항심 가득한 좀도둑이었지만, 자신의 운명을 바꿔줄 동료와 멘토, 그리고 적들을 만나면서 마스터 암살자로 거듭나는 바심의 여정을 경험해보세요.

games.name: Assassin's Creed® Origins
games.short_description: Explore Ancient Egypt in this action-adventure game. Battle powerful enemies, unveil conspiracies, and discover the origin story of the Assassin’s Brotherhood.

descriptions.en: Explore Ancient Egypt in this action-adventure game. Battle powerful enemies, unveil conspiracies, and discover the origin story of the Assassin’s Brotherhood.

detailed_descriptions.en: A COUNTRY TO DISCOVER From deserts to lush oases, from the Mediterranean Sea to the tombs of Giza, sail down the Nile, and fight your way against dangerous ancient factions and wild beasts as you explore this gigantic and unpredictable land. EMBRACE ACTION-RPG Experience a completely new way to fight. Loot and use dozens of weapons with different characteristics and rarities. Explore deep progression mechanics and challenge your skills against unique and powerful bosses. A NEW STORY EVERY TIME YOU PLAY Engage in multiple quests and gripping stories as you cross paths with strong and memorable characters, from the wealthiest high-born to the most desperate outcasts.

From deserts to lush oases, from the Mediterranean Sea to the tombs of Giza, sail down the Nile, and fight your way against dangerous ancient factions and wild beasts as you explore this gigantic and unpredictable land.

A NEW STORY EVERY TIME YOU PLAY

Engage in multiple quests and gripping stories as you cross paths with strong and memorable characters, from the wealthiest high-born to the most desperate outcasts.

As Shay, you will experience the slow transformation from Assassin to Assassin Hunter. Follow your own creed and set off on an extraordinary journey through New York City, the wild river valley, and far away to the icy cold waters of the North...

Follow your own creed and set off on an extraordinary journey through New York City, the wild river valley, and far away to the icy cold waters of the North...

detailed_descriptions.en: Story 18th century, North America. Amidst the chaos and violence of the French and Indian War, Shay Patrick Cormac, a fearless young member of the Brotherhood of Assassin’s, undergoes a dark transformation that will forever shape the future of the American colonies. After a dangerous mission gone tragically wrong, Shay turns his back on the Assassins who, in response, attempt to end his life. Cast aside by those he once called brothers, Shay sets out on a mission to wipe out all who turned against him and ultimately become the most feared Assassin hunter in history. Introducing Assassin’s Creed® Rogue, the darkest chapter in the Assassin’s Creed franchise yet. As Shay, you will experience the slow transformation from Assassin to Assassin Hunter. Follow your own creed and set off on an extraordinary journey through New York City, the wild river valley, and far away to the icy cold waters of the North Atlantic in pursuit of your ultimate goal - bringing down the Assassins for good. Key Features Become the Ultimate Assassin Hunter - For the first time ever, experience the Assassin’s Creed universe from the perspective of a Templar. Play as Shay, who, in addition to the deadly skills of a Master Assassin, also possesses never before seen skills and weapons: o Equip Shay’s deadly air rifle for both short and long range combat. Distract, eliminate, or confuse your enemies by using a variety of ammunition, including specialized bullets and grenades o Protect yourself from hidden Assassins with your enhanced eagle vision. Constantly assess your surroundings and detect Assassins hiding in the shadows, on rooftops, and in the crowds Slowly Descend into Darkness - Witness Shay’s transformation from an adventurous Assassin to a grim and committed Templar willing to hunt down his former brothers. Experience first-hand the events that will lead Shay down a dark path and set him on a course that will forever change the fate of the Assassin Brotherhood. New and Improved Naval Gameplay - Cast off in your ship, The Morrigan, and fight your way through the icy seas of the North Atlantic and the narrow waters of America’s river valleys. Assassin’s Creed® Rogue builds on the award winning naval experience from Assassin’s Creed® IV Black Flag™ with all new gameplay including: o New enemy tactics: Defend yourself from Assassins as they attempt to board your ship and overthrow your crew. Fight them off quickly to avoid losing too many crew members. o New weapons: Including burning oil, which leaves a trail of fire behind to burn enemy ships, and the puckle gun, capable of delivering continuous machine-gun-like fire. o An arctic world full of possibilities: Ram through ice sheets to discover hidden locations and use icebergs as cover during naval battles. Vast Diverse Open World to Explore - Shay’s story will allow you to explore three unique environments: o The North Atlantic Ocean Experience the cold winds and towering icebergs of the arctic in this expansive naval playground o The River Valley A large hybrid setting of the American Frontier mixing seamless river navigation and ground exploration o New York City One of the most well-known cities in the world, fully recreated as it existed in the 18th century. ENHANCE YOUR EXPERIENCE WITH EYE TRACKING Your eyes lead the way with Tobii Eye Tracking. Direct your character’s journey across North America and the North Atlantic as you focus on the path ahead. The Auto-Pause feature helps make sure you don’t miss out on any action – in the unlikely event you can peel your attention away from the screen, that is. Compatible Eye Tracking Devices: Tobii Eye Tracker 4C, Alienware 17 Notebook, Acer Predator Notebook 21 X, MSI GT72 Notebook, Acer Predator Monitors Z301CT, Z271T, XB271HUT

After a dangerous mission gone tragically wrong, Shay turns his back on the Assassins who, in response, attempt to end his life. Cast aside by those he once called brothers, Shay sets out on a mission to wipe out all who turned against him and ultimately become the most feared Assassin hunter in history. Constantly assess your surroundings and detect Assassins hiding in the shadows, on rooftops, and in the crowds Slowly Descend into Darkness - Witness Shay’s transformation from an adventurous Assassin to a grim and committed Templar willing to hunt down his former brothers. games.name: ASTLIBRA Revision
games.short_description: Confront time and fate in the 2D action RPG, Astlibra Revision. Explore meticulously crafted worlds, fight brutal boss battles, and upgrade your skills to take down enemies lurking around every corner.

descriptions.en: Confront time and fate in the 2D action RPG, Astlibra Revision. Explore meticulously crafted worlds, fight brutal boss battles, and upgrade your skills to take down enemies lurking around every corner.

detailed_descriptions.en: Join our Discord Server Travel Through Unfamiliar WorldsExplore a vast, dangerous, yet beautiful world. Broken up through multiple chapters, join the protagonist and Karon, his talking bird companion, as they confront time and fate. Back to The Golden Age Of JRPGs, with Side-scrolling Action Slashing, Smashing, thrusting countless enemies while building up stamina for powerful Possession Skills, which are enough to melt away anything that blocks your way, including huge bosses that could take half, or even more of the screen. Fight aggressively while thinking strategically, always pick up the most trust worthy equipment, and select the best suited skills to deal with ever changing circumstances. Fight God-Like Boss Battles Battle ferocious bosses throughout the story, each with their own set of attacks and challenges. Upgrading abilities and acquiring new skills are vital to finishing each battle and progressing through the protagonist’s story. Multiple Ways to Build Your Character A warrior mastered ranged combat with bows and throwing knives? A mage smashing enemies with staffs and cast magic at the same time? Play it in your way. Gathering experience to level up, collecting force to grow up, forging and mastering equipment to open up more tactical options. Combat and Story, Why Choose When You Can Enjoy Both 14 years in development and more than 1 year for revision, award-winning indie developer KEIZO gave his all into this work. The plot keeps twisting as characters growing in an ever expanding world; Classic themes like time travel and tons of spoilers are all custom-made with the developer's own style. In ASTLIBRA, Story elements are often made into game mechanics, for example, your soul-mate Karon is not just a sidekick to talk with. Fruitful Endgame with Even More Challenges With 6 difficulty options, all kinds of players can enjoy the combat system at their own pace, but no one can finish all those contents casually - even after you "beat" the game, the Postscript after Final Chapter will provide extra story, new adventure and fresh system, tapping the potential of skills, equipment, as well as your imagination.

games.name: Astral Ascent

names.ja: アストラル アセント

games.short_description: Choose one of four heroes and explore the Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful mystical bosses: the Zodiacs. Challenge them with dozens of unique spells and faithful friends by your side to unfold the story of this platform roguelite with lightning fast combat.

descriptions.en: Choose one of four heroes and explore the Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful mystical bosses: the Zodiacs. Challenge them with dozens of unique spells and faithful friends by your side to unfold the story of this platform roguelite with lightning fast combat.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 《星界戰士》（原名：星座上昇）是一款以現代幻想世界為背景的2D平臺rogue-lite遊戲。作為4個性格迥異的英雄之一，你必須設法從花園逃離，這個大花園是一座由12個强大且邪惡的boss守護的星界監獄，另稱“十二星宮”。
descriptions.ja: 『アストラルアセント』は、ファンタジーな世界を舞台とした２Ｄローグライク・アクションアドベンチャーゲームです。４人のキャラクターから主人公を選び、強大な12体の守護者「ゾディアック」に守られた境界の監獄「ガーデン」を攻略していきます。
descriptions.ko: 4 영웅 중 한 명을 골라 12가지의 강력하고 신비로운 보스인 별자리들이 지키는 애스트럴 감옥인 정원에 도전하세요. 수십 가지의 독특한 주문과 신실한 친구들과 함께 놈들에게 도전하여 번개처럼 빠른 전투로 이 플랫포머 로그라이트 속에서의 이야기를 펼치십시오.

detailed_descriptions.en: Astral Ascent is a 2D platformer roguelite game set in a modern fantasy world. As one of 4 Heroes with very different personalities, you must escape from The Garden , an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful and vicious bosses, the Zodiacs. CREATE YOUR OWN PLAYSTYLE Unlock dozens of unique spells for each or your characters. Optimize your own build or try out new ones to face all the challenges you'll find on your journey for freedom. Get progressively stronger with time to match up with your foes. Each run will test your skills and your reactivity. TWELVE ALMIGHTY BOSSES TO FACE The Zodiacs are 12 experienced guardians dispatched over 4 gorgeous worlds. Each with their own unique attacks and combat styles, backstories to uncover and reasons to be fighting you, they'll pose as a big threat to anyone seeking a way out of the Garden . Get yourself warned! 4 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS Unique characters. Unique weapons. Unique ways to play. Ayla: A skilled assassin sent on a mission by her guild to prove her worth, she uses her sharp blades to eliminate targets before they can react. Her speed and proficiency are unmatched. Kiran: An orphan that has learned life the hard way. He uses his raw strength to deliver attacks powerful enough to create shockwaves. Brutal. Calie: This talented sculptor became a warrior to recover the freedom her people have lost. She will use her magical gemstones to pierce enemy defenses and shred them to bits. She is unforgiving. Octave: Trained by a powerful witch, this young fighter summons ethereal weapons to attack his foes. Big or small, short or long range, he has the right one for every occasion. Lethal in all cases. A STORY THAT OPENS UP, ONE PIECE AT A TIME Astral Ascent is a roguelite infused with narration. Replayability is part of a story that will be unraveled piece by piece. As you get stronger, you will discover more about the characters, their motivations and the secrets of the world they’re trapped in. LOCAL CO-OP The weight of destiny is too heavy to carry by yourself? Don’t worry and bring a friend to play with the two-player co-op mode. Fight and crush your enemies together in local co-op or online using the Steam's Remote Play Together feature. A VAST, COLORFUL FANTASY WORLD WAITING TO BE EXPLORED Dash across gigantic landscapes. Explore original and hand-crafted areas. Discover a fantastic universe loaded with gorgeous art and fluid frame-by-frame animation.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 成為我們社區的一員吧，歡迎加入我們的 ！ 《星界戰士》（原名：星座上昇）是一款以現代幻想世界為背景的2D平臺rogue-lite遊戲。作為4個性格迥異的英雄之一，你必須設法從 花園 逃離，這個大花園是一座由12個强大且邪惡的boss守護的星界監獄，另稱“十二星宮”。 勇往直前 為你的4個不同角色解鎖數十個獨特的法術。優化你的構建或嘗試一個新的管道試圖擊敗12個强大的boss。隨著時間的推進你會變得更強，擁有匹配與敵人抗衡的實力。每次跑關都將測試你的技能和反應能力。 好友合作 命運的重擔想找人一起扛？這個可以有，歡迎邀請好友一起體驗我們的 雙人合作 模式。通過本地合作或使用 Steam線上遠程同樂功能 ，和朋友聯手把敵人按在地上摩擦吧！ 星體威脅 “十二星宮”是由被派往4個華麗世界的12名經驗豐富的守護者所看護。他們將在戰場上展示獨有的攻擊，能力和模式，同時揭露戰鬥背後的故事，讓你知道對你展開攻擊的原因。接受挑戰警告吧！ 重玩價值 《星座上昇》是一款融入敘述的rogue-lite遊戲。重玩性是我們故事的一部分，在重複體驗中將故事逐步揭開。當你變得更强大，你會發現更多關於角色，動機，以及他們所困世界的秘密。 優美的現代幻想世界 在廣闊的風景中穿梭。探索原始和手工製作的領域。通過華麗的藝術和逐幀動畫，探索我們的藝術家創造的世界。 4個遊戲角色 獨特的角色。獨特的武器。獨特的遊戲管道。 Ayla: 作為其所屬刺客公會唯一的倖存者，她能揮舞雙刀在敵人做出反應之前就消滅他們。其速度和精巧是無與倫比的。 Kiran: 這名孤兒在逆境中體驗生活。他可利用自己的力量發動足以產生衝擊波的攻擊。足够殘忍。 Calie: 這位才華橫溢的雕刻家想要重獲自由。她將使用她的魔法寶石刺穿敵人的防禦並粉碎他們。冷酷無情。 Octave: 在一比特强大女巫的訓練下，這位年輕的戰士能召喚空靈的武器來攻擊他的敵人。在需要的時候，他也可以召喚更强大的武器。招招致命。 希望之光：結盟 你可以依靠忠誠的盟友幫你找到出路 The Merchant: 這個神秘的人物有能力通過回憶遺忘技能展示你真正的潜能。小心點，這是要付出代價的。 Zim-Zim: 她的溫室裏藏著可以新增你能力的神奇植物。當然，前提是你能忍受她異想天開和不那麼成熟的行為。 Oloon: 全世界最好的造型師就在這裡，隨時待命。想改變衣服的顏色嗎？想給頭髮染個新的顏色？她能滿足你一切需求！ Papa Yalee: 這只老傢伙——快20歲了！-它能持續分享關於你將遇到的敵人和你跑關的故事。好消息是……大部分內容都是真實的。 Sova: Sova曾經是一個强大的女巫，後來由於遭受了詛咒，現在她必須服務於這個大花園。她的過去一直是在默默承受耻辱。 Ordan: 作為花園 實際 的領導者，這位勇猛的戰士幫助英雄們完成任務。她擁有傳奇的力量。 Ikki: 他是Ordan的前夫，也是一名强大的戰士，負責英雄們的訓練。擁有無盡的兵法知識。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 私たちのDiscordコミュニティーに参加しよう！ ! 『アストラルアセント』は、ファンタジーな世界を舞台とした２Ｄローグライク・アクションアドベンチャーゲームです。４人のキャラクターから主人公を選び、強大な12体の守護者「ゾディアック」に守られた境界の監獄「ガーデン」を攻略していきます。 意志を貫け 個性的な４人のキャラクターと、数十種類のスペルをアンロックしよう！自分に合ったビルドを見つけ試していこう！そして、どんどん強くなって、ボスへ立ち向かおう！行動一つ一つに、あなたの反応とスキルが試されている。 １人じゃない 宿命を１人で背負うのは重すぎる･･。そんな時は 「２人協力」 モードでフレンドと一緒にプレイしよう！Steamの REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER を使って、ローカル協力プレイや、オンラインで一緒に敵に立ち向かおう！ アストラルの脅威 気を付けて！「ゾディアック」は、華やかな４つのフィールドに位置する強大な12体の守護者です。彼らは、特殊な攻撃、能力、パターンを駆使し、キャラクター達と戦う真の理由を持ってくる！ リプレイ性を通じた物語 『アストラルアセント』は、リプレイ性が高いローグライクゲームです！プレイヤーが成長することで、物語はすこしずつ紐解かれ、キャラクターとその動機や、彼らが閉じ込められている世界の真相を見つけよう！ 美しいモダンファンタジーの世界 巨大な風景を駆け抜けよう！繊細な手作り感あるステージを探索しよう！豪華なアート、フレーム単位のアニメーション、アーティストたちが創り出した世界を冒険しよう！ 4人のキャラクター 個性的なキャラクターと武器、遊び方 アイラ： 彼女はアサシンギルドの唯一の生き残り。ツインダガーを使って、気づかれる前に敵を排除する。そのスピードと精度は、他の追随を許さない。 カイラン： 苦難な生涯を生き抜いた孤児。そこに宿る強靭な心は、衝撃波が出るほどの、強力かつ残忍な攻撃を繰り出す。 キャリー： 誰よりも自由を求める彫刻家。彼女の攻撃は容赦がなく、魔石を使って敵を貫き、粉砕する。 オクターヴ： 屈強な魔女に鍛えられた若きファイター。エーテルのような銃を召喚し敵を攻撃する。必要に応じて強大な武器を呼び起こし、すべてに致命傷を負わせる。 希望の同盟 ゴールを目指すうえで、信頼のおける同盟を頼ろう。 謎の商人： この謎の人物は、失われた技術を復旧し、あなたの真の可能性を引き出せる。但し･･それには代償が伴う。 ヂムヂム： 彼女の温室では、あなたの能力を高める魔法植物が隠されてます。彼女の気まぐれで稚拙な行動に、耐えられるかどうか。 オルーン： 宇宙一のスタイリストがここにいて、利用できる。服の色を変えたい？髪を染めたい？必要なものは何でもそろってる！ パパ・ヤリー： もうすぐ20歳になるこの老猫は、あなたが遭遇するであろう敵や、あなたが走る先について、いつも良い話をするだろう。 ソヴァ： かつて強力な魔術師だった彼女は呪われてしまい、今はガーデンに仕えなければならなかった。彼女は過去を「恥」思い、沈黙を続けている。 オルダン： ガーデンの実質リーダー であり、この勇敢な戦士は、英雄探しを助けている。彼女の力は伝説となっている。 イッキ： オルダンの元夫であり、強力な戦士の一人である彼は、英雄たちの育成を担当している。彼の戦争術の知識は尽きない。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 成为我们社区的一员吧，欢迎加入我们的 ! 애스트럴 어센트는 현대 판타지 세계를 배경으로 한 2D 플랫포머 로그라이트 게임입니다. 각기 다른 특성을 지닌 4명의 영웅 중 한 명이 되어 12가지의 강력하고 사악한 보스 별자리들이 지키는 애스트럴 감옥인 정원을 탈출하십시오. 자신만의 방식으로 싸워라 4명의 고유한 캐릭터가 지닌 수십 가지의 주문을 해금하십시오. 자신의 빌드를 최적화하거나 새로운 빌드를 시도하여 12가지의 강력한 보스를 쓰러뜨리십시오. 시간을 들여 더욱 강력해진 상태로 적과 맞서십시오. 각 회차는 당신의 기술과 반응성을 시험합니다. 혼자가 아니다 운명의 무게를 혼자 짊어지기엔 너무 무거운가요? 걱정하지 말고 친구를 데려와 2인 협동 모드에서 플레이하십시오. Steam의 Remote Play Together 기능을 사용하여 로컬 협동 또는 온라인에서 함께 적과 싸우고 박살내십시오. 애스트럴 위협 별자리는 4개의 화려한 세계에 파견된 12명의 숙련된 수호자입니다. 놈들은 전장에서 독특한 공격, 능력, 패턴, 밝혀낼 배경 이야기, 당신과 싸워야만 하는 이유를 가지고 있습니다. 부디 조심하십시오. 다회 플레이를 통한 스토리 전달 애스트럴 어센트는 내레이션이 포함된 로그라이트 게임입니다. 다회 플레이는 게임 이야기의 일부이며 조각별로 풀리게 됩니다. 강해지면 캐릭터, 동기, 갇힌 세계의 비밀에 대해 더 많이 알게 됩니다. 아름다운 현대 판타지 세계 거대한 대지에 질주하십시오. 독창적이고 손으로 그려낸 지역을 탐험하십시오. 멋진 아트와 프레임 단위로 짜인 애니메이션으로 아티스트가 만들어낸 세상을 탐구하세요. 4명의 플레이 캐릭터 독특한 캐릭터. 독특한 무기. 독특한 플레이 방식. 아일라: 아일라: 암살자 길드의 유일한 생존자인 그녀는 쌍단검을 사용하여 적들이 반응하기 전에 제거합니다. 아일라의 속도와 실력은 타의 추종을 불허합니다. 키란: 힘든 인생을 살아온 고아. 자신의 힘을 사용하여 충격파를 일으킬 만큼 강력한 공격을 전합니다. 잔인합니다. 칼리: 칼리는 재능있는 조각가로 자유를 되찾고 싶어합니다. 그녀는 마법의 원석을 사용하여 적의 방어를 뚫고 조각조각냅니다. 자비란 없습니다. 옥타브: 강력한 마녀에게 훈련을 받은 전사, 옥타브는 천상의 총을 소환하여 공격합니다. 필요하다면 더 큰 무기도 만들어낼 수 있습니다. 언제나 강력합니다. 희망을 위한 동료 탈출구를 찾는 데 도움이 되는 충실한 동료에 의지하십시오. 상인: 이 신비한 인물은 잊힌 기술을 기억하여 진정한 잠재력을 드러내는 힘을 가지고 있습니다. 조심하십시오… 대가가 따릅니다. 짐-짐: 그녀의 온실에는 능력을 향상시킬 수 있는 마법의 식물이 숨겨져 있습니다. 그녀의 변덕스럽고 성숙하지 않은 행동을 참을 수 있다면 동료가 되어보는 것도 좋습니다. 올룬: 세계 최고의 스타일리스트. 옷의 색을 바꾸고 싶나요? 머리를 염색하고 싶나요? 그녀는 당신이 필요한 모든 것을 가지고 있습니다. 파파 예일리: 거의 20살이 된 이 노장 고양이는 당신이 마주할 적에 앞으로의 회차에 대한 좋은 이야기를 지니고 있습니다. 좋은 소식은 이 고양이의 이야기가… 대부분 사실이라는 것입니다. 소바: 한때 강력한 마법사였던 소바는 저주를 받아 이제 정원을 섬겨야 합니다. 그녀의 과거는 침묵을 이어가는 수치심의 짐덩이입니다. 올단: 사실상 정원의 지도자인 이 사나운 전사는 영웅들의 임무를 도와줍니다. 그녀의 능력을 전설적입니다. 아이키: 전 남편이자 강력한 전사인 오르단은 영웅의 훈련을 담당하고 있습니다. 전쟁 기술에 대한 그의 지식은 무한합니다.

games.name: Astro Colony
games.short_description: Explore endless Universe and create the most efficient constellation of colonies. Build conveyor systems to automate production. Take care of Astronauts and their needs! Establish new colonies as part of intergalactic simulation.

descriptions.en: Explore endless Universe and create the most efficient constellation of colonies. Build conveyor systems to automate production. Take care of Astronauts and their needs! Establish new colonies as part of intergalactic simulation.

detailed_descriptions.en: Astro Colony is a game of automation and exploration in an infinite procedurally generated universe. It is composed of fully destructible voxel planets. Move stations, dock them and create a galaxy network no one have seen before! A space adventure game could not exist without a variety of biomes and hundreds of plants! Construct unique transport systems using conveyor belts and pipes. Recruit new Astronauts and fulfill their needs by providing food and shelter. Research over 70 unique technologies to progress in colony development. Play the game in the co-op mode with your friends or join other hosted lobbies. Traverse the universe full of unexpected events and discover unknown grounds. But be aware, the danger is lurking around the corner!

games.name: ASTROBOTANICA
games.short_description: Science-driven exploration adventure on prehistoric Earth with a relaxing vibe. Farming, crafting, puzzle-solving, and exploration on Prehistoric Earth, where you arrive as an alien botanist who is very good at plant research, but... can't breathe oxygen.

descriptions.en: Science-driven exploration adventure on prehistoric Earth with a relaxing vibe. Farming, crafting, puzzle-solving, and exploration on Prehistoric Earth, where you arrive as an alien botanist who is very good at plant research, but... can't breathe oxygen.

detailed_descriptions.en: ASTROBOTANICA™ is a science-driven exploration adventure set on prehistoric Earth. You’re Xel - an alien botanist stranded on a hostile primeval world while searching for rare plant species capable of saving your dying home planet. Ancient Earth is beautiful, mysterious, and toxic to your physiology. To survive, you must study the planet’s ecosystems, discover powerful prehistoric flora, and master the art of botanical experimentation. Scan unfamiliar plants, gather rare ingredients, and combine their properties to create tonics that restore health, energy, and CO₂. Learn how different species interact, uncover powerful botanical aspects, and develop new ways to adapt to Earth’s dangerous atmosphere. Journey through tropical coastline, rocky cliffs, lush jungles and hidden caves filled with unique plant habitats, environmental mysteries, and extinct wildlife. Discover forgotten locations, unlock new regions, and uncover pathways hidden behind ancient puzzles. Encounter a lone Neanderthal surviving in the prehistoric wilderness. Heal his ailments using handcrafted botanical remedies and uncover the secrets surrounding his mysterious totem. Earth’s atmosphere is deadly to Xel. Use your crashed ship as a mobile research base - store energy, power advanced systems, generate CO₂, and recharge your equipment while preparing for deeper expeditions into the unknown. Discover and study prehistoric plant species Create experimental tonics Explore interconnected biomes filled with secrets and environmental puzzles Manage energy and CO₂ using alien technology and plant science Explore a prehistoric world inhabited by extinct creatures

games.name: Astrometica
games.short_description: Astrometica is a space exploration and base-building survival game. After a catastrophic event, explore vast space, gather resources, build bases, and uncover cosmic mysteries. Use advanced technology, craft tools, and discover new blueprints to survive and thrive in the unknown.

descriptions.en: Astrometica is a space exploration and base-building survival game. After a catastrophic event, explore vast space, gather resources, build bases, and uncover cosmic mysteries. Use advanced technology, craft tools, and discover new blueprints to survive and thrive in the unknown.

detailed_descriptions.en: Immerse yourself in Astrometica, a space exploration and base-building survival game. After an explosion at a mining space station, you awaken inside an emergency pod adrift in the vastness of space. To survive, you must harness your skills, explore the endless universe, and search for other survivors’ emergency pods or outposts. Space Exploration: Experience the thrill of exploring the vastness of space with cutting-edge technology. Navigate through asteroid belts, mysterious cosmic anomalies, and abandoned space stations using a variety of vehicles specially designed for deep space travel. Discover hidden secrets and uncover the mysteries of the cosmos as you chart a course through the unknown. Every corner of space holds a new discovery, whether it's a new resource, a signal from another survivor, or a piece of lost technology waiting to be found. Base Building: Build and expand your own bases across the stars. In Astrometica, base building is key to your survival and exploration. Construct modular bases to serve as safe havens, research facilities, or resource gathering outposts. Automate mining operations to extract valuable resources from asteroids and deposits. Design your bases to be both functional and fortified, ensuring they can withstand the harsh conditions of space and potential threats. As you explore, you'll unlock new blueprints to further enhance and customize your bases, making each outpost uniquely yours. Mining and Tools: Equip yourself with a variety of tools to mine for essential resources and salvage valuable materials. Craft and upgrade tools like drills, mining lasers, and scrappers to efficiently gather resources needed for survival and expansion. The more you explore and mine, the more you uncover rare materials that can be used to create advanced technologies and powerful equipment. Your tools are your lifeline in space; maintaining and upgrading them is crucial to your survival and success in the unforgiving environment of deep space. Scanning Environment: Utilize advanced scanning tools to survey your surroundings and discover new blueprints and technologies. When you come across other survivors' outposts or wreckages, use your scanner to analyze fragments and gain insights into new crafting recipes and tech upgrades. Scanning isn't just about finding new gear—it's about piecing together the story of what happened and understanding the universe around you. With each scan, you get closer to unraveling the mysteries of Astrometica and finding the means to thrive in space. Astrometica is more than just survival—it's about exploring the unknown, building a life among the stars, and uncovering the secrets hidden in the vast cosmos.

games.short_description: Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration takes players on an interactive journey through 50 years of video games via interviews with designers, developers and industry leaders, documentary footage, product design documents, high-res original artwork, and a curated list of more than 90 playable games.

descriptions.en: Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration takes players on an interactive journey through 50 years of video games via interviews with designers, developers and industry leaders, documentary footage, product design documents, high-res original artwork, and a curated list of more than 90 playable games.

detailed_descriptions.en: Join the celebration! Atari 50: The Anniversary Celebration takes you on an interactive journey through 50 years of video games. At the heart of Atari 50 are the Interactive Timelines, which combine historical trivia, digital artifacts, over 60 minutes of new interviews, documentary footage, and playable games into one cohesive experience. When you encounter a game in the Timelines, you can immediately play it without losing your place. The massive selection of over 100 games spans seven different platforms: Arcade, 2600, 5200, 7800, Atari 8-bit computers, and, for the first time ever on modern consoles, Atari Lynx and Jaguar! Play the classics like Tempest 2000, Asteroids, and Yars' Revenge, or dive into some deeper cuts. Behind every game are the stories of Atari, what was happening at the company, and what went into the creation of the games and the hardware on which they ran, all told by the people who were there. Also includes six new games: Swordquest: AirWorld – Yes, you read that right: After nearly 40 years of waiting, the team at Digital Eclipse has created a new entry in the legendary Swordquest series, inspired by the design concepts of original Swordquest creator Tod Frye. Who will be the first to solve its mysteries – and finally complete the quest? Haunted Houses – The original “survival horror” game for the Atari 2600 gets a modern 3D voxel-based sequel, featuring more houses, more spooky situations, and more urns. VCTR-SCTR – This mashup celebration of the vector era of gaming combines the gameplay from Asteroids, Tempest, and other vector-based arcade classics into a single, continuous challenge. Neo Breakout – An amazing and addictive two-player competition that combines the best features of Breakout and Pong, with a modern graphic style Quadratank – The first new entry in the classic Tank series since 1978 combines features from the original games with four-player fun in team or free-for-all modes. Yars’ Revenge Reimagined – The Atari 2600 masterpiece gets a whole new look. Swap between original and modern graphics at any time!

games.short_description: A 2D automation sandbox adventure. Build an automated factory with Mana-powered machines, progress through an expansive tech tree, explore a vast and wonderful world, upgrade yourself with ancient technologies, and defend it all from invasions.

descriptions.en: A 2D automation sandbox adventure. Build an automated factory with Mana-powered machines, progress through an expansive tech tree, explore a vast and wonderful world, upgrade yourself with ancient technologies, and defend it all from invasions.

descriptions.ko: 2D 자동화 샌드박스 어드벤처 게임입니다. 마나로 가동되는 기계를 갖춘 자동화된 공장을 건설하고, 광범위한 기술 체계를 따라 발전하고, 드넓고 멋진 세계를 탐험하고, 고대의 기술을 통해 자신을 개발하면서, 그 모든 성과를 침공으로부터 방어하세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: A 2D automation sandbox adventure. Build an automated factory with Mana-powered machines and farming, progress through an expansive tech tree, uncover a vast world filled with wonder and danger, upgrade yourself with ancient technologies, and defend it all from enemy invasions. You are Otto, a magical golem who awakens to find himself abandoned and alone. Seek out your ancient masters and learn what happened to them and the world – but first, you must build… Automate Crafting takes time. Instead, build a automated factory composed of Mana-powered machines, farming and monster husbandry. Design sprawling production lines connecting vital resource outposts to the heart of your factory. Reshape the world to fit your needs. Explore Forge your own path through dangerous lands. Find new ore deposits to expand your factory, uncover valuable treasures, and interact with the denizens of the world. Each new region is a unique blend of procedural generation and hand-crafted points of interest. Expand Otto is forever tethered to the powerful Apotheos; however, with the right materials these bounds can be expanded. Unlock a sprawling sandbox world region by region. Progress Delve into a massive technology tree, discovering new structures and materials as your factory’s power expands. Use ancient technology scattered throughout the world to upgrade Otto’s mainframe. Defend A mysterious auto-defense system has awakened to protect the world’s resources – from you! Defeat the drones with a sword, blaster, and an auto-defense system of your own.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 2D機器人沙盒冒險遊戲。用法力驅動的機器建造自動化工廠，在龐大的技術樹中推進進度，探索廣袤而奇妙的世界，利用古代科技升級，幫助工廠抵禦入侵。 你將扮演一個被遺棄且孤獨的魔法傀儡——奧托。尋找遠古主人，了解他們和這個世界的遭遇——但首先，你必須建造…… 自動化 製作需要時間。與其如此，不如建造一個包含法力驅動的機器、種植和怪物飼養多種功能的自動化工廠。設計龐大的生產線，將重要的資源前哨與工廠中心連接起來。按照你的需要重塑世界。 探索 在危險的土地上開闢自己的道路。尋找新的礦藏來擴建工廠，發掘珍貴的寶藏，並與世界中的居民互動。每個新區域都由程式生成，包含精心製作的興趣點。 擴展 奧托一直被強大的生命水晶阿波西歐斯束縛著，但是，只要有合適的材料，這個束縛就能得到擴展。逐個解鎖地區，體驗廣闊的沙盒世界。 推進進度 深入探索龐大的科技樹，隨著工廠實力的增強而發現新結構和材料。利用散落在世界各地的古代科技，升級奧托主機。 防禦 一個神秘的自動防禦系統已經甦醒，它將保護世界資源免受你的開採！用劍、槍和你自己的自動防禦系統打敗無人機。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 『AutoForge』は2D自動化サンドボックスアドベンチャーだ。マナで動く機械で自動化された工場を建設し、大規模なテックツリーを進め、広大で素敵な世界を探索し、古代の技術で自らをアップグレードし、侵略を食い止めよう。 プレイヤーが操作するのは不思議なゴーレム、オットーだ。目を覚ますと、オットーは捨てられ、ひとりぼっちになっていた。古代のマスターたちを探し出し、彼らと世界に何があったのか確かめよう。だがまずは、世界を築き上げるところからだ… 自動化 クラフトは時間がかかるものだ。マナで動く機械や農作、モンスターの畜産などが組み合わさった自動化された工場を作ってしまおう。重要な資源基地と工場の中心とを結ぶ、大規模な生産ラインを設計しよう。自分のニーズに合わせて世界を再構築できる。 探索 危険な世界で自分の道を切り開こう。鉱床を見つけて工場を拡張し、貴重な財宝を発見し、世界中にいる住民と交流しよう。プロシージャル生成と手作業を組み合わせて作られた世界は、どれもユニークだ。 拡大 オットーは強大な力を持つアポテオスと初めからつながっているが、適切な素材があればこの結界を広げることができる。世界の地域を一つずつアンロックしよう。 発展 大規模なテックツリーで、新しい建造物や素材について学びながら、工場の力を拡大していこう。世界中に散らばる古代技術を使って、オットーのメインフレームをアップグレードしよう。 防衛 オットーから世界の資源を守るため、謎の自動防衛システムが目覚めた！剣やブラスター、自分の自動防衛システムを駆使してドローンを倒そう。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 2D 자동화 샌드박스 어드벤처 게임입니다. 마나로 가동되는 기계를 갖춘 자동화된 공장을 건설하고, 광범위한 기술 체계를 따라 발전하고, 드넓고 멋진 세계를 탐험하고, 고대의 기술을 통해 자신을 개발하면서, 그 모든 성과를 침공으로부터 방어하세요. 당신은 혼자 버려진 채로 깨어난 마법 골렘인 오토입니다. 고대의 주인들을 찾으면서 그들과 세상이 어떻게 된 건지 알아보세요. 다만 일단, 건설해야만 합니다... 자동화 제작에는 시간이 걸립니다. 그 대신 마나로 가동되는 기계와 농사와 몬스터 축산업을 갖춘 자동화된 공장을 건설하세요. 필수적인 자원 전초기지를 당신의 공장 중심으로 연결하는, 불규칙하게 확장할 수 있는 생산 라인을 설계하세요. 편의성을 위해 세상의 형태를 변경하세요. 탐험 위험한 땅을 헤쳐나가며 당신만의 길을 만드세요. 새로운 광석층을 찾아 공장을 확장시키고, 값진 보물을 발견하고, 세계의 주민들과 소통하세요. 새로운 지역마다 절차적 생성과 수제작한 관심 거점들이 독특하게 뒤섞여 있습니다. 확장 오토는 강력한 아포테오스에게 영원히 속박당한 상황이지만, 이 한계는 올바른 자원을 통해 확장시킬 수 있습니다. 지역을 넘나들며 불규칙하게 확장되는 샌드박스 세계를 해금하세요. 발전 당신의 공장 생산력이 확장되는 동안, 거대한 기술 체계를 확인하고 새로운 건물과 재료를 확인하세요. 세계 곳곳에 흩어진 고대의 기술을 활용하여 오토의 본체를 업그레이드하세요. 방어 불가사의한 자동 방어 시스템이 세상의 자원을 지키기 위해, 당신으로부터 깨어났습니다! 검과 우주총과 당신만의 자동 방어 시스템으로 드론들을 격파하세요.

games.name: Automaton Heart
games.short_description: Automaton Heart is an RPG with platforming elements where you visit obscure and interesting places while upgrading your organs and strategizing about which items to bring along.

descriptions.en: Automaton Heart is an RPG with platforming elements where you visit obscure and interesting places while upgrading your organs and strategizing about which items to bring along.

detailed_descriptions.en: Automaton Heart Automaton Heart is an RPG with platforming elements where you visit obscure and interesting places while upgrading your organs and strategizing about which items to bring along. Organ Management System Upgrading organs will influence not only your combat stats, but also will unlock new features for your automaton. Upgrade the mind to gain useful navigation tools or upgrade your lungs to breath underwater for longer. Different tools will help you gain access to new areas but you may only carry so many at a time. The world remains persistent so you can stash items and come back for them later, but beware of enemies that can stalk you between areas or steal items off your person or the floor. Periods of action are punctuated by stretches of pure exploration and rest areas where the player may choose to deal with their equipment and upgrades. Characters Play through the stories of the automatons Uma, Alma, and Misha experiencing their unique abilities and traits. Each of the three characters have a set of six unique abilities with a wide range of different effects like allowing the player to summon a friendly companion or jet through the air for a short time. Item Strategy Players will need to assess their equipment and stats, make hidden item stashes, and plan to bring an adequate bundle of supplies for an excursion into the unknown. Shopkeepers and friendly sentient creatures in the world can trade useful items so you'll have to think before you act during an encounter. Progression Gain experience levels to generate organ cores, and then choose how you distribute organ cores amongst each organ to upgrade them. Experience is gained by finding new secret areas, defeating enemies, or choosing to invest computer chips into your own body vs. selling them to a shopkeeper. Thank you For reading a little bit about my game. I worked a long time on it and didn't use generative tools of any kind so I hope for human expression to shine through in the work I did.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Automaton Heart

Automaton Heart is an RPG with platforming elements where you visit obscure and interesting places while upgrading your organs and strategizing about which items to bring along.

Organ Management System

Upgrading organs will influence not only your combat stats, but also will unlock new features for your automaton. Upgrade the mind to gain useful navigation tools or upgrade your lungs to breath underwater for longer.

Different tools will help you gain access to new areas but you may only carry so many at a time.

The world remains persistent so you can stash items and come back for them later, but beware of enemies that can stalk you between areas or steal items off your person or the floor.

Periods of action are punctuated by stretches of pure exploration and rest areas where the player may choose to deal with their equipment and upgrades.

Characters

Play through the stories of the automatons Uma, Alma, and Misha experiencing their unique abilities and traits.

Each of the three characters have a set of six unique abilities with a wide range of different effects like allowing the player to summon a friendly companion or jet through the air for a short time.

Item Strategy

Players will need to assess their equipment and stats, make hidden item stashes, and plan to bring an adequate bundle of supplies for an excursion into the unknown.

Shopkeepers and friendly sentient creatures in the world can trade useful items so you'll have to think before you act during an encounter.

Progression

Gain experience levels to generate organ cores, and then choose how you distribute organ cores amongst each organ to upgrade them.

Experience is gained by finding new secret areas, defeating enemies, or choosing to invest computer chips into your own body vs. selling them to a shopkeeper.

Thank you

For reading a little bit about my game. I worked a long time on it and didn't use generative tools of any kind so I hope for human expression to shine through in the work I did.

games.name: Backrooms Rec.
games.short_description: Dive into the mysteries of the Backrooms with a solo-developed survival game. Explore eerie hallways, uncover secrets alone or in multiplayer (up to 6 players), and take on unique challenges.

descriptions.en: Dive into the mysteries of the Backrooms with a solo-developed survival game. Explore eerie hallways, uncover secrets alone or in multiplayer (up to 6 players), and take on unique challenges.

detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to the depths of the Backrooms! Dive into a terrifying and unsettling journey where reality fades and nightmares come to life. I am proud to present my solo-developed game, offering a total immersion into a world as mysterious as it is disturbing, soon to be available in early access on Steam. In this immersive survival game, you will explore the labyrinthine corridors of the Backrooms, an extraordinary place where the boundaries of reality are blurred. As a passionate solo developer, I have devoted countless hours to recreating the oppressive atmosphere and sense of dread that dominate this sinister environment. The early access of my game promises an immersive and captivating gameplay experience, with realistic graphics that plunge you directly into the heart of the Backrooms. Soon, you will be invited to uncover the hidden secrets behind its walls. The game stands out for its diversity of gameplay modes, including a solo story mode for those who dare to face the horrors of the Backrooms alone, as well as an enriched multiplayer mode. The latter offers a cooperative story mode, allowing you to share this frightening adventure with friends, and an innovative escape mode with procedural level generation, ensuring each player a renewed experience and unique challenges in every session. Your feedback has been an invaluable source of inspiration. As a solo developer, I have listened closely to the community to incorporate significant improvements into the game. I eagerly await the opportunity to share this unique experience during early access, where we can together shape the future of this project. Stay tuned for all the latest news and announcements regarding the early access of the Backrooms! Prepare to explore, survive, and unveil the mysteries hidden within these endless corridors. Darkness awaits you... but perhaps you will find a way out. The adventure awaits!

games.name: Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden
games.short_description: Hunt ghosts as two memorable characters in a story-driven Action-RPG where your decisions carry dramatic consequences. Torn between honoring your oath to the living and saving your departed partner, how far will you go for love?

descriptions.en: Hunt ghosts as two memorable characters in a story-driven Action-RPG where your decisions carry dramatic consequences. Torn between honoring your oath to the living and saving your departed partner, how far will you go for love?

detailed_descriptions.en: In New Eden, 1695, communities of settlers are plagued by a dreadful curse. As Banishers, step into their lives, investigate the source of evil, unravel chilling mysteries, explore diverse landscapes, and interact with unforgettable characters whose fate lies in your hands. Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden is an all-new title crafted by renowned studio DON'T NOD, known for their acclaimed titles such as Life is Strange and Vampyr. Immerse yourself in an intimate narrative Action-RPG, taking you on an exhilarating journey between life, death, love and sacrifices. Play as a couple of Banishers, Red and Antea, experienced spirit hunters entrusted with the daunting task of dispelling a malevolent curse through powerful rituals. Protect the living from the threat of lingering ghosts and specters, and become a beacon of hope in a world consumed by darkness. Experience a heart-wrenching love story between Antea Duarte and Red mac Raith. When Antea is killed and turned into a spirit, you find yourself facing a choice. Will you uphold your oath and ascend her soul, or will you sacrifice the living in the hope of bringing her back? Your decisions will shape the fate of New Eden’s inhabitants - may they be living or dead, and determine the end of your journey. BLAME the living and sacrifice their lives, holding them responsible for their actions BANISH souls of the departed, condemning them to eternal suffering ASCEND souls, liberating them from eternal sorrow and granting them serenity Banishers are specialized in combat against undead creatures, such as specters or ghosts.
