games.name: DRAGON BALL FighterZ

names.ja: ドラゴンボール ファイターズ

games.short_description: DRAGON BALL FighterZ is born from what makes the DRAGON BALL series so loved and famous: endless spectacular fights with its all-powerful fighters.

descriptions.en: DRAGON BALL FighterZ is born from what makes the DRAGON BALL series so loved and famous: endless spectacular fights with its all-powerful fighters.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 由著名格鬥遊戲開發公司ARC System Works所製作，「七龍珠」正統格鬥遊戲登場！ 本作使用了「超水準動畫表現」，畫面有如動畫自己動起來一般。 請盡情享受這前所未有的戰鬥、以及追求畫面表現等魅力的「全新七龍珠戰鬥」吧。
descriptions.ja: 「ドラゴンボール」本格格闘ゲームが登場。開発は格闘ゲームで定評のあるアークシステムワークス社。ビジュアルは、まるでアニメを自ら動かしているかのような「超ハイエンドアニメ表現」を採用。かつてないバトルへのこだわり、アニメ表現への追及などの魅力が詰まった「新約ドラゴンボールバトル」をご堪能ください。
descriptions.ko: 드래곤볼 시리즈는 강력한 캐릭터들이 펼치는 끝없는 엄청난 전투 덕분에 지금까지 사랑받아 왔으며, 또한 유명합니다. 드래곤볼 파이터즈는 아크 시스템 웍스 사와 함께 애니메이션다운 뛰어난 그래픽을 매우 잘 살려, 배우기는 쉽지만 마스터하기는 어려운 격투 게임으로서 개발되었습니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: DRAGON BALL FighterZ is born from what makes the DRAGON BALL series so loved and famous: endless spectacular fights with its all-powerful fighters. Partnering with Arc System Works, DRAGON BALL FighterZ maximizes high end Anime graphics and brings easy to learn but difficult to master fighting gameplay. H igh-end Anime Graphics Using the power of the Unreal engine and the talented team at Arc System Works, DRAGON BALL FighterZ is a visual tour-de-force. 3vs3 Tag/Support Build your dream team and sharpen your skills to master high-speed tag combinations. Thrilling Online Features Ranked matches, interactive lobby, crazy 6-player Party Match... There is something for every taste! Exclusive Story Mode Discover a never-seen-before scenario featuring Android 21, a brand new character whose creation was supervised by Akira Toriyama himself. Spectacular Fights Experience aerial combos, destructible stages and famous scenes from the DRAGON BALL anime in 60FPS and 1080p resolution!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: ■2.5D畫面表現 不是2D也不是3D──「2.5D」的畫面表現席捲而來！猶如電視動畫以即時運算呈現，臨場感十足的超水準動畫表現。 ■超高速戰鬥 在地面、在空中引爆《七龍珠》風格的戰鬥──敬請體驗超高速、極具魄力的「七龍珠戰鬥」！ ■3對3團體戰 憑著對角色特性與相剋的瞭解，決定戰術、自由編輯隊伍的「3對3團體戰」── 掌握替換角色的時機、善用支援招式，以及3個角色同時使出必殺技等等，享受布局作戰的樂趣！ ■原創故事模式 本遊戲也具備原創故事模式。玩家將和包含「孫悟空」在內的《七龍珠》角色們連結，一同挑戰迎面而來的危機！ 此外，更有原作者鳥山明老師所監修的角色登場──神祕科學家「生化人21號」！究竟會有什麼樣的故事……！？ 不僅如此，只有在本遊戲才能看到的角色間的互動與心聲等等，更是一大看點。
detailed_descriptions.ja: ■2.5D表現 2Dでも3Dでもない『2.5D表現』で繰り広げられる、まるでリアルタイムでアニメを動かしているような臨場感のある超ハイエンドアニメ表現 ■超高速バトル 地上・空中で炸裂する「ドラゴンボール」ならではの超高速・ド迫力のバトルで、本格的な「ドラゴンボールバトル」を体験することができます。 ■3on3のチーム戦 キャラクターの特徴や相性を見極めプレイヤーの戦略次第で自在にチームが編成できる『3on3のチーム戦』 キャラ交代、アシスト技、3人同時の必殺技などを駆使し、戦略的なバトルが楽しめる。 ■オリジナルストーリーモード プレイヤーが「孫悟空」等、「ドラゴンボール」のキャラクターにリンクし、共に新たな危機に挑む本作オリジナルストーリーモードも搭載。 さらに、原作者の鳥山明先生がデザインを監修した謎の科学者「人造人間21号」も登場！物語にどう絡んでくるのか…！？ 本作でしか見られないキャラクター同士の掛け合いや心の声なども必見。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 드래곤볼 시리즈는 강력한 캐릭터들이 펼치는 끝없는 엄청난 전투 덕분에 지금까지 사랑받아 왔으며, 또한 유명합니다. 드래곤볼 파이터즈는 아크 시스템 웍스 사와 함께 애니메이션다운 뛰어난 그래픽을 매우 잘 살려, 배우기는 쉽지만 마스터하기는 어려운 격투 게임으로서 개발되었습니다. 3vs3 태그/서포트 하이 스피드 태그 콤비네이션 배틀을 마스터하기 위해 당신만의 꿈의 팀을 만들고 기술을 갈고닦으세요. 스릴 넘치는 온라인 요소 랭크 매치, 인터랙티브 로비, 놀라운 플레이어 6인 파티 매치... 모든 요소가 특별합니다! 오리지널 스토리 모드 Akira Toriyama에 의해 감수되고 만들어진 인조인간 21호에 얽힌 지금까지 본 적 없는 시나리오를 파헤쳐 보세요. 화려한 대전 공중 콤보와 파괴할 수 있는 스테이지 및 드래곤볼 애니메이션의 유명한 장면들을 1080p 해상도의 60FPS로 즐겨 보세요!

games.name: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO

names.ja: ドラゴンボール Sparking! ZERO

games.short_description: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Make yours the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in Dragon Ball!

descriptions.en: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Make yours the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in Dragon Ball!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 「七龍珠 電光炸裂！ZERO」堂堂登場！本作超越「七龍珠Z 電光炸裂！」（即過去「七龍珠Z Sparking!」）到達新的境界。讓你擁有毀滅性的力量，成為七龍珠史上最強的戰士！
descriptions.ja: 「ドラゴンボールZ Sparking!」シリーズ最新作が遂に登場！ シリーズ最大規模のキャラクターが登場し、かめはめ波や舞空術など、ドラゴンボールならではの技を駆使しながら闘う３D対戦アクション。 超戦士となって、天地を揺るがす限界突破のドラゴンボールバトルを体感せよ！
descriptions.ko: 『드래곤볼 스파킹! 제로』는 『드래곤볼Z 스파킹!』 시리즈의 전설적인 게임 플레이를 새로운 수준으로 끌어올립니다. 『드래곤볼』에 등장하는 초전사들의 파괴적인 힘을 여러분의 것으로 만드세요!

detailed_descriptions.en: DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO takes the legendary gameplay of the Budokai Tenkaichi series and raises it to whole new levels. Become a super warrior and experience the earth-shaking, limit-breaking power of Dragon Ball battles! Unleash the strength of over 180 fighters from Dragon Ball Z, Dragon Ball Super, Dragon Ball GT, and selected Dragon Ball movies, all in the base game! Each character comes with their own signature abilities, transformations, and techniques. Make the destructive power of the strongest fighters ever to appear in Dragon Ball yours! Engage in heart-pounding, high-speed 3D battles that stay true to the anime and video game series, with breathtaking visuals and authentic combat moves like beam clashes, rush attacks, movements too quick for the eyes to see, and planet-razing ultimate attacks. Challenge other players online to test your skills, or sit down with friends offline to hone your skills! Fight your way to become a champion across various tournament modes and victory conditions. Conquer the action-packed battles from the beloved original story, or discover and unlock new encounters for your favorite Z-Fighters and more. Relive your favorite moments from the series through cutscenes you can experience from the perspectives of eight characters! Recreate your favorite battles from throughout the Dragon Ball story, or set up your dream story battle with your favorite characters! Share your creations with other fans and experience the battles brought to life by imaginations around the world. *In addition to this edition, Deluxe Edition and Ultimate Edition are also available. Please be careful not to purchase the same content twice.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 「七龍珠 電光炸裂！ZERO」堂堂登場！本作超越「七龍珠Z 電光炸裂！」（即過去「七龍珠Z Sparking!」）到達新的境界。化身超戰士，來體驗驚天動地，突破極限的七龍珠戰鬥吧！ 史無前例豐富的角色陣容 收錄包括七龍珠Z、七龍珠超、七龍珠GT以及部分電影版，總計超過180名戰士的力量。每位角色都有獨特的能力、變身以及技巧。 讓你擁有毀滅性的力量，成為七龍珠史上最強的戰士！ 身臨其境的3D對戰 加入緊張刺激的高速3D對戰，忠實呈現動畫與遊戲系列作，擁有令人嘆為觀止的視覺效果及寫實的戰鬥動作，例如光束衝突、突擊攻擊等令人目不暇給的高速戰鬥，甚至也有足以毀滅星球的終極攻擊。 與對手切磋激勵 可以線上挑戰其他玩家來測試自己的招式，也可以與友人席地而坐遊玩離線對戰！全力以赴橫掃各種比賽模式，達成勝利條件以奪得冠軍吧。 開疆闢土 原創故事備受喜愛，戰勝其中充滿張力的戰鬥吧，也可以探索並邂逅鍾愛的Z戰士與其他角色。透過八名角色的視角體驗劇情，觀賞過場動畫重溫系列作中你最喜歡的時刻！ 創造、玩樂、分享 不只再現七龍珠的故事中最熱血的戰鬥，也可以為最愛的角色設計夢想中的戰鬥故事！分享你的作品給其他粉絲，體驗來自世界各地天馬行空的想像力。 ※另有發售其他版本，請留意勿重複購買。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 「ドラゴンボールZ Sparking!」シリーズ最新作が遂に登場！ 超戦士となって、天地を揺るがす限界突破のドラゴンボールバトルを体感せよ！ ◆シリーズ最大のキャラクターが登場する3D対戦アクション かめはめ波や舞空術などドラゴンボールならではの技を駆使しながら闘う3D対戦アクション。 「ドラゴンボールZ」「ドラゴンボール超」のキャラクターをはじめ、「ドラゴンボールGT」や劇場版に登場したキャラクターなど、総勢180体を超えるプレイアブルキャラクターが本編に登場！ キャラクターの持つ個性豊かな能力や特徴を活かし、超サイヤ人への変身や、極限まで気を溜めて放つ強力な必殺技での一発逆転など、ドラゴンボールらしいドラマチックな闘いを思いのままに楽しめます。 気を高めることで、風が巻き起こり草木が揺れ、天候までもが変わり、更には必殺技で岩や建物をも吹き飛ばす。 闘いの中でリアルタイムに起こる大迫力の演出により超戦士たちのパワーを体感でき、まさにドラゴンボールのキャラクターになりきったような体験が可能に。 ◆「Sparking! METEOR」からの正統進化 吹っ飛ばしからの追撃や、タイミングを読んでのカウンターなどの「Sparking!」シリーズ伝統のバトルシステムはそのままに、新たなアクションが加わり進化。 原作さながらのハイスピードな攻防がさらにヒートアップ。 ◆モード紹介 【エピソードバトル】 悟空やベジータなど8人のキャラクターから、選んだキャラクター目線で原作に沿ったシチュエーションのバトルを楽しめる一人用モード。一部のバトルの結果や選択次第では、原作とは異なる場面を見ることが出来ます。 【カスタムバトル】 本作のオリジナルのシチュエーションを楽しめるモード。ただ相手を倒すだけでなく、様々なシナリオや条件のバトルを楽しむことができます。また、オリジナルのシチュエーションを作ることができ、オンライン上で世界中のプレイヤーに共有することが可能です。 【対戦】 オンラインでの対戦に加え、オフラインでは画面分割でのローカル対戦が可能！ 更に、ランクマッチで覇を競うようなバトルもお楽しみいただけます。 ※本商品の他にもエディションがございます。重複購入にご注意ください。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 『드래곤볼 스파킹! 제로』는 『드래곤볼Z 스파킹!』 시리즈의 전설적인 게임 플레이를 새로운 수준으로 끌어올립니다. 초전사가 되어 천지를 뒤흔드는 한계 돌파의 드래곤볼 배틀을 체험하세요! ◆사상 최대 캐릭터 참전 『드래곤볼 Z』, 『드래곤볼 슈퍼』, 『드래곤볼 GT』, 일부 엄선된 『드래곤볼 극장판』에서 등장하는 180명을 넘는 초전사들의 힘을 해방해 보세요. 모두 게임 본편에 수록됩니다! 각각의 캐릭터들은 자신만의 고유한 능력과 변신, 기술을 가지고 있죠. 『드래곤볼』에 등장하는 초전사들의 파괴적인 힘을 여러분의 것으로 만드세요! ◆숨 막히는 3D 대전 충돌하는 에네르기파, 추격, 눈으로 좇을 수 없을 정도로 빠른 이동과 행성이 부서지는 궁극기를 비롯한 원작을 방불케 하는 전투와 숨 막히는 비주얼로 표현되어 애니메이션과 비디오 게임 시리즈를 그대로 재현해내는 가슴 뛰는 초스피드 3D 대전을 즐겨 보세요. ◆라이벌들이 당신을 강하게 한다 여러분의 실력을 시험하기 위해 온라인에서 다른 플레이어들에게 도전하거나 친구와 오프라인으로 함께할 수 있습니다. 여러 대회 모드와 승리 조건을 걸고 챔피언이 되기 위해 자신의 방식으로 싸우세요. ◆새로운 길을 열어라 사랑받는 오리지널 스토리의 액션으로 가득한 전투를 이겨내고, 여러분이 가장 좋아하는 Z 전사들과 다른 캐릭터들의 새로운 면모를 만나고 잠금 해제하세요. 8명의 캐릭터의 시점에서 펼쳐지는 컷신을 통해 시리즈에서 여러분이 가장 좋아하는 순간을 경험해 보세요! ◆만들고, 플레이하고, 공유하라 『드래곤볼』의 스토리에서 여러분이 가장 좋아하는 전투를 재창조하고, 여러분이 가장 좋아하는 캐릭터들로 꿈에 그리던 이야기가 담긴 전투를 세팅해 보세요! 여러분이 만든 결과물을 다른 팬들과 공유하고 전 세계의 상상력이 생명을 얻은 전투를 체험해 보세요. *본 상품 외에도 에디션이 별도로 판매 중입니다. 중복 구매에 주의하십시오.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS
games.short_description: The beloved block-building RPG, DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS, is bringing its handy crafting features to Steam! Weave your own tale as you build your own unique buildings and towns to restore Alefgard to it's former glory!

descriptions.en: The beloved block-building RPG, DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS, is bringing its handy crafting features to Steam! Weave your own tale as you build your own unique buildings and towns to restore Alefgard to it's former glory!

detailed_descriptions.en: The first title in the BUILDERS series, DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS, is bringing its handy crafting features to Steam! Gather, craft and build to defeat defeat the evil Dragonlord and restore Alefgard to it's former glory! In a world made out of blocks, everything that you see can be materials used to create! Farm ingredients, craft various items and build your base to unite the people roaming the ruins. From buildings to entire towns, you have the freedom to make your village your very own. ■ Story BUILDERS is set in the realm of Alefgard, the setting for the first ever DRAGON QUEST game. The world of Alefgard has been plunged into darkness, its light stolen by the evil Dragonlord, and this story begins with the appearance of a young hero with a mysterious ability to build things... And so the stage is set for an epic tale in which the dark world of Alefgard is returned to life with the power of creation! ■ The first DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS title, helpful crafting features include: Place blocks remotely, or destroy blocks with ease, with just a single click of the mouse! Now Includes a helpful Undo feature, which allows you to put things back to how they were before! Now Featuring Big Bash, a useful feature introduced in DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS 2 that allows you to break all objects in a particular area in one go! Terra Incognita, BUILDERS’ free build stage, the stackable block height is doubled! Includes fun side content, like collecting figurines of NPCs and monsters, or gathering pixels and exchanging them for a variety of handy items! Use Build Cards to share buildings with other players and bring their buildings to life on your island! ■ Includes all DLC from previous versions of DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS! The Steam version of DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS includes all of the DLC from past versions including the free build mode, Terra Incognita: Magic Carpet, Boss Monster Model Set, Astronomy Set and Pixel Ring.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS™ 2
games.short_description: DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS™ 2 is a block-building RPG set in a fantasy land threatened by an evil cult. Explore, battle, build and harvest in the charming single-player campaign or build big projects in the online sandbox mode for up to 4-players.

descriptions.en: DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS™ 2 is a block-building RPG set in a fantasy land threatened by an evil cult. Explore, battle, build and harvest in the charming single-player campaign or build big projects in the online sandbox mode for up to 4-players.

detailed_descriptions.en: OVERVIEW DRAGON QUEST BUILDERS 2 is the critically acclaimed block-building RPG from DRAGON QUEST series creators Yuji Horii, character designer Akira Toriyama and composer Koichi Sugiyama – now for Steam players! The Steam version includes the base game as well as additional in-game content to go even further in building: Hotto Stuff Pack, Modernist Pack, Aquarium Pack, Designer’s Sunglasses, Historic Headwear, Legendary Builder Outfit, Dragonlord’s Throne, and more! Don’t let the name fool you, despite the 2, this is a completely standalone experience featuring new characters, an expansive world, unlimited building combinations, and a storyline that’s sure to satisfy long-time fans and newcomers alike! Embark on an epic journey and became the master Builder! Customized your character and set off to revive a forsaken world alongside a mysterious companion named Malroth. Then, take your builder online and join your friends to collaborate and create something truly magnificent. STORY The evil Children of Hargon are determined to eradicate all creators and have outlawed the building, cooking, and creation of all things. To spread their destructive dogma, the calamitous cult captures the builders of the world. All hope seems to be lost until you, a young apprentice builder, manage to escape from the clutches of evil. After washing up on the shores of the deserted Isle of Awakening, you encounter the spirited Malroth, a mysterious youth with no memory of his past. With the help of your fearless new friend, you embark on a grand adventure to gather the skills required to become a full-fledged builder, but the road you build is paved with peril. Only you can defeat the Children of Hargon, uncover the secrets of Malroth’s past, and unravel the riddles of this mysterious land. Block-building RPG – Prove yourself as a Builder and a Warrior, help the people of the realm to rebuild their destroyed lands. The more you help the more you’ll receive hearts and recognition. Prepare for a cure of creativity and friendliness! Creative open-world – Construct big structures in this fantasy block world with a large variety of options. Explore, gather, and craft – Each island contains its own set of unique materials to help you grow, craft, and cook new creations. Along the way you’ll improve your skills and grow as a builder as you learn new recipes and blueprints. Battle fearsome foes alongside your partner – Accompanying you on your quest is the mysterious Malroth, an aggressive amnesiac with a fondness for fighting foes. His powerful attacks and skills on the battlefield are truly indispensable! Dash, swim, and glide across an expansive world – Run across open fields and explore charming villages, treacherous mines, and spectacular castles. Dive into the watery depths to discover hidden treasures, climb the highest mountain to catch the sunset, and glide home to rest up for your next day of adventure. Plant, water, and grow! – Work together with your villagers to till soil, plants seeds, and raise a multitude of crops. Be sure to customize the way you build your fields to support the kind of crops you’re growing. Harvest anything from the humble cabbage to sweet sugar canes! Design and Build with Friends Online – Big projects require big help! Up to 4 players can team up online to build anything you can imagine on the sandbox Isle of Awakening.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake

names.en: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake

games.short_description: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake is a stunning reimagination of the first two legendary adventures in The Erdrick Trilogy, brought together in one package.

descriptions.en: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake is a stunning reimagination of the first two legendary adventures in The Erdrick Trilogy, brought together in one package.

detailed_descriptions.en: DRAGON QUEST I & II HD-2D Remake is a stunning reimagining of the first two legendary adventures in the Erdrick trilogy, brought together in one package. (Players can play either DRAGON QUEST I or II whenever they want by selecting their preferred title on the game's start screen.) DRAGON QUEST I Story: Thanks to the heroic efforts of the legendary Erdrick, the Lord of the Underworld was defeated and peace returned to the land of Alefgard. Yet this peace was not to last, as the diabolical Dragonlord has risen and unleashed hordes of monsters on the realm once more. Now, descendant of Erdrick, it is your destiny to defeat this new evil and rescue the world from its plight! The Setting: This tale takes place in the land of Alefgard, a realm given shape by a goddess known as Rubiss. The hero travels the land hoping to slay the mighty Dragonlord once and for all. Along the way he meets plenty of charming characters and faces numerous fearsome foes. DRAGON QUEST II Story: Many years have passed since Alefgard was saved at the hero's hand, earning him the same title as his storied forebear. The descendants of this Erdrick and his scions founded three kingdoms that thrived in peacetime. Yet, darkness stirs once more and a sudden invasion of malicious monsters plunges the world into shadow again. All that stands between the forces of evil and their wicked ambitions is a band of young princes and princesses of Erdrick's lineage. The time has come for them to venture forth and honor their ancestor's legacy! The Setting: Explore a world filled with locales visited by the legendary hero as well as a host of new towns, castles, caves, and dungeons. As the story progresses, you'll obtain a ship, which will allow you to traverse the seas and rivers, and broaden your horizons ever further. The Party: The Prince of Midenhall, the game's protagonist, is joined on his quest by his cousins the Prince of Cannock, the Princess of Moonbrooke and, entirely new to this version of the game, the Princess of Cannock. These four descendants of the legendary hero, Erdrick, band together to protect the world from evil forces. Turn-based Battles: Enjoy the traditional turn-based battles the series is known for. Attack with an assembly of weapons and let loose all kinds of spells and abilities to slay the many menacing monsters.

DRAGON QUEST I Story:

Thanks to the heroic efforts of the legendary Erdrick, the Lord of the Underworld was defeated and peace returned to the land of Alefgard. Yet this peace was not to last, as the diabolical Dragonlord has risen and unleashed hordes of monsters on the realm once more. Now, descendant of Erdrick, it is your destiny to defeat this new evil and rescue the world from its plight!

The Setting:
This tale takes place in the land of Alefgard, a realm given shape by a goddess known as Rubiss. The hero travels the land hoping to slay the mighty Dragonlord once and for all. Along the way he meets plenty of charming characters and faces numerous fearsome foes.

DRAGON QUEST II Story:

Many years have passed since Alefgard was saved at the hero's hand, earning him the same title as his storied forebear. The descendants of this Erdrick and his scions founded three kingdoms that thrived in peacetime. Yet, darkness stirs once more and a sudden invasion of malicious monsters plunges the world into shadow again. All that stands between the forces of evil and their wicked ambitions is a band of young princes and princesses of Erdrick's lineage. The time has come for them to venture forth and honor their ancestor's legacy!

The Setting:
Explore a world filled with locales visited by the legendary hero as well as a host of new towns, castles, caves, and dungeons.
As the story progresses, you'll obtain a ship, which will allow you to traverse the seas and rivers, and broaden your horizons ever further.

The Party:
The Prince of Midenhall, the game's protagonist, is joined on his quest by his cousins the Prince of Cannock, the Princess of Moonbrooke and, entirely new to this version of the game, the Princess of Cannock. These four descendants of the legendary hero, Erdrick, band together to protect the world from evil forces.

Turn-based Battles:
Enjoy the traditional turn-based battles the series is known for. Attack with an assembly of weapons and let loose all kinds of spells and abilities to slay the many menacing monsters.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince

names.en: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince

games.short_description: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince comes to Steam®! Recruit monsters from the DQ series, synthesize new creatures and compose your ideal team.

descriptions.en: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince comes to Steam®! Recruit monsters from the DQ series, synthesize new creatures and compose your ideal team.

detailed_descriptions.en: Overview DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince comes to Steam®! Compose your very own team of monsters from across the DRAGON QUEST series and engage in thrilling battles against your foes. Recruit monsters from the wild world around you and combine them to synthesize new creatures as you see fit. With over 500 monsters to choose from and a revamped synthesis system to explore, you can mix and match to you heart's content to create your favorite cute critters and dastardly supervillains, as well as brand-new additions to the monstrous roll call. Your quest to become the greatest monster wrangler of all time starts here! Story Psaro is cursed and is unable to harm anything with monster blood. Now, he must become a Monster Wrangler to create an army for battle. The hunt for high-ranked monsters takes Psaro through the ever-changing seasons of Nadiria and its unique environments, with rivers of bubbling lava, mysterious ancient ruins, and soaring towers of cake. Along the way, Psaro meets the kind-hearted elf, Rose, who joins his adventure to seek out ever-stronger monsters. The key to Psaro's success lies with synthesis: the ability to combine two monsters and create a stronger offspring. Each new creation brings Psaro one step closer to his goal of becoming the Master of Monsterkind. (The network mode Online Battles from the console version, where players battle one another in real time, is not included.) Game Features - A Wondrous World Awaits As time passes in Nadiria, so too do the seasons change, with different weather conditions tempting new monsters out of hiding and revealing paths to undiscovered areas. The Circles of Nadiria are sure to provide a fresh experience every time you visit. - Over 500 Unique Monsters With such varied environments to explore, you can expect them to be inhabited by a plethora of monsters. While many can be recruited in battle, occasionally a defeated monster will ask to join your team of its own accord. Befriend as many monsters as you can, then combine them to synthesize new creatures and build a unique party to your exact liking. - Enjoy All the DLC from the Console Version The Steam® version includes the DLC packs from the console version: the Mole Hole, Coach Joe's Dungeon Gym and Treasure Trunks. Make the most of their unique features to enhance your adventure. - Test Your Might in Quickfire Contests Register your team for the network mode Quickfire Contests to participate in automated battles against the party data of 30 other players. Once a day you can earn stat-boosting items as a prize, and the monsters from any team you defeat will be added to your roster (up to rank B monsters only).

Overview


DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Dark Prince comes to Steam®!

Compose your very own team of monsters from across the DRAGON QUEST series and engage in thrilling battles against your foes. Recruit monsters from the wild world around you and combine them to synthesize new creatures as you see fit. With over 500 monsters to choose from and a revamped synthesis system to explore, you can mix and match to you heart's content to create your favorite cute critters and dastardly supervillains, as well as brand-new additions to the monstrous roll call.

Your quest to become the greatest monster wrangler of all time starts here!

Story


Psaro is cursed and is unable to harm anything with monster blood. Now, he must become a Monster Wrangler to create an army for battle.

The hunt for high-ranked monsters takes Psaro through the ever-changing seasons of Nadiria and its unique environments, with rivers of bubbling lava, mysterious ancient ruins, and soaring towers of cake. Along the way, Psaro meets the kind-hearted elf, Rose, who joins his adventure to seek out ever-stronger monsters.

The key to Psaro's success lies with synthesis: the ability to combine two monsters and create a stronger offspring. Each new creation brings Psaro one step closer to his goal of becoming the Master of Monsterkind.

(The network mode Online Battles from the console version, where players battle one another in real time, is not included.)

Game Features


- A Wondrous World Awaits
As time passes in Nadiria, so too do the seasons change, with different weather conditions tempting new monsters out of hiding and revealing paths to undiscovered areas. The Circles of Nadiria are sure to provide a fresh experience every time you visit.

- Over 500 Unique Monsters
With such varied environments to explore, you can expect them to be inhabited by a plethora of monsters. While many can be recruited in battle, occasionally a defeated monster will ask to join your team of its own accord. Befriend as many monsters as you can, then combine them to synthesize new creatures and build a unique party to your exact liking.

The Steam® version includes the DLC packs from the console version: the Mole Hole, Coach Joe's Dungeon Gym and Treasure Trunks. Make the most of their unique features to enhance your adventure.

Register your team for the network mode Quickfire Contests to participate in automated battles against the party data of 30 other players. Once a day you can earn stat-boosting items as a prize, and the monsters from any team you defeat will be added to your roster (up to rank B monsters only).

games.name: DRAGON QUEST TREASURES
games.short_description: Erik and his sister Mia dream of the day they can explore the world. One night they encounter a pair of otherworldly creatures, Porcus and Purrsula, and are whisked away to Draconia - a land full of treasures just waiting to be discovered.

descriptions.en: Erik and his sister Mia dream of the day they can explore the world. One night they encounter a pair of otherworldly creatures, Porcus and Purrsula, and are whisked away to Draconia - a land full of treasures just waiting to be discovered.

detailed_descriptions.en: Head to Draconia, where the free-spirited hunt for treasure never ends! “DRAGON QUEST TREASURES” is a Treasure Hunting RPG that allows players to enjoy a boundless adventure and free-spirited treasure hunting. ＜Story＞ Erik and his sister Mia live on a Viking longship, dreaming of the day they can explore the world in search of grand treasure. One night they encounter a pair of otherworldly creatures, Porcus and Purrsula, and are whisked away to a mysterious place known as Draconia - a legendary land full of monsters to befriend and treasures just waiting to be discovered. The adventure Erik and Mia have always dreamed of is finally underway! ＜Setting＞ DRAGON QUEST TREASURES is all about the thrill of adventure—and that means treasure hunting! The adventure takes place in Draconia, a land that's home to countless pieces of precious loot. Join Erik and Mia as they search for the legendary Dragonstones, picking up as much treasure as they can along the way! ＜Base＞ With the threat of rival treasure-hunting crews looming large, Erik and Mia form a gang of their own and snag a base of operations. Every piece of loot they acquire adds to the total value of their treasure vault. When this value hits a certain point, their gang will go up a rank, unlocking new treasure-hunting abilities and the option to add to the base's amenities. ＜Rival Gang＞ Treasure hunting gangs have been known to flock from far and wide in the hope of striking it rich. “Rival Gangs” will stop at nothing to get their hands on Erik and Mia’s treasure – from attacking out in the field to launching a raid on base. <Field＞ Draconia was formed from the bodies of two enormous Golden Dragons. Over the rocky eons their rocky remains have eroded away to leave six floating islands. Erik and Mia can scout five very different biomes in their hunt for treasure, from volcanic mountains and bone-dry deserts to frozen wastelands. Each island in inhabited by various types of monsters. Using the powers of the “Dragon Daggers”, Erik and Mia can recruit monsters to join their gang. Each monster has a special ability called a 'Forte', allowing them to soar through the air or dive into the ground to bypass obstacles enroute to the loot. By working together with their well-manner monster, Erik and Mia hunt for treasures buried across the lands of Draconia! *Please thoroughly review the product content and bonuses before purchasing, as this product has a “standard edition” and a “digital deluxe edition”.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined
games.short_description: Unravel the mysteries of the past in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined! Gather your companions and travel beyond the shores of your small kingdom to discover why it is the only remaining island in the world.

descriptions.en: Unravel the mysteries of the past in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined! Gather your companions and travel beyond the shores of your small kingdom to discover why it is the only remaining island in the world.

detailed_descriptions.en: "There's more to the world than this island... And we're going to prove it!" Set sail on an adventure spanning past and present in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined! As a bright-eyed young fisherman's son, you've lived your entire life on the peaceful island of Estard. Your journey begins with a simple question: is there more to the world than this small island kingdom? On a quest for answers, you and your childhood friends discover the Shrine of Mysteries and are swept back in time. There, you uncover the shocking truth that entire lands have been sealed away by a malevolent force. The fate of the world now rests in your hands. DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined brings a timeless classic to life in a whole new way with charming diorama visuals, updated gameplay mechanics, and a streamlined story. For seasoned adventurers, rediscover a tale of plucky companions that is brimming with joy and heartbreak. For fledgling heroes new to the series, this is a great place to begin your DRAGON QUEST journey. ■A Diorama Brought to Life DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined blends a beautiful diorama art style with Akira Toriyama's iconic character designs to make every encounter feel vibrant, heartfelt, and full of adventure. From lush forests and bustling towns to ancient ruins and whimsical monsters, every environment is bursting with color and personality. ■Travel through History to Restore the Present Scattered stone fragments unlock portals to long-lost eras with their own challenges to solve. Restore the islands, solve mysteries, and make allies in the past to breathe life back into the present. ■A Beloved Tale with a Streamlined Narrative DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined is told through a series of vignettes with an overarching narrative. The main story has also been streamlined to make the journey more accessible to all players. ■Classic Combat, Improved! The battle system in DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined has undergone significant changes. Turn the tides of battle with new vocational perks. Each vocation has its own unique ability, from all-out attacks to those that support your allies. Battle speed adjustments and an auto-battle feature are also available. Battles can progress without interruptions between each turn, depending on the tactics selected for the protagonist and allies. While on the field, players can pre-emptively strike monsters and instantly defeat them If the monster is weaker than the party. ■Moonlight and Level Up Two Vocations at the Same Time! Customize your playstyle with the new Moonlighting mechanic. Having two vocations assigned at once provides access to the skills, magic spells, and unique perks from both.

The fate of the world now rests in your hands.

For seasoned adventurers, rediscover a tale of plucky companions that is brimming with joy and heartbreak. For fledgling heroes new to the series, this is a great place to begin your DRAGON QUEST journey.

■A Diorama Brought to Life

■Travel through History to Restore the Present

Scattered stone fragments unlock portals to long-lost eras with their own challenges to solve. Restore the islands, solve mysteries, and make allies in the past to breathe life back into the present.

■A Beloved Tale with a Streamlined Narrative

DRAGON QUEST VII Reimagined is told through a series of vignettes with an overarching narrative. The main story has also been streamlined to make the journey more accessible to all players.

games.name: DRAGON QUEST® XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age™ - Definitive Edition

names.en: DRAGON QUEST® XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age™ - Definitive Edition

games.short_description: The Definitive Edition includes the critically acclaimed DRAGON QUEST XI, plus additional scenarios, orchestral soundtrack, 2D mode and more! Whether you are a longtime fan or a new adventurer, this is the ultimate DQXI experience.

descriptions.en: The Definitive Edition includes the critically acclaimed DRAGON QUEST XI, plus additional scenarios, orchestral soundtrack, 2D mode and more! Whether you are a longtime fan or a new adventurer, this is the ultimate DQXI experience.

detailed_descriptions.en: The Definitive Edition includes all the content from the original release of the acclaimed DRAGON QUEST XI, and adds extra character-specific scenarios, the choice of playing with the original soundtrack or a grand orchestral version of the music, the ability to switch between 2D and 3D graphic modes, a Japanese voice-acting option, and much more. OVERVIEW DRAGON QUEST XI S is the last entry in the legendary RPG series from creator Yuji Horii, character designer Akira Toriyama and composer Koichi Sugiyama. This eleventh main entry is a completely standalone experience that features new characters, a beautifully detailed world, finely tuned turn-based combat, and an immersive story that will appeal to longtime fans and franchise newcomers alike. After its release in Japan, DRAGON QUEST XI won multiple gaming awards and received critical praise, including PlayStation’s Platinum Prize and a perfect 40/40 score from Famitsu (an influential video game publication in Japan). STORY A young man, about to participate in his village’s coming of age ceremony, travels to a sacred stone alongside his childhood friend. After a series of unexpected events, this intrepid adventurer learns he is the reincarnation of a legendary hero from a forgotten age. The young hero sets forth into an unknown world on a journey to unravel the mystery of his past… but the welcome he receives is far from warm. Upon revealing his identity to the King, the hero is branded as “The Darkspawn” and hunted by a relentless army. Fleeing from his pursuers, the hero assembles a band of endearing adventurers who believe he is actually The Luminary reborn. The Luminary and his newfound companions embark on a quest that will take them across continents and over vast oceans as they learn of an ominous threat facing the world. KEY FEATURES Unravel an Epic Mystery in a Riveting Tale – You are the Luminary, the reincarnation of a hero from a forgotten age. Denigrated as a demon and pursued by a malicious monarch, you must embark on a quest to uncover the mystery of your fate and save a doomed world. Be prepared for an immersive story with twists and turns that pull you in and keep you craving more. Assemble a Colorful Cast of Loyal Companions – Accompanying you is an endearing band of adventurers with their own rich backstories and personalities. Famed manga artist Akira Toriyama brings the characters of DRAGON QUEST to life with his one-of-a-kind style. Explore a Massive, Beautiful, Living World – Excitement lurks around every corner, observe NPC’s attend to their daily schedules, monsters change behaviors to fit their environments, and access new areas, by foot, on horseback or with the use of monstrous vehicles. Engage in Classic Turn-based Battles with a Modern Twist – DRAGON QUEST XI features mechanics simple enough for beginners, but with enough depth to satisfy hardcore fans. As your adventure continues, learn incredible new abilities to take down even the most fearsome foe with your powerful allies. Have Some Fun & Save the World – Tons of side-quests and addicting mini-games awaits you for enough content to keep you playing for well over 100 hours. You will face insurmountable odds and an evil force of unimaginable power… but while the stakes are high, there are many fun distractions to find if you know where to look. Challenge Yourself with the Draconian Quest - Available when you start a new game, these options allow you to craft you own customized difficulty with different settings and provide a greater challenge.

games.name: Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous
games.short_description: Ready to run a tavern with a Dragon companion? On this charming island, you can live out your tavern-keeping dreams. Along the way, you'll meet all kinds of guests, Encounter unicorns, battle Giant Elementals, and embrace adventures! Begin your journey as the Dragon Song calls!

descriptions.en: Ready to run a tavern with a Dragon companion? On this charming island, you can live out your tavern-keeping dreams. Along the way, you'll meet all kinds of guests, Encounter unicorns, battle Giant Elementals, and embrace adventures! Begin your journey as the Dragon Song calls!

detailed_descriptions.en: Dragon Song Tavern: Cozy & Adventurous tells the story of two adventurous siblings. On a whim, the younger sister Gracie purchases a coastal tavern in a small town. To their surprise, they discover an adorable baby dragon inside. Together with this little dragon, they run the tavern, befriend new companions, and gradually immerse themselves in a tranquil new life. You may choose to play as either sibling or create your own character to begin a journey uniquely yours. With plenty of customization options such as hairstyles, skin tones, facial expressions, and more, you can shape your character just the way you like. Dress up before setting out on your adventure! On the picturesque seaside farm, you can plant crops, fish, and gather resources. Beyond the shore, set sail from the dock to explore uncharted maps, collect rare treasures, uncover the world’s mysterious legends, and experience extraordinary stories. Cute and full of energy, magical pets are here to help you. Whether it’s boosting production or shortening crop growth time, they’ve got it all covered. After gathering ingredients and materials through exploration, return to the island to brew wine, craft handicrafts, and manage your tavern using these carefully prepared items, welcoming every customer drawn in by fine drinks and cuisine. Too busy to manage everything on your own? Team up with a partner. Work together to explore, manage the tavern, and build your very own shared island. With teamwork, the workload is halved and the fun is doubled. May you delight in the joys this world brings. Add to your Wishlist now and embark on a journey that is both cozy and adventurous. Every bit of support fuels our progress. Your Wishlist not only encourages us, it empowers us to craft an even better experience. Join the Wishlist and grow together with this fantastical world.

games.name: Dragonkin: The Banished
games.short_description: The draconic threat is once again upon us. Legendary heroes rise up to face the legions from the depths. Tame your wyrmlings, create unique power builds with the Ancestral Grid, expand your city and destroy the Dragons!

descriptions.en: The draconic threat is once again upon us. Legendary heroes rise up to face the legions from the depths. Tame your wyrmlings, create unique power builds with the Ancestral Grid, expand your city and destroy the Dragons!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 龙的威胁再次降临到我们身上。传奇英雄挺身而出，面对来自深处的军团。驯服你的小龙，利用祖先网格创造独特的力量构建，扩展你的城市并摧毁巨龙！
descriptions.ja: 竜の脅威が再び私たちに迫っています。伝説の英雄たちが立ち上がり、地底から軍団に立ち向かう。ドラゴネットを飼いならし、Ancestral Grid でユニークなパワー ビルドを作成し、都市を拡張してドラゴンを破壊しましょう。
descriptions.ko: 용의 위협이 다시 한번 우리에게 다가왔습니다. 전설적인 영웅들이 일어나 깊은 곳의 군단에 맞서고 있습니다. 드래곤을 길들이고, Ancestral Grid로 독특한 파워 빌드를 만들고, 도시를 확장하고 드래곤을 파괴하세요!

detailed_descriptions.en: LIBERATE A RAVAGED WORLD: In Dragonkin: The Banished, immerse yourself in a world corrupted by dragon blood, where evil creatures emerge from the bowels of the earth. Play as one of the legendary hero classes, driven by a singular mission: to hunt down and annihilate the dragon creatures. Each battle brings you closer to your goal of finding and eliminating the Dragon Lords. JOIN THE DRAGONKIN ADVENTURE IN CO-OP Experience the adventure of Dragonkin: The Banished with your friends in online co-op for up to 4 players. From your arrival in the City of Montescail through to the Endgame activities, the entire Dragonkin adventure can be played in co-op. Join other players and work together to upgrade the City of Montescail and unlock new services for your characters. FOUR HEROES READY TO HUNT: Choose the hero that best suits your gameplay. Play as the Knight and Barbarian for close combat, or play from a distance with the Oracle and Archer. Each hero has developed their own abilities and fighting techniques for facing the dragons. As you progress, your character, gear, Wyrmling and Ancestral Grid evolve. A UNIQUE UPGRADE MECHANISM: Discover the Ancestral Grid of skills, a brand new mechanism for transforming your character into a legendary fighter with unique powers. Acquire skills as loot from battles, and strategically place them in the grid alongside numerous modifiers. Optimize each slot to increase your power. Each hero has their own grid, offering a phenomenal number of skill and modifier combinations. A CITY TO DEVELOP THROUGHOUT YOUR ADVENTURE: Nestled in the heart of the mountains, sheltered from dragons, lies a great city: the last bastion of humanity. This city grows and evolves according to your decisions and discoveries. As you progress, you can choose priorities for its development. Upgrade your buildings, welcome new residents, and discover additional equipment and services that will help you transform this refuge into a true haven for humanity.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 解放饱受摧残的世界： 在《Dragonkin: The Banished》中，你将沉浸于被龙血腐蚀的世界，邪恶生物从地底深处涌现。选择一个传奇英雄职业，肩负单一使命：追猎并消灭龙族生物。每场战斗都将你一步步引向最终目标——寻觅并铲除龙族领主。 联机共赴 Dragonkin 冒险 与好友联机，最多支持 4 人，共同体验《Dragonkin: The Banished》的冒险。从踏入 Montescail 城直到终局活动，整个 Dragonkin 冒险旅程皆可联机游玩。你还能与多达 31 名玩家组队协作，共同升级 Montescail 城，为角色解锁全新服务设施。 四位猎龙英雄待命： 每位英雄都已练就了各自对抗巨龙的本领和战斗技巧。随着冒险推进，你的角色、装备、幼龙以及祖先网格都将不断成长进化。 追踪者：作为氏族顶尖猎手，她以猎物淬炼技艺，改良武器库。凡逃过她箭矢、利刃或陷阱的怪物，终将倒在她调制的毒药之下。 蛮族战士：如今他已拥有龙族血统，半人半兽之身，超凡力量与冰霜之力，融入他的传奇怒火，足以击败最强敌手。 神谕者：蓝龙之血改造了她，她能够精准运用电龙之力，借助神谕视野将其威力放大。 圣骑士：历经战斗的磨炼，他挥舞火焰长枪技艺超群。对永恒者的坚定信仰与不屈意志，使他免受龙族腐蚀，成为驱散黑暗的永恒之光！ 独特升级机制： 探索祖先网格——全新系统助你将角色蜕变为拥有独特力量的传奇战士。战斗中获取技能作为战利品，结合众多增益效果在网格系统内进行战略布局。优化每个技能槽以提升实力。每位英雄拥有专属网格，可衍生出海量技能与增益组合。 待探索的世界： 征战龙族生物，踏遍 Dragonkin 的广袤世界。 丛林、古老岛屿、毒沼、广袤平原、冰川、干旱火山……众多秘境静待你去探索。你的冒险将揭示这个世界的丰饶，每片土地都孕育着独特的文化与历史。在旅途中，你还会遭遇各具特色的怪物，它们各自拥有独特的能力和属性（冰、毒、火、电），其掉落的资源可用来强化你的英雄。 随冒险推进而发展起来的城市： 群山环抱，远离龙族侵扰的秘境中矗立一座宏伟都市——人类最后的堡垒。城市会随你的决策和探索不断发展和演变。随着冒险推进，你可设定城市发展的优先级：升级建筑、接纳新居民、发掘新装备与服务设施，将这座避难所打造成人类真正的庇护所。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 荒廃した世界を解放せよ： 『Dragonkin: The Banished』では、ドラゴンの血によって堕落し、大地の奥底から邪悪な怪物が出現する世界を舞台に、プレイヤーは没入感を味わえます。伝説のヒーロークラスの一員としてプレイし、ドラゴンの怪物を狩り、殲滅するという唯一の使命を背負います。戦いを重ねるごとに、ドラゴンロードを見つけ出し、殲滅するという目標に近づきます。 協力プレイでドラゴンキンの冒険に参戦 最大4人でオンライン協力プレイを楽しみながら、『Dragonkin: The Banished』の冒険を体験しましょう。Montescai市への到着からエンドゲームまで、ドラゴンキンの冒険は全て協力プレイでプレイできます。最大31人のプレイヤーと協力し、モンテスケイル市をアップグレードし、キャラクターに新しいサービスを追加しましょう。 4人のヒーローが狩りに挑む： 各ヒーローはドラゴンと戦うために、独自の能力と戦闘テクニックを習得しています。ゲームを進めるにつれて、キャラクター、装備、ワームリング、そしてアンセストラル・グリッドが進化していきます。 トラッカー：一族最高のハンターである彼女は、獲物を糧に技を磨き、武器庫を強化します。彼女の矢、刃、罠を逃れたモンスターは、彼女が調合する毒に屈します。 バーバリアン：ドラゴンの血を受け、半人半怪物となった彼は、超人的な力と氷の力、そして伝説的な怒りによって、どんなに手強い敵でも倒すことができます。 オラクル：蒼き竜の血によって変貌を遂げた彼女は、電撃竜の力を正確に使いこなし、幻視によってその力を増幅させます。 ナイト：戦闘訓練を受け、比類なき技で炎の槍を操ります。永遠なる神への揺るぎない信仰と揺るぎない決意により、彼はドラゴンの堕落を免れ、闇を滅ぼす光として君臨します！ 独自のアップグレードメカニズム： キャラクターを特別な力を持つ伝説の戦士へと変貌させる、全く新しいメカニズム「先祖伝来のスキルグリッド」を体験しましょう。戦闘で戦利品としてスキルを獲得し、様々なスキル補正値と共にグリッドに戦略的に配置しましょう。各スロットを最適化してパワーアップ。ヒーローごとに独自のグリッドが用意されており、スキルとスキル補正値の組み合わせは驚くほど豊富です。 探索すべき世界： ドラゴンの怪物と戦い、Dragonkinの世界を旅しましょう。 ジャングル、古代の島々、毒の沼地、平原、氷河、乾燥した火山など、様々な場所が探索を待っています。冒険を通して、それぞれの地域に独自の文化と歴史を持つこの世界の豊かさが明らかになるでしょう。また、それぞれ異なる能力と属性（氷、毒、火、電気）を持つユニークなモンスターや、ヒーローを強化できる資源にも遭遇します。 冒険を通して発展させられる都市： 山奥深く、ドラゴンの脅威から守られた場所に、人類最後の砦とも言える壮大な都市が存在します。この都市は、プレイヤーの決断と発見によって成長し、進化していきます。ゲームを進める中で、都市開発の優先順位を決めることができます。建物をアップグレードし、新たな住民を迎え入れ、新たな設備やサービスを発見することで、この街を人類にとって真の安息の地へと変貌させましょう。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 황폐해진 세계 해방: 땅속 깊은 곳에서 사악한 존재들이 출현하는 Dragonkin: The Banished에서 드래곤의 피로 더럽혀진 세계에 빠져보세요. 전설적인 영웅 클래스 중 하나로 플레이하며 드래곤 추적 및 전멸이라는 단 하나의 사명을 수행하세요. 전투를 치를 때마다 드래곤 군주를 찾아 제거한다는 목표에 한 걸음 더 다가서게 됩니다. 협동 플레이로 Dragonkin 모험에 참여: 최대 4명의 플레이어가 참여할 수 있는 온라인 협동 플레이로 친구들과 함께 Dragonkin: The Banished 속 모험을 경험하세요. Montescail 시 도착부터 최종 단계의 활동까지, Dragonkin의 모든 모험을 협동 모드로 즐길 수 있습니다. 최대 31명의 다른 플레이어와 함께 Montescail 시를 업그레이드하고 캐릭터를 위한 새로운 서비스를 해제하세요. 사냥 준비가 완료된 네 명의 영웅: 각 영웅은 드래곤과 맞서기 위해 자신만의 능력과 전투 기술을 개발했습니다. 진행도에 따라 캐릭터, 장비, 드래곤, 그리고 Ancestral Grid가 진화합니다. 추적자: 부족 최고의 사냥꾼으로서, 사냥감을 이용해 기술을 연마하고 무기를 개선합니다. 그의 화살, 칼날, 함정을 피한 괴물들도 결국 그가 제조한 독에 쓰러지게 됩니다. 야만인: 드래곤의 피를 이어받은 반인반수입니다. 초자연적인 힘과 얼음 마법, 그리고 전설적인 분노를 결합해 가장 강력한 적도 물리칠 수 있습니다. 오라클: 블루 드래곤의 피로 변한 그는 일렉트릭 드래곤의 힘을 정밀하게 다루며, 예지력을 통해 그 힘을 증폭시킬 수 있습니다. 기사: 전투 훈련을 받아 그 누구보다 불의 창을 능숙하게 휘두릅니다. 영원에 대한 흔들림 없는 신념과 꺾이지 않는 결의를 지니고 있어 드래곤의 타락에 결코 흔들리지 않습니다. 그는 어둠을 몰아낼 빛으로 존재합니다! 독보적인 업그레이드 시스템: 당신의 캐릭터를 특별한 힘을 지닌 전설적인 전사로 변신시킬 수 있는 완전히 새로운 시스템, 'Ancestral Grid' 기술을 만나보세요. 전투에서 획득한 전리품으로 기술을 얻고, 다양한 보조 요소와 함께 그리드에 전략적으로 배치하세요. 각 슬롯을 최적화하여 힘을 극대화하세요. 각 영웅마다 고유한 그리드를 보유하며 엄청난 수의 기술과 요소 조합을 제공합니다. 발견할 세계: Dragonkin의 세계를 가로지르며 드래곤과 싸우세요. 정글, 고대 섬, 유독한 늪지대, 평원, 빙하, 메마른 화산 등 탐험을 기다리는 다양한 지형이 펼쳐집니다. 퀘스트를 통해 각 지역마다 고유한 문화와 역사를 지닌 풍요로운 세계를 발견하게 될 것입니다. 또한 독특한 능력과 속성(얼음, 독, 불, 전기)을 지닌 특별한 몬스터들과 영웅을 강화할 수 있는 자원을 만나게 됩니다. 모험을 통해 발전시키는 도시: 산맥 한가운데, 드래곤들의 위협으로부터 보호받는 곳에 위대한 도시가 자리 잡고 있습니다. 인류의 마지막 보루인 이 도시는 당신의 결정과 발견에 따라 성장하고 진화합니다. 진행하면서 도시 발전의 우선순위를 선택할 수 있습니다. 건물을 업그레이드하고, 새로운 주민을 맞이하며, 이 피난처를 진정한 인류의 안식처로 변모시키는 데 도움이 될 추가 장비와 서비스를 발견하세요.

names.en: Duck Detective: The Ghost of Glamping

games.short_description: You are the one and only Duck Detective, a depressed and recently divorced duck who must quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!

descriptions.en: You are the one and only Duck Detective, a depressed and recently divorced duck who must quack the case. Inspect evidence, make de-duck-tions, and solve this no-murder mystery!

detailed_descriptions.en: The Duck Detective is back! Get ready to interview suspects, inspect evidence, and deduce the truth in another stand-alone mystery! This campsite might have ghosts, but the real thing haunting Eugene McQuacklin is his failed marriage and bread addiction. Can he escape the shadows of his past? To the annoyance of the Duck Detective, he is joined by a new partner in (solving) crime. Work together to unravel the truth and nibble on the crumbs of justice! A 2-3 hour long cozy mystery game! A stand-alone sequel to the acclaimed ‘Duck Detective: The Secret Salami!‘ Interview suspects, fill in the blanks and crack the case! Fully voice-acted cast of suspiciously secretive characters! Dive into a murky pond of delinquency and dredge up the truth! Throw bread to the fine beak of lady justice!

games.short_description: Solving crime is no walk in the pond. You are a down-on-his-luck detective who also happens to be a duck. Use your powers of de-duck-tion to inspect evidence, fill in the blanks, and bust the case wide open! This is a short but twisty detective case.

detailed_descriptions.en: Aggretsuko meets Return of the Obra Dinn in Duck Detective, a cozy mystery game about a down-on-his-luck duck searching for answers in a sinister sausage-based conspiracy. Join the Duck Detective on his latest, greatest case: Inspect and interview suspects to learn their hidden secrets, then use the information you’ve gathered (plus your own de-duck-tive reasoning) to locate the suspect and bust the case wide open! A 2-3 hour long mystery game! Interview suspects, fill in the blanks and crack the case! Fully voice-acted! Throw bread to the fine beak of lady justice! Judge everyone on first impressions, just by looking at them really, really hard! Get them to admit things by staring! Do ducks blink? You don’t.

games.name: Dune: Awakening

names.ja: Dune: Awakening デューン：アウェイクニング

games.short_description: Dune: Awakening is an Open World Survival RPG where you can fully immerse yourself in the epic world of Dune. Alone or with friends, explore a vast open world Arrakis, survive the sandworms, build a home, craft an ornithopter, and unravel the mystery of the missing Fremen.

descriptions.en: Dune: Awakening is an Open World Survival RPG where you can fully immerse yourself in the epic world of Dune. Alone or with friends, explore a vast open world Arrakis, survive the sandworms, build a home, craft an ornithopter, and unravel the mystery of the missing Fremen.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 《Dune: Awakening》是一款能讓你完全沉浸在《沙丘》史詩世界的開放世界生存 RPG。不論是單獨冒險或是與朋友合作，你將能探索幅員遼闊的厄拉科斯，對抗沙蟲的威脅、建造自己的基地、製作撲翼機，並揭開弗瑞曼人失蹤的謎團。
descriptions.ja: 『デューン』シリーズの壮大な世界を没入体験できる、オープンワールドサバイバルRPG『Dune: Awakening デューン：アウェイクニング』。単独で、またはフレンドと、広大なオープンワールドのアラキスを探索し、サンドワームから生き延び、オーニソプターをクラフトして、消えたフレメンの謎を解き明かせ。
descriptions.ko: Dune: Awakening 듄 ：어웨이크닝은 듄 세계관에 완전히 빠져들 수 있는 오픈 월드 서바이벌 RPG입니다. 홀로, 또는 친구와 함께 광활한 아라키스의 오픈 월드를 탐험하고 모래벌레를 피해 살아남으세요. 집을 짓고, 오니솝터를 제작하고, 사라진 프레멘의 미스터리를 밝혀내세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: Dune: Awakening is an epic Open World Survival RPG where you get to fully immerse yourself in the legendary world of Dune. You have been chosen by the Bene Gesserit to go to Arrakis as their agent, to uncover the mystery of the missing Fremen. Visit locations such as Arrakeen and Hagga Basin and meet familiar characters such as Duke Leto Atreides and Feyd-Rautha Harkonnen, as you unravel an epic Dune story never told before: yours. Whether you prefer to play alone or together with friends, Dune: Awakening gives you the opportunity to explore a vast, open world Arrakis brimming with secrets to discover, stories to investigate, and the opportunity for you to rise from survival to greatness. Avoid the roaming sandworms. Seek shadows to stay out of the scorching sun. Study the slow blade or learn to master the powers of the Bene Gesserit. Build a modest home or a massive base and decorate it to reflect your character’s unique personality. Climb mountains or craft your ornithopter and take to the skies. The choice is yours. Dune: Awakening gives you a living, breathing Dune on a scale never seen before. Explore a dynamic and immersive Arrakis, from the vast sand dunes of the Deep Desert to hidden Fremen caves and the bustling city streets of Arrakeen. Climb towering mountains with the Shigawire hook and fly across sandworm-infested sands in your own, crafted ornithopter. Witness massive sandstorms towering above you as they sweep across the landscape. Experience an epic, cinematically told Dune story that asks the mind-bending question: what if Paul Atreides was never born? What would be different? Meet familiar characters from the books and movies including Duke Leto and Feyd-Rautha, investigate the mysterious disappearance of the Fremen, and discover the truth about your own past. Join the Atreides or the Harkonnen and rise through their ranks as you explore their unique stories. Seek shadows in the scorching heat of the day. Craft a stillsuit to reclaim your bodily fluids. Look for wormsign or risk being eaten by Shai-Hulud himself. Arrakis is a test, and to succeed, you must uncover the secret knowledge of the Fremen and study the teachings of the Schools of the Imperium to unlock a powerful repertoire of abilities, weapons, and tools. Carve out a piece of Arrakis for yourself. Discover unique resources to mine and craft hundreds of items, armors, gadgets, vehicles, and base parts. Build and decorate a modest home just for yourself, set up an efficient spice refinery with your friends, or construct a massive seat of power for your guild. Scavenge, craft, build, and trade your way to fortune. Play alone, with a handful of friends, or head into the wider world filled with hundreds of other players and engage in the politics of Arrakis. Unlock powerful new abilities to become a master of hand-to-hand and ranged combat or pursue the life of a planetologist, surveying Arrakis and uncovering its ancient mysteries. You decide how to spend your time on Arrakis. Private Servers You can play Dune: Awakening on an official server or a private server rented from a third-party provider.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《Dune: Awakening》是一款能讓你完全沉浸在《沙丘》傳奇世界的開放世界生存 RPG。 你被貝尼潔瑟睿德選上，以特務身分前往厄拉科斯探索弗瑞曼人失蹤之謎。造訪厄拉欽恩與哈卡盆地等地點，並與雷托．亞崔迪公爵與菲德．羅薩．哈肯能等熟悉角色會面，撰寫一篇以你為主角的壯闊《沙丘》故事。 不論你偏好當獨行俠還是與朋友一同冒險，《Dune: Awakening》都能讓你有機會探索一個充滿祕密、浩瀚且開放的厄拉科斯，體驗撲朔迷離的故事，並從區區一名生存者開始，成就你的豐功偉業。 躲避四處出沒的沙蟲。在陰影中遮蔽炎熱的太陽。修煉慢速劍法，或是精通貝尼潔瑟睿德的力量。建築簡樸的住所或龐大要塞，然後用你自己的獨特風格進行裝飾。爬上高山，或製作撲翼機翱翔天際。一切選擇都在你手中。 《Dune: Awakening》能帶給你一個栩栩如生的《沙丘》世界，其規模前所未見。 探索充滿變化性與沉浸感的厄拉科斯，從深邃沙漠的巨大沙丘、隱藏的弗瑞曼人洞穴，到厄拉欽恩繁忙的街道。用魆迦滕爪爬上高聳的山巔，或製作你專屬的撲翼機飛越沙蟲肆虐的沙漠。親眼目睹巨型沙暴橫掃大地。 體驗一個極具電影感的壯大《沙丘》故事。在其中，你將會面對一個令人費解的問題：如果保羅．亞崔迪從未出生，這世界的命運會有何不同？你將會遇見如包括雷托公爵與菲德．羅薩等小說與電影中的角色，調查弗瑞曼人神秘的失蹤事件，並揭開你自己過去的謎團。加入亞崔迪或哈肯村陣營，並在提升自己地位的同時探索雙方的獨特故事。 你必須在炎熱的白天尋找陰影。製作蒸餾服來回收身體流失的水分。注意蟲跡以免被沙胡羅吞噬。厄拉科斯是一場測試，如要成功，你必須精通弗瑞曼人的祕密知識與帝國學院的教導，以便解鎖能力、武器與工具。 在厄拉科斯開闊一片自己的天地。你將能挖掘獨特資源，並製作數百種物品、盔甲、裝置、載具與基地組件。為自己建造一座簡單的住所，與朋友一起設立高效能的香料提煉機，或是為你的公會建築一座宏偉的權力中心。通過收集、製作、建造與交易，你將能漸漸累積你的財富。 你可以單獨一人或與朋友一起遊玩，或是與上百位玩家共同一同在廣闊的厄拉科斯參與政治角力。解鎖新能力，成為近距離或遠距離戰鬥好手，或是成為行星生態學家，調查厄拉科斯的古老祕密。在厄拉科斯想做甚麼， 你 完全可以自己決定。 私人伺服器 在《Dune: Awakening》中，您可選擇要在官方伺服器或第三方供應商出租的私人伺服器遊玩。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 『デューン』シリーズの伝説的な世界を没入体験できる、壮大なオープンワールドサバイバルRPG『Dune: Awakening デューン：アウェイクニング』。 ベネ・ゲセリットに諜報員として選ばれたあなた。アラキスへ向かい、消えたフレメンの謎を解き明かしましょう。アラキーン、ハガ盆地などの場所を訪れ、レト・アトレイデス公爵やフェイド＝ラウサ・ハルコンネンなどの馴染みのキャラクターと出会いながら、かつてないほど壮大な『デューン』の物語――「あなた」の物語を紐解きましょう。 単独でプレイするも、フレンドとプレイするもよし。『Dune: Awakening デューン：アウェイクニング』は、明かすべき秘密、調査すべき物語、単なる生存から高みへと上り詰めるための可能性で溢れる、広大なオープンワールドのアラキスを探索する機会を与えてくれます。 そばをうろつくサンドワームを回避し、日陰を求めて、灼熱の太陽を避けましょう。低速刃攻撃を学んだり、ベネ・ゲセリットの力を習得したりするのもまた一興。質素な家や巨大な基地を建設し、キャラクターのユニークな性格を反映させた装飾を施してもよいでしょう。はたまた、山登りをしたり、クラフトしたオーニソプターで飛行したり...選択肢は無限大です。 『Dune: Awakening デューン：アウェイクニング』で、かつてないほど生き生きとした生命力ある『デューン』の世界をお楽しみください。 砂漠の奥地の広大な砂漠から、隠れたフレメンの洞窟やアラキーンのにぎわう通りまで...ダイナミックかつ没入型のアラキスを探索しましょう。そびえたつ山々をシガワイヤーのフックで登り、クラフトした自分のオーニソプターでいざサンドワームが巣食う砂漠へ。景色を素早く駆け抜ける、立ちはだかるような巨大な砂嵐をその目で目撃しましょう。 「もしポール・アトレイデスが存在しなかったら...？世界はどう違っていたのか？」シネマティックに語られる壮大でショッキングな『デューン』の物語を体験してください。本や映画でお馴染みのレト公爵やフェイド＝ラウサに出会い、謎めいたフレメン失踪の謎を調査し、自身の過去にまつわる真実を解き明かしましょう。アトレイデス家またはハルコンネン家に加わり、地位を駆け上がり、ユニークな物語に浸ってください。 日中のうだるような暑さの中では、日陰を探し求めましょう。体外排出液を再利用する保水スーツをクラフトし、ワームサインを探し求め、シャイー＝フルードに食われる危険をおかし、砂漠へ繰り出しましょう。アラキスは試練です。生き残るためには、フレメンの秘密の知識を暴き、帝国養成学校の教えを学び、強力な能力、武器、ツールをアンロックせねばなりません。 あなたらしいアラキスを作り上げましょう。ユニークな採掘資源を発見し、数百種類におよぶアイテム、防具、装置、乗り物、基地パーツをクラフトしましょう。質素な家を建設してもよし、フレンドと一緒に効率的な香料精製器を設置するもよし、所属ギルドのために巨大な権力の象徴を築き上げるもよし...富を求めて、回収、クラフト、建設、取引しましょう。 単独でプレイしたい人も、少数のフレンドと一緒にプレイしたい人も、数百人のプレイヤーがひしめく広大なワールドに繰り出してアラキスの政治に介入したい人も...全員、大歓迎。強力な新能力をアンロックして近接戦闘や遠距離戦闘を極めたり、アラキスを探査して古代の謎を暴く惑星学者の人生を追い求めたり...アラキスでの生き方を決めるのは、 あなた自身 です。 プライベートサーバー プレイヤーの皆さんは、公式サーバーまたはサードパーティーのプロバイダからレンタルしたプライベートサーバー上で『Dune: Awakening デューン：アウェイクニング』をお楽しみいただけます。
detailed_descriptions.ko: Dune: Awakening 듄 ：어웨이크닝은 전설적인 듄 세계관에 완전히 빠져들 수 있는 장대한 오픈 월드 서바이벌 RPG입니다. 플레이어는 베네 게세리트의 선택을 받고 사라진 프레멘의 미스터리를 파헤칠 요원으로서 아라키스로 가게 됩니다. 아라킨, 하가 분지 같은 장소를 방문하고 레토 아트레이데스 공작, 페이드 로타 하코넨을 비롯해 익숙한 캐릭터들을 만나보세요. 전에 없던 장대한 듄의 이야기, 바로 여러분의 서사시가 펼쳐집니다. 혼자 플레이하든 친구와 함께하든, Dune: Awakening 듄 ：어웨이크닝은 광활한 오픈 월드 아라키스를 탐험할 기회를 선사합니다. 사막에 가득한 비밀을 찾고, 이야기를 파헤치며, 단순히 목숨을 부지하는 것을 넘어 위대한 존재가며 되어보세요. 사막을 돌아다니는 모래벌레를 피하고, 뜨겁게 내리쬐는 햇빛을 피해 그늘을 찾아다니세요. 슬로우 블레이드 공격법을 익히거나, 베네 게세리트의 능력을 마스터해 보세요. 아담한 집에서 대규모 기지까지 취향대로 짓고 본인의 개성을 살려 꾸며보세요. 산을 오르거나 오니솝터를 제작해 하늘로 날아오르세요. 선택은 모두 여러분이 하는 겁니다. Dune: Awakening 듄 ：어웨이크닝은 전에 없던 규모로 살아 숨 쉬는 듄의 세계를 선사합니다. 광활한 깊은 사막의 모래 언덕부터 숨겨진 프레멘 동굴, 북적이는 도시 아라킨의 거리에 이르기까지 역동적으로 변화하며 몰입감을 선사하는 아라키스를 탐험하세요. 시거와이어 후크로 드높은 산을 오르고, 직접 만든 오니솝터를 타고 모래벌레가 들끓는 사막 위를 날아보세요. 거대한 모래폭풍이 대지를 휩쓸며 머리 위로 치솟는 모습을 목격하세요. ‘만약 폴 아트레이데스가 태어나지 않았다면? 무엇이 달라졌을까?’란 생각해 보지 못한 질문에서 출발하여 영화처럼 펼쳐지는 장대한 이야기를 경험해 보세요. 레토 공작, 페이드 로타처럼 원작 소설과 영화로 익숙해진 캐릭터를 만나고, 프레멘이 사라진 수수께끼의 진상을 조사하세요. 자신의 과거에 대한 진실을 발견하세요. 아트레이데스나 하코넨에 들어가 가문 고유의 이야기를 따라 탐험하고 계급을 올리세요. 낮에는 뜨겁게 내리쬐는 햇빛을 피해 그늘을 찾으세요. 사막복을 제작해 체내 수분을 재활용하세요. 벌레징조을 잘 찾아보지 않으면, 샤이훌루드에게 잡아먹힐지도 모릅니다. 아라키스는 시험의 장입니다. 시험에 통과하려면 프레멘의 비밀스러운 지식을 찾아내고 제국 학파의 가르침을 배워 강력한 능력, 무기, 도구를 해제해야 합니다. 아라키스에 나만의 공간을 만드세요. 고유 자원을 찾아 채굴하고 다양한 아이템, 보호구, 장치, 차량, 기지 부품을 제작하세요. 나만의 아담한 집을 지어 꾸미거나, 친구와 함께 효율적인 스파이스 정제소를 세우거나, 길드를 위한 거대한 권력의 거점을 건설해 보세요. 자원을 찾고, 제작하고, 건설하며, 거래하여 부를 쌓아나가세요. 혼자 플레이해도 되고, 친구 몇 명과 플레이해도 되고, 수백 명의 다른 플레이어로 가득한 드넓은 세계로 들어가 아라키스의 정치에 몸을 담아도 됩니다. 강력한 새 능력을 얻어 근거리 및 원거리 전투의 대가가 되거나, 행성학자로 살아가며 아라키스를 조사하고 고대의 신비를 풀어내세요. 아라키스에서 어떻게 시간을 보낼지 결정하는 주체는 바로 여.러.분.입니다. 비공개 서버 Dune: Awakening 듄 ：어웨이크닝은 공식 서버 또는 타사 제공업체에서 임대한 비공개 서버에서 플레이할 수 있습니다.

games.name: Dwarf Eats Mountain
games.short_description: Dwarves hunger for gold, and no mountain shall stand in their way! Mine riches, unearth artifacts, and upgrade your dwarves to devour ever-bigger peaks in this whimsical incremental game.

descriptions.en: Dwarves hunger for gold, and no mountain shall stand in their way! Mine riches, unearth artifacts, and upgrade your dwarves to devour ever-bigger peaks in this whimsical incremental game.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 矮人对黄金充满渴望，没有任何一座高山能阻挡他们的脚步！在这款轻松有趣的放置类游戏中，开采宝藏、发掘神器、升级矮人，去吞噬一座又一座更雄伟的山峰。

detailed_descriptions.en: Dwarf Eats Mountain is a strategic incremental game about devouring mountains for gold. Hire dwarves, deploy war machines, and collect powerful artifacts to build absurd synergies and grow faster each run. Hurting the mountain physically (and emotionally) is only half the battle— you still have to safely haul the gold home. That perilous job falls to the Runners, who weave through falling rocks, risking their beards to feed the Great Maw! But beware—the Great Mother won’t give up her treasure easily. The more damage your greedy dwarves deal to the mountain, the more calamities it unleashes upon the wobbling beards below! Balance mining with hauling your gold home—before the sky falls on your head. Master the dwarven ways of treasure extraction! This game is about making numbers go up, but the way you do that is open to your interpretation and ingenuity. At your fingertips: Many buildings and dwarves, each with various strengths and weaknesses, such as dynamite throwers, ballistas, flamers, laser cannons, spelunkers, runesmiths, brewmasters, bulldozers, gyrocopters and more! Acquire countless upgrades and cast active rituals to buff your dwarves and their machines Collect 120+ ancient artifacts and display them in your gallery, each with build-shaping effects Unlock 96+ prestige upgrades to replay, accelerate progress, and discover new synergies Spend rare resources like mithril and mountain souls on tough choices Uncover what the gods have hidden beneath the world spire—and what happened to those who dug too deep
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《 矮人吞山 》是一款策略性的放置类游戏，核心玩法就是啃山夺金。 招募矮人、部署战争机器、收集强力神器 ，搭配出天马行空的联动效果，让每一轮成长都更加迅猛。 从肉体（到精神）上摧毁山峰只是成功的一半—— 你还得把黄金平安运回营地 。这项凶险的差事落在了“搬运工”头上，他们在落石间穿梭，冒着失去胡须的风险，只为喂饱“巨口”！ 但小心——大地之母绝不会轻易交出宝藏。 贪婪的矮人对山脉造成的破坏越大，它就会对下方摇摇晃晃的胡须们降下越多灾祸。 在天崩地塌之前，平衡好开采与运金的节奏。 掌握矮人一族的夺宝秘术！ 这是一款数值不断飙升的游戏，而如何实现增长，全凭你的思路与巧思。你将拥有： 种类繁多的建筑与矮人，各有优劣特长，比如：炸药投掷手、弩炮、烈焰使者、激光炮、洞穴探险家、符文铁匠、酿酒大师、推土机、旋翼机等！ 海量升级选项，可施放主动仪式，为矮人及其机器提供增益 收集百余件上古神器，陈列在展馆中，每件都能彻底改变你的玩法流派 解锁九十余种威望升级，反复游玩、加速进度、发掘全新联动 消耗秘银、山之魂等稀有资源，做出艰难抉择 揭开诸神藏在世界尖峰之下的秘密，以及那些挖得太深的先驱者们的下场

games.name: Dying Light
games.short_description: First-person action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open world overrun by flesh-hungry zombies. Roam a city devastated by a mysterious virus epidemic. Scavenge for supplies, craft weapons, and face hordes of the infected.

descriptions.en: First-person action survival game set in a post-apocalyptic open world overrun by flesh-hungry zombies. Roam a city devastated by a mysterious virus epidemic. Scavenge for supplies, craft weapons, and face hordes of the infected.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 這款第一人稱動作生存遊戲，位於一個充滿食肉喪屍的末日後世界。穿梭於一座被神秘病毒所摧殘的城市。收集物資、打造武器並面對成群的感染者。
descriptions.ja: 血肉に飢えたゾンビがはびこるポストアポカリプスの世界で、一人称視点のオープンワールド・アクションサバイバルゲームに飛び込もう。未知のウイルスの蔓延により崩壊した都市を探索しよう。物資をあさって武器を作成し、無数の感染者に立ち向かえ。
descriptions.ko: 종말 이후 굶주린 좀비가 넘쳐나는 오픈 월드를 배경으로 펼쳐지는 1인칭 액션 생존 게임을 즐겨보세요. 여러분은 수수께끼의 바이러스 전염에 의해 몰락한 도시를 탐험하며 물자를 찾고, 무기를 제작하여 감염된 생명체 무리들을 상대해야 합니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: IMPORTANT: Enjoy enhanced visuals, a remastered soundtrack, and graphical improvements with the Retouched Update — available for free to all Dying Light owners. Dying Light Essentials Edition contains: Dying Light (base game) The Bozak Horde DLC Cuisine & Cargo DLC Ultimate Survivor Bundle 5th Anniversary Bundle 10th Anniversary Bundle Harran Ranger Bundle Gun Psycho Bundle Volatile Hunter Bundle Retrowave Bundle Shu Warrior Bundle From the creators of hit titles Dead Island and Call of Juarez. Winner of over 50 industry awards and nominations. The game whose uncompromising approach to gameplay set new standards for first-person zombie games. Thanks to its legacy and seven-year post-launch support, today it goes down in history as one of gaming's greatest zombie titles. Survive in a city beset by a zombie virus! Discover the hard choice you will have to make on your secret mission. Will loyalty to your superiors prove stronger than the will to save the survivors? The choice is yours… VAST OPEN WORLD Roam the city with unprecedented freedom and bask in its unique atmosphere. Use parkour to scale every building and reach remote areas. CREATIVE COMBAT Engage in gory combat and discover limitless options to confront your enemies. Use the environment paired with various weapon types and abilities to gain an advantage. DAY AND NIGHT CYCLE Experience the dramatic shift in the world, as you change from a hunter to hunted at sundown. Face the coming threat or run away without wasting your time to look behind. 4-PLAYER CO-OP Join forces with other players and raise your chances of survival in an exciting co-op mode. Tackle the story campaign together and see how far you'll go as a team.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 重要：潤飾更新帶來增強畫面、重製原聲、圖形改良－擁有任何版本《消逝的光芒》的玩家都可以免費獲得。 《消逝的光芒》精要版包含： 《消逝的光芒》（原版遊戲） 波扎克部落DLC 餐廳和鐵路站DLC 終極倖存者禮包 5週年禮包 10週年禮包 哈蘭突擊隊禮包 瘋狂槍手禮包 夜魔獵人禮包 復古槍手禮包 鼠戰士禮包 來自《Dead Island》和《Call of Juarez》的創作團隊。在業界榮獲超過 50 個獎項與提名。遊戲對玩法的不懈追求為第一人稱喪屍遊戲設立了新的標竿。遊戲在發行後的七年間繼續優化，使其成為了有史以來最偉大的喪尸遊戲之一。 在喪屍病毒肆虐的城市中求生！在執行秘密任務時做出艱難的抉擇。你究竟會選擇對上司保持忠誠，還是會選擇去拯救生還者們？這一切都將由你決定…… 廣闊的開放世界 以前所未有的自由度穿梭於城市之中，感受其中的獨特氣氛。使用跑酷技巧來攀爬建築並到達遙遠的地方。 創意十足的戰鬥 展開血腥的戰鬥並探索無數的抗敵手段。使用各種武器與技能，並根據環境進行搭配來取得優勢。 日夜交替體驗 體驗世界的重大變化——日落之後，你將從獵人變成獵物。要麼對抗來襲的威脅，要麼頭也不回地拼命逃跑。 4 人合作模式 在緊張刺激的合作模式中，和其他玩家並肩作戰來提高生存的機率。一起遊玩故事戰役模式，看看你們作為一個團隊能走多遠。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 重要：リタッチアップデートで解像度の上がったビジュアル、リマスターされたサウンドトラック、そして改善されたグラフィックを楽しみましょう — 「Dying Light」をお持ちのユーザーは無料でダウンロードいただけます。 Dying Light Essentials Editionの内容： Dying Light（ゲーム本編） DLC「The Bozak Horde」 DLC「Cuisine & Cargo」 究極のサバイバー バンドル 5周年 バンドル 10周年 バンドル ハランレンジャー バンドル ガンサイコ バンドル ヴォラタイル・ハンター バンドル レトロウェーブ バンドル Shu ウォーリアーバンドル 人気タイトル『Dead Island』や『Call of Juarez』のクリエーター達が集結。50を超える賞を受賞し、多数部門にノミネート。妥協を許さないゲーム作りにより、一人称視点のゾンビゲームとして革新的な作品に仕上がりました。築き上げられたレガシー、および発売後7年間にわたるサポートが実を結び、ゲーム史に残るゾンビゲームの名作として語り継がれています。 ゾンビウイルスの感染者がはびこる都市を生き残れ！極秘ミッションの最中、あなたに迫られた究極の選択とは？雇い主への忠誠心は、生存者たちを救いたいという心に勝ってしまうのか？運命の行く末はあなたに委ねられている… 広大なオープンワールド 前代未聞の自由度を誇る都市を探索し、本作独自の雰囲気を体感。パルクールを駆使して建物を飛び渡り、未知のエリアに辿り着こう。 クリエイティブな戦闘 血みどろの戦いに飛び込んで、無数の選択肢から自分あった戦い方を見つけ、敵と対峙しよう。周囲の環境と武器のコンビネーションを活かし、アビリティを駆使して優位に戦おう。 夜と昼の体験 夜には狩る者から狩られる者へ、劇的に変化する世界を体感しよう。迫り来る脅威と対峙するも、なりふり構わず逃げ惑うも自由だ。 4人協力プレイ 白熱の協力モードで他のプレイヤーと共に部隊を結成して、生存確率を高めよう。共にストーリーキャンペーンを進めて、チームとしての実力を試そう。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 중요: 리터치 업데이트를 통해 향상된 그래픽, 리마스터된 사운드트랙, 그리고 그래픽 개선을 경험하세요. 이 업데이트는 모든 Dying Light 소유자에게 무료로 제공됩니다. Dying Light 에센셜 에디션 구성: Dying Light (기본 게임) The Bozak Horde DLC Cuisine & Cargo DLC 궁극의 생존자 번들 5주년 기념 번들 10주년 기념 번들 하란 레인저 번들 건 사이코 번들 볼래틸 사냥꾼 번들 레트로 웨이브 번들 슈 워리어 번들 명작 Dead Island와 Call of Juarez를 제작했으며, 50번이 넘는 업계 수상과 후보 선정 경력이 있는 제작자로부터 탄생한 이 신작은 여러분에게 차원이 다른 1인칭 좀비 게임 플레이 경험을 선사할 것입니다. 릴리스 이후 수년이 지났지만, 여전히 새 콘텐츠와 무료 커뮤니티 이벤트 덕분에 오늘날 게임 역사상 가장 위대한 좀비 게임 타이틀 중 하나로 널리 알려져 있습니다. 좀비 바이러스가 넘쳐나는 도시에서 살아남으세요! 비밀 임무 수행을 위해 힘든 결정을 내려야만 합니다. 과연 상급자를 위한 충성이 생존자를 구조하는 것보다 더 우선시되어야 할까요? 선택은 여러분의 몫입니다... 광대한 오픈 월드 전례 없는 자유도와 함께 도시를 탐험하며 독특한 분위기를 느껴보세요. 파쿠르 기술을 사용하여 모든 건물 및 쉽게 갈 수 없는 곳까지 도달할 수 있습니다. 창의적인 전투 적과 피 튀기는 전투를 치러보세요. 적을 상대하는 방법은 무한하며, 환경 및 다양한 무기와 능력을 활용할 수 있습니다. 낮과 밤의 경험 일몰이 되면 여러분도 사냥꾼에서 먹잇감이 됩니다. 다가오는 위협에 대비하거나 뒤를 돌아보지 말고 바로 도망치세요. 4인 플레이어 코옵 코옵 모드에서 다른 플레이어들과 힘을 합쳐 생존력을 높여보세요. 함께 스토리 캠페인을 진행하고 팀으로서 어디까지 나아갈 수 있는지 시험해 보세요.

games.name: Dying Light: The Beast
games.short_description: BECOME THE BEAST. SURVIVE THE NIGHT. A terrifying new chapter in the Dying Light universe begins. As Kyle Crane, explore the vast and unpredictable wilderness, uncover a deadly evolution of the infected, and learn to control the beastly powers awakening inside you.

descriptions.en: BECOME THE BEAST. SURVIVE THE NIGHT. A terrifying new chapter in the Dying Light universe begins. As Kyle Crane, explore the vast and unpredictable wilderness, uncover a deadly evolution of the infected, and learn to control the beastly powers awakening inside you.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 你是凱爾·克蘭，多年來遭受了各種慘無人道的實驗，被改造成一個半人半獸的怪物。在開放世界和恐怖動作生存結合的獨特遊戲體驗裡，追殺把你變成這個樣子的罪魁禍首。
descriptions.ja: 幾年にもわたって実験体とされてきたカイル・クレインとして、復讐を求めることとなる。オープンワールドとアクション・サバイバルホラーという唯一無二の組み合わせの中で、あなたを半人半獣にした男を追い詰めろ。
descriptions.ko: 당신은 카일 크레인으로, 수년간 실험 대상이었다가 복수를 위해 나섰습니다. 오픈 월드와 생존 호러를 독특하게 조합한 게임을 통해 당신을 반인반수로 만든 사람을 추적해 내세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: Dying Light: The Beast is the next AAA Dying Light game and the best-reviewed entry in the franchise’s history. Packed with more than 40 hours of survival adventure, both in single-player and shared progression co-op, it delivers the most ambitious, modern and content-rich Dying Light experience ever created. Immerse yourself in the expansive open world of Castor Woods and get lost in the scope, atmosphere and innovation of this must-play survival horror. A terrifying new chapter in the Dying Light universe begins. As Kyle Crane, explore the vast and unpredictable wilderness, uncover a deadly evolution of the infected, and learn to control the beastly powers awakening inside you. " The Beast really is Dying Light 3. ” - GamesRadar+ The highest-rated Dying Light game ever, shaped by a decade of Techland’s experience with the series. Everything fans love - immersion, exploration, physical FPP melee combat, grounded parkour, and the iconic day–night cycle - refined and elevated to the next level. A perfect return for veterans, and the ideal entry point for newcomers. " Kyle Crane Steals The Show And Gives Dying Light Its Best Story Yet " - The Gamer Dive into a gripping tale of vengeance filled with twists, shifting alliances, and characters you’re never sure you can trust. Follow Kyle Crane’s powerful journey as his fight for justice uncovers reveals dangers far greater than he ever imagined. " Techland perfectly nailed it, the Beast Mode really makes you feel like you could tear through anything " - WCCFtech Play as Kyle Crane, a hero with the DNA of both man and beast. Freely switch between two playstyles and face a fierce conflict that lead to the acceptance of the monster within. " Melee combat is once again a highlight of the game, with heft behind every attempt to take out a zombie, and so many different weapons and modifiers to choose from " - Gamespot Feel the full force of Dying Light’s most physical combat yet. Your blows land with real momentum, enemies react believably, and your emerging beast-like abilities add intensity without losing the challenge and immersion. " The night continues to be one of Dying Light’s greatest gameplay " - GamingBIBLE The distinct experiences of night and day, a signature of the Dying Light series, merge into one unique whole. Explore and scavenge by day, but remember the constantly ticking clock. Because once the sun sets, the night unleashes horrors that leave you with just three choices: run, hide or fight for your life. " Running, sliding, jumping, climbing, and hopping around Castor Woods is a treat " - Kotaku Feel the adrenaline rush of best-in-class first-person parkour. Jump from rooftop to rooftop and overcome any obstacle. And when that’s not enough, grab the wheel of an off-road vehicle and ruthlessly tear through hordes of zombies. " Techland brings its A-game when it comes to crafting a densely interactive, photorealistic world that frequently takes my breath away " - GamesRadar+ Next-gen visuals bring the hand-crafted zombie apocalypse to life. Every detail tells a story of survival. Lose yourself in the majesty of Castor Woods: explore the tourist town, industrial area, national park, farmland, swamps and more. All full of beauty… and decay. " Playing the game with friends is creating a different kind of experience " - GameRant Band together with up to three other players in co-op! Brave the dangers of Castor Woods, where you can experience every encounter, every discovery and every twist as a unit with shared progress.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《垂死之光：困獸》是一段驚險刺激的獨立喪屍冒險旅程，故事發生在末日後的河狸谷，一個曾經很受歡迎的旅行目的地。在忍受了持續 13 年的實驗後，你逃了出來並開始追捕當時劫持你的那些人來復仇，卻發現更多危險接踵而至。雖然這片地區的人口數量不似從前，但仍然存在著形形色色的人和派閥，以及恐怖的事物。一些人想找你幫忙，另一些則想置你於死地，更不用說還有那些已經把這片樹林變成了自己的狩獵場的神秘生物。 半人半獸，掙扎求生 化身為凱爾·克蘭，一名體內兼具生存者與野獸DNA的獨特英雄。在兩種玩法之間切換，體驗人與怪物間激烈的內心掙扎，最終擁抱無可抵擋的力量。 原始的殘暴 將《消逝的光芒》的戰鬥殘暴性提升到極限，超越人類極限，以原始兇性擊碎頭骨、扯斷敵人的頭顱，甚至將敵人撕成兩半，同時努力控制主角持續演化、充滿狂怒的獸性力量。 白晝為王，夜幕為懼 《消逝的光芒》系列的經典特色——截然不同的日夜體驗融合成難以忘懷的整體。在白天探索與搜刮物資，緊盯著逐漸逼近的日落，當夜幕降臨時，恐怖席捲而來，只剩下逃跑、躲藏或戰鬥到底三個選項。 飛簷走壁，稱霸道路 感受業界最佳的第一人稱跑酷體驗，從屋頂躍至屋頂，攀爬任何障礙，享受人人皆可上手、但唯有大師才能盡情發揮的移動系統。然後駕駛越野車橫掃殭屍群，享受開放世界無與倫比的自由感。 絕美的末日殭屍世界 次世代精美視覺效果打造出一個手工雕琢的殭屍末日世界，每個細節都訴說著倖存的故事。沉醉於受到瑞士阿爾卑斯山啟發的河狸谷，各種生態區域—觀光小鎮、工業區、國家公園、農田與沼澤——在美麗與腐敗中交織。 共享冒險 最多4名玩家可共同面對河狸谷的險境，每場戰鬥、每次探索以及劇情中的每一個轉折都能夠一同經歷。透過共享的遊戲進度並肩冒險，一同面對無盡的敵人、搜尋寶貴資源，並在危急時刻彼此扶持。
detailed_descriptions.ja: あなたの名はカイル・クレイン。「バロン」に捕らわれ、実験体として幾年にもわたり苦痛を味わわされ、そしてようやく脱出に成功する。だが傷跡は残ったままだ。人間とゾンビ両者のDNAを持ち、人間性の淵に立つあなたは、内なる獣とそのせめぎあいに苦悩する。だが、このような目に遭わせた男に復讐するには、その獣を飼いならさなければならない。 オープンワールドとアクション・サバイバルホラーを組み合わせた唯一無二の『Dying Light: The Beast』は、美しくも危険にあふれた、観光客よりもゾンビが多い谷「カストル・ウッズ」が舞台である。かつての捕獲者を倒すには、決して強固とはいえない同盟関係を築き、使用可能なあらゆる戦闘と移動手段を活用しなければならない。 だが外の世界では、一歩一歩が生き残りを賭けた戦いであり、太陽の光が届かなくなれば緊張感は大きく増し、夜に真の恐怖が闊歩することになる。 ビーストでありサバイバー サバイバーであり、ビーストのDNAを宿す唯一無二の英雄、カイル・クレインとして戦え。2つのプレイスタイルを切り替え、人と怪物の狭間に揺れる内なる葛藤を乗り越え、やがて誰にも止められない力を手に入れろ。 原始の獣性 Dying Lightならではの荒々しい戦闘を限界のその先へ──頭蓋を砕き、首を引きちぎり、敵を真っ二つに裂け。怒りに突き動かされ、進化を続ける主人公の獣のごとき力を制御し、操るのだ。 制すべき白昼、恐るべき夜 Dying Lightシリーズの特徴である昼夜で大きく異なる2つの体験が融合し、鮮烈なプレイ体験を生み出す。昼は探索し、物資を回収し、過ぎ行く時間に追われていく。陽が沈めば、やってくるのは恐怖の夜。夜が訪れればあなたに残された選択肢は3つだ――即ち、逃走、潜伏、或いは戦って抗うか。 屋上を駆け抜け、道を支配せよ 一人称視点で楽しむ、最高峰のパルクールアクションの疾走感を体感せよ。屋根から屋根へ飛び移り、あらゆる障害物を乗り越えられる直感的かつ奥深い移動システムを極めろ。さらにオフロード車両のハンドルを握り、ゾンビの群れをなぎ倒しながら、比類なき自由を誇るオープンワールドを駆け巡れ。 美しきゾンビアポカリプス 息をのむほど美麗な次世代のビジュアルで描かれるゾンビアポカリプスの世界。ディテールに拘られたその世界からは命の息吹を感じ取れることだろう。スイスアルプスに着想を得たCastor Woodsの谷に広がる観光地、工業地帯、農地、湿地帯――多様なバイオームに満ちた、美しくも荒廃した世界が待ち受けている。 冒険を共有せよ 最大4人の協力プレイでCastor Woodsに潜む危険に挑め。すべての戦闘、すべての発見、そして波乱に満ちた物語を仲間と共に体験せよ。進行状況も共有しながら、無慈悲な敵と戦い、資源を探し、死の淵から仲間を救え。力を合わせて、この壮大な冒険を制覇せよ。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 당신은 카일 크레인입니다. 바론에게 붙잡힌 뒤 수년간 고통스러운 실험을 견뎠던 당신은 탈출했습니다. 하지만 상처는 남아 있습니다. 인간과 좀비의 DNA를 모두 보유한 당신은 인류의 경계에 남아 내면의 야수를 다스리고 이에 수반되는 갈등을 해결하기 위해 고군분투합니다. 하지만 당신에게 이런 짓을 한 자에게 복수하기 위해 이겨 내야 합니다. 오픈 월드와 액션 생존 호러를 독특하게 조합한 Dying Light: The Beast는 아름다우면서도 위험한 캐스터 우즈의 계곡이 배경으로, 이제는 관광객보다 좀비들이 들끓는 곳입니다. 당신을 붙잡아 두고 있던 자를 쓰러뜨리려면 아슬아슬한 동맹을 유지하고 주어진 전투와 이동 방법을 총동원해야 할 것입니다. 하지만 조심하세요. 이곳에선 매 순간이 생존을 위한 싸움입니다. 특히 해가 지고 밤이 되면 진정한 공포가 고개를 들며 긴장감이 높아집니다! 야수의 본능, 인간의 의지 생존자와 야수의 DNA를 동시에 지닌 특별한 영웅, 카일 크레인이 되어 보세요! 두 가지 플레이 스타일을 오가며 인간과 야수 사이에서의 치열한 내적 갈등을 경험하고, 마침내 막을 수 없는 궁극의 힘을 온전히 받아들이세요. 원초적 잔혹함 다잉 라이트(Dying Light) 속 전투를 통해 원초적 야만성을 극한까지 끌어올리세요. 적을 잔혹하게 해치우며 끊임없이 진화하는 분노로부터 자라나는 야수의 힘을 통제하고, 영웅으로 살아남기 위해 분투하세요. 정복의 낮, 저항의 밤 다잉 라이트(Dying Light) 시리즈의 시그니처 시스템, 낮과 밤이라는 완전히 다른 환경은 하나의 잊을 수 없는 세계를 만들어냅니다. 낮에는 자원을 모으며 끊임없이 흘러가는 시간을 의식하고, 공포의 밤이 다가오면 세 가지 선택지 중 하나를 선택해야 합니다 - 도망치거나, 숨거나...목숨을 걸고 싸우세요. 끝없이 오르고, 끝없이 질주하라 최고 수준 1인칭 파쿠르의 짜릿함을 온몸으로 느끼며 지붕 위를 뛰어넘고, 어떠한 장애물도 거침없이 오르세요. 누구나 할 수 있지만 완벽히 마스터한 생존자들 만이 진정한 자유를 맛볼 수 있습니다. 또, 오프로드 차량을 몰고 좀비 무리를 뚫고 나아가며 오픈월드 속 한순간의 해방감을 만끽하세요. 매혹적인 좀비 아포칼립스 놀랄 만큼 정교한 차세대 비주얼은 좀비 아포칼립스를 생동감 있게 구현하며 당신에게 아포칼립스 속 생존 스토리를 들려줍니다. 스위스 알프스를 연상시키는 캐스터 우즈의 웅장한 계곡에서 다양한 생태계 - 관광 도시, 산업 지역, 국립공원, 농장, 습지 등을 탐험하며 아름다움과 몰락이 공존하는 세계를 경험하세요. 함께 하는 모험 최대 4인과 협동해 다가오는 위험에 맞서고 전투와 발견, 예측할 수 없는 스토리의 전개까지 다 함께 마주하세요. 진행 상황을 공유하며 끝없이 몰려오는 적들과 싸우고, 자원을 수집하고, 죽음의 문턱에서 서로를 구해내며 생존의 희망을 키우세요.

games.short_description: Ascend from your shelter. Ruin everything. Escape the wretched island. ⚔️🔨🎣🌱🌵🍰 Explore. Fight. Level up. Survive. Gather. Craft. Harvest. Hunt. Build. Farm. Solve puzzles. Fish. Cook. Live. Enjoy the bittersweet post-apocalypse.

descriptions.ja: 避難所から抜け出せ。すべてを破壊しろ。悲惨な島から脱出しろ。⚔️🔨🎣🌱🌵🍰 探索。戦闘。レベルアップ。生存。収集。作成。収穫。狩猟。建築。栽培。謎解き。釣り。料理。生活。厳しくも楽しい、終末後の世界へ。
descriptions.ko: 쉘터에서 일어나라. 모든 것을 파괴하라. 끔찍한 섬을 탈출하라. ⚔️🔨🎣🌱🌵🍰 탐험하라. 싸우라. 레벨업하라. 살아남으라. 모으라. 제조하라. 수확하라. 사냥하라. 건설하라. 농사를 지으라. 퍼즐을 풀라. 낚시를 하라. 요리하라. 살라. 괴로우면서도 즐거운 포스트 아포칼립스를 즐기라.

detailed_descriptions.en: As you ascend from your shelter after the long long years , a brave new old world awaits you. A world inhabited with nasty and vile creatures. A world with no other human soul to be seen. A world with nature in reigns now. A world that's about to get even worse. You need to find a way to escape the wretched island . But before that, enjoy the bittersweet apocalypse . 💥 Break over 99% of all objects for materials with the right tools. No barrier will stop you. 🔪 Fight with (or run away) nasty and vile creatures of the post-apocalyptic era. 🌵 Explore the handcrafted open world and uncover its mysteries. ⛺ Survive . Clear areas of monsters and claim them as yours. 🔨 Build outposts to establish your presence. 💎 Craft permanent weapons, tools, outfits, and trinkets. 🐫 Hunt various game or tame them for your post-apocalyptic zoo ranch. 🌱 Farm nutritious plants and reap the rewards as the crop gets ripe. 🏆 Solve puzzles above ground and underground in the Tombs of the Old Ones 🎣 Fish cunning scaly things under the watery surface. 🍰 Cook delicious recipes for permanent stat and ability upgrades. 🗿 Unravel the mysteries of the strange island. Explore the ruins of the past and discover technology from the hitech era. Gain technological advantage against the hostile environment. Or go deeper and recover the ancient lost knowledge from the hidden tomb chambers of the old ones. Acquire materials with almost magic-like properties and use them to craft insanely powerful gear. Over 99% of everything can be broken for materials with the right equipment. Do that, and collect the sweet nectar of the old world: plastics, rubber, and metals. There is a reasonable number of different materials to gather. Find Recipes to craft permanent items and upgrades. Explore the vast hand-crafted open world and build Outposts to establish your presence. Claim back the land area by area. Find hidden treasures and solve puzzles long ago forgotten. Find your means of escaping the island. The world after the end is inhabited by nasty creatures. Something vile has affected most of the wildlife and former human inhabitants of the island -- turning them into aggressive beast-like creatures. Slay them and collect their loot. Harvest their organs and provide them eternal rest . Or run away and come back when you're stronger. Fight using various melee and ranged weapons. Create traps and lure monsters in. Do whatever it takes. You will not be fighting just to maintain the status quo . This IS NOT a game about starving. You won't be constantly looking for a tasty cockroach to fill your over-metabolic stomach while waiting for the unavoidable bliss that is death. You will never die of hunger . You will get more powerful, and unlock permanent upgrades . The world is a dangerous place, and you may take a few steps back once in a while, but eventually you will thrive . Enjoy the bittersweet apocalypse.

detailed_descriptions.ja: 長い長い時間 を経てシェルターから 抜け出した あなたを、素晴らしき新旧世界が待っている。危険で 邪悪な 生物が巣食う世界。他の人間がまったく見当たらない世界。 自然 が支配するようになった世界。ますます険しいものになろうとしている世界だ。 あなたは、 悲惨な島からの脱出 方法を見つけねばならない。しかしその前に、 厳しくも楽しい終末 を楽しもう。 💥 全オブジェクトの99％以上を 破壊 して、必要なツールの材料を集めよう。障壁は存在しない。 🔪 終末後の危険で邪悪な生物と 戦闘 （または逃走）。 🌵 手作りのオープンワールドを 探索 し、その謎を解明。 ⛺ 生存 。エリアからモンスターを駆逐して制圧。 🔨 前哨基地を 建築 して足場を確立。 💎 恒久的な武器、道具、衣装、装身具を 作成 。 🐫 獰猛な獲物を狙った 狩猟 や、彼らを手名付けての終末後の動物園。 🌱 見たこともない植物を 栽培 し、熟したものを採取。 🏆 地上や地底の古代人の墓で 謎解き 🎣 水面下の狡猾な鱗魚の 釣り 。 🍰 恒久的なステータスや能力向上のためのおいしいレシピで 料理 。 🗿 奇妙な島の謎を 解明 。 遺跡を探索し、ハイテク時代の技術を発見しよう。危険な環境に技術で立ち向かおう。あるいは、地底へと潜入し、古代人の墓所に隠された、失われた古代の知識を手にしよう。魔法のような特性を持つ材料を入手して、驚異的に強力な装備を作成しよう。 全オブジェクトの99％以上は破壊可能。必要なツールの材料を集められる。これによって、プラスチック、ゴム、金属など、古代世界の甘い果実が手に入るだろう。収集できる素材は それなりに 種類豊富。 レシピ を探して 恒久的な アイテムやアップグレードを 作成 しよう。 手作りの広大なオープンワールドを探索し、 前哨基地 を建築して足場を確立しよう。エリアごとに土地を取り戻していこう。秘宝を見つけ、遠い昔に忘れ去られた謎を解こう。島を脱出する方法を見つけよう。 終末を経た世界には獰猛な生物が巣食っている。なにか 邪悪 なものが、島のほとんどの野生生物やかつての住人たちを冒し、獰猛な生物へと変えてしまった。彼らを倒し、戦利品を集めよう。彼らの臓器を収穫し、 永遠の眠り を与えよう。ひとまず逃げて、力を付けてから対峙することもできる。様々な近接・遠隔武器を使って戦おう。罠を作り、モンスターをおびき寄せよう。あらゆる手を尽くせ。 あなたが戦うのは、 現状 を維持するためではない。このゲームのテーマは飢え死にではない。免れ得ない死の優しい抱擁を待ちながら、消化のよい胃を満たすため、常に おいしいゴキブリ を探し回ることはない。 飢え死にすることは決してない 。力を付け、 恒久的なアップグレード をアンロックしていこう。ここは危険な世界だ。ときに後退することもあるだろうが、いずれ あなたは勝利する はずだ。 厳しくも楽しい、終末後の世界へ。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 아주 오랜 시간 뒤에 쉘터에서 일어난 뒤에 멋지고 새로우며 오래된 세계가 기다리고 있습니다. 위험하고 사악한 생물들이 사는 세계. 다른 인간의 영혼이 보이지 않는 세계. 이제는 자연 이 지배하는 세계. 더 나빠지려 하는 세계. 끔찍한 섬을 탈출 할 방법을 찾아야 합니다. 하지만 그 전에, 괴로우면서도 즐거운 아포칼립스를 즐기세요 . 💥 부수기 알맞은 도구로 99%의 오브젝트를 부수어 재료로 사용할 수 있습니다. 한계란 없습니다. 🔪 싸우기 포스트 아포칼립스 시대의 위험하고 사악한 생물들과 맞서 싸우거나 도망치세요. 🌵 탐험 섬세한 오픈 월드를 탐험하고 그 비밀을 풀어보세요. ⛺ 생존 살아남으세요. 몬스터로 가득한 지역을 청소하고 자신의 것으로 만드세요. 🔨 건설 전초기지를 지어 입지를 강화하세요. 💎 제작 영구 무기, 도구, 의상, 장신구를 제작하세요. 🐫 사냥 어려운 사냥감을 사냥하거나 길들여 포스트 아포칼립스의 동물원을 만들어 보세요. 🌱 농사 이국적인 식물을 재배하고 작물이 익으면 수확하세요. 🏆 퍼즐 풀기 땅 위와 땅 속 고대인의 무덤 안의 퍼즐을 푸세요. 🎣 낚시 물 속의 교활하고 비늘로 뒤덮인 물고기를 잡아 보세요. 🍰 요리 맛있게 요리하여 영구 스탯과 어빌리티 업그레이드를 하세요. 🗿 풀기 이상한 섬의 비밀을 푸세요. 과거의 유적을 탐험하고 하이테크 시대의 기술을 발견하십시오. 가혹한 환경에서 기술적 우위를 점하십시오. 또는 깊은 곳으로 들어가 고대인의 숨겨진 무덤 속 방에서 고대의 잃어버린 지식을 복원하세요. 마법과도 같은 건물에서 재료를 얻어 아주 강력한 기어를 제작하세요. 알맞은 장비로 99%의 오브젝트를 부수어 재료로 사용할 수 있습니다. 시도하여 오래된 세계의 멋진 보물인 플라스틱, 고무, 금속을 수집하세요. 다양한 재료를 충분히 모을 수 있습니다. 레시피 를 찾아 영구 아이템과 업그레이드를 제작하세요 . 광대하고 섬세한 오픈 월드를 탐험하고 전초기지 를 지어 입지를 강화하세요. 땅을 구획별로 되찾으세요. 숨겨진 보물을 찾고 오래 전 잊혀진 퍼즐을 푸십시오. 섬을 탈출할 수단을 찾으세요. 종말 뒤의 세계는 사악한 생물들이 점령했습니다. 악한 무언가가 야생과 섬의 이전 인간 거주지 대부분에 영향을 주었고 공격적인 야수와 같은 생명체로 변모시켰습니다. 쓰러뜨리고 전리품을 수집하십시오. 장기를 수집해 영원한 안식 을 주십시오. 일단 도망친 뒤 강해져서 돌아와도 됩니다. 다양한 근접 및 원거리 무기로 싸우십시오. 트랩을 설치하여 몬스터를 끌어들이십시오. 수단과 방법을 가리지 마세요. 현 상황 을 유지하기 위해서만 싸우는 것이 아닙니다. 기아를 벗어나는 것이 목적인 게임이 아닙니다. 피할 수 없는 축복인 죽음만을 기다리며 꼬르륵대는 배를 채우기 위해 계속해서 맛있는 바퀴벌레 를 찾아서는 안 됩니다. 기아로 절대 죽지 않을 것입니다. 더욱 강해지고, 영원한 업그레이드 를 잠금 해제할 것입니다. 세상은 위험한 곳이므로 가끔씩 몇 발짝 물러서야 할 수도 있겠지만, 궁극적으로는 번영할 것입니다. 괴로우면서도 즐거운 포스트 아포칼립스를 즐기세요.
