detailed_descriptions.en: You are a prisoner sentenced to explore a derelict megastructure that sprawls deep beneath the surface of the mimic moon Luna. You are tasked with recovering forgotten technology from within the Abyss and the lost colony it consumed. Every move you make will be overseen by your artificial prison guard named Aylin. These centuries-old ruins are alive with maddening echoes, insinuating secrets of the once prosperous city of Greymont and its terrible fate. The Scourge. The tenets of the All-Father. The choir of the Collective. The voices of the Abyss call to you; they whisper strange missives... "Don’t be afraid, little wanderer. You need only go deeper, the better to be seen by us. The slumbering silent one breathes deep and waits. All we need is the key. All we need is you." Uncover the mysteries of the mimic moon, and the abyss within its depths. Come face to face with remnants of the colony’s downfall & discover your role within this doomed world. Learn all the secrets the abyss has to offer. Sprint, jump & dash your way through this brutalist alien megastructure. Experience fluid first-person platforming as you travel through Luna & the depths of the abyss. Face corrupted souls & twisted cosmic horrors of Luna Abyss with weapon in hand. Master your tools, adjust on the fly and survive in a bullet hell.

games.name: Lushfoil Photography Sim
games.short_description: A tranquil exploration and photography experience set across a vast selection of faithfully detailed landscapes.

descriptions.en: A tranquil exploration and photography experience set across a vast selection of faithfully detailed landscapes.

detailed_descriptions.en: Experience detailed, true-to-life recreations of beautiful and diverse locations around the world. Trek through and explore environments to capture stunning vistas and landscapes with your fully-featured in-game camera. Each environment is filled with objectives to reward players that have a good eye for angles and perspectives, and hidden secrets for those who are patient and observant. The rich atmosphere of Lushfoil Photography Sim is enhanced by an ambient, ethereal soundtrack featuring licensed music from artists around the world. Capture the Perfect Shot The in-game camera includes an abundance of settings that you'd expect from a real-world professional DSLR camera. The camera simulates settings such as Auto/Manual Focus, Flash, Exposure, Contrast, White Balance, Aperture, Burst Shot and other effects for full creative control over your photography. The game further provides tools that allow for manipulation of the environmental conditions for your photos, such as manual adjustment of light angles, fog, snow, wind, and rain. Off the Beaten Path Dive deeper into the game’s many locations to find unlockable cameras and experience the world from unique perspectives. Find a first-person drone that allows you to soar above the landscape and capture the world from above, or find a hidden rowboat that allows you to traverse still waters in pursuit of the perfect shot. Very Efficiently Optimised Each environment has been created in Unreal Engine 5 and is built from the ground up to be both efficiently optimized and showcase the game’s locations in stunning visual fidelity. There are extensive custom settings that will help the game run on a wide range of PCs, while taking full advantage of high-end graphics cards.

games.name: Mafia: The Old Country

names.ja: マフィア：オリジン ～裏切りの祖国

games.short_description: Uncover the origins of organized crime in Mafia: The Old Country, a gritty mob story set in the brutal underworld of 1900s Sicily. Fight to survive as Enzo Favara and prove your worth to the Family in this immersive third-person action-adventure.

descriptions.en: Uncover the origins of organized crime in Mafia: The Old Country, a gritty mob story set in the brutal underworld of 1900s Sicily. Fight to survive as Enzo Favara and prove your worth to the Family in this immersive third-person action-adventure.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 《四海兄弟：故鄉》講述的是以1900年代西西里殘酷地下世界為背景的寫實粗獷黑幫故事，為大家揭開組織犯罪的起源。在這令人沉醉的第三人稱動作冒險遊戲中，化身為恩佐·法瓦拉奮力求生，證明自己是夠格的家族成員。
descriptions.ja: 『マフィア：オリジン ～裏切りの祖国』で一大マフィア物語の起源に迫るー。これは、1900年代にシチリア島の闇社会で成り上がっていく一人の男の物語。没入感あふれる三人称視点アクションアドベンチャーで、主人公エンツォ・ファヴァーラとして生き残りをかけて戦い、裏社会で自身の価値を証明せよ。
descriptions.ko: 1900년대 시칠리아의 잔혹한 지하 세계를 배경으로 살아가는 근성으로 똘똘 뭉친 마피아 이야기, 마피아: 올드 컨트리에서 조직범죄의 탄생 비화를 알아보세요. 3인칭 몰입형 액션 어드벤처에서 엔조 파바라로서 살아남기 위해 싸우고 가족에게 나의 가치를 증명하세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: Uncover the origins of organized crime in Mafia: The Old Country, a gritty mob story set in the brutal underworld of 1900s Sicily. Fight to survive as Enzo Favara and prove your worth to the Family in this immersive third-person action-adventure set during a dangerous, unforgiving era. Enzo will do anything for a better life. After a brutal childhood of forced labor, he's ready to risk everything to become a man of honor in the Torrisi crime family. His oath to the Mafia, with all the power, temptation, and hardship it entails, is a burning reminder of this simple truth: Family Takes Sacrifice. This thrilling narrative is brought to life by stunning visuals, cinematic storytelling, and the authentic realism that the critically acclaimed Mafia series is known for. Enzo's story unfolds in a time when skill with a stiletto blade was a deadly asset, a lupara sawed-off shotgun was a go-to firearm, murderous vendettas raged for decades, and mafiosi patrolled their protection rackets on foot, horseback, or behind the wheel of turn-of-the-century motorcars. The rough-hewn beauty of Sicily's rugged countryside is a stark contrast to the grime of urban alleyways—but the treachery and violence of this gangland run just as deep. Rival families and their ruthless leaders wage unending turf wars in the shadows, hidden from the public eye. Trust is a fleeting rarity, and loyalties are worth killing for. You're the antihero of this thrilling 1900s story, living out every tense moment of Enzo's descent into Sicily’s clandestine criminal underworld. Come face-to-face with a cast of unpredictable allies and cutthroat enemies in this classic crime drama, rich in period-authentic details that will immerse you in this treacherous Mediterranean setting. Engage in life-or-death combat, be it up close with a blade or from afar with a variety of firearms. Ambush enemies for vicious stealth takedowns, or slice them up in close-quarters duels. If you prefer firearms, wield period-authentic handguns, rifles, and shotguns to overcome any odds and doggedly eliminate the Don's enemies. Traverse a wide range of Sicilian environments, from underground crypts and crumbling ruins to bountiful vineyards and ornate opera houses. To reach your next target or make a hurried getaway, you'll need to gallop on horseback across cobbled streets and open fields, or speed down dirt roads in authentic turn-of-the-century automobiles.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《四海兄弟：故鄉》講述的是以1900年代西西里殘酷地下世界為背景的寫實粗獷黑幫故事，為大家揭開組織犯罪的起源。在這令人沉醉的第三人稱動作冒險遊戲中，於危險無情的時代裡，化身為恩佐·法瓦拉奮力求生，證明自己是夠格的家族成員。 恩佐不惜一切只為了追求更好的生活。經歷過殘酷童年與強迫勞動的他，決心冒險一搏，試圖在托里西犯罪家族中出人頭地。 他對黑手黨的誓言，以及隨之而來的權力、誘惑和各種磨難，全都刻骨銘心地提醒著他一個簡單的真理： 家族全靠犧牲奉獻。 這段驚險刺激的故事將透過令人驚豔的視覺效果，電影等級的敘事手法，以及《四海兄弟》系列作品著名的逼真風格精彩呈現。恩佐的故事發生在這樣的時代裡：善耍彈簧刀是致命的本領、「獵槍」短管霰彈槍是首選武器、血腥復仇會延續數十年，黑手黨員靠著步行、騎馬，或駕駛世紀之交的汽車巡視他們的地盤。 西西里鄉村曠野的粗獷美感與城市小巷的骯髒污穢形成鮮明對比—但在這片幫派橫行的土地上，背叛與暴力同樣盤根錯節。在世人看不見的暗處，敵對家族及其冷血首領為了爭奪地盤不斷激戰。信任轉瞬即逝，忠誠值得為之殺戮。 在這個驚險刺激的1900年代故事中，你將化身為反派英雄，體驗恩佐踏入西西里祕密犯罪世界的每個緊張時刻。在這齣充滿寫實時代氛圍的經典犯罪戲碼中，你將置身於危機四伏的地中海環境裡，面對難以預料的盟友與心狠手辣的敵人。 參與生死攸關的戰鬥，無論是手持刀刃近身格鬥，還是使用各種槍枝遠距作戰。埋伏敵人發動致命的潛行擊殺，或在近身搏鬥中斬殺敵人。如果你更喜歡槍械，也能使用年代感十足的手槍、步槍和霰彈槍克服萬難，剷除老大的眾多敵人。 探索形形色色的西西里環境，從幽深的地下墓穴、殘破的遺跡，乃至於富饒的葡萄園和華麗的歌劇院。無論是前往下一個目標，還是匆忙逃離，你都需要騎著快馬穿越石板街道和開闊原野，或是駕駛逼真重現的世紀之交汽車疾馳在泥濘道路上。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 『マフィア：オリジン ～裏切りの祖国』で一大マフィア物語の起源に迫るー。これは、1900年代にシチリア島の闇社会で成り上がっていく一人の男の物語。没入感あふれる三人称視点アクションアドベンチャーで、主人公エンツォ・ファヴァーラとして生き残りをかけて戦い、裏社会で自身の価値を証明せよ。 エンツォは人間らしい生活を手に入れるためならば、どんなことも厭わない。奴隷労働を強いられた過酷な幼少期を経て、彼は犯罪組織トリージ・ファミリーで名を上げるために、すべてを賭ける覚悟を決めた。 エンツォはマフィアの血の掟に身を捧げる誓いを立て、あらゆる権力と苦難を受け入れていくのだった。だが、真実とは残酷なものー。 ”ファミリー”に、全てを捧げることができるのか。 このスリリングな物語は、美しいグラフィック、映画さながらのストーリー展開、そして高い評価を得た「マフィア」シリーズならではの圧倒的リアリズムによって描かれる。エンツォの生きる時代では、ナイフさばきが生死を分け、ルパラという散弾銃が主要な武器として普及し、数十年にわたる因縁が死体を積み上げていた。その合間をマフィアたちは闊歩し、時には馬や前世紀の自動車に乗って、みかじめ料を徴収していたのだ。 美しきシチリアの田舎街。しかし、都市部の汚れた路地とは対照的なこの地で起きる裏切りと暴力の闇は、都会のそれ以上に深いものだったー。ライバルのファミリーとその冷酷なリーダーたちは、世間の目が届かない闇の中で、終わりなき縄張り争いを繰り広げている。信頼が儚い過酷な世界で、命懸けの忠誠を示せ。 プレイヤーは1900年代のスリリングな物語のアンチヒーロー、エンツォとして、シチリアの裏社会に身を落としていく。その緊迫のシーンすべてをその手で体験せよ。このクラシックな犯罪ドラマでは、予測不可能な味方や冷酷な敵と対峙することになる。また、当時の雰囲気を細部まで忠実に再現しており、危険な地中海の舞台に没入することができる。 刃物を使った接近戦や、さまざまな銃器を使った遠距離戦など、生死をかけた戦いに身を投じよう。敵を待ち伏せして一気に仕留めるのか、接近戦の決闘で切り刻むのか。時代考証によってリアルに再現されたハンドガンやライフル、ショットガンなどあらゆる武器を使いこなし、次々に訪れる困難を乗り越え、ドンの敵を抹殺せよ。 地下の墓所や崩れかけた遺跡から、豊かなブドウ畑や豪華なオペラハウスまで、シチリアの美しい環境を横断しよう。次の目的地へ到達する、あるいは急いで逃走するために、石畳の道や広々とした野原を馬に乗って駆け抜けたり、20世紀初頭の自動車で未舗装の道路を疾走したりすることとなる。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 1900년대 시칠리아의 잔혹한 지하 세계를 배경으로 살아가는 근성으로 똘똘 뭉친 마피아 이야기, 마피아: 올드 컨트리에서 조직범죄의 탄생 비화를 알아보세요. 위험하고 무자비한 시대를 배경으로 펼쳐지는 3인칭 몰입형 액션 어드벤처에서 엔조 파바라로서 살아남기 위해 싸우고 가족에게 나의 가치를 증명하세요. 엔조는 더 나은 삶을 성취하기 위해서라면 무엇이든 할 준비가 되어 있습니다. 강제 노역을 해야 했던 잔혹한 어린 시절을 거쳐 이제 그는 토리시 범죄 조직의 '명예를 아는 사람'이 되는 데 모든 것을 걸었습니다. 마피아에 대한 그의 맹세와 여기에 동반되는 모든 힘과 유혹, 역경은 단 한 가지 명명백백한 진실을 가리킵니다. 가족은 서로를 위해 희생한다. 이 스릴 넘치는 이야기는 비평가들의 극찬을 받은 마피아 시리즈 특유의 눈부신 비주얼과 시네마틱한 스토리텔링, 실감 나는 현실주의를 통해 구현됩니다. 엔조의 이야기는 스틸레토 나이프를 다루는 기술이 치명적인 자산으로 여겨지고, 총신을 잘라낸 루파라식 산탄총이 주 총기로 활약하며, 피가 낭자한 복수가 수십 년간 이어지는, 마피아 조직원이 보호비를 걷기 위해 직접 걸어다니거나, 말이나 초창기의 자동차를 타고 다녔던 시절을 배경으로 펼쳐집니다. 시칠리아의 다듬어지지 않은 전원 지역의 투박한 아름다움은 배반과 폭력으로 점철된 이 범죄의 도시의 으슥한 뒷골목과 강렬한 대비를 이룹니다. 라이벌 조직과 이들의 인정사정없는 지도자는 대중의 눈을 피해 그림자 속에 서 끊임 없는 전쟁을 벌입니다. 신뢰는 갈수록 희귀해지고, 충성은 목숨보다 귀합니다. 이 스릴 넘치는 1900년대 이야기의 안티히어로가 되어 시칠리아의 은밀한 범죄 지하 세계에 몸을 담는 엔조의 모든 긴장 넘치는 순간을 직접 경험해 보세요. 시대를 반영한 디테일을 통해 위험천만한 지중해를 배경으로 놀라운 몰입감을 선사하는 이 전통 범죄 드라마에서 예측할 수 없는 동료와 잔혹한 적으로 이뤄진 캐스트와 정면으로 맞서세요. 칼을 들고 근접전을 벌이거나 다양한 총기를 사용하여 거리를 유지하며 목숨을 건 전투에 참여해 보세요. 적의 허를 찔러 은밀히 제압하거나, 2인 근접전에서 적을 난도질해 보세요. 총기를 더 선호한다면 시대를 반영한 이 시대에 흔히 쓰였던 권총과 소총, 산탄총을 쏴서 모든 확률을 극복하고 돈의 적을 조용히 처리하세요. 지하실과 무너져 가는 유적지, 풍성한 포도원, 정교한 오페라 하우스까지 다양한 시칠리아의 풍경을 마음껏 누비세요. 다음 목표에 접근하거나 서둘러서 도망칠 때 말을 타고 자갈이 깔린 거리나 광활한 평야를 달리거나, 시대를 반영한 세기 전환기 무렵의 자동차를 타고 비포장도로를 전력 질주하세요.

games.name: Make Way
games.short_description: Speed around loops, dart through train crossings, drift around helter skelters, and unleash wacky weaponry in this modern take on classic top-down multiplayer racing games such as Micro Machines and Mashed. The twist? You build the track.

descriptions.en: Speed around loops, dart through train crossings, drift around helter skelters, and unleash wacky weaponry in this modern take on classic top-down multiplayer racing games such as Micro Machines and Mashed. The twist? You build the track.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 進入這個現代版的由上至下多人競速經典遊戲，您可以邊繞圈子邊加速、衝過平交道、溜過迴旋滑梯，還能暢快地使用怪誕武器。而其中最大的特色是：賽道由您搭建。
descriptions.ja: ループを駆け抜け、踏切をくぐり、ヘルタースケルター（大型の滑り台）をドリフトしながら武器を相手にお見舞いしよう。そのコースを作るのは君だ！
descriptions.ko: 루프를 쌩하니 달리고, 기차 건널목을 쏜살같이 지나가고, 나선형 미끄럼틀에서 드리프트를 하고, 독특한 무기를 잠금 해제해, 현대적인 스타일의 클래식 탑다운 멀티플레이어 레이싱 게임을 즐겨 보세요. 반전이요? 트랙을 여러분이 직접 설계해야 합니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: Make Way is classic, top-down, multiplayer racing shifted up multiple gears. It's a party game at heart, inspired by the chaotic racing of Mashed and Micro Machines , and the course-building mayhem of Ultimate Chicken Horse . Grab track pieces from a pick n mix menu and snap them together to build your first course. Dodge hazards, unleash weaponry, and avoid falling off the edge in a chaotic rush to the finish line, then bolt on new track pieces for the next round. Scrap across ever-growing courses with increasingly perilous features until a winner is crowned before starting over with a brand-new course. Build your course Work together—or against one another—to quickly build tracks using a range of ridiculous pieces, including loops, seesaws, corkscrews, and even train crossings. Then add obstacles and power-ups. Ruin your friends’ race with a well-placed barrier or jettison them off the side of a curve with a crafty boost-pad. Blow up the competition Six racers jostle and shunt to cross checkpoints and reach the finish line. Obliterate opponents with a range of wacky weapons, including goo cannons and Tesla coils, but beware: each checkpoint acts as a respawn point and revenge is a dish best served via a giant mallet or rooftop-mounted shotgun… Keep on truckin’ The finish line isn’t the finish! Add new track pieces after each round to create monstrously large courses, and score bonus points with your performance to take home the trophy. Add to your collection Unlock new track pieces and hazards for more dangerous course designs. Add new vehicles to your garage to romp to victory in style. Key Features Mix and match unique track pieces and hazards for near-endless course configurations Fight for weapons and power-ups to gain the advantage Unlock new track pieces and vehicles for wackier races Up to six players, on the same screen or online with cross-platform multiplayer Toggle traps and safety barriers on or off to make those twisty turns easier (or more perilous!) using fully customisable rulesets Now includes the World Tour update, adding an additional eight vehicles, three track environments, Team Mode, and more! Make Way's solo developer previously worked on Toybox Turbos and the Micro Machines series.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《Make Way》是由上至下、可一次拉高多檔位的經典多人競速遊戲。 您可從混搭選單中挑選賽道零件，組合成第一處賽車場。競賽過程中必須閃避危險、解放武器，避免摔落邊緣，歷經紛亂的猛衝到達終點線，然後再為下一回合組合新的賽道。 一次又一次驚險闖過節節高升的難關，直到出現優勝者，接著再重新用全新賽道開始比拼。 自建賽道 玩家可共同合作，也可相互較量之下，用一系列誇張的零件（包括圈圈、蹺蹺板、開瓶器，甚至列車平交道）迅速地組合成賽道，再增添障礙物和強化物。可精心放置路障，或用狡猾的加速板把朋友拋出彎路，擾亂對方比賽。 炸飛競爭對手 六位賽車手挨挨碰碰地爭相通過關卡，搶先到達終點線。可用一連串奇特的武器除掉對手，包括黏呼呼砲彈和特斯拉線圈，但請注意：每個關卡都是重生點，要想復仇，還是靠巨槌或是架在屋頂的獵槍才算王道… 持續上路 到達終點線還不算結束！每回合結束後緊接著新增賽道零件，建立龐大的賽道，再以突出的表現奪得獎盃，領取紅利點數。 充實收藏內容 解鎖新賽道零件和危險物品，採行更凶險的設計。為車庫增添新車，歡喜雍容地奪冠。 主要特色 混搭獨特的賽道零件和危險物品，可建成的賽車場變化無窮 爭奪武器和強化，取得競爭優勢 解鎖新的賽道零件和車輛，展開特異的競速 支援多達六位玩家共享畫面同樂，或採用線上跨平台多人遊戲模式 利用完全可自訂的規則集，開啟或關閉陷阱和安全屏障，讓刁鑽的拐彎輕鬆些（或是更危險）。 現在加入了環球之旅更新內容、新增額外八款車輛、三個全新場景、團隊模式、還有更多！
detailed_descriptions.ja: "マルチプレイレーシングゲーム『Make Way』は、クラシックなトップダウン視点、かつ複数ギアのシフトチェンジが楽しめる。 メニュー画面でトラックピースを選び、組み合わせて最初のコースを作ろう。障害をかわし、武器を駆使し、コースから脱落しないように気をつけてゴールを目指せ。クリアすれば、次のラウンド用の新たなトラックピースが手に入る。 伸び続ける危険なコースを駆け抜け、勝負を決したら、また新しいコースがレーサー達を待ち受ける。 自分だけのコースを作ろう ループ、シーソー、コークスクリュー、踏切……様々なパーツを使って、みんなで協力＆反発したりしながらコースを作っていこう（コースは簡単にできるのでご心配なく）。コースには障害物やパワーアップアイテムも追加できる。バリアを巧みに配置して対戦相手を妨害したり、カーブからブーストパッドをお見舞いするのだ。 対戦相手をぶっ潰せ レースに参加するのは6人のレーサー。押し合いへし合いしながらチェックポイントを通過し、ゴール目指して突き進む。グーキャノンやテスラコイルなどの豪華な武器で相手をぶっ潰そう！……でも油断は禁物。各チェックポイントはリスポーン（復活）ポイントでもある。巨大な鉄槌をお見舞いされたり、屋上からショットガンが飛んでくることだってある。 ゴールを超えたら フィニッシュラインを超えても安心するべからず。まだ終わりじゃない！各ラウンドの後に新たなトラックピースを追加して出来上がった巨大なコースで素晴らしいパフォーマンスを披露し、ボーナスポイントを獲得すればトロフィーは君のものだ。 コレクションに追加しよう トラックピースや障害物をアンロックして、もっと危険なコースを作ってみよう。ガレージにレースカーを追加して、さらに勝ちまくれ。 主な機能 ユニークなトラックピースや障害物を組み合わせて、コースを作ろう。その組み合わせはほぼ無限大だ。 武器やパワーアップアイテムを上手に使って、対戦相手の先を行こう。 新たなトラックピース＆レースカーをアンロックすれば、より刺激的なレースが楽しめる。 最大6人での対戦が可能（同じ画面共有、またはクロスプラットフォームのマルチプレイでのオンライン対戦）。 トラップやセーフティバリアのオン/オフを切り替えることもできる。右へ左へ伸びる道をより簡単に（逆により危険に）カスタマイズしよう。 「ワールドツアー」アップデートを収録！新たに8台のマシン、3つのコース環境、チームモードなどが追加されています！
detailed_descriptions.ko: Make Way는 클래식한 탑다운 멀티플레이 레이싱 게임으로, 다양한 장비로 색다른 모습을 뽐낼 수 있습니다. 픽 앤 믹스 메뉴에서 트랙 아이템을 고르고 조립해 첫 코스를 만들어 보세요. 결승선까지 달려가는 정신없는 레이싱에서 위험물들을 피하고, 무기를 해제하고, 가장자리에서 떨어지는 것을 피하고 나면, 다음 라운드의 새로운 트랙 아이템을 조립할 수 있답니다. 점점 더 위험해지는 것들로 가득 찬 변화하는 코스에서 싸워 나가세요. 완전히 새로운 코스로 다시 시작하기 전에, 승자가 정해지기 전까지 말이죠. 코스를 직접 만드는 재미 함께 힘을 모으세요. 아님 서로 붙어 볼 수도 있죠. 그리고 고리, 시소, 코르크 따개, 심지어는 기차 건널목처럼 희한한 것들을 이용해 빠르게 트랙을 만들어보는 겁니다. 그리고 장애물과 강화 아이템을 추가하세요. 배리어를 잘 놓고 친구들의 레이스를 망쳐 보세요. 아니면 부스트 패드로 커브 구간에서 밀어 버릴 수도 있죠? 바퀴 터지는 경쟁 체크포인트를 통과하고 결승선에 도달하기 위해 6명의 레이서가 서로를 밀고 넘어뜨리기 위해 고군분투합니다. 점착 대포와 테슬라 코일과 같은 다양한 이상한 무기로 상대를 쓸어버리세요. 하지만 잊지 마세요. 각 체크포인트는 부활 지점이기도 하며, 거대한 망치나 지붕에 장착된 산탄총을 사용하여 복수를 할 수 있습니다! 결승선을 끊어도 레이싱은 계속 결승선은 완전한 끝이 아닙니다! 각 라운드가 끝나고 새로운 트랙 아이템을 추가해 무시무시하게 커다란 코스를 만들고, 놀라운 퍼포먼스를 선보여 보너스 점수를 따내 트로피를 가져가세요. 컬렉션에 더하는 재미 새로운 트랙 아이템과 위험물을 잠금 해제하고 더 위험한 코스를 설계하세요. 차고에 새로운 차량을 추가해서 스타일리시하게 승리를 낚아 보세요. 주요 컨텐츠 유니크한 트랙 아이템과 위험물을 믹스 앤 매치해 거의 무한에 가깝게 다양한 코스를 설계할 수 있습니다 무기와 강화 아이템을 향해 싸우고 유리한 위치를 선점하세요 새로운 트랙 아이템과 차량을 잠금 해제해 괴상한 레이스를 즐겨 보세요 크로스 플랫폼 멀티플레이로 최대 6인까지 같은 화면에서, 또는 온라인에서 플레이할 수 있습니다 사용자 설정 가능한 룰셋으로 트랩 및 안전 배리어를 켜거나 끌 수 있어 정신없는 레이스를 더 쉽게(아니면 더 위험천만하게!) 즐길 수 있습니다 이제 월드 투어 업데이트가 포함되어 8대의 차량, 3개의 트랙 환경, 팀 모드 등이 추가되었습니다!

games.name: MakeRoom
games.short_description: Build rooms, gardens, and camper vans with 1,100+ objects and the ability to make your own furniture from scratch. Learn with gentle design requests, then relax and create at your own pace.

descriptions.en: Build rooms, gardens, and camper vans with 1,100+ objects and the ability to make your own furniture from scratch. Learn with gentle design requests, then relax and create at your own pace.

detailed_descriptions.en: MakeRoom is an adorable sandbox building game. Start with a few gentle design requests to learn the ropes, or jump straight into freeform building with more than 1,100 objects and the ability to create your own custom furniture. What will you make? Whether it's a cozy room for cats, a moody hideaway for a vampire, or a compact camper van, the choice is yours! Start with a few simple, guided requests Dive right in with gentle design requests to discover MakeRoom 's tools and extensive furniture catalog. Get inspired by the cozy, cute, and weird variety of gentle design requests on MakeRoom Island. Customize everything with powerful design tools Start with four different settings for your diorama: Room, Camper, Boat, or Garden. Use powerful design tools to create your own custom furniture from scratch. Move, rotate, resize, and recolor objects to your heart's content. Add the finishing touches with dozens of backgrounds, environments, and even ambient sound options. Dazzle the MakeRoom community with your creations Snap beautiful photos with filters and visual effects like tilt shift, share your creations with other players via Steam Workshop, and discover secret codes to unlock even more objects. There are 6,000+ creations to explore! Features Learn through gentle guided requests or dive straight into freeform design with 1,100+ objects Create your own custom furniture from scratch Share your creations with beautiful screenshots and Steam Workshop integration Make messes or clean them up with tools like a mop, duster, or vacuum cleaner Add furry friends to your dioramas with the “Pets” category

games.name: Maneater
games.short_description: Experience the ultimate power fantasy as the apex predator of the seas - a giant Shark! Terrorize the coastal waterways. Tear swimmers and divers limb from limb, give the humans a reason to fear you!

descriptions.en: Experience the ultimate power fantasy as the apex predator of the seas - a giant Shark! Terrorize the coastal waterways. Tear swimmers and divers limb from limb, give the humans a reason to fear you!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 化身巨型鯊魚，體驗頂級掠食者稱霸海洋的終極力量！在沿海水路製造恐慌。撕咬肢解泳客與潛水客的肢體，他們才有理由怕你！
descriptions.ja: 大海原の頂点捕食者であるジャイアントシャークとなり、究極のパワーファンタジーを体験しよう！沿岸海域を恐怖に陥れよう。スイマーやダイバーを八つ裂きにし、人間たちを恐怖で震え上がらせろ！
descriptions.ko: 바다의 최상위 포식자인 거대 상어가 되어 강력한 힘을 느껴보세요! 해변을 공포로 몰아넣으세요. 수영을 즐기는 사람들과 다이버들을 갈갈이 찢어버리고 인간들에게 공포를 심어주세요!

detailed_descriptions.en: Become a MANEATER Experience the ultimate power fantasy as the apex predator of the seas - a terrifying SHARK! Maneater is a single player, open world action RPG (ShaRkPG) where YOU are the shark. Starting as a small shark pup you are tasked with surviving the harsh world while eating your way up the ecosystem. To do this you will explore a large and varied open world encountering diverse enemies - both human and wildlife. Find the right resources and you can grow and evolve far beyond what nature intended, allowing the player to tailor the shark to their play style. This is fortunate, because to get revenge on the cruel fisherman that dismembered you will take evolving into a massive shark, an apex predator of legends. Eat. Explore. Evolve. Unique Story Play through a full narrative, story-based campaign narrated by Chris Parnell (Rick and Morty, Saturday Night Live, 30 Rock) and set against the backdrop of a reality TV show. Diverse, Compelling Combat Battle fierce wildlife including other apex predators or fight against various types of human hunters ranging from town drunks all the way up to the Coast Guard. Evolve Into a Legend Feed on humans and wildlife to grow your shark, and find shark loot to evolve your shark down multiple possible paths. Explore the Gulf 7 large regions including bayous of the gulf coast, resort beaches, industrial docks, the open ocean and more. Experience a living world with a full day/night cycle.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 成為食人鯊 化身恐怖的鯊魚，體驗頂級掠食者稱霸海洋的終極力量！《Maneater》是單人，開放世界動作角色扮演遊戲（ShaRkPG），遊戲中你就是那隻鯊魚。從小小的幼鯊開始，你的任務就是要在險惡的世界中求生存，同時一步步在生態系中進食茁壯。要達到這個目標，你必須探索浩瀚多樣的開放世界，對抗各式各樣的敵人，不論是人類亦或是野生生物。找到正確的資源，你就能成長、進化，遠遠超越天生的限制，讓玩家能根據他們的遊戲風格訂製鯊魚。所幸，為了要報復殘酷至極的漁夫，你將進化成一條巨型鯊魚，成為傳說中的頂級掠食者。進食。探索。進化。 獨特的劇情 由克里斯帕內爾（作品：《瑞克和莫蒂》、《週六夜現場》、《超級製作人》）講述完整故事情節，並以實境秀節目為背景。 多變又引人入勝的戰鬥 與其他頂級掠食者等等的兇猛野生動物對抗，或是反擊各種類型的人類獵人，包括城裡的醉漢和海岸巡防隊。 化身傳奇 靠著餵食人類與野生動物，讓你的鯊魚成長茁壯；尋找鯊魚戰利品，讓你的鯊魚沿著各種可能的路徑達成進化。 探索墨西哥灣 7大地區包括墨西哥灣沿岸的海灣地區、渡假海灘、工業碼頭、開放的大洋等等。體驗晝夜循環不息的活躍世界。
detailed_descriptions.ja: Maneaterになろう 泣く子も黙るサメになり、大海原の頂点捕食者として究極のパワーファンタジーを体験しよう！「Maneater 」は、サメとなって暴れまわる、シングルプレイのオープンワールドアクションRPG(ShaRkPG)ゲームです。小さな小サメから始まり、生態系の頂点を目指しながら、厳しい世界の中で生き残りを懸け、獲物を食べていくことになります。その目標を達成するため、あなたは広大で様々な開けた世界を探索し、人間や野生動物といった色々な敵と遭遇します。正しい資源を見つければ、自然に与えられた以上の姿へ成長し、進化していくことが可能です。これにより、プレイヤーが独自のプレイスタイルに合わせてサメを作り上げていくことが可能になります。自分をバラバラにした意地悪な漁師に復讐を果たすには、伝説の頂点捕食者である巨大なサメに進化する必要があるため、この機能は非常に役立ちます。食べて、捜索して、進化しよう。 ユニークなストーリー Chris Parnell (Saturday Night Live、30 Rock、Rick and Morty)がナレーションを担当して物語の全編を語っていくストーリーモードで、リアリティー番組の背景風のプレイを楽しみましょう。 多様かつ印象的な戦闘 他の頂点捕食者を含む獰猛な野生動物と戦うか、町の酔っぱらいから沿岸警備隊まで、様々な種類の人間のハンターを相手にバトルを繰り広げましょう。 伝説に進化しよう 人間や野生動物を餌食とし、サメを育て、いくつもの可能性の中でサメを進化させるために、戦利品を見つけていきましょう。 湾岸を探索しよう 7つの広大な地域には、メキシコ湾岸、リゾートビーチ、産業用ドック、外洋などのバイユーが含まれています。完全な日中/夜間サイクルで、生き生きとした世界を体験しましょう。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 식인상어가 되어보세요 바다의 최상위 포식자인 무서운 상어가 되어 강력한 힘을 느껴보세요! Maneater는 식인상어가 되어 플레이하는 싱글 플레이어 오픈 월드 액션 RPG(ShaRkPG) 게임입니다. 작은 새끼 상어로 시작해서 생태계의 많은 것들은 차근차근 먹어치우며 험한 세상 속에서 살아남는 것이 임무죠. 살아남기 위해서는 인간과 야생동물, 다양한 적을 마주하며 넓은 세계를 탐험해야만 합니다. 적당한 자원을 찾아서 자연적인 크기를 훨씬 넘어 성장하고 진화하세요. 플레이어가 자기만의 플레이 스타일로 상어를 조정할 수 있습니다. 잔인한 낚시꾼에게 복수하기 위해서는 전설의 최상위 포식자, 거대한 상어로 진화해야 하기 때문에 이런 점은 정말 행운입니다. 먹고, 탐험하고, 진화하세요. 개성 있는 스토리 SNL, 30 Rock, Rick and Morty의 크리스 파넬이 나레이션을 담당한 스토리 기반 캠페인 모드를 플레이하세요. 리얼리티 TV 쇼의 배경이 아닌, 주인공이 되는 겁니다. 다양하고 매력적인 전투 다른 최상위 포식자를 포함한 맹렬한 야생동물, 아니면 도시의 주정꾼부터 해안경비대에 이르기까지 다양한 유형의 인간 사냥꾼을 상대로 전투를 벌이세요. 전설로 진화하세요 사람과 야생동물을 먹어치워 상어를 자라게 하고, 다양한 상어 진화 패턴의 루트를 찾아보세요. 걸프 만을 탐험하세요 멕시코 연안의 지류와 리조트 해변, 산업용 부두, 외해 등 7곳의 지역을 탐험해보세요. 살아있는 세계의 밤과 낮을 경험해보세요.

games.name: Maneater: Truth Quest
games.short_description: Unlock the mystery of Plover Island in Truth Quest, a DLC expansion to the hit "ShaRkPG," Maneater. A new predator threatens your apex status—grow bigger and evolve further to assert your dominance!

descriptions.en: Unlock the mystery of Plover Island in Truth Quest, a DLC expansion to the hit "ShaRkPG," Maneater. A new predator threatens your apex status—grow bigger and evolve further to assert your dominance!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 热门「ShaRkPG」《Maneater》的DLC扩展《真理探索》中，揭开千鳥島的秘密。一種全新的掠食者正威脅著你頂級掠食者的地位 – 去長得更大、進化得更強，維護自己的主宰地位吧！
descriptions.ja: 大人気サメアクションRPG (ShaRkPG) Maneaterの拡張DLC「真実クエスト」でチドリ島の謎を解き明かしましょう。頂点捕食者の座を脅かす新たな捕食者が現れました。圧倒的優位性を誇示するために、より大きく成長し、さらなる進化を遂げましょう！
descriptions.ko: 大人気サメアクションRPG (ShaRkPG) Maneaterの拡張DLC「真実クエスト」でチドリ島の謎を解き明かしましょう。頂点捕食者の座を脅かす新たな捕食者が現れました。圧倒的優位性を誇示するために、より大きく成長し、さらなる進化を遂げましょう！

detailed_descriptions.en: DISCOVER THE TRUTH! Escape the net and explore Plover Island to unlock its mysteries! Maneater: Truth Quest is a DLC expansion to the smash hit single-player, open-world “ShaRkPG,” Maneater. The shark has survived a PT boat explosion only to discover that a new, extremely powerful predator has moved in to threaten her apex status. You must venture out to new waters to discover the mystery of Plover Island as you grow bigger and evolve further to take back the title of apex predator. Experience a new story - Play through a new full narrative, story-based expansion as Trip Westhaven (Chris Parnell; SNL, 30 Rock, Rick and Morty) is back to narrate, having now been relegated to the online video streaming platform “ViewTube.” Explore the Plover Island Military Complex - The mysterious naval base nicknamed “Site P” has long been the subject of wild speculation. Now, you’ll infiltrate the facility to find out the real story. Fight new evolved creatures – Battle fierce wildlife including new evolved apex predators as you battle your way up the food chain to regain your regional dominance. Add new evolutions to your arsenal – Feed on military personnel and evolved wildlife to grow your shark further, and find new evolutions to gain more powerful abilities.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 揭开真相！ 拨开重重迷雾，探索千鸟岛，揭开它的神秘面纱！《Maneater:Truth Quest》是风靡一时的单人开放世界“鲨鱼RPG”游戏——《Maneater》的DLC扩展。一条鲨鱼在PT艇爆炸事故中幸存下来，但它发现一种从未见过的极为强大的掠食者正在威胁它的顶级掠食者的地位。你必须探索新的水域，揭开千鸟岛的神秘面纱，并且随着自己的成长和进化逐渐夺回顶级掠食者的称号。 体验全新的故事 - 游戏中贯穿全新的故事情节，崔普·韦斯特海文（克里斯·帕内尔；《周六夜现场》、《我为喜剧狂》、《瑞克和莫蒂》）的又一力作，现已整合到在线视频流媒体平台——"ViewTube"。 探索千鸟岛军事设施 - 被昵称作“P地点”的神秘海军基地长时间以来一直吸引外界对它天马行般的猜测。现在，你要渗透进入这座设施，揭示其背后隐藏的真相。 对抗进化后的新生物 - 通过与凶残的野生生物（包括进化后的新顶级掠食者）战斗回到食物链的顶端，并且重夺该区域的支配权。 为你的军械库添加新的进化形态 - 以军事人员和进化的野生生物为食，使你的鲨鱼进一步成长并找到新的进化形态，从而获得更多令人畏惧的能力。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 真実を見つけ出せ！ 網から逃れチドリ島を探索し、その実態を暴こう！「Maneater:Truth Quest」は、 大ヒットしたシングルプレイのオープンワールドアクションRPG『Maneater』の拡張DLC。PTボートの爆発から生き延びたサメは、頂点捕食者としての自分の地位を脅かす、超強力な捕食者が新たに現れたことに気づいた。頂点捕食者としての地位を再び確立するには、新たな海域へ進み、より大きく成長して進化し、チドリ島の実態を調査しなければならない。 新たなストーリーを体験し、完全に新しい物語をプレイしよう。オンライン動画配信プラットフォーム「ViewTube」を立ち上げた、トリップ・ウェストヘブン（Chris Parnell、「Saturday Night Live」、「30 Rock」、「Rick and Morty」)が再びナレーターを務める拡張ストーリー。 チドリ島軍事施設を調査しよう！長年にわたって、「チドリ施設」とも呼ばれる謎の海軍基地について様々な憶測が飛び交っていた。このチドリ施設に潜入し、その実態を解き明かそう。 新たな進化を遂げたクリーチャーと戦おう！海域の支配権を取り戻すため、新しい頂点捕食者など、どう猛な野生動物たちと弱肉強食の戦いを繰り広げよう。 新たな進化スタイルが追加！軍人や進化した野生動物を餌にサメを成長させ、新たな進化を成し遂げて、より強力な能力を手に入れよう。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 진실을 발견하세요! 그물을 뚫고 탈출하여 플로버 섬을 탐험하며 미스터리를 풀어보세요! Maneater: Truth Quest는 초유의 히트작인 싱글 플레이어 오픈 월드 “샤크 RPG” Maneater의 DLC입니다. PT 보트 폭발에서 살아남은 상어는 자신의 최상위 포식자 지위를 위협하는 새롭고 강력한 포식자를 만나게 됩니다. 새로운 바다를 누비며 플로버 섬에 얽힌 미스터리를 풀고, 최상위 포식자의 자리를 되찾기 위해 더 크고 흉폭하게 진화하세요. 새로운 스토리 - 새로운 전체 스토리를 플레이하세요. 이 스토리 기반 확장팩에서 트립 웨스트헤이븐(Chris Parnell; SNL, 30 Rock, Rick and Morty 출연)이 다시 나레이터로 출연하여 온라인 비디오 스트리밍 플랫폼인 "ViewTube" 방송을 진행합니다. 플로버 섬 군사 기지 탐험 - 일명 'P 지역'이라고 불리는 의문의 해군 기지는 다양한 소문의 대상이 되는 곳이기도 합니다. 이제 시설을 침투하여 여기 얽힌 진짜 스토리를 알아내세요. 새롭게 진화한 크리처와의 전투 - 진화하여 새로운 최상위 포식자 자리에 올라선 무시무시한 야생 동물들과 싸우며 먹이 사슬 꼭대기로 오르고 지역의 지배자가 되세요. 새로 추가된 무기 - 군인들과 진화한 야생 동물들을 먹어치우며 상어를 더 크게 키우고, 새로운 진화를 하며 더 많은 능력을 획득하세요.

games.name: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion
games.short_description: A cosmic battle awaits! Choose between 15 Marvel Super Heroes in this frenetic action beat ‘em up to fight against the deadly Annihilation Wave threatening the galaxy. From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the future of the Marvel Universe will be fought for across the stars!

descriptions.en: A cosmic battle awaits! Choose between 15 Marvel Super Heroes in this frenetic action beat ‘em up to fight against the deadly Annihilation Wave threatening the galaxy. From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the future of the Marvel Universe will be fought for across the stars!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 一場宇宙規模的大戰即將爆發！從15名漫威英雄當中挑選出戰角色，在這款令人眼花撩亂的清板動作遊戲中對抗威脅銀河的致命滅絕浪潮。從紐約市一直到負空間的最深處，這場攸關漫威宇宙存續的大戰將橫跨群星！
descriptions.ja: 宇宙規模の激戦が幕を開ける！15人のMARVELのスーパーヒーローたちと共に、恐るべき勢いで銀河を脅かす「アナイアレーション・ウェーブ」に立ち向かえ。ニューヨーク市からネガティブ・ゾーンの深部まで、MARVEL Universeの未来をかけた壮絶な戦いが、宇宙の至るところで繰り広げられる！
descriptions.ko: 폭풍 같은 벨트스크롤 액션으로 펼쳐지는 범우주적 대격전! 무시무시한 기세로 은하계를 위협하는 어나일레이션 웨이브에 맞서, 15인의 마블 히어로와 함께 싸우세요. 뉴욕에서 네거티브 존의 심부까지, 마블 유니버스의 미래를 건 대격전이 우주 곳곳에서 펼쳐집니다!

detailed_descriptions.en: Tribute Games and Dotemu are teaming up again, in collaboration with Marvel Games, to craft an original, fresh beat 'em up. Featuring dynamic combat combos and dazzling pixel art, this planet-hopping adventure stands as a love letter to the Marvel Universe. So swears Annihilus, the living death that walks! After an unprecedented attack is launched across the galaxy, all life hangs in the balance. From New York City to the depths of the Negative Zone, the future of the Universe will be fought for across the stars in MARVEL Cosmic Invasion ! Spider-Man, Wolverine, She-Hulk, Captain America, Phoenix, Black Panther, Storm and Iron Man, some of the most powerful earth-born Marvel Super Heroes, are ready to face the threat. But they won't be alone! Galactic Super Heroes Rocket Raccoon, Beta Ray Bill, Venom, Cosmic Ghost Rider, Nova, Phyla-Vell and the Silver Surfer enter the battle as well to complete the relentless line-up. All will join forces in a star-spanning brawling adventure against the deadly Annihilation Wave. Whether you’re an old-school expert or a first-time fan, you’ll find familiar faces and discover new favorites in a captivating roster of characters from across the Marvel Universe! With the Cosmic Swap tag-team system, choose two Super Heroes for each level and switch between them instantly. Create unique combos and powerful special attacks. Each character’s abilities encourage creative team-ups and a more tactical approach to the action. MARVEL Cosmic Invasion is a tribute to one of Marvel’s most iconic eras, with stunning full-color pixel art designs. Whether you're teaming up with friends or family, MARVEL Cosmic Invasion has you covered with local/online play and a drop-in/drop-out adaptive system. A cosmic battle awaits!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: Tribute Games與Dotemu再次聯手出擊，與Marvel Games合作打造了這款讓人耳目一新的獨特清板動作遊戲。結合了流暢又多變的戰鬥連技與色彩繽紛的像素美術風格，這場星間冒險堪稱是寫給漫威宇宙的一封情書。 死亡的象徵──殲滅者如此宣言！ 一場史無前例的侵略直指銀河彼端，宇宙所有生命都已危在旦夕。 在漫威宇宙入侵當中，這場攸關宇宙存續的大戰將橫跨群星，從紐約市直到負空間的最深處！ 蜘蛛人、金鋼狼、女浩克、美國隊長、暴風女、黑豹、暴風女與鋼鐵人——這些地球上最強大的漫威超級英雄已整裝待發。 但他們並非孤軍奮戰！來自宇宙的超級火箭浣熊、貝塔·雷·比爾、猛毒、惡靈戰警、新星、菲拉·維爾以及銀色衝浪手也將加入戰局，共同組成夢幻英雄聯軍。 全體英雄將並肩參與星際大混戰，直面致命威脅——湮滅波。 不論你是能夠引經據典的老朋友，還是初來乍到的新粉絲，都能在這份橫跨漫威宇宙的迷人名單中找到熟悉的面孔，並且進一步挖掘出角色嶄新的魅力！ 透過宇宙切換拍檔系統，你將在每個關卡挑選兩名超級英雄，並且能夠瞬間互相切換。創造獨特連技與強大的特殊攻擊。每一名角色的能力都能在充滿創意的組隊後為你帶來驚喜，也為本作的動作要素增添了更多戰略性。 漫威宇宙入侵擁有令人驚嘆的彩色像素美術風格，也是對那段漫威黃金時代的致敬。 漫威宇宙入侵支援單機/線上遊玩，並且具有能夠隨時加入/離開的彈性系統，不論你想要與朋友或是家人並肩作戰，都能夠輕鬆實現。 一場宇宙規模的大戰即將爆發！
detailed_descriptions.ja: Tribute GamesとDotemuがチームアップし、Marvel Gamesとのコラボレーションで、新鮮でオリジナリティあふれるベルトスクロールアクションを提供。ダイナミックな格闘コンボや美麗なドット絵を豊富に含むこの星を跨ぐ大冒険は、マーベルユニバースへの愛が溢れている。 歩く死の権化、アニヒラスはそう誓う！ 前代未聞の攻撃が銀河中を襲い、全生命が危機に晒された。 MARVEL Cosmic Invasion では、ニューヨークからネガティブ・ゾーンの奥地までが戦場だ。全宇宙の運命は、この星を跨ぐ戦争にかかっている！ スパイダーマン、ウルヴァリン、シー・ハルク、キャプテン・アメリカ、フェニックス、ブラックパンサー、ストーム、そしてアイアンマンまで。地球を代表するMARVELのスーパーヒーローたちが悪を打ち砕くために集まった。 彼らを助けてくれる心強い仲間たちにも出会える！強力な宇宙出身のヒーローたちも参戦し、豪華なラインナップが完成した。ロケット・ラクーン、ベータ・レイ・ビル、ヴェノム、コズミック・ライダー、ノヴァ、フィラ・ヴェル、そしてシルバーサーファーが一緒に戦ってくれる。 このヒーローたちは力を合わせて宇宙を駆け回り、強力な「アナイアレーション・ウェーブ」の侵攻に立ち向かう。 昔からのマーベルガチ勢でも、まったく新しいファンでも楽しめる！マーベルユニバースの隅々から到来するこの迫真的なラインアップで、馴染みのある顔ぶれとしてプレイしたり、新たなお気に入りヒーローを発見することもできるはず！ レベルごとに2人のスーパーヒーローを選び、即座に切り替えながら行うコズミック・スワップのタッグチームシステム」を導入。自分だけのコンボを組み立て、強力な特殊攻撃を繰り出そう。各キャラクターの能力は、個性豊かなチーム構成と戦略的なスタイルを活かしたアクションを存分に楽しめるよう設計されている。 MARVEL Cosmic Invasion は今までのマーベル史にリスペクトを示すため、美しいフルカラーのドット絵で描かれる。 MARVEL Cosmic Invasion はオンライン／ローカルマルチに対応しており、途中参加や途中退場システムを搭載しているため、友達でも家族でも、誰とプレイしても楽しめる。 宇宙規模の闘いが、今はじまる！
detailed_descriptions.ko: Marvel Games의 협력하에 Tribute Games와 Dotemu가 다시 한번 손잡고 만든 마블 유니버스로의 러브레터! 다이내믹한 컴뱃 콤보와 현란한 픽셀 아트, 행성을 오가는 모험 활극이 앙상블을 이뤄, 전혀 새로운 감각으로 완성된 벨트스크롤 액션 게임을 만나 보세요! 죽음 그 자체가 현현한 존재 '어나일러스'는 그렇게 맹세했습니다. 전례 없는 범우주적 대침공에 모든 생명체는 존망의 기로에 놓이고 말았고... 뉴욕에서 네거티브 존의 심부까지, 마블 유니버스의 미래를 건 대격전이 MARVEL Cosmic Invasion 의 우주 곳곳에서 펼쳐집니다! 스파이더맨, 울버린, 쉬-헐크, 캡틴 아메리카, 피닉스, 블랙 팬서, 스톰, 그리고 아이언맨까지. 지구를 대표하는 Marvel 슈퍼 히어로들이 악을 응징하기 위해 뭉쳤습니다. 이들을 도와줄 든든한 동료도 만나보세요! 강력한 우주 출신 히어로들도 참전하여 막강한 라인업을 이룹니다. 로켓 라쿤, 베타 레이 빌, 베놈, 코스믹 고스트 라이더, 노바, 파일라-벨, 그리고 실버 서퍼가 함께합니다. 이 히어로들은 힘을 모아 우주를 가로지르며 강력한 어나일레이션 웨이브의 침공에 맞서 싸웁니다. 마블 마니아는 물론, 처음으로 팬이 된 분까지 한눈에 사로잡을 매력적인 캐릭터를 마블 유니버스 전체에서 엄선했습니다. 익숙한 히어로와 함께하거나, 새로운 최애를 발견해 보세요! 레벨마다 슈퍼 히어로 둘을 선택하여, 즉각적으로 교체하며 진행하는 '코스믹 스왑 태그팀 시스템'을 도입했습니다. 나만의 콤보를 만들고 강력한 특수 공격을 구사하세요. 각 캐릭터의 능력은 개성 넘치는 팀 구성과 전략적 색깔이 더해진 액션을 만끽할 수 있도록 구성되었습니다. 현란한 풀컬러 픽셀 아트 디자인으로 꾸며진 MARVEL Cosmic Invasion 은 마블을 대표하는 연대 중 하나에 보내는 헌사입니다! MARVEL Cosmic Invasion 은 로컬/온라인 멀티 플레이와 드롭 인/드롭 아웃 시스템을 제공하여, 친구나 가족과 손쉽게 즐길 수 있습니다. 범우주적 대격전이 펼쳐집니다!

games.name: Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite
games.short_description: The epic clash between two storied universes returns with Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite. Ultron Sigma has begun the eradication of all biological life. Against all odds, heroes stand together against the ultimate threat, their only hope laying with the all-powerful Infinity Stones.

descriptions.en: The epic clash between two storied universes returns with Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite. Ultron Sigma has begun the eradication of all biological life. Against all odds, heroes stand together against the ultimate threat, their only hope laying with the all-powerful Infinity Stones.

detailed_descriptions.en: GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW The epic clash between two storied universes returns with Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite , the next era of the highly revered action-fighting game series. Marvel and Capcom universes collide like never before as iconic characters team up for action-packed player-versus-player combat. Imagined and created through a shared vision between the two companies, Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite will feature a variety of exciting and accessible single player modes and rich multi-player content for new players and longtime fans alike. In addition to single player Arcade, Training and Mission modes, a visually stunning and immersive cinematic Story Mode will put players at the center of both universes as they battle for survival against a sinister new threat, Ultron Sigma. Marvel vs. Capcom: Infinite is being built to highlight a combination of iconic locations and fan favorite characters from both universes, including Captain Marvel and Iron Man from the Marvel side, and Ryu and Mega Man X from Capcom. GAMEPLAY FEATURES Reborn Rivalries: Universes collide once again in this all-new crossover clash for the ages, where players select their favorite Marvel and Capcom characters and engage in accessible and free-form 2v2 team battles, which allow for new gameplay dynamics never-before-seen in the franchise. Infinite Power: Choose one of the six powerful Infinity Stones from the Marvel Universe to influence the outcome of battle. Each Infinity Stone will customize characters with unique abilities and powerful game-changing effects that can quickly turn the tide of battle. Iconic Heroes: More characters join the announce roster (Captain Marvel, Iron Man, Captain America, Ryu, Mega Man X and Morrigan) in the battle for survival, including Hulk, Thor, Hawkeye, Rocket Raccoon, Chun-Li, Strider Hiryu, Chris Redfield and Ultron, bringing the current roster up to 14 characters with more to be revealed in the future. Cinematic Story: The Marvel and Capcom universes collide as heroes and villains battle together to save their merged worlds from a sinister new threat, Ultron Sigma. A combination of the robotic foes known as Ultron from the Marvel Universe and Sigma from the Capcom Universe, this psychotic villain is obsessed with infecting all organic life with a cybernetic virus. History’s greatest gathering of warriors must now unite to fight back against Ultron Sigma and save their newly formed world. Accessible Single Player Content: In addition to the cinematic story experience, players can hone their skills in a variety of accessible single player modes, including Training, Mission, and Arcade modes. Vast Multiplayer Features: Robust online modes and content including ranked and casual matches, global leaderboards, and online lobbies with spectator mode deepen the overall experience.

descriptions.en: Max Payne is a man with nothing to lose in the violent, cold urban night. A fugitive undercover cop framed for murder, hunted by cops and the mob, Max is a man with his back against the wall, fighting a battle he cannot hope to win. Prepare for pain…

detailed_descriptions.en: Max Payne is a man with nothing to lose in the violent, cold urban night. A fugitive undercover cop framed for murder, hunted by cops and the mob, Max is a man with his back against the wall, fighting a battle he cannot hope to win. Max Payne is a relentless story-driven game about a man on the edge, fighting to clear his name while struggling to uncover the truth about his slain family amongst a myriad of plot-twists and twisted thugs in the gritty bowels of New York during the century's worst blizzard. The groundbreaking original cinematic action-shooter, Max Payne introduced the concept of Bullet Time® in videogames. Through its stylish slow-motion gunplay combined with a dark and twisted story, Max Payne redefined the action-shooter genre.

games.name: MAZEBOUND: Hunt, Gather, Run!
games.short_description: In this survival horror, you're surrounded by sea and a towering gate ahead. Walk into the maze, hunt, gather, and run to survive, alone or with friends. Remember: You're not the only one starving...

descriptions.en: In this survival horror, you're surrounded by sea and a towering gate ahead. Walk into the maze, hunt, gather, and run to survive, alone or with friends. Remember: You're not the only one starving...

detailed_descriptions.en: With boundless sea at your back and a towering gate ahead, you have no choice but to walk into the maze. Hunt, gather, and run to survive, alone or with friends. In this survival horror, you're not the only one watching. You're not the only one starving. Find Your Own Way No one is waiting around the corner to guide you. The only allies are the ones you bring: your friends. So choose wisely, plan carefully, and think outside the box. Tear branches for torches. Break crates for scraps. Build crude defenses, light your path, and hold your ground when the maze closes in. Everything you carry, you earned. Gather and Endure Just because it’s quiet or the view looks good doesn’t mean it’s safe. Craft weapons from wood, stone, and scrap to defend yourself. Hunt for food, light fires, pick berries, and collect anything that helps you survive. Do not linger in one spot for too long... Face What Haunts You The maze isn’t empty. It's alive. You'll encounter twisted beings shaped by hunger, curiosity, or something worse. Some like to crawl. Some like to wait. Some mimic what once was human. You have to keep moving. No. Matter. What.

games.name: MechWarrior 5: Clans
games.short_description: In MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS, players become new Smoke Jaguar pilots in the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. Lead a five-mech "Star" squad across diverse planets, engaging in an expansive campaign with immersive gameplay and intricate combat. Customize BattleMechs and explore strategic options.

descriptions.en: In MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS, players become new Smoke Jaguar pilots in the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere. Lead a five-mech "Star" squad across diverse planets, engaging in an expansive campaign with immersive gameplay and intricate combat. Customize BattleMechs and explore strategic options.

detailed_descriptions.en: In MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS, players take on the role of a newly graduated pilot from the Smoke Jaguar cadet program, thrust into the heart of the Clan Invasion of the Inner Sphere during Operation Revival. This pivotal moment in the MechWarrior universe sees players leading a five-mech "Star" squad across numerous planets with diverse biomes, engaging in an expansive campaign filled with immersive gameplay and intricate combat encounters. Armed with customizable BattleMechs featuring cutting-edge technologies, players explore a wealth of tactical options and strategic possibilities. The game leverages the power of the Unreal Engine to deliver stunning environmental details and visceral destruction, making every battle against the tyrants of the Inner Sphere an epic experience. As the first Clan-based MechWarrior game in nearly three decades, it combines a captivating narrative with well-crafted characters and moral dilemmas, culminating in a dynamic and adaptive combat experience enhanced by a revamped MechLab, Hardpoint, and OmniPod system. Experience the Clan Invasion from the perspective of Clan Smoke Jaguar as you lead your Star through engaging missions and combat, with cinematics unlike anything seen before in MechWarrior Strategic adaptability is key to victory and more accessible than ever with the new Battle Grid, Command Wheel, and Streamlined Controls Customize your 'Mechs with advanced Clan weapon systems, equipment, and upgrades for mission-specific battles, and advance your pilots with the new pilot progression system Experience MechWarrior like never before with a fully standalone campaign featuring detailed environments and dynamic destruction using the latest Unreal Engine and new Tech Updates Play with up to 4 other players as you protect and lead your Star through complex missions and thrilling combat

Completely rebalanced so you can explore the Inner Sphere and build your merc company as you please. Expanded Inner Sphere Map that includes 61 total warzones (+18), 34 Industrial Hubs, and 55 quest lines (+11). Career Paths Visit Cantinas to pick up jobs from the Inner Sphere's shadiest characters. Use counter mode to disable an enemies ECM. BAP, EWAP - an active probe that allows sensors to detect hidden enemies regardless of line of sight MASC, Supercharger - gives mechs a short duration but incredibly powerful mobility boost. Start a career from scratch in any of the great houses or import your progress from the original Campaign. 7 new 'Mech chassis: Corsair, Vulcan, Charger, Hatamoto-Chi, Dervish, Champion, and Marauder II
Adds 50 new variants including new variants for existing chassis

New music tracks set a more diverse and epic tone to the game.

Hazardous Atmosphere Garrisons

Artillery and Airstrikes
Avoid enemy airstrikes, call in air support to deliver devastating bombardments, or use TAG/NARC on specific enemies for precision airstrikes

ECM, EWECM - an Electronic Counter Measure creates a distortion bubble that jams opponents sensors and HUD and reduces their ability to detect you or target effectively. Use counter mode to disable an enemies ECM.
BAP, EWAP - an active probe that allows sensors to detect hidden enemies regardless of line of sight
MASC, Supercharger - gives mechs a short duration but incredibly powerful mobility boost.
New Weapons: Chem Lasers, Short Burst Lasers, Mech Rifles, Stream SRMs.

detailed_descriptions.en: The year is 3050, and the Inner Sphere is under siege. The Clans have returned. Take command of your battle-hardened Mercenary Company as you're hired by the Rasalhague Republic to hold the line against an overwhelming new enemy. What begins as a routine mission quickly escalates into a desperate fight for survival, uncovering secrets tied to your past—and to the origins of the Clans themselves. Campaign Experience a Hand Crafted 12-mission story campaign that brings you face to face with the Clan Invasion. Fight iconic factions as you unravel a mystery with ties to your Past. Cinematics, briefings, and high-stakes missions deliver a front-line narrative. The Inner Sphere New contracts emerge as the battle lines are redrawn across the Inner Sphere. Take high-risk missions near Clan territory—where patrols are constant and danger is always close. Clan 'Mechs and Tech Face off against the Clans 16 powerful OmniMechs—then add cutting-edge firepower to your own hangar. Unleash Clan weapons and equipment to tip the odds in your favor. Inner Sphere 'Mechs and Tech New IS Weapons, 13 New Variants and the Bullshark. Hero Pilots Recruit new elite MechWarriors with unique abilities.

detailed_descriptions.en: SOLARIS SHOWDOWN Fresh off a successful mission for the notorious Mercenary Star, Mason and crew journey to the Hardcore system where they collide with 'Mech pilot Duncan Fisher embarking on a quest to secure a spot in the FedCom Unification Tournament. Forming an unlikely alliance, Mason and Fisher traverse the shadows of Solaris, engage in harrowing 'Mech duels, and race against the clock to save the day - a true Solaris Showdown. Join Duncan Fisher in a race against time to thwart the overthrow of the Solaris Council, discover the new Loader King 'Mech, collect 11 new Gladiator 'Mech variants, select new weapons and equipment tailored for close-quarter engagements, and help save the very future of Solaris Assist Duncan Fisher on his zany adventures, and witness his ascension as the official and iconic Voice of Solaris Seek fortune and Fame with new Arena Missions and reward system Solaris Showdown adds the new Loader King 'Mech chassis with 6 variants, including the mighty Hero LDK-IDM 'Indomitable' Collect 11 new 'Mech variants designed specifically for the intense Gladiator-style combat of the BattleMech arenas Select from an array of new Gladiator-style weaponry and equipment Enhancements to MechLab, AI Improvements, and various other free QoL updates

games.name: MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries - The Dragon's Gambit
games.short_description: THE DRAGONS GAMBIT - Brace yourself for 15 thrilling missions and find the valuable high-tier weapon cache in every mission. Introducing the Longbow fire-support 'Mech. Unlock Izanagi Warriors Variants as exclusive campaign rewards! New Instant Action Team Combat Mode, Garrisoned and Free For All.

descriptions.en: THE DRAGONS GAMBIT - Brace yourself for 15 thrilling missions and find the valuable high-tier weapon cache in every mission. Introducing the Longbow fire-support 'Mech. Unlock Izanagi Warriors Variants as exclusive campaign rewards! New Instant Action Team Combat Mode, Garrisoned and Free For All.

detailed_descriptions.en: THE DRAGONS GAMBIT In the aftermath of the Fourth Succession War, the Davion/Steiner Alliance dealt a devastating blow to the Capellan Confederation, leaving First Prince Hanse Davion eager to replicate this success against the Draconis Combine. Gunji-no-Kanrei Theodore Kurita, fully aware of the encroaching menace posed by the FedCom Alliance, has taken decisive action to fortify the Combine's defenses against an inevitable war. As tensions rise, a unique opportunity presents itself – to unite with the Draconis Combine and rally behind Kurita's audacious and unexpected plan. NEW MISSIONS Embark on an epic quest line as your mercenary company joins forces with the 5th Amphigean Light Assault Group. Together, you must defend the Draconis Combine against a massive invasion by the FedCom Alliance. Brace yourself for the largest handcrafted campaign yet, spanning 15 thrilling missions, and prove your mettle in the face of this formidable threat as you strive to safeguard the future of the Draconis Combine. NEW CHASSIS The Longbow is one of the most iconic fire support 'Mechs in existence. This massive BattleMech has earned a reputation for being a dependable and unwavering machine, consistently delivering on its missions and leaving no room for doubt in its devastating capabilities. OTOMO Introducing the ultimate military unit of The Dragon's Gambit DLC for MechWarrior 5: Mercenaries, the "Otomo"! This elite force comprises the finest 'Mechs the Draconis Combine has to offer. With their exceptional performance and iconic paint jobs, the Royal Guard stands as a symbol of power and dominance on the battlefield. Unlock these Special Variants as exclusive campaign rewards! FREE UPDATE - NEW INSTANT ACTION MODE New to Instant Action Team Combat Mode featuring Garrisoned and Free For All. Customize your mode and drop solo or with friends. This Free Update Mode is available through Instant Action to anyone who owns MechWarrior 5 Mercenaries.

games.name: Megaquarium
games.short_description: The public aquarium simulator. Design your displays, look after your fish, manage your staff and keep your guests happy! It's all in a day's work as the curator of your very own Megaquarium.

descriptions.en: The public aquarium simulator. Design your displays, look after your fish, manage your staff and keep your guests happy! It's all in a day's work as the curator of your very own Megaquarium.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 以水族馆为背景的管理大亨游戏。设计场馆、照顾各种鱼类、雇用管理人员，让游客快乐观赏！作为大水族馆的馆长管理水族馆的日常运营。
descriptions.ja: アクアティックな趣向を凝らしたテーマパーク経営シミュレーションゲーム。ディスプレーをデザインし、魚たちを世話し、スタッフを管理して、来館者を満足させる！それらすべてがMegaquariumのキュレーターとしてのあなたの一日の仕事となります。

detailed_descriptions.en: From the creator of Big Pharma comes a brand new economic simulation game. Megaquarium follows in the footsteps of classic theme park management tycoon games and adds an aquatic spin! A living simulation Starting with just a few tanks and the most basic of livestock, you’ll grow your aquarium to a thronging metropolis filled with hundreds of guests, tens of staff and a multitude of different aquatic lifeforms, each with their own unique care requirements. Design your exhibits Megaquarium features almost 100 different marine species including fish, sharks, crustaceans, corals, jellyfish, other invertebrates and even a turtle! You’ll be spoilt for choice as you design, decorate and populate your tanks. The right staff for the job You won’t get far without the right staff. Choose who to hire based on their skills and future potential. Will you train up a team of multi-disciplined staff or a set of super-focussed experts? You’ll have to weigh up the pros and cons of each strategy and work out what is right for your aquarium. Research new animals and technology As guests experience your displays you’ll earn points which you can assign to discovering new livestock and equipment. Keep upgrading and expanding your aquarium and work your way up to the most prestigious animals and displays in the aquarium industry. Manage your finances The latest fish might look cool, but have you considered its impact on your aquarium’s bottom line. Tricky animals may require new staff to be hired, expensive fish food or supplements and the best tanks are a hefty investment! As aquarium curator you’ll need to master creativity and economics to succeed. Manage your guests! Keep your guests happy by providing them with seating, food, drinks and toilet facilities. Then at the end of their visit, direct them through the gift shop to boost your profits! Curator school Start your career in the campaign mode where you’ll learn everything you need to know about designing and managing an aquarium. Each of the 10 levels challenges you to build an aquarium with unique gameplay conditions and objectives, while new features and concepts are explained along the way. Dive into the sandbox Next explore sandbox mode where, with customisable settings and a random challenge generator, you can find virtually unlimited fish-related gameplay! Easy to learn, difficult to master Running an inefficient aquarium is easy. To really thrive and take on the greatest challenges you’ll need a lateral thinking brain and attention to detail. Will you group your animals by food type, water quality or something else entirely? Will you locate your equipment in a centralised hub using pumps or spread them out embracing the zoning system? How will you optimise your layout so that visitors can find your tanks and staff can easily access them? Every decision you make in Megaquarium has consequences. Your choice of animals, filters, tanks, staff and layout all have subtle and far reaching effects on each other. Experiment, adjust, learn, reapply and most importantly, have fun! Features 10 level ‘learn the game’ campaign Sandbox mode with full customisation and random challenge generator 97 species of livestock to discover each with their own unique care requirements Over 100 different objects to place including filters, skimmers, nitrate reactors, chillers, heaters, food boxes, equipment stations, doors, gates, food and drink dispensers, balloon stands, decorations, paint and more! Plan staff talks down to the subject, time and frequency to increase your point income even further! Gift shop and guest facilities Fully featured theming and decoration system
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: Big Pharma 开发商推出的全新模拟经营游戏。 大水族馆 沿用经典管理大亨游戏的模式，并加入了水下世界的多彩内容！ 栩栩如生的模拟环境 从几个水族箱和最基本的鱼类开始，您将把这里发展成为有大批管理人员、游客络绎不绝的大型水族馆。水族馆的物种多样，每一种都需要独特的照料方法 设计场馆展示内容 水族馆提供近100种不同的海洋生物，包括观赏鱼、鲨鱼、甲壳动物、珊瑚、水母、其他无脊椎动物、甚至还有海龟！您在设计、装饰和布置水族箱时会发现：选择真的是太多了！ 雇用合适的管理人员 不雇用合适的管理人员是发展不下去的。根据技能和未来的潜能来选择要雇用的员工。您能培养出一支多才多艺的管理员团队吗？或是培养出一批超级专才？您必须权衡每种策略的利弊，找出适合您水族馆运营方法。 研究新的动物和科技 当游客欣赏您的展出内容时，您就能获得点数，您需要用点数来解锁新的物种和设备。不断提升和扩张您的水族馆，一步一步做大做强，致力于展出水族馆行业内独一无二的物种。 管理财务 最新解锁的鱼类看起来很酷，但您是否考虑过它对水族馆财务状况的影响？引入新的物种可能需要新的管理员、昂贵的鱼食或补给才能维持运营。另外，最好的水族箱也是最贵的！作为馆长，您需要掌控吸引力和财务的平衡，才能取得成功。 接待游客！ 为游客提供座位、食物、饮料和卫生间，让其感到满意。在游客参观完毕时，指引他们进入礼品店，以增加您的利润！ 馆长学校 在剧情模式中开始您的职业生涯，您将从中学习到有关水族馆设计和管理的所有知识。10关中的每一关都会要求您根据独特的游戏条件和目标去建设水族馆，在建设的同时您将学会新的功能和概念。 沙盒磨合 在沙盒模式中，通过可自定义的设置和随机挑战生成器，您可以获得无限种可能的游戏体验！ 易学难精 管理效率低下的水族馆并不难。但要面对终极挑战从而真正成功运营，您需要有非线性思维的能力和关注细节的习惯。您会根据食物种类、水质或其他因素将物种分组吗？您是否会使用泵将设备集中放在一个位置，还是将它们分散到不同区域中？您将如何优化馆內的布局，在便于游客观赏的同时，也方便管理人员的维护？ 您在大水族馆中所作出的每一个决定，都会产生影响。您选择的物种、过滤器、水族箱、管理员和场馆布置，都会造成微妙但深远的影响。尝试、调整、学习、改进，最重要的是，玩得开心！ 功能特点 10关「剧情」模式 提供完全自定义设置和随机挑战生成器的沙盒模式 97种具有独特生存需求的生物 超过100种的不同物件，包括过滤器、蛋白质分离器、硝酸盐反应器、冷却器、加热器、配食器、工具站、门、闸门、食品和饮料贩卖机、气球架、装饰品、涂料等等！ 决定管理员演说的主题、时间和频率，以进一步提高您的点数收入！ 礼品店和游客设施 完整的主题和装饰系统
detailed_descriptions.ja: Big Pharma のクリエイターがお贈りする、まったく新しい経済シミュレーションゲーム。 Megaquarium は定番のテーマパーク経営ゲームに、アクアティックな趣向を加えてあります！ 生き生きしたシミュレーション ほんの数個の水槽と基本的な生き物から始めて、あなたの水族館を、数百人が来館し、数十人のスタッフが働き、それぞれ独自の飼育要件がある多数の異なる水生生物で満たされた巨大なメトロポリスへと成長させましょう。 あなた好みに展示をデザイン Megaquariumには、魚、サメ、甲殻類、サンゴ、クラゲ、その他の無脊椎動物、さらにはカメなども含め、およそ100種類もの海洋生物がいます！水槽をデザインや装飾、何を住ませるかなど、選択の幅は悩めるくらい膨大です。 適材適所にスタッフを配置 優秀なスタッフなしでは運営はままなりません。スキルや将来の成長性を考慮して、適切な人材を雇いましょう。何でもこなすスタッフチームを育て上げるか、それとも一芸に秀でた専門家たちを集めるか？それぞれの方針の長所と短所を考えつつ、あなたの水族館に最適な人員を揃えましょう。 新しい生物やテクノロジーの研究 来館者が展示を観賞するごとに、あなたは新しい生き物や機材の発見のために使えるポイントを獲得できます。水族館の改善と拡張を続け、水族館業界で最上級の生物や展示を揃えて行きましょう。 財務管理 最新の魚はクールに見えるかもしれませんが、水族館の収益に与える影響を考慮しましょう。飼育の難しい生物のためには、新しいスタッフを雇ったり、高価な餌やサプリメントが必要になる場合があり、また最高の水槽には多額の投資が求められます！水族館のキュレーターとして成功するには、創造性と経済学を習得する必要があるのです。 来館者のニーズ！ 来館者用のイスや飲食物、トイレの設備を充実させて、彼らの満足度を高めましょう。そして帰るときにはギフトショップを訪れるよう誘導し、収益を底上げするのです！ キュレーター学校 あなたのキャリアをキャンペーンモードで始めましょう。水族館の設計と管理のあらゆるノウハウを学ぶことができます。10個のレベルそれぞれで、ユニークなプレイ条件と目的を備えた水族館を建設することが求められる一方で、新しい機能やコンセプトが説明されていくのです。 サンドボックスに飛び込もう 次はサンドボックスモードを探求してみましょう。カスタマイズ可能な設定とランダムなチャレンジジェネレーターにより、魚と触れ合うゲームプレイが事実上無制限に楽しめます！ 簡単に始められ、とことん追求できる テキトーに水族館を運営するのは簡単です。本当に繁栄させ、最大の挑戦に取り組むのであれば、水平思考できる頭脳と、細部まで行き届く注意力が不可欠です。あなたは生物を、餌の種類でグループ化しますか？それとも水質や、まったく違った条件で？あなたは機材を、ポンプを利用した中央ハブに配置させますか、それともゾーニングシステムを利用して分散させますか？来館者が見やすく、かつスタッフが簡単にアクセスできるようにするため、水槽のレイアウトをどう最適化しますか？ Megaquariumにおけるあなたの決断のすべてに、結果が伴います。生物、フィルター、水槽、スタッフ、そしてレイアウトの選択はすべて、微妙かつ広範囲に影響を及ぼします。実験し、調整し、学習し、再適用しましょう。そして最も重要なことは――楽しむことです！ 特徴 ゲームを学べる10レベルのキャンペーン 多彩なカスタマイズ項目とランダムなチャレンジジェネレーターを備えたサンドボックスモード それぞれユニークな飼育要件を持つ、97種もの生き物を発見可能 配置可能なオブジェクトは100種類以上！フィルター、タンパク質分離機、硝酸塩除去装置、クーラー、ヒーター、餌の箱、工具置き場、ドア、ゲート、飲食物の自販機、バルーン売り場、装飾品、ペイントなどが含まれます スタッフトークの話題、時間、頻度などを計画し、獲得ポイントをさらに増やしましょう！ ギフトショップや来館者用設備 フル機能のテーマ化および装飾システム

games.short_description: An adrenaline-rush sci-fi FPS. A HYPER UNIT ASKA is sent on a suicide mission to rescue citizens' COREs from MOEBIUS, an orbital city turned into a deadly trap. Dive into cybernetic warfare, face the ENGINEERS, and uncover the secrets of METAL EDEN.

descriptions.en: An adrenaline-rush sci-fi FPS. A HYPER UNIT ASKA is sent on a suicide mission to rescue citizens' COREs from MOEBIUS, an orbital city turned into a deadly trap. Dive into cybernetic warfare, face the ENGINEERS, and uncover the secrets of METAL EDEN.

detailed_descriptions.en: METAL EDEN is an adrenaline-rush sci-fi FPS. An advanced HYPER UNIT ASKA is sent on a suicide mission to rescue the citizens’ COREs from the vast monolithic city MOEBIUS once a hopeful new home for humanity now turned into a deadly trap. Blast your way through the INTERNAL DEFENCE CORPS in cybernetic warfare, confront the ENGINEERS and uncover the mysteries of the project EDEN . Dive into cybernetic warfare against the machine forces that protect the secrets of an artificial world. Fight a diverse roster of tough, agile mecha troops and elemental forces. Extract energy cores and destroy the INTERNAL DEFENCE CORPS shields to gain a battle zone advantage. Develop your arsenal and combat capabilities to become an unstoppable HYPER UNIT . You are a HYPER UNIT - an advanced battle android. Built to protect. Specialized in recon missions. Powered by a PHANTOM CORE . Dash, grapple and wall-run through the INTERNAL DEFENCE CORPS using enhanced parkour skills. Harness your superior agility and acrobatic combat prowess in pulse-pounding encounters. Transform into an ARMORED RAMBALL to charge into action and take on new and deadly machine foes. Control the air and dominate the battle with your gravity hooks and jetpack. MOEBIUS – a vast monolithic city high above the planet’s surface protecting the mysterious HIVE TOWER . Run by mysterious ENGINEERS , once a hopeful new home for humanity has turned into a deadly trap. Explore the brutalist and monolithic environments of the derelict orbital city and the mysterious world below, VULCAN . As HYPER UNIT ASKA , engage in the ongoing conflict over the consciousness of a lost human colony stored within reinforced storage units.

Don your gas mask, brave the crippling radiation and venture into the depths of the Metro where threats haunt your every step.

detailed_descriptions.en: Metro Awakening is a story-driven first person adventure built exclusively for VR that blends atmospheric exploration, stealth and combat in the most immersive Metro experience yet. The year is 2028 The survivors of nuclear Armageddon cling to existence in the buried subways of the Moscow Metro – civilization’s last refuge and tomb, where ghosts and spirits haunt the living in this man-made purgatory. You are Serdar, a doctor braving the darkness, crippling radiation and deadly threats of the Metro in the search for your wife and the medication she so desperately needs. As your courage and sanity are pushed to the limit you must learn to walk the line between life and death, the spirit and the material world, and awaken the being you will become… Features: Lose yourself in a journey of spiritual awakening in this chilling, supernatural origins story from Metro creator Dmitry Glukhovsky Experience Metro’s tense, heart-pounding gameplay in VR for the first time as you put on your mask, ammo and filters run low and your torchlight flickers and dies in the darkness Wield a signature arsenal of hand-made weapons, don your gas mask, and venture into the depths of the Metro where desperate bandits, mutants, and worse haunt your every step

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Metro Awakening is a story-driven first person adventure built exclusively for VR that blends atmospheric exploration, stealth and combat in the most immersive Metro experience yet.

The year is 2028

The survivors of nuclear Armageddon cling to existence in the buried subways of the Moscow Metro – civilization’s last refuge and tomb, where ghosts and spirits haunt the living in this man-made purgatory.

You are Serdar, a doctor braving the darkness, crippling radiation and deadly threats of the Metro in the search for your wife and the medication she so desperately needs. As your courage and sanity are pushed to the limit you must learn to walk the line between life and death, the spirit and the material world, and awaken the being you will become…

Features:

  • Lose yourself in a journey of spiritual awakening in this chilling, supernatural origins story from Metro creator Dmitry Glukhovsky

  • Experience Metro’s tense, heart-pounding gameplay in VR for the first time as you put on your mask, ammo and filters run low and your torchlight flickers and dies in the darkness

  • Wield a signature arsenal of hand-made weapons, don your gas mask, and venture into the depths of the Metro where desperate bandits, mutants, and worse haunt your every step

games.name: Mind Scanners
games.short_description: Greetings. Your Mind Scanner request has been approved. Your duty is to diagnose and treat the citizens of The Structure. The patient list is long so don't waste your time. We’ll let you see your daughter soon...

descriptions.en: Greetings. Your Mind Scanner request has been approved. Your duty is to diagnose and treat the citizens of The Structure. The patient list is long so don't waste your time. We’ll let you see your daughter soon...

detailed_descriptions.en: Mind Scanners is a retro-futuristic psychiatry simulation in which you diagnose the citizens of a dystopian metropolis. Locate a host of other-worldly characters and use arcade-style treatment devices to help them. Manage your time and resources to keep The Structure in balance. Remember, you take full responsibility for your patients. Manage your time and resources to aid the citizens of The Structure Diagnose your patients by analyzing their views of the world Operate and master a variation of arcade-style devices to treat your patients Spend your ₭apok and science points to develop new devices Face difficult moral choices and ethical dilemmas Report the resistance group Moonrise or join them to help their cause Gain the trust of The Structure if you want to see your daughter again The meteor came. And from it, the survivors learned to harness the power source known as Zygnoka. In the next forty years, the megacity known as The Structure was erected inside the impact crater. Here, the people isolated themselves, accelerating their dependence on technology and created a society as a machine of its own. In The Structure, order and efficiency is maintained by severe top-down control. In the name of efficiency, new machines and instruments are put to use on the public the instant they are invented. In pursuit of optimisation, a new profession is tasked to maintain the increasingly precarious anomaly levels of the city's inhabitants. These are called Mind Scanners.

games.name: Mini Airways - ATC simulator
games.short_description: Mini Airways is a real-time management game where you play the role of an air traffic controller. Clear your aircraft to takeoff & land, direct them to the destination...and most of all don't let them crash!! London, Tokyo, Shanghai... Test your ATC skills in distinctive maps around the globe!

descriptions.en: Mini Airways is a real-time management game where you play the role of an air traffic controller. Clear your aircraft to takeoff & land, direct them to the destination...and most of all don't let them crash!! London, Tokyo, Shanghai... Test your ATC skills in distinctive maps around the globe!
descriptions.zh-Hant: 迷你空管是一款極簡主義風格的實時管理遊戲。你將扮演一名忙碌的空中交通管制員。你需要指揮飛機起飛，引導飛機降落，指揮它們飛往目的地......最重要的是，避免相撞事故！倫敦、東京、上海、華盛頓——在世界各地的機場上，巧用獨特的跑道配置和各色道具，盡可能久地管理空域，展現你高超的指揮技巧。
descriptions.ja: Mini Airwaysは、ミニマリスチックなリアルタイムストラテジーゲームです。あなたは忙しい航空管制官となり、飛行機の離陸と着陸を誘導し、衝突を避けます。ロンドン、東京、上海、ワシントン……世界中の空港で、交わる滑走路を利用し、色んなアイテムを使って空域を管理して、プロ級の指揮技術を披露しましょう！
descriptions.ko: Mini Airways는 항공 교통 관제사 역할을 맡아 실시간으로 비행기를 관리하는 게임입니다. 비행기를 이륙하고 착륙시키고, 목적지로 안내하세요... 그리고 무엇보다 중요한 것은, 충돌하지 않도록하세요! 런던, 도쿄, 상하이... 세계 각지의 독특한 지도에서 Mini Airways의 ATC 기술을 테스트해 보세요!

detailed_descriptions.en: Mini Airways is a real-time management game with an air traffic control theme. You will play as a busy air traffic controller in the game: directing planes to take off and land, clearing air traffic, upgrading airspace ...... And most of all, don't let them crash! Each airport can accommodate up to 4 people online and supports the use of the Workshop map. You can work with your friends to jointly manage the same airspace to reduce the impact of mistakes and challenge higher scores! Fast-paced, real-time ATC gameplay: Manage airspace, clear planes for takeoff and landing, and avoid near misses! In addition to the normal arrangement of takeoffs and landings, you also need to face the challenges of mountains, no-fly zones, and peak landing hours, so please concentrate! Every time you finish one day's management, you will be able to pick an upgrade for your airspace and airport: auto holding, accelerating turns, increasing airspace, waypoints ...... upgrade and customize airports to keep flights running more smoothly. As you increase your flight management records, you will gradually unlock a total of 19 airspace maps based on real-world airports—from Beijing Capital, Shanghai Hongqiao, Chengdu Shuangliu in China to Vancouver, New York in North America, and then to London, Amsterdam in Europe... Showcase your air traffic control skills across various global airports! The game triggers random events under certain specific maps and conditions, featuring classic moments in aviation history: the miracle landing on the Hudson River, Air Force One crossing, emergency incidents, high-priority flights, etc. The game offers three modes: Classic, Hardcore, and Sandbox. In Hardcore mode, the airspace simulates real ATC operations without the ability to pause within the session; In Sandbox mode, players have full control over waypoints, props, and landing intensity, allowing you to design their own waypoints and test the maximum flight density they can handle. The game supports creating custom maps and mods. Players can import map assets, freely configure runways, restricted areas, and other terrains for gameplay. For those with more demanding needs in aviation management, they can create MODs for altitude, wind speed, etc., enhancing the strategic depth of the game. Don't Miss Out! As you’ve read this far, you must be a true fan! If you are into ATC (Air Traffic Control), civil aviation, or flight simulation, then Mini Airways is definitely worth trying! Our development and publishing team are enthusiasts of ATC and flight simulation. We have experienced and researched all kinds of air traffic control and flight simulation games available, most of which feature highly abstract graphics like Endless ATC or Air Traffic: Greenlight, or extremely realistic simulations like Global ATC Simulator, I am an Air Traffic Controller 4 (ATC4), Microsoft Flight Simulator, and X-Plane 12, which almost all opt for professional and complex routes. By the way: Mini Airways plays more like 112 Operator and 911 Operator than Mini Metro or Mini Motorways. However, for beginners who are not professionals, they might prefer a simpler entry-level product that doesn’t necessarily strive for realism but focuses on gradual terminology explanations and functional guidance. We believe this approach can help grow the somewhat niche community of ATC enthusiasts. This is why we developed Mini Airways . Since its release half a year ago, Mini Airways has received a lot of positive feedback and suggestions. It even made a small appearance in the East China Air Traffic Management Bureau’s skill competition. Thank you all for your support! Based on feedback from reviews, we are continuously optimizing the game to balance professionalism and gaming enjoyment. In the future, we will work hard to bring more new maps, new events, and even explore new features (such as voice control similar to sim4D ATC). Mobile development is also underway, so stay tuned to our Steam page for updates! See you next time!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 迷你空管是一款以空中交通管制為主題的實時管理遊戲。 你將在遊戲中扮演一位繁忙的空中交通管制員：指揮飛機起降，疏導空中交通，升級機場…… 最重要的是，別出現撞機事故！ 【最新】多人模式更新！ 每個機場最多可容納4人聯機遊玩，並且支援使用創意工坊地圖。你可以和自己的朋友們一起聯合管理同一片空域，以減少失誤帶來的影響，挑戰更高分數！ 指揮飛機起降 你只需要拖動飛機到跑道一端即可完成起降操作，不同顏色的航班需要將航向箭頭拖動至同色圓點完成引導。 管理空中交通 除了正常安排起降，你還需要面對群山環繞、禁飛區、單向跑道、意外事件、降落高峰時段等挑戰，請時刻保持精神集中！ 升級你的空域 每當你完成一天的管理工作，你將能夠為你的空域和機場選擇一項升級——盤旋、加速轉彎、擴大空域……用好它們將使你的工作事半功倍。 解鎖各地機場 隨著管制航班記錄的增加，你將陸續解鎖總計19張基於真實機場製作的空域地圖，從國內的北京首都、上海虹橋、成都雙流機場到北美大陸的溫哥華、紐約，再到歐洲地區的倫敦、阿姆斯特丹……在世界各地的機場空域中展現你的空管技藝！ 重現歷史事件 遊戲在某些特定地圖和條件下會觸發隨機事件，其中不乏航空史上的經典案例：國產大飛機C919首飛、哈德遜河上的迫降奇蹟、空軍一號過境、航班緊急事件、高優先級航班…… 多種玩法模式 遊戲提供經典、硬核和沙盒三種模式，硬核模式下的空域將模擬真實的空管操作，無法進行局內暫停；沙盒模式下玩家可以自由控制所有的航點道具和降落航班強度，自行設計航點引導並測試其可容納的航班密度上限。 自製地圖&模組 遊戲支援自製地圖製作和模組製作，玩家可以自行匯入地圖素材，自由配置跑道、限制區域等地形進行遊玩，對航空管理有更高需求的玩家可以自製對應的高度、風速等等玩法MOD，讓遊戲的策略深度更上一層。 社交媒體 如果你對遊戲的開發進展感興趣或者有任何意見建議，都歡迎加入我們的Q群或關注我們的社交媒體： 官方Q群1群：693192338 官方Q群2群：450374968 嗶哩嗶哩：@迷你空管 小紅書：@迷你空管 走過路過不要錯過！ 看到這裡的你，想必是真愛了！最後說點兒心裡話，順便做做搜索優化 ≖‿≖✧ 如果你是ATC（Air Traffic Control，空中交通管制）、民航或者模擬飛行愛好者，那麼《迷你空管 Mini Airways》非常值得你體驗！ 我們的開發和發行團隊都是ATC/模擬飛行的愛好者，體驗和調研了市面上所有的空中交通管制類乃至飛行類遊戲，其中大多數畫面高度抽象，比如Endless ATC或者Air Traffic: Greenlight；要不就是擬真度非常高，比如Global ATC Simulator、I am an Air Traffic Controller 4（我是航空管制官4，簡寫ATC4），甚至微軟模擬飛行（Microsoft Flight Simulator）和X-Plane 12，它們幾乎都選擇了專業和複雜路線。 順帶一提：相比前面那些遊戲和《迷你地鐵 Mini Metro》或者《迷你高速公路 Mini Motorways》來說，《迷你空管 Mini Airways》的玩法其實更像是《112 Operator》和《911 Operator》。 但對於初窺門徑的非專業愛好者來說，他們或許更需要一款不一定擬真，但一定要簡單的入門產品，循序漸進的術語說明和功能引導，完善的中文本地化環境，不必去啃英文生肉就能明白的ATC知識，相信這些都能夠壯大ATC這個有點小眾的圈子！這就是我們開發《迷你空管 Mini Airways》的初衷。 《迷你空管 Mini Airways》發布的半年以來，我們收穫了許多的好評和建議，非常感謝大家的支持！同時針對評價區的反饋意見，我們也在嘗試進行優化，努力地達到專業和遊戲樂趣並重！ 未來我們也會努力為大家帶來更多新的地圖、新的事件，甚至新的功能探索（類似sim4D ATC的語音控制），行動端的開發也在進行當中，請大家持續關注我們的steam主頁~我們下次更新見！
detailed_descriptions.ja: Mini Airwaysは、航空管制をテーマにしたリアルタイムストラテジーゲームです。 忙しい航空管制官になり、飛行機の離着陸を誘導し、地上交通を管理して、空港をアップグレードしましょう！……そして一番大事なのは、飛行機同士の衝突を起こさないようにご注意！ 離陸 & 着陸 航空管制 通常の離着陸のスケジュールに加えて、山地、飛行禁止空域、着陸ラッシュなどの挑戦も待ち望んでいます。集中して難関突破しましょう！ 空域のアップグレード 一日の管理業務を完了するたびに、空域や空港のアップグレードを一つ選択できます。旋回から、方向転換加速や空域の拡大まで……様々なアイテムを利用して、目指すのは空港の効率と秩序！ 世界中の空港を探索 ゲームが進むことで、精巧に作られた空域マップは次々と解除されていきます。世界中の空域や空港で、あなたの航空管制官の技術を披露しましょう！
detailed_descriptions.ko: Mini Airways는 실시간 관리 게임으로 항공 교통 관제를 테마로 하고 있습니다. 게임에서 당신은 바쁜 항공 교통 관제사가 되어 비행기의 이착륙을 지시하고, 항공 교통을 정리하며, 공역을 업그레이드하는 등 다양한 업무를 수행하게 됩니다. 그리고 가장 중요한 것은, 절대 충돌이 일어나지 않도록 해야 합니다! 이륙 및 착륙 항공 교통 관제 일반적인 이착륙 관제 외에도, 산악 지형, 비행 금지 구역, 피크 착륙 시간대 등의 도전 과제를 마주하게 됩니다. 그러니 집중하세요! 공역 업그레이드 하루의 관제를 마칠 때마다 공역과 공항을 업그레이드할 수 있는 기회를 얻게 됩니다. 자동 대기, 회전 속도 가속, 공역 확대 등의 업그레이드를 현명하게 활용하면 업무가 훨씬 수월해질 것입니다. 다양한 공항 해제 점차 더 정교한 공역 지도를 해제하고 전 세계의 공역과 공항에서 당신의 ATC 기술을 뽐내세요.

games.name: MIO: Memories in Orbit
games.short_description: Play as android MIO in this mesmerizing metroidvania where you explore the Vessel, an enormous technological ark overgrown with machines gone rogue. Uncover its secrets, enhance MIO's abilities, and save the spaceship and its residents from oblivion.

descriptions.en: Play as android MIO in this mesmerizing metroidvania where you explore the Vessel, an enormous technological ark overgrown with machines gone rogue. Uncover its secrets, enhance MIO's abilities, and save the spaceship and its residents from oblivion.

detailed_descriptions.en: A mesmerizing, intertwined, decaying world awaits. You are MIO, a nimble robot with extraordinary abilities. You wake up in the Vessel, a space ship drifting aimlessly in space.This enormous technological ark, whose initial purpose remains unknown, lies now as a field of ruins, overgrown with lush vegetation and machines gone rogue. Nobody knows why the Pearls, The Vessel's AI caretakers, have ceased functioning. Forgotten by all, the Vessel faces imminent shutdown. Dive into its depths to revive its lost memories, as you unravel your true past and destiny. Delve into this mesmerizing metroidvania, as you guide MIO through the vast expanse of the Vessel. You won’t be alone on your journey. Repair damaged robots and help them to unveil the Ark's past and gain valuable bonuses. Interact with the environment to learn more about its past and memories. Unravel the dark secrets behind its tragic blackout. And let your curiosity guide you as you discover its many secret pathways. Experience a magnificent world of breathtaking scenery and innumerable details. Inspired by comics, paintings, and anime, its universe is full of wonder and artistic curiosities. Let its unique and dynamic soundtrack, blending lo-fi beats and choral melodies, carry you through this captivating universe. As a gigantic labyrinth, the Vessel is a true living organism, with its own ecosystems, bestiaries and architectures. Earn game-changer abilities, like grappling hook, air gliding or spider-like wall clinging, to help MIO progress through this twisted and interconnected space. Master precision, rhythm, and timing to find the perfect flow! Face off a diverse array of over 30 enemy units and 15 formidable guardian bosses. From the relentless Mosquito to the menacing Scarecrow, confront a variety of deadly adversaries each with their own distinct fighting styles and movement patterns. Use your arsenal of powers to adapt to every encounter. Evade foes using your Hook, unleash orbs as powerful projectiles, and even create decoy clones to strike from unexpected angles. Enhance and customize MIO abilities by scavenging enemy components. Spice up your fighting skills with many Modifiers and transform MIO into a formidable force tailored to your playstyle. Would you make your grappling Hook a deadly lasso or an evade move? Sacrifice your Shield to boost your damage? It’s always your choice! Will you rise to the challenge and save the Vessel from oblivion? Will you dare to seek and wake its memories?
