games.name: Unrailed!
games.short_description: Unrailed! is a co-op multiplayer game where you have to work together with your friends to build a train track across endless procedurally generated worlds. Master random encounters with its inhabitants, upgrade your train and keep it from derailing!

descriptions.en: Unrailed! is a co-op multiplayer game where you have to work together with your friends to build a train track across endless procedurally generated worlds. Master random encounters with its inhabitants, upgrade your train and keep it from derailing!

detailed_descriptions.en: Unrailed! is a chaotic online and couch co-op multiplayer railroad construction game where you work together with your friends as a team to build a train track across endless procedurally generated worlds. Master encounters with its inhabitants, upgrade your train and keep it from derailing! BUILD A TRACK FURTHER THAN EVER BEFORE Gather resources and craft tracks to extend your railroad to prevent your train from reaching the end. But watch out - there is only one tool of each type. Co-operation and co-ordination of your team is essential to survive this increasingly challenging journey! PLOUGH YOUR WAY THROUGH THE WORLD Every world is unique! You and your team will have to master ever new challenges to stay on track! ATTACH NEW WAGONS TO MASTER THE UNKNOWN Upgrade your train to be prepared for whatever is about to come. Get an atomic engine, upgrade your crafting wagon, attach a supercharger or choose from a vast range of other options. PLAY WITH OR AGAINST YOUR FRIENDS Play cooperatively with up to four players in a single team or challenge the co-op skills of your friends in a two versus two game. OVERVIEW An intense and chaotic railroad construction experience Online and local couch co-op multiplayer (also mixing both possible) Procedurally generated worlds with 4 different difficulty levels Dynamic weather system & day and night cycle Game modes: Endless, Quick, Sandbox (up to 4 players) and Versus (2 vs 2 players) Distinct biomes (5+) A bunch of upgradable wagons (10+) to modify your train in Endless mode Unlockable characters A replay system Online highscores with replays Simple controls & split keyboard and split controller mode Blocky to the core

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Unrailed! is a chaotic online and couch co-op multiplayer railroad construction game where you work together with your friends as a team to build a train track across endless procedurally generated worlds. Master encounters with its inhabitants, upgrade your train and keep it from derailing!

BUILD A TRACK FURTHER THAN EVER BEFORE


Gather resources and craft tracks to extend your railroad to prevent your train from reaching the end. But watch out - there is only one tool of each type. Co-operation and co-ordination of your team is essential to survive this increasingly challenging journey!

PLOUGH YOUR WAY THROUGH THE WORLD


Every world is unique! You and your team will have to master ever new challenges to stay on track!

ATTACH NEW WAGONS TO MASTER THE UNKNOWN


Upgrade your train to be prepared for whatever is about to come. Get an atomic engine, upgrade your crafting wagon, attach a supercharger or choose from a vast range of other options.

PLAY WITH OR AGAINST YOUR FRIENDS


Play cooperatively with up to four players in a single team or challenge the co-op skills of your friends in a two versus two game.

OVERVIEW


  • An intense and chaotic railroad construction experience
  • Online and local couch co-op multiplayer (also mixing both possible)

games.name: Utawarerumono: Past and Present Rediscovered
games.short_description: The Utawarerumono legend reaches a new climax in this sprawling JRPG! As a shadow falls over Yamato once more, Oshtor and friends set out on a fresh adventure—and somewhere, amid white mists, a long slumber approaches its end.

descriptions.en: The Utawarerumono legend reaches a new climax in this sprawling JRPG! As a shadow falls over Yamato once more, Oshtor and friends set out on a fresh adventure—and somewhere, amid white mists, a long slumber approaches its end.

detailed_descriptions.en: The Utawarerumono legend reaches a new climax in this sprawling JRPG! As a shadow falls over Yamato once more, Oshtor and friends set out on a new adventure—and somewhere, amid white mists, a long slumber approaches its end. FEATURES A massive traditional JRPG! Explore the sprawling lands of Yamato! The Action Ring system returns, bringing tempo and strategy to every turn-based battle ! Unleash devastating techniques and the power of your masks to defeat deadly enemies! Fight and befriend a rich cast including returning Utawarerumono fan favorites! STORY Long, long ago, in the distant past... or was it in the far-off future? The mighty empire of Yamato exists at peace under the rule of its god incarnate the Mikado. Oshtor, Mikazuchi, Munechika, and Shunya have been hailed as heroes ever since they repelled an invasion out of long-lost Arva Shulan. Yet once more, a shadow falls over the nation. Monster rise in every corner of the land, and disconnected incidents spiral towards one conclusion while old comrades triangulate a response. As their journey begins anew, they have no way of knowing—what awaits them is sung about only in legends. Somewhere, white mists still cloud a cradle—but a long, light slumber is about to end. CHARACTERS Oshtor – Voice: Kentaro Tone A warrior from the frontier province of Ennakamuy. Following the events of Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten , he has been anointed as the Imperial Guard of the Right, one of the Twin Shields of Yamato. He wears the mask that he inherited from his fallen master Dikotoma. Shunya – Voice: Yuko Minaguchi A girl from distant Arva Shulan, the land at the ends of the earth. She traveled with Oshtor and his allies in their adventures but is currently recuperating in the mountains of Ennakamuy. Munechika – Voice: Saori Hayami The daughter of Murasame, viceroy of Izumo. As demure and polite as she appears, Munechika's ladylike affectations barely conceal a burgeoning warrior's spirit. Mikazuchi – Voice: Yuya Uchida A man hailing from Ashiwara, the City of Squalls. Following the events of Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten , has been anointed as the Imperial Guard of the Left, one of the Twin Shields of Yamato. He wears the mask that he inherited from his family, once worn by a legendary ancestor. CREATIVE STAFF Producer & Music Director: NAOYA SHIMOKAWA ( ToHeart , White Album 2 , etc.) Concept & Story: MUNEMITSU SUGA ( Utawarerumono , etc.) Character Design: MI ( Monochrome Mobius , etc.) Original Character Design: TATSUKI AMADUYU , MISATO MITSUMI ( Utawarerumono , ToHeart 2 , etc.)

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Utawarerumono legend reaches a new climax in this sprawling JRPG! As a shadow falls over Yamato once more, Oshtor and friends set out on a new adventure—and somewhere, amid white mists, a long slumber approaches its end.

STORY

Long, long ago, in the distant past... or was it in the far-off future?

The mighty empire of Yamato exists at peace under the rule of its god incarnate the Mikado.

Oshtor, Mikazuchi, Munechika, and Shunya have been hailed as heroes ever since they repelled an invasion out of long-lost Arva Shulan.

Yet once more, a shadow falls over the nation.
Monster rise in every corner of the land, and disconnected incidents spiral towards one conclusion while old comrades triangulate a response.

As their journey begins anew, they have no way of knowing—what awaits them is sung about only in legends.
Somewhere, white mists still cloud a cradle—but a long, light slumber is about to end.

Following the events of Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten, has been anointed as the Imperial Guard of the Left, one of the Twin Shields of Yamato.

detailed_descriptions.en: Wake up, Hakuowlo. It's time to face the world again. You come to in bed, gravely injured, attended by a girl with twitching furry ears and a lush, bushy tail. A beast? You've forgotten your past, but has it forgotten you? Command your comrades and fight to defend your family, and discover the secrets of this world—and your own lost history! The first game in the hit Japanese tactics-RPG visual novel series Utawarerumono joins its sequels back on PC! games.name: Utawarerumono: ZAN 2
games.short_description: Hack and slash your way through the world of Utawarerumono once again! Experience the saga's climactic conclusion like never before with fast-paced combat, slick animations, and all-new exclusive scenes and side-stories!

descriptions.en: Hack and slash your way through the world of Utawarerumono once again! Experience the saga's climactic conclusion like never before with fast-paced combat, slick animations, and all-new exclusive scenes and side-stories!

detailed_descriptions.en: Mix and match flashy combat techniques, gameplay-altering equippables, and evolvable abilities. Create an unstoppable team from the 20+ playable characters to blast through 50+ story missions and more in this action-packed adventure. Utawarerumono: ZAN is back and it's better than ever! BEYOND MASK OF DECEPTION The primary story mode follows the plot of Utawarerumono: Mask of Truth , including many new, fully-voiced scenes original to Utawarerumono: ZAN 2 that expand the breadth of the world and the depth of the characters! 3D HACK-AND-SLASH REBORN ZAN 2 improves on its predecessor in every way, with a new Skill Board system and refined hack-and-slash elements that allow for a renewed focus on character exploration and growth. Meanwhile, the new base system allows you to explore Oshtor's estate in Ennakamuy, where you can interact with your companions, progress the story, strengthen your characters, and more. You can even upgrade the base's functionality using points obtained in the course of gameplay! ANIMATED STORYTELLING No paper dolls here! 3D animated story cutscenes give every pivotal moment the sense of weight and place that it deserves, bringing the adventure to life like never before. DREAM ONLINE Co-op or in single player, the Dream Arena mode brings enemies, challenges, and maps that wouldn't be possible within the scope of the regular story. Play online with friends from around the world!

games.short_description: Awaken as a Vampire. Hunt for blood in nearby settlements to regain your strength and evade the scorching sun to survive. Raise your castle and thrive in an ever-changing, open world full of mystery. Gain allies online and conquer the land of the living.

descriptions.en: Awaken as a Vampire. Hunt for blood in nearby settlements to regain your strength and evade the scorching sun to survive. Raise your castle and thrive in an ever-changing, open world full of mystery. Gain allies online and conquer the land of the living.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 作為一隻吸血鬼醒來，在附近的定居點狩獵鮮血以此恢復力量。避開致命陽光的炙烤。建設您的城堡，在這個充滿謎團、不斷變化的開放世界裡蓬勃發展。線上尋覓友軍，征服生者的土地。
descriptions.ja: ヴァンパイアのお目覚めだ。近くの拠点で血を狩って体力を回復する際は、くれぐれも灼熱の太陽から身を隠すように。城を建設し、謎に満ちた刻々と変化するオープンワールドで主権を示せ。オンラインで仲間を増やし、生者の大地を征服するのだ。
descriptions.ko: 뱀파이어로서 깨어나 인근 거주지에서 피 사냥을 통해 힘을 회복합니다. 치명적인 뜨거운 햇빛을 피하고 자신만의 성채를 건설하고 끊임없이 변화하는 신비로운 오픈 세계에서 발전합시다. 온라인에서 동맹군을 찾아 생존자의 땅을 정복하세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: UPDATE 1.1: INVADERS OF OAKVEIL IS AVAILABLE NOW! Experience a Vampire Survival Action RPG adventure like no other. Awaken as a weakened Vampire after centuries of slumber. Hunt for blood to regain your strength while hiding from the scorching sun to survive. Build a mighty castle worthy of your name and convert humans into loyal thralls to serve your growing empire. Pillage villages, raid bandit camps, and challenge supernatural beings, drinking their blood to steal their power. Make allies or enemies online or play solo locally and wage war in a world of conflict. Seize your destiny, defy Dracula, and rise as the ultimate predator to rule the night! Now with native gamepad support and a reimagined interface, prepare for action-packed, hands-on gameplay! A Gothic Open-World Explore a vast world teeming with mythical horrors and danger. Travel through lush forests, open countryside, and dark caverns to discover valuable resources, meeting friends and foes alike along the way. Traverse the world with vampire comrades or hunt solo as you ravage villages, fend off holy soldiers, and challenge supernatural bosses. Fear the light - Rule the night Stick to the shadows during the daytime, or the burning sunlight will turn you to ashes. Roam the night and prey on your victims in the darkness. As a vampire, you must quench your thirst for blood while planning your strategies around the rising and setting sun. Raise your Castle Gather resources and discover ancient techniques to uncover forgotten knowledge. Use your newly acquired insight to build a castle to store your loot and grow your army of darkness. Personalize your domain, exhibit your vampiric style, and make sure to craft coffins for servants and friends. Strengthen your castle to protect your treasure hoard from vampire rivals. Compete or Cooperate Travel alone or explore the world with friends. Fighting side by side with other Vampires will give you an advantage in the fight to conquer the greatest threats of Vardoran. Raid other players’ castles, play the diplomat in the game of blood, power, and betrayal, or craft an indomitable retinue of insidious allies. Compete or cooperate - the choice is yours. Master your Vampire Learn and master an arsenal of deadly weapons and unholy abilities. In V Rising, you aim skillshots and dodge projectiles using​ precise​​ ​WASD controls ​and cursor-based​ ​aiming - no click to move. Tailor your vampire to fit your play style by combining weapons with a variety of spells earned through vanquishing powerful foes. Find and master your personal, perfect blend of sword and sorcery to become the ultimate nocturnal predator!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 體驗前所未有的吸血鬼生存動作RPG冒險。 您是一隻剛從數百年的沉睡中醒來的虛弱吸血鬼。狩獵鮮血來恢復力量；避開致命陽光的炙烤。重建您的城堡，將人類變成忠實的僕從，以便打造屬於您的吸血鬼帝國。線上結盟或樹敵，抑或在本機上獨自遊玩。在這個衝突不斷的世界裡抵禦神聖的士兵，發動戰爭。掌控自己的命運！碾壓德古拉！統治黑夜！ 哥德風開放世界 探索廣大的世界吧，這裡充滿著神話中的恐怖和危險。穿梭在茂密的森林、開闊的鄉村和黑暗的洞穴中，尋找寶貴的資源；沿途上結交朋友，對抗敵人，和吸血鬼戰友一起周遊世界，或是獨自狩獵也沒問題。劫掠村莊，襲擊強盜，深入超自然野獸的領地。 畏懼光明——統治黑夜 在白日躲入陰影，否則烈日會把您灼燒成灰燼。在夜間遊蕩、在黑暗中捕食獵物。作為吸血鬼，您必須飲血止渴，同時圍繞著日出日落來制定戰略。 建設您的城堡 收集資源、發現古老的技術，揭露被遺忘的知識。依靠新的領悟去建造一座城堡，用於儲存戰利品，培育您的黑暗大軍。訂製您的領地，展現您的吸血鬼風格，別忘了為僕從和朋友製作棺材，還要加固城堡，防止吸血鬼對手們奪走您囤積的寶藏。 競爭或合作 獨自旅行，或是與朋友一起探索世界。和其他吸血鬼並肩作戰可以獲得優勢，幫助您攻克瓦爾多蘭種種最強大的威脅。您可以攻擊其他玩家的城堡，在這場圍繞鮮血、力量與背叛的遊戲中巧妙與各方勢力周旋，或是構建一支由陰險友軍組成的頑強團隊。競爭或合作——由您決定。 掌握吸血鬼能力 學習並掌握一系列致命武器和邪惡技能。在《夜族崛起》中，您使用WASD鍵或滑鼠精確瞄準、發射法術，並躲避射彈——不需要透過滑鼠點擊來移動。擊敗強大的敵人，獲得各式各樣的法術，將其與武器結合，制定您自己的吸血鬼遊戲體驗。找到並掌握您專屬的、完美的劍與法術組合，成為終極的暗夜掠食者！
detailed_descriptions.ja: 今までにないヴァンパイアサバイバルARPGを体験しよう 数世紀にわたる眠りから覚めると、あなたはひ弱いヴァンパイアになってしまった。灼熱の太陽から身を隠しながら、血を狩って体力を回復させ、生き残れ。マイキャッスルを再建して、人間を忠実な下僕に変え、ヴァンパイア帝国を築き上げろ。オンラインで味方や敵を作るのもよし、ローカルでソロプレイを楽しむのもよし。オカルティックな兵隊を撃退し、この紛争に満ちた世界で戦争を繰り広げよう。運命をつかめ！ドラキュラを倒せ！この夜を支配せよ！ ゴシック・オープンワールド 神秘的な恐怖と危険に満ちた広大な世界で探検してみよう。緑豊かな森、広々とした田舎、暗い洞窟などで旅しながら貴重な資源を探し、敵や仲間との出会いを楽しもう。ひとり旅も悪くないが、ヴァンパイアの仲間と共に世界を駆け巡れ。村や盗賊を襲い、オカルティックな獣のナワバリで狩りをしよう。 光への恐怖——闇を支配せよ 昼間は物陰の中で身を潜めよ。さもないと、あなたは炎天下で灰になるだろう。夜は旅続け、闇の中で獲物を捕食しよう。ヴァンパイアの嗜みとして、昼と夜は別々の対応策を立てなければならない。 マイキャッスルを築こう 資源と古代の技術を発見し、忘れ去られた知識を解き明かす。それらの知識はマイキャッスルの建設に役立つだろう。城に戦利品を貯え、闇の部隊を築くのだ。自分の領地をパーソナライズして、己のヴァンパイア・スタイルを見せつけよう。使用人や友人のための棺を作るのもお忘れなく。他のヴァンパイアに自分の資源を奪われないように、城は常に強化するように！ 殺し合いか協力か ひとり旅の楽しさと、仲間と一緒に探索する楽しさ。他のヴァンパイアと協力すれば、ヴァルドラン各地の脅威を征服するのに役立につだろう 。プレイヤーの城を襲撃でき、血なまぐささ・権力・裏切りに満ちたのこのゲームでは、敵対勢力を巧みに操ったり、不吉な味方同士で強固なチームを作ったり、やり方は様々である。いずれにせよ、殺し合いをするか、協力を求めるか、すべては自分次第だ。 ヴァンパイアを使いこなせ 強力な武器や不浄なアビリティを習得しよう。『V Rising』では、クイック移動ではなく、WASDキーまたはカーソルを使って正確に狙いを定め、スペルを放ち、投射物をかわす仕様です。敵を倒して得られたスペルや武器を組み合わせ、自分のゲームスタイルに合ったヴァンパイアをカスタマイズしましょう。自分だけの剣とスペルの正解を見つけ、それをマスターし、究極の夜の捕食者を目指せ！
detailed_descriptions.ko: 전에 없던 뱀파이어 서바이벌 액션 RPG 어드벤처 게임을 즐겨보세요! 당신은 수백 년의 깊은 잠에서 깨어난 허약한 뱀파이어입니다. 피 사냥을 통해 힘을 회복하며 치명적인 뜨거운 햇빛을 피하고 성채를 재건하고 인간을 충실한 종복으로 만들어 당신만의 뱀파이어 제국을 세우세요. 온라인으로 동맹을 맺거나 적을 만들거나 로컬에서 혼자 놀아도 좋습니다. 갈등으로 가득 찬 이 세상에서 신성한 병사를 막아내고 전쟁을 일으킵니다. 자신의 운명과 드라큘라를 장악하고 밤의 지배자가 되세요! 고딕 스타일의 오픈 세계 전설 속의 공포와 위험으로 가득 찬 광활한 세계를 탐색합니다. 울창한 숲, 넓은 마을, 어두운 동굴을 누비며 소중한 자원을 찾고, 친구를 사귀거나 적과 싸웁니다. 뱀파이어 전우와 함께 세계 여행을 떠나거나 혼자의 사냥을 즐깁니다. 마을을 약탈하고 산적을 습격하여 깊숙한 초자연 짐승의 영역에 침투합니다. 빛을 두려워한 밤의 지배자 낮에는 그늘에 숨어 있어야 하며 그렇지 않으면 뜨거운 태양이 당신을 잿더미로 만들 것입니다. 밤에는 어둠 속에서 돌아다니면서 사냥감을 포획합니다. 뱀파이어인 당신은 반드시 피를 마시고 일출과 일몰을 기반으로 전략을 세워야 합니다. 성채를 건설합니다 자원을 수집하고 오래된 기술을 발견하고 잊혀진 지식을 밝힙니다. 새로운 깨달음으로 성채를 건설하여 전리품을 보관하고 어둠의 군대를 육성합니다. 당신만의 뱀파이어 스타일을 연출하고 종복과 친구를 위해 제작한 관을 잊지 말고 적들이 보물을 빼앗지 못하도록 성채를 강화시키세요. 경쟁 또는 협력 혼자 여행을 떠나거나 친구와 함께 세계를 탐험해도 좋습니다. 다른 뱀파이어와 함께 싸우면 바도란의 가장 강력한 위협을 정복할 수 있습니다. 다른 플레이어의 성채를 공격하여 피와 힘, 배신으로 가득 찬 게임에서 다양한 세력과 맞서거나 흉악한 우군으로 구성된 강력한 부대를 편성할 수도 있습니다. 경쟁 또는 협력, 선택권은 당신 손에 쥐고 있습니다. 뱀파이어의 능력을 파악합니다 일련의 치명적인 무기와 사악한 능력을 배우세요. 에서 정확하게 조준하기, 주문 발사하기, 발사체 피하기 등은 WASD 키나 커서를 사용하여 조작할 수 있으며, 또한 마우스를 클릭해서 움직일 필요가 없습니다. 강력한 적을 물리치고 다양한 주문을 얻어 무기와 결합하면 자신만의 뱀파이어 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다. 당신만의 완벽한 검과 주문의 조합을 찾아내어 궁극적인 밤의 포식자가 되어주세요!

games.name: V Rising - Dracula's Relics Pack
games.short_description: Embrace your dark legacy and project your intentions of supremacy with the Dracula’s Relics pack. Strikeout into Vardoran in iconic black, red, and gold. Whether on the battlefield or resting atop your extravagant throne, these colors represent a vampire with an ambition worthy of the next Dracula.

descriptions.en: Embrace your dark legacy and project your intentions of supremacy with the Dracula’s Relics pack. Strikeout into Vardoran in iconic black, red, and gold. Whether on the battlefield or resting atop your extravagant throne, these colors represent a vampire with an ambition worthy of the next Dracula.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 你作为一名虚弱的吸血鬼醒来。你需要寻找血液以恢复体力，同时躲避烈日以求生存。建立你的城堡和吸血鬼帝国，在这个神秘的、充满变化的开放世界中成长，结交盟友和征服。

detailed_descriptions.en: Dracula’s Relics Pack Embrace your dark legacy and project your intentions of supremacy with the Dracula’s Relics pack. Strikeout into Vardoran in iconic black, red, and gold. Don the Immortal King’s Mantle and mark yourself a commander of death with the Immortal King’s Greathelm as your battle crown. Whether on the battlefield or resting atop your extravagant throne, these colors represent a vampire with an ambition worthy of the next Dracula. Return home to a castle worthy of the scourge of Vardoran. From throne to coffin, walls to floors, carpet runs to brilliant braziers, your castle will project regality. The royal decor will project an unmistakable air of dominance, elegance, and taste. The Dracula’s Relics Pack contains: The Immortal King’s Drape, Cloak, and Mantle. The Immortal King’s Greathelm. The Royal Coffin The Royal Throne The Royal Pattern stone floors The Royal Gate castle doors Interior Royal Walls wallpaper Interior Royal Walls Pillar wallpaper Exterior Royal Walls wallpaper Exterior Royal Walls Pillar wallpaper Glass Window: Royal Red & Black Glass Window: Royal Black & Red Royal Carpets Royal Braziers with Orange, Blue, Green, Red, White, Yellow, and Purple flames. While you have this DLC, all items unlock and become available in-game to be crafted as you become worthy of crafting equivalent equipment.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 德古拉的遗物包 带着德古拉的遗物包，拥抱你的黑暗遗产，映射你的霸权雄心。 瓦尔多兰以标志性的黑色、红色和金色凸显。穿上不朽之王的斗篷，用卓越头盔作你的战斗王冠，将自己标记为死亡指挥官。无论是奋斗在战场上，还是休息在奢华的王座上，你都显示着不愧为下一个德古拉吸血鬼的野心。 在这一座值得祸害瓦尔多兰的城堡中。从王座到棺材，从墙壁到地板，从地毯到精美的火盆，处处彰显尊贵。皇室的装饰将带给你统治、优雅和品味的气息。 德古拉的遗物包包括 永生之王的披风、斗篷和斗篷。 （这些物品会在您获得不同层斗篷层级，证明自己值得穿着它们时解锁） 永生之王的的卓越头盔。（在制作站台解锁） 皇家棺材 王座 皇家纹石地板 皇家之门城堡门 室内皇家墙纸 室内皇家墙柱壁纸 室外皇家墙纸 室外皇家墙柱壁纸 玻璃窗：皇家红&黑色 玻璃窗：皇家黑&红色 皇家地毯 皇家火盆，带有橙色、蓝、绿、红、白、黄和紫色火焰 拥有此 DLC 后，物件会在你值得制作同等装备时解锁并可供制作。

games.name: V Rising - Eternal Dominance Pack
games.short_description: Embrace your richest palette and indulge in ultimate luxury with the Eternal Dominance pack! From servant to celebrated master, your gilded castle will be the envy of all lesser Vampires.

descriptions.en: Embrace your richest palette and indulge in ultimate luxury with the Eternal Dominance pack! From servant to celebrated master, your gilded castle will be the envy of all lesser Vampires.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 【永恆主宰】禮包為您帶來最豐富的配色，讓您盡享極致奢華！讓您的城堡從低微僕從到顯赫領主都熠熠生輝，所有低階吸血鬼都會羡慕不已。閃閃發光的池子、噴泉和寶石。您這位吸血鬼領袖的財富甚至可以惠及囚犯，讓他們都用上更舒適的訂製器具。
descriptions.ja: 豪華絢爛な「永遠の支配者（Eternal Dominance）」パックで、至高の贅沢をお届けします！最下層の使用人から高貴なる領主に至るまで、城の至る所が眩い輝きを放つ。他のヴァンパイアたちの羨望を集めることでしょう。煌めくプールや噴水、宝石に彩られた城内。圧倒的なヴァンパイアの富を用いれば、囚人さえも豪華な専用設備でその恩恵を味わえます。
descriptions.ko: “영원한 지배자” 패키지는 가장 다양한 색상 조합으로 최고의 호화를 선사합니다! 당신의 성채가 하찮은 종복부터 위엄 있는 영주까지 모두의 시선을 사로잡을 것입니다. 모든 하급 뱀파이어들이 부러워할 정도로요. 반짝이는 연못, 분수, 보석 장식들. 뱀파이어 군주인 당신의 부유함은 죄수에게까지 미쳐, 그들조차 더 편안한 맞춤형 기구를 사용할 수 있게 됩니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: Embrace your richest palette and indulge in ultimate luxury with the Eternal Dominance pack! From servant to celebrated master, your gilded castle will be the envy of all lesser Vampires. With glittering pools, fountains, and gems, even your prisoners can recline in the bespoke comfort of an affluent Vampire mastermind. The Eternal Dominance Pack contains: 5 Unique Silky Armor Pieces The complete set can be crafted in-game when you unlock the tailor bench. It costs cloth and coarse thread to make and is purely cosmetic. Place this into a cosmetic armor slot to present yourself as a fearsome creature of the night of the highest status. Opulent Night Sabatons Opulent Night Rainment Opulent Night Vambraces Opulent Night Leggings Opulent Night Visage One Wolf Shapeshift Form Take on the mysterious magical form of the Gilded Darkwolf, an alternate appearance of the Vampire’s wolf shapeshift. Unlock this alternate skin when you unlock the Wolf Shapeshift in-game. Gilded Darkwolf One Mystical Mount's Appearance A corrupted steed in glorious gold plating and silken purple drapery, glimmering with supernatural power left in your wake as you ride. The Darkvenom Horse Saddle is a craftable item unlocked as you unlock the Horse Saddle in the game. Darkvenom War Saddle Project the power of Nocturnal Opulence Wherever you rest, let it be as luxurious as you deserve and glimmering with gold and gems worthy of your rich taste. Your instrument of instant transportation, the Waygate, can now be elevated above the common design! Nocturnal Opulence Waygate available in 12 colors Nocturnal Opulence Throne available in 12 colors Nocturnal Opulence Coffin available in 12 colors Spoil your underlings with Grandeur Let it never be said that you are not a benevolent keeper. Gild your prison cells and gift your servants lovely gemstone-topped coffins to rest between their duties. Nocturnal Opulence Prison Cell available in 12 colors Nocturnal Opulence Servant Coffin available in 12 colors Floor-to-Ceiling Evidence of Your Affluence Adorn your walls, floors, and windows with gleaming gold and splendid drapery. Smooth, intricate patterns will fill your home, delighting the eye of the discerning Vampire and showing your cultivated taste. One Glass Window available in 12 colors With 3 Window Curtains available in 12 colors Nocturnal Opulence Gate (with servant lock variant) available in 12 colors 3 Wallpaper Variants available in 12 colors Nocturnal Opulence Wall x 3 Nocturnal Opulence Stairs, 4 variants available in 12 colors 2 Floor Patterns available in 12 colors Nocturnal Opulence Treasury Tiles Nocturnal Opulence Pattern Layer Your Lair With Decor to Suit Your Elevated Taste You deserve a castle to come home to. detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《夜族崛起》：永恆主宰禮包 永恆主宰禮包 為您帶來最豐富的配色，讓您盡享極致奢華！讓您的城堡從低微僕從到顯赫領主都熠熠生輝，所有下級吸血鬼都會羡慕不已。閃閃發光的池子、噴泉和寶石。您這位吸血鬼領袖的財富甚至可以惠及囚犯，讓他們都用上更舒服的定製器具。 永恆主宰禮包涵蓋以下內容： 5件獨特絲質護甲 解鎖裁縫台後，可以在遊戲中製造完整套裝。製作需要花費織物和粗線，服飾僅發揮視覺作用。將這個放進外觀護甲槽中，以無畏的最高貴暗夜生物之姿示人。 ● 奢華暗夜鋼甲靴 ● 奢華暗夜上衣 ● 奢華暗夜手套 ● 奢華暗夜腿甲 ● 奢華暗夜面甲 一款狼形態變身 變身為神秘而奇幻的鍍金黑狼外形，這是吸血鬼狼形態變身的一個變體。在遊戲中解鎖狼形態變身後，即可解鎖這款變體時裝。 ● 鍍金黑狼 一款神秘坐騎外觀 一匹身披華麗黃金鎧甲與紫色綢緞的腐化駿馬。騎上它，您所到之處都會留下它身上閃爍的超自然力量。在遊戲中解鎖坐騎鞍座後，您就可以製造黑暗毒液馬鞍。 ● 黑暗毒液戰鬥鞍具 彰顯暗夜華貴的力量 您的休憩之所應該有與您般配的奢華佈置，有符合您華貴品味的金銀珠寶在閃耀。傳送門——供您瞬間移動的手段——可以有更高級的設計了！ ● 暗夜華貴傳送門，12種顏色可選 ● 暗夜華貴寶座，12種顏色可選 ● 暗夜華貴棺材，12種顏色可選 以名貴器具優待手下 別讓人有理由抱怨您不是位樂善好施的主人。替牢籠加上黃金鍍層，贈送給您的僕從表面飾有寶石的可愛棺材，供他們在執行任務的間隙休息。 ● 暗夜華貴牢籠，12種顏色可選 ● 暗夜華貴僕從棺材，12種顏色可選 從地板到天花板都盡顯您的富有 用閃耀的黃金與精美的布料裝飾您的牆壁、地板與窗戶。您的居所將隨處是繁華精緻的圖案，讓識貨的吸血鬼眼前一亮，彰顯您高雅的品味。 ● 一款玻璃窗，12種顏色可選 ○ 含3種窗簾，12種顏色可選 ● 暗夜華貴大門（含僕從鎖變體），12種顏色可選 ● 3種壁紙變體，12種顏色可選 ○ 3種暗夜華貴牆壁 ● 暗夜華貴樓梯，4種變體，12種顏色可選 ● 2種地板圖案，12種顏色可選 ○ 暗夜華貴金庫磚片 ○ 暗夜華貴圖案 用裝飾品佈置您的巢穴，讓它配得上您的高雅品味 您應該有一座稱得上家的城堡。您是一名勤勞的吸血鬼，在一整天夢魘般的掠奪和不可動搖的統治後，應當有一座奢華舒適的城堡休息。永恆主宰禮包涵蓋所有您能想到的墮落配色，甚至還有您想不到的，足夠滿足您對不同顏色的渴求。 ● 8款牆面裝飾 ○ 暗夜華貴牆幔，12種顏色可選 ○ 6款暗夜華貴畫作 ○ 暗夜華貴壁掛噴泉 ● 5款桌台變體，12種顏色可選，每款都有獨特的桌台設定。 ○ 一張小型暗夜華貴圓桌，選項包括暗夜華貴水煙袋、2種暗夜華貴盛宴、暗夜華貴花卉和暗夜華貴點心 ● 一張暗夜華貴矩形桌，選項包括暗夜華貴水煙袋和2種暗夜華貴盛宴 ● 一張大型暗夜華貴圓桌，選項包括暗夜華貴水煙袋、暗夜華貴盛宴和暗夜華貴盛宴與點心 ● 2張大型暗夜華貴矩形桌，選項包括暗夜華貴點心與水煙袋、暗夜華貴盛宴、暗夜華貴盛宴與點心 ● 6種座位變體，12種顏色可選 ○ 暗夜華貴厚坐墊 ○ 暗夜華貴座椅 ○ 暗夜華貴座位 ○ 暗夜華貴座椅 ○ 暗夜華貴長沙發椅 ○ 暗夜華貴沙發 ● 3種裝飾用枕頭擺放方式，12種顏色可選 ○ 3款暗夜華貴坐墊 ● 3種光源，10種顏色可選 ○ 暗夜華貴燈座 ○ 2款暗夜華貴吊燈 ● 一款城堡走道地毯，12種顏色可選 ○ 暗夜華貴地毯——轉角、X型、末端、筆直與T型變體 ● 5種裝飾性地毯變體，12種顏色可選 ○ 暗夜華貴圓形地毯 ○ 暗夜華貴優雅方形地毯 ○ 暗夜華貴富麗方形地毯 ○ 暗夜華貴矩形地毯 ○ 暗夜華貴菱形地毯 ● 3座雕像，12種顏色可選 ○ 暗夜華貴女性雕像2尊 ○ 暗夜華貴男性雕像 ● 2座裝飾用水池，12種顏色可選 ○ 暗夜華貴方形水池 ○ 暗夜華貴圓形水池 免責聲明： 該內容至少需要1.1版的存檔才能載入。該DLC與1.1版本之前創建的存檔並不相容，無法在此類存檔上使用。即便擁有此DLC，您也可以載入遊玩1.1版本之前的存檔。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 『V Rising』：「永遠の支配者」パック 豪華絢爛な 「永遠の支配者（Eternal Dominance）」パック で、至高の贅沢をお届けします！最下層の使用人から高貴なる領主に至るまで、城の至る所が眩い輝きを放つ。他のヴァンパイアたちの羨望を集めることでしょう。煌めくプールや噴水、宝石に彩られた城内。圧倒的なヴァンパイアの富を用いれば、囚人さえも豪華な専用設備でその恩恵を味わえます。 「永遠の支配者」パックに含まれるもの： シルクのようになめらかな質感を持つ、5種のユニークなアーマー 「仕立て台」をアンロックするとフルセットをクラフト可能。クラフトには布と粗い糸が必要です。本セットに属性付与はございません。スキン用アーマースロットに装備して、夜の頂点に君臨する堂々たる姿を示しましょう。 ● オプレントナイト サバトン ● オプレントナイト レインメント ● オプレントナイト ヴァンブレイス ● オプレントナイト レギンス ● オプレントナイト ヴィサージュ 新たなウルフフォーム 黄金の装甲と絹のような紫の布に包まれ、妖しく輝く「ダークヴェノムの軍馬」。その背に乗れば、魔力の余韻が地を照らすでしょう。ゲーム内で「乗用鞍」をアンロックすると、「ダークヴェノムの軍馬」がクラフト可能になります。 ● ダークヴェノムの乗用鞍 「夜の栄華」を代表するアイテム どこに休むとしても、その場所はあなたの格式にふさわしく、金と宝石に輝いていなければなりません。瞬時に移動できるウェイゲート（転送門）も、平凡なデザインのままではもったいないです！ ● 夜の栄華 ウェイゲート（全12色） ● 夜の栄華 玉座（全12色） ● 夜の栄華 棺（全12色） 使用人も虜にするアイテム あなたが寛大なる主であることを、全世界が知るべきです。囚人の牢も黄金に輝かせ、使用人には宝石の冠を添えた棺桶で休息の時を与えましょう。 ● 夜の栄華 独房（全12色） ● 夜の栄華 使用人の棺（全12色） 床から天井まで、豪奢な装飾で富を示せ―― 壁、床、窓に至るまで、金の輝きと豪華な装飾であなたの邸宅を飾りましょう。滑らかで精緻なパターンが城全体を彩り、同じ美学を抱くヴァンパイアの心を満たし、洗練された趣味を世に知らしめるのです。 ● 窓ガラス（全12色） ○ 専用カーテン（全3種・各12色） ● 夜の栄華 門（使用人ロックバリエーションあり・全12色） ● 壁紙バリエーション（全3種・各12色） ○ 夜の栄華 壁（全3種） ● 夜の栄華 detailed_descriptions.ko: <V Rising>: 영원한 지배자 패키지 영원한 지배자 패키지는 가장 다양한 색상 조합으로 최고의 호화를 선사합니다! 당신의 성채가 하찮은 종복부터 위엄 있는 영주까지 모두의 시선을 사로잡을 것입니다. 모든 하급 뱀파이어들이 부러워할 정도로요. 반짝이는 연못, 분수, 보석 장식들. 뱀파이어 군주인 당신의 부유함은 죄수에게까지 미쳐, 그들조차 더 편안한 맞춤형 기구를 사용할 수 있게 됩니다. 영원한 지배자 패키지 내용물: 5가지 특수 비단 갑옷 재단 작업대가 해제되면 풀세트를 제작할 수 있습니다. 제작에는 천과 굵은 실타래가 필요하며 복장은 비주얼 효과만 발휘합니다. 외관 슬롯에 장착하면, 두려움 없고 고귀한 어둠의 존재로서 모습을 드러낼 수 있습니다. ● 호화로운 밤의 강철 부츠 ● 호화로운 밤의 상의 ● 호화로운 밤의 장갑 ● 호화로운 밤의 다리 보호구 ● 호화로운 밤의 얼굴 보호구 늑대 형태 변신체 1종 신비롭고 환상적인 도금 검은 늑대의 모습으로 변신하세요. 이것은 뱀파이어의 늑대 변신체 중의 하나입니다. 게임에서 늑대 변신체를 해제하고 이 외관도 함께 손에 넣으세요. ● 도금 검은 늑대 신비로운 탈것 외형 1종 화려한 황금 갑옷과 보라색 비단으로 치장된 부패한 말입니다. 그의 등에 올라타면, 지나가는 길마다 초자연적인 힘의 흔적이 남을 것입니다. 게임에서 탈것 안장을 해제하고 어둠의 독액 안장을 제작하세요. ● 어둠의 독액 전투 안장 어둠의 고귀함이 뿜어내는 힘을 느껴보세요. 당신의 안식처는 당신의 위엄에 걸맞게 꾸며져야 합니다. 고귀한 취향을 반영한 금은보화가 찬란히 빛나야 하죠. 웨이게이트--더 고급스럽고 정교한 디자인으로 바꿔보세요! ● 고귀한 밤의 포탈 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ● 고귀한 밤의 왕좌 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ● 고귀한 밤의 관 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 귀중한 기구로 부하를 대접하세요. 누군가 당신이 인색한 주인이라 오해하지 않도록 하세요. 감옥에 금빛 도금을 더하고, 임무 사이사이 휴식을 취할 수 있도록 보석 장식이 된 고급 관을 종복들에게 제공해 주세요. ● 고귀한 밤의 감옥 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ● 고귀한 밤의 종복 관 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 바닥부터 천장까지 당신의 부를 뽐내세요. 화려한 금장과 고급 천으로 벽, 바닥, 창문을 꾸며보세요. 세밀하고 정교한 문양이 저택 곳곳을 수놓아, 품격이 있는 뱀파이어들의 시선을 사로잡고 당신의 세련된 취향을 드러내세요. ● 유리창 1종 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ○ 커튼 3종 포함 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ● 고귀한 밤의 대문(종복 자물쇠 변신체 포함) – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ● 벽지 변신체 3종 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ○ 고귀한 밤의 벽 3종 ● 고귀한 밤의 계단 – 4가지 변신체, 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ● 바닥 패턴 2종 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ○ 고귀한 밤의 금고 벽돌 조각 ○ 고귀한 밤의 장식 패턴 당신의 품격에 걸맞은 장식으로 둥지를 꾸며보세요. 진정 ‘집’이라 부를 수 있는 성채가 있어야 합니다. 하루 종일 악몽 같은 약탈과 흔들림 없는 지배를 마친 성실한 뱀파이어라면, 마땅히 고급스럽고 안락한 성채에서 휴식을 취해야 하죠. 영원한 지배자 패키지는 상상 가능한 모든 타락의 색상은 물론, 상상 너머의 색조까지 담고 있어, 다양한 색감에 대한 갈증을 충분히 해소시켜 드릴 수 있습니다. ● 벽 장식 8종 ○ 고귀한 밤의 벽 커튼 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ○ 고귀한 밤의 그림 작품 6종 ○ 고귀한 밤의 벽걸이 분수 ● 테이블 변신체 5종 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능, 각각 고유의 세팅 옵션 포함 ○ 소형 고귀한 밤의 원형 테이블 – 포함 옵션: 고귀한 밤의 물담배, 고귀한 밤의 연회 2종, 고귀한 밤의 꽃, 고귀한 밤의 다과 ● 고귀한 밤의 직사각형 테이블 – 포함 옵션: 고귀한 밤의 물담배, 고귀한 밤의 연회 2종 ● 대형 고귀한 밤의 원형 테이블 – 포함 옵션: 고귀한 밤의 물담배, 고귀한 밤의 연회, 고귀한 밤의 연회와 다과 ● 대형 고귀한 밤의 직사각형 테이블 2종 – 포함 옵션: 고귀한 밤의 다과와 물담배, 고귀한 밤의 연회, 고귀한 밤의 연회와 다과 ● 좌석 변신체 6종 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ○ 고귀한 밤의 두꺼운 방석 ○ 고귀한 밤의 의자 ○ 고귀한 밤의 좌석 ○ 고귀한 밤의 의자 ○ 고귀한 밤의 디반 소파 ○ 고귀한 밤의 소파 ● 장식용 베개 배치 방식 3종 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ○ 고귀한 밤의 방석 3종 ● 조명 3종 – 10가지 색상 선택 가능 ○ 고귀한 밤의 램프 홀더 ○ 고귀한 밤의 플라잉 샹들리에 2종 ● 성채 복도 카펫 1종 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ○ 고귀한 밤의 카펫--모서리, X자형, 끝부분, 일자형 및 T자형 변신체 ● 장식용 카펫 변신체 5종 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ○ 고귀한 밤의 원형 카펫 ○ 고귀한 밤의 우아한 사각형 카펫 ○ 고귀한 밤의 화려한 사각형 카펫 ○ 고귀한 밤의 직사각형 카펫 ○ 고귀한 밤의 마름모형 카펫 ● 조각상 3종 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ○ 고귀한 밤의 여성 조각상 2개 ○ 고귀한 밤의 남성 조각상 ● 장식용 연못 2종 – 12가지 색상 선택 가능 ○ 고귀한 밤의 사각 연못 ○ 고귀한 밤의 원형 연못 주의 사항: 해당 콘텐츠는 1.1버전 이상의 저장 데이터에서만 사용할 수 있습니다. 해당 DLC는 1.1버전 이전에 생성된 저장 데이터와는 호환되지 않으며, 관련 저장에서는 적용되지 않습니다. 다만, DLC를 보유하고 있더라도 1.1버전 이전의 저장 데이터를 불러와 플레이할 수 있습니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: V Rising: Legacy of Castlevania Premium Pack Introducing the Legacy of Castlevania Premium Pack in collaboration with Konami Digital Entertainment (KONAMI). This pack includes new cosmetics that allow you to take on the storied aesthetics of hair, clothing, and forms from one of the all-time classic Vampire franchises. Invoke style and indulge in your Castlevania nostalgia alongside the action-packed V Rising experience you’ve come to know and love. The Legacy of Castlevania Premium Pack contains: 5 Unique Armor Pieces With Alucard’s Regalia The complete set can be crafted in-game when you unlock the tailor bench. It costs cloth and coarse thread to make and is purely cosmetic. Using the new armor customization feature, you can don the garb of the Vampire Prince at any level of your Vampire journey. Alucard’s Cloak Alucard’s Coat Alucard’s Leggings Alucard’s Gloves Alucard’s Boots 3 Unique Shapeshifting Form Variants Traverse the open world with the Soul of the Wolf, embody the prodigal Maria Renard to move unnoticed among the realms of man, or spring through the air as the mischievous Flea Man! Wolf Form Variant: Soul of the Wolf Human Form Variant: Glamour of Maria Renard Toad Form Variant: Guise of The Flea Man Wall-to-Wall Castlevania Ambience Drape your walls, floors, and most valued places of power in the style of Castlevania. Adorn your walls with the sweeping iconography of pristine angelic figures juxtaposed with the bared fangs of the evolved beast of the night wrapped around the head of your bejeweled coffin. Sit on a throne that projects power, shadowed only by the great bat wings cresting each side of its towering frame. Ancient Symphony Coffin Ancient Symphony Throne 5 Variants of Ancient Symphony Wallpapers Ancient Symphony Floor Pattern Ancient Symphony Gate (Castle Door with Servant Lock variant) 4 Variants of Ancient Symphony Stairs Ancient Symphony Carpet (Corner, End, Straight, T-Section, X-Section) Ancient Symphony Candelabra Ancient Symphony Glass Window - Wraith Ancient Symphony Glass Window - Vampire Ancient Symphony Blood Fountain 2 Ancient Symphony Paintings Line Your Halls With Figures of Greatness Surround yourself with the imagery of regal creatures of the night, stunning heroes, and the hopeless duality of angelic beauty. Ancient Symphony Statue of Alucard Ancient Symphony Statue of Maria Ancient Symphony Evolved Being (Statue) Ancient Symphony Bone Trophy Ancient Symphony Angelic Statue One Bespoke Undead Mount Ride into battle upon Rowdain's famed skeletal steed and enjoy the delicious irony of bringing your unliving fantasy to life. Rowdain’s Steed (Saddle) New Unique Hairstyles Some of these styles might seem familiar to you, and if they don’t, you’ll just have to do a little bit of homework to fully appreciate how good you look. 4 new hairstyles: The Lecarde sisters and two Succubus variants. Unlock Castlevania Music Tracks Set the tone in your ominous abode with two classic Castlevania themes, “Simon’s Theme” and “Bloody Tears”, reimagined by V Rising composer Aleksandria Migova. This DLC unlocks the music to be played with the Music Box in your castle. Bloody Tears (V Rising Adaptation) Simon’s Theme (V Rising Adaptation) The items are unlocked when you research or discover equivalent tiers of items in the game as you progress in your adventure. For instance, you will gain access to the Soul of the Wolf variant after defeating the Alpha Wolf and unlocking Wolf Form. In the Vampire Powers menu, there should be arrows that allow you to change the cosmetic on any of the vampire forms if you have them. OCTOBER 21 UPDATE: NEW ITEMS In addition to what was already available, this pack has been updated as October 21, 2024 with even more content to deck out your Vampire in decadent Castlevania style. New Content for the Legacy of Castlevania DLC Includes: Shanoa Outfit : Step into the elegant, battle-ready attire of Shanoa, the powerful warrior from Castlevania: Order of Ecclesia. Adorn yourself in her iconic black-and-blue gothic dress, featuring flowing dark fabrics, intricate metallic accents, and a look that exudes mystery and strength. Soma Cruz Outfit : Embrace the destiny of the prophesied dark lord with the iconic look of Soma Cruz from Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow and Dawn of Sorrow. This outfit features Soma’s signature long white trench coat with striking blue accents, paired with sleek pants and boots. New Castle Walls New Castle Windows New Castle Door New Castle Fence New Castle Paintings While you have this DLC, all items unlock and become available in-game to be crafted as you become worthy of crafting equivalent equipment.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《夜族崛起》：惡魔城傳奇典藏包 向您介紹《夜族崛起》與科樂美數碼娛樂株式會社（KONAMI）聯名的 惡魔城傳奇典藏包 。該典藏包中包含新的外觀，您可以使用它們解鎖一個永不退流行的經典吸血鬼的髮型、服裝和造型，獲得傳奇般的美感。換上《惡魔城》風格的外觀，在沉醉於懷舊之情中的同時，體驗並享受您熟知和喜愛的《夜族崛起》動作遊戲。 惡魔城傳奇典藏包包含： 5件阿魯卡多服飾獨特護甲 解鎖裁縫台後可以在遊戲中製造完整套裝。製作需要花費布料和粗線，服飾僅起到觀賞作用。有了新的護甲自訂功能，您可以在吸血鬼之旅的任意階段穿上吸血鬼王子的服裝。 阿魯卡多的斗篷 阿魯卡多的外套 阿魯卡多的腿甲 阿魯卡多的手套 阿魯卡多的靴子 3種獨特的變形 用狼之魂漫遊開放世界，成為揮霍的瑪利亞·雷納德，在男人的地盤上潛行，或是像愛搗蛋的跳蚤男那樣在空中彈跳！ 狼形態變體：狼之魂 人形態變體：瑪利亞·雷納德的魅力 蟾蜍形態變體：跳蚤男的偽裝 滿牆的《惡魔城》氛圍 將您的牆壁、地板和彰顯權力的重要場所裝修成《惡魔城》風格。使用盛行的純潔天使圖案裝飾您的牆壁，同時，將黑夜中進化出的野獸的獠牙纏繞在您鑲滿珠寶的棺材頂端。坐在象徵權力的寶座上，您頭頂唯一的陰霾來自寶座那高聳骨架頂點上的巨大蝙蝠翅膀。 遠古交響曲棺材 遠古交響曲寶座 5種遠古交響曲牆紙變體 遠古交響曲地板圖案 遠古交響曲大門（城堡大門–僕從鎖變體） 4種遠古交響曲樓梯變體 遠古交響曲地毯（拐角、封邊、筆直、T形、X形） 遠古交響曲燭臺 遠古交響曲玻璃窗–惡靈 遠古交響曲玻璃窗–吸血鬼 遠古交響曲血之噴泉 2 遠古交響曲畫作 用偉大的形象裝點您的大廳 讓自己置身於夜間生物之王、魅力英雄人物和天使之美的無望二元性的意象之中。 遠古交響曲阿魯卡多雕像 遠古交響曲瑪利亞雕像 遠古交響曲進化生物（雕像） 遠古交響曲骨制獎盃 遠古交響曲天使雕像 一匹定做的亡靈坐騎 騎著羅戴因著名的骷髏馬踏上戰場，將不切實際的幻想變為現實，多麼美味的諷刺。 羅戴因的愛馬（鞍座） 新的獨特髮型 其中一些髮型看起來可能有些眼熟，如果您對它們沒有印象，您只需要做點功課就能完全理解到自己看起來有多棒。 4款新髮型：李卡德姐妹和兩名魅魔。 解鎖《惡魔城》音樂曲目 使用這兩首經典的《惡魔城》主題曲奠定您不祥居所的基調——由《夜族崛起》作曲家Aleksandria Migova重新演繹的「西蒙主題曲」與「血之淚」。該DLC會解鎖音樂，可以用您城堡的音樂盒播放。 血之淚（《夜族崛起》改編版） 西蒙主題曲（《夜族崛起》改編版） 對應等級物品解鎖後，這些物品也將解鎖。例如，擊敗頭狼並解鎖狼形態後，您將解鎖狼之魂變體。 10月21日更新：新物品 該遊戲包已於2024年10月21日更新，在先前內容的基礎上新增物品，更便於將您的吸血鬼打扮成墮落的惡魔城風格。 惡魔城傳奇DLC新內容有： 夏諾雅服裝 ：這是《惡魔城：被奪走的刻印》中，強大戰士夏諾雅華麗的戰鬥服裝。一條藍黑相間的經典哥德式裙裝，飛舞的黑色布料上裝飾著精緻的金屬配件，帶給人神秘又富有力量的印象。 來須蒼真服裝 ：穿上《惡魔城：曉月圓舞曲》與《惡魔城：蒼月的十字架》中，來須蒼真的經典服裝，擁抱預言中黑暗領主的宿命。這套服裝包含蒼真最具特色的白底藍紋長大衣，搶眼的時髦長褲與靴子。 新的城堡牆壁 新的城堡窗戶 新的城堡門 新的城堡籬笆 新的城堡畫作 獲得該DLC後，所有物品會解鎖，只要您有資格製造相應類別的裝備，即可在遊戲裡製造這些物品。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 『V Rising』：悪魔城ドラキュラプレミアムパック 株式会社コナミデジタルエンタテインメント（KONAMI）とのコラボレーションによる『V Rising』の最新パック「 悪魔城ドラキュラプレミアムパック 」のご紹介です。本プレミアムパックには、時代を超越したクラシックなヴァンパイアIPのヘアスタイル、コスチューム、フォームが含まれます。レジェンドを謳う美学を手に入れるチャンスです！少しおめかしをして、アクション満載の『V Rising』と共に「悪魔城」のノスタルジアを満喫しよう。 悪魔城ドラキュラプレミアムパックの内容： アルカードの伝説を語る5つのユニークなアーマー 「仕立て台」をアンロックするとフルセットをクラフト可能。クラフトには布と粗い糸が必要です。本セットに属性付与はございません。新しいアーマーカスタマイズ機能を使えば、ヴァンパイアの旅の中で、いつでもヴァンパイア・プリンスの衣装を着ることができます。 アルカードのクローク アルカードの外套 アルカードのレギンス アルカードのグローブ アルカードのブーツ 3つのユニークフォーム オープンワールドを「狼の魂」で駆け巡ろう！放蕩者のマリア・レナードになりきって人間の世界に紛れ込んだり、いたずら好きなノミ男になって空中を飛び跳ねたり。楽しみ方は人それぞれ！ ウルフフォーム：狼の魂 人間フォーム：麗しきマリア・レナード トードフォーム：ノミ男の装い 「悪魔城」雰囲気満載 壁、床、そして最も重要な権力の座を、悪魔城スタイルで飾りましょう。壁には清らかな天使のパターンを、宝石をちりばめた棺のトップには暗闇で進化した夜の獣のむき出しの牙を並べよう！権力の象徴である玉座に座れば、そびえ立つ骸骨フレームの頂点にある巨大コウモリの翼が頭上に広がるだろう。 古のシンフォニー 棺 古のシンフォニー 玉座 古のシンフォニー 壁シリーズ 古のシンフォニー フローリングパターン 古のシンフォニー 門（城門–使用人ロックシリーズ） 古のシンフォニー 階段シリーズ 古のシンフォニー カーペットシリーズ 古のシンフォニー 燭台 窓ガラス-古のシンフォニー（悪霊） 窓ガラス-古のシンフォニー（ヴァンパイア） 古のシンフォニー 血の噴水 2 古のシンフォニー 絵画 偉人たちをホールに飾ろう 夜の王、華やかな英雄像、天使の美しさといった絶望的な二面性を堪能できるでしょう。 古のシンフォニー アルカード像 古のシンフォニー マリア像 古のシンフォニー 進化クリーチャー（像） 古のシンフォニー 骨のトロフィー 2 古のシンフォニー 天使の像 オーダーメイドのアンデッド・マウント ローダインの愛馬、骸骨の馬に乗って戦場に挑み、ファンタジーに命を吹き込むという愛おしい皮肉を楽しもう！ ローダインのマウント（乗用鞍） 新しいユニークヘアスタイル これらのスタイルの中には、見覚えのあるものもあるかもしれない。もし記憶にないのあれば、今自分がどれほどおしゃれに染まっているか、自分を見直す時間が必要だろう。 4つの新しいヘアスタイル：リカード姉妹とサキュバスの亜種2名。 「悪魔城」楽曲 『V Rising』の作曲家Aleksandria Migova氏によるアレンジされた2つのクラシック楽曲「シモンのテーマ」と「血の涙」で、不吉な住まいの雰囲気を盛り上げよう。このDLCでは、城の音楽プレイヤーで再生できる楽曲がアンロックされます。 血の涙（『V Rising』アレンジ） シモンのテーマ（『V Rising』アレンジ） これらのアイテムは、対応するレベルのアイテムがアンロックされると同時アンロックされます。例：アルファを倒してウルフフォームをアンロックすると、狼の魂のバリエーションがアンロックされる。 10月21日アップデート：新アイテム 本パックは2024年10月21日にアップデートいたしました。既存のコンテンツに加え、この度は堕落した悪魔城スタイルを実現できる新アイテムが追加されています。 悪魔城DLCの新コンテンツ： シャノアのコスチューム ：『悪魔城ドラキュラ 奪われた刻印』に登場する強き戦士シャノアの戦闘コスチュームです。ブルーとブラックのクラシックなゴシック・ドレスと、ひらひらと揺れるブラック生地に繊細なメタリックアクセントがあしらわれ、ミステリアスでありながら力強い印象が特徴です。 来須蒼真のコスチューム ：『キャッスルヴァニア 〜暁月の円舞曲〜』と『悪魔城ドラキュラ 蒼月の十字架』に登場する来須蒼真の定番衣装。予言された暗黒卿の運命を受け入れよう。本コスチュームには、蒼真の最も特徴的な白地に青のストライプのロングコート、人目を引くシックなパンツとブーツが含まれています。 新しい城壁 新しい窓 新しい城門 新しいフェンス 新しい絵画 本DLCを入手すると、すべてのアイテムがアンロックされ、該当するクラスの装備を作る条件が揃っている限り、いつでもゲーム内で作成できます。
detailed_descriptions.ko: --'캐슬바니아의 유산' 클래식 패키지 및 코나미 디지털 엔터테인먼트(KONAMI)의 연동 캐슬바니아의 유산' 클래식 패키지 를 소개해 드립니다. 클래식 패키지에 포함된 새로운 외관으로 유행을 타지 않은 클래식한 뱀파이어 IP 헤어스타일과 복장 및 스타일링을 해제하여 아름다움을 선사하세요. '캐슬바니아' 스타일로 바꾸어 옛날 감정에 취하면서 사랑하는 액션 게임을 즐기세요. 캐슬바니아의 유산' 클래식 패키지 내용물： 아루카도 특별 갑옷*5 재단 작업대가 해제되면 풀세트를 제작할 수 있습니다. 제작에는 천과 굵은 실타래가 필요하며 복장은 비주얼 효과만 발휘합니다. 새로운 갑옷 커스텀 기능으로 뱀파이어 여정에서 마음대로 뱀파이어 왕자의 의상을 착용할 수 있습니다. 아루카도의 단망토 아루카도의 코트 아루카도의 다리 보호구 아루카도의 장갑 아루카도의 부츠 특별한 변신*3 울프 소울로 오픈 세계를 누비며 방탕한 마리아 레나드가 되어 남자의 영토에서 잠행하거나 말썽꾸러기 벼룩 남자처럼 공중에서 뛰어오르세요! 늑대 변신체：울프 소울 인간 변신체：마리아 레나드의 매력 두꺼비 변신체：벼룩 남자의 위장 가득한 캐슬바니아 분위기 벽과 바닥 권력을 드러내는 중요한 장소를 '캐슬바니아' 스타일로 꾸미세요. 순결한 천사 도안을 사용하여 벽을 장식하고 어두운 밤에 진화된 짐승의 송곳니를 보석 박힌 관 꼭대기를 장식하세요. 권위를 상징하는 왕좌에 앉아 머리 위에 드리워진 유일한 그늘은 왕좌 꼭대기에 있는 거대한 박쥐 날개에서 비롯됩니다. 고대 교향곡 관 고대 교향곡 왕좌 고대 교향곡 벽지 변신체*5 고대 교향곡 바닥 패턴 고대 교향곡 문(성채 문–종복 자물쇠 변신체) 고대 교향곡 계단 변신체*4 고대 교향곡 카펫(모서리, 테두리, 일자형, T자형, X자형) 고대 교향곡 촛대 고대 교향곡 유리창-악령 고대 교향곡 유리창-뱀파이어 고대 교향곡 혈액 분수 고대 교향곡 그림*2 위대한 이미지로 홀을 장식하세요. 야행 생물의 왕, 매력적인 영웅과 천사의 아름다움에 도취하세요. 고대 교향곡 아루카도 조각상 고대 교향곡 마리아 조각상 고대 교향곡 진화 생물(조각상) 고대 교향곡 뼈 트로피 고대 교향곡 천사 조각상 전용 언데드 탈것 로테인의 유명한 해골말을 타고 전쟁터에 나가 환상을 현실로 바꾸는 것은 정말로 웃기는 아이러니죠? 로테인의 말(안장) 새로운 특별한 헤어스타일 일부는 익숙해 보일 수도 있지만 기억이 안 난다면 지금 얼마나 멋진지 공부 좀 해야 할 것 같습니다. 새로운 헤어스타일*4：리칼드 자매와 두 서큐버스. 캐슬바니아 음악을 감상하세요. 불길한 거처의 분위기를 돋우는 클래식 캐슬바니아 주제곡-- 작곡가 Aleksandria Migova가 리메이크한 “사이먼 주제곡”과 “피와 눈물”을 재생해보세요. 해당 DLC는 음악 잠금을 해제하고 성채 오르골 통해 재생할 수 있습니다. 피와 눈물（ 리메이크 버전） 사이먼 주제곡( 리메이크 버전) 해당 레벨의 아이템이 해제되면 위 아이템도 잠금이 해제됩니다. 예를 들어 알파 늑대를 물리치고 늑대 변신체를 해제하면 울프 소울 변신체가 해제됩니다. 10월 21일 업데이트: 새로운 아이템 해당 버전은 2024년 10월 21일에 업데이트되었으며, 이전 콘텐츠를 기반으로 새로운 아이템을 추가했습니다. 타락한 캐슬바니아 스타일로 뱀파이어를 더욱 편리하게 꾸밀 수 있습니다. 캐슬바니아의 유산 DLC 신규 콘텐츠: 샤노아 의상 ：이건 강력한 전사 샤노아의 화려한 전투 의상입니다. 파란색과 검은색이 어우러진 고전적인 고딕 드레스와 흩날리는 검은 천에는 정교한 금속 장식이 더해져 신비롭고 강렬한 인상을 줍니다. 소마 크루즈 의상 : 와 소마 크루즈의 클래식 의상을 입고 예언에서 어둠의 군주의 운명을 맞이해 보세요. 이 의상 세트는 소마 크루즈의 가장 특징 있는 흰색 바탕에 파란 무늬 긴 코트, 눈에 띄는 멋진 바지와 부츠가 포함됩니다. 새로운 성벽 새로운 성채 창문 새로운 성채 문 새로운 성채 울타리 새로운 성채 그림 해당 DLC를 획득하면 모든 아이템이 잠금 해제되며, 해당 유형 장비의 제작 자격이 있다면 게임에서 이런 아이템들을 제작할 수 있습니다.

games.name: Valorborn
games.short_description: Dive into a living medieval fantasy sandbox RPG where the world moves with or without you and factions rise and fall. detailed_descriptions.en: Dive into a living medieval fantasy sandbox RPG where the world lives and acts with or without you. Villagers follow routines, factions compete for power, dangers roam the land, and every decision can create opportunity or disaster. Become a thief, hunter, or sellsword. Travel alone or build a party. Hunt, steal, trade, fight, and survive in a fully enterable world where every building, cave, and road can become part of your story. No fake doors. No decorative cave entrances. If you can reach it, you can enter it. Play solo or build your squad Create the heroes of your journey. Customize each member of your party’s appearance, hairstyle, physique, and background story to make your mark on the world. Every choice teaches you something. Earn experience through what you do and unlock skills that keep you alive. Go in loud with brutal weapons, or stay unseen, avoid fair fights, and end threats before they notice you. Survive, Craft & Build The world won’t keep you safe; you’ll have to prepare. Stock up, craft gear, and choose how you live: settle in town by renting a house, or roam freely with camps you can set up between expeditions. Hunt, gather, and craft your loadout, then do whatever it takes to survive. Write Your Own Story Valorborn is built around player-driven stories, not a single scripted path. Start small and survive however you can. Steal and sell stolen goods. Live off the wilderness and trade pelts for coin. Take contracts and hunt the dangers stalking roads, ruins, and settlements. Tip faction conflicts in your favor, exploit the chaos for profit, or stay out of politics and carve your own path. Your choices shape your identity, your reputation, and your future. Mechanics Available in Early Access Living World Simulation AI characters follow day and night routines, travel, work, and react to danger with or without your involvement. Sandbox Roleplay Choose your own path as a thief, hunter, sellsword, or forge your own way through the world. Faction Tension and Conflict Kingdoms, guilds, and local groups pursue power, survival, and influence across the region. Fully Enterable World Every building, cave, and point of interest is designed to be explored. Survival Systems Hunt, gather, manage resources, and prepare for long journeys through dangerous territory. Stealth, Stealing, and Crime Pick locks, steal valuables, and profit from risk while living with the consequences. Camp and Progression Systems Set up camps, prepare supplies, and build a stronger foothold as your story grows. Solo or Party Play Survive alone or build a group and shape multiple lives in the same world. Permadeath Death can wait behind every corner, but risk, loss, and adaptation are part of what make each run rewarding.

To stop the turmoil, humanity created a white-haired, godlike girl with overwhelming power and social anxiety. Enter the Vortex Zone, summon your allies, form your battle line, and tear through the enemy forces.

descriptions.en: A sci-fantasy roguelite deckbuilder set in a world collapsing under cosmic instability. To stop the turmoil, humanity created a white-haired, godlike girl with overwhelming power and social anxiety. Enter the Vortex Zone, summon your allies, form your battle line, and tear through the enemy forces.

detailed_descriptions.en: Endless chaos reverberates throughout a world where the only constant is war. In an effort to overcome the turmoil, the people decide to create a little warrior. But this white-haired, god-like entity has a major case of social anxiety?! She turns the once apocalyptic, barren world into a new one filled with races and civilizations previously known only from mythology and fairy tales, and grants the mysterious power of The Source to its inhabitants, including humans. Voice of Belldona takes place in this fantastic world created by Cheryl and tells the story of her adventures after being unexpectedly awakened again. Step into a collapsing universe where cosmic horrors, corrupted machines, and winged god-engines roam the void. Voice of Belldona blends sci-fantasy atmosphere with tactical roguelike deckbuilding: summon allies, control the battlefield’s formation, and clash against everything from twisted robots to Pegasus-like divine war machines. What starts as clean strategy soon becomes a dance of positioning, timing, and high-risk decisions that can reshape your entire build. In this game, you need to decide how to carve your path through The Vortex Zone. Do you want to dash into battle as Rinsana or command the field with Griza ’s summons? Each hero plays differently, offering unique strategies and routes to mastery. Build your deck through every battle you fight, and every path you take can alter the cards you obtain. Shape your strategy to enhance the sense of progression and further increase the tactical depth of each run. Every choice reshapes your build, and every build opens new ways to outsmart the void. Explore shifting maps where no two runs are ever the same. Each route presents new events, unpredictable rewards, and bosses that can appear in different sequences. Your decisions on the map are just as important as your decisions in combat. Let your deck spiral, twist the map’s fate, and break the run in ways the void never intended. Now when reality starts folding… Will you be the one to reach the True Ending and survive what’s inside?

detailed_descriptions.en: Void Crew is a 1-6 player co-op First Person Space Adventure: Rally your crew, power your spaceship, and get ready for epic space battles, facing chaotic dangers you and your crew never trained for! In the future, a doctrine of survival unites humanity against a mysterious aggressor - the Hollow. As the chosen ones, it’s up to you as a crew of up to 1-6 mavericks to brave the void and bring order to the galaxy! Embark on the most advanced spacecrafts ever built, and journey into deep space on thrilling missions that you and your crew absolutely never trained for! Asteroid storms, solar flares and your buddies’ screw-ups will be the least of your worries, as hostile aliens, and desperate human scavengers push your crew to their limits. CHAOTIC 1 - 6 -PLAYER CO-OP Pilot the ship, man the turrets, perform emergency repairs, recharge the power cells, utilize space station weaponry, fabricate munitions and exit the ship on extravehicular missions - be it patching the ship hull or scavenging derelict wrecks. EPIC SPACE BATTLES Teamwork is key: pick a role and prioritize your most urgent tasks with your crew... or try to do everything at once and just wing it as you’ll be short on reliable manpower! games.name: Voodoo Fishin'
games.short_description: A creepy-cozy co-op fishing game for 1–4 players with proximity voice chat. Explore a haunted swamp for rare fish, sell your haul by the pound, and try to survive what hunts you in the dark.

descriptions.en: A creepy-cozy co-op fishing game for 1–4 players with proximity voice chat. Explore a haunted swamp for rare fish, sell your haul by the pound, and try to survive what hunts you in the dark.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 一款适合 1–4 名玩家的 creepy-cozy 合作钓鱼游戏，支持近距离语音聊天。探索一片闹鬼的沼泽，寻找稀有鱼类，按重量出售你的渔获，并努力在黑暗中躲过猎杀你的东西。
descriptions.ja: 近接ボイスチャット対応、1～4人用の不気味で心地いい協力釣りゲーム。呪われた沼を探索し、レアな魚を釣り、釣果を重さで売りさばき、闇の中であなたを狩る“何か”から生き延びましょう。
descriptions.ko: 근접 음성 채팅을 지원하는 1~4인용 creepy-cozy 협동 낚시 게임. 저주받은 늪을 탐험하며 희귀한 물고기를 찾고, 잡은 물고기를 무게로 팔고, 어둠 속에서 여러분을 사냥하는 무언가로부터 살아남으세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: Voodoo Fishin’ is a 1–4 player online co-op creepy-cozy fishing game featuring proximity voice chat and swamp-dwelling surprises. Venture into the bayou with friends in search of rare and legendary fish. The deeper you go, the stranger things get. Fish together. Laugh together. Try not to lose your haul. If you die, the swamp keeps your catch. (And any Tackle you have equipped) Craft your puppet angler and hit the dock! It’s chill… until it isn’t. This swamp hunts back. If you make it back alive, the Fish Monger pays by the pound. Upgrade your Bait, Reels, and Rods to chase bigger and rarer fish Play Forever The swamp doesn’t run on corporate servers. Voodoo Fishin’ is self-hosted , so once you’re in, you can always jump back in with friends. No server shutdowns. No “service discontinued.” The swamp stays open as long as you can stay alive. The demo provides access to the full core gameplay systems, but limits world exploration and higher-tier Tackle.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: Voodoo Fishin’ 是一款适合 1–4 名玩家联机合作游玩的 creepy-cozy 钓鱼游戏，拥有近距离语音聊天，以及潜伏在沼泽中的诡异惊喜。 和朋友一起深入 bayou，寻找稀有鱼类和传奇鱼类。你们越往深处走，周围的一切就越诡异。 一起钓鱼。一起欢笑。尽量别把收获弄丢了。如果你们死了，沼泽就会吞掉你们的渔获。 （以及你身上装备的所有渔具。） 诡趣木偶钓鱼 打造你的木偶钓手，前往码头出发吧！ 在沼泽中活下来 这里看似平静……直到一切不再平静。这片沼泽也会反过来猎杀你。 出售你的渔获 只要你能活着回来，鱼贩子就会按重量收购你的渔获。 升级你的渔具 升级你的鱼饵、卷线器和鱼竿，去追逐更大、更稀有的鱼。 一直玩下去 这片沼泽并不依赖企业服务器。 Voodoo Fishin’ 支持玩家自建主机，所以只要进入了游戏，你就能随时和朋友再回来玩。没有服务器停运。没有“服务终止”。 只要你还能活下去，这片沼泽就始终开放。 试玩版详情 试玩版开放了完整的核心玩法系统，但会限制世界探索范围，以及高阶渔具的获取。
detailed_descriptions.ja: Voodoo Fishin’ は、近接ボイスチャットに対応した、1～4人用の不気味で心地いいオンライン協力釣りゲーム。沼地には、思いがけない“何か”が潜んでいます。 仲間と一緒にバイユーへ足を踏み入れ、レア魚や伝説級の魚を探しましょう。奥へ進むほど、周囲はどんどん奇妙になっていきます。 一緒に釣って、一緒に笑って、獲物は落とさないように。死ねば、沼があなたの釣果を奪っていきます。 （装備していたタックルごと。） 不気味かわいいパペット釣り 自分だけのパペット釣り師を作って、桟橋へ向かおう！ 沼地を生き延びろ のどかに見えるのは最初だけ。やがて、この沼そのものがあなたを狩り始めます。 釣果を売りさばけ 生きて戻れたなら、魚屋が釣果を重さで買い取ってくれます。 タックルを強化しよう エサ、リール、ロッドを強化して、さらに大きく、さらに珍しい魚を狙いましょう。 いつまでも遊べる この沼は企業サーバーでは動いていません。 Voodoo Fishin’ はセルフホスト対応なので、一度入り込めば、いつでも仲間と戻ってこられます。サーバー終了なし。サービス終了なし。 あなたが生き延びられる限り、この沼は開き続けます。 デモ版について デモ版では、コアとなるゲームプレイ要素をひと通り体験できますが、探索できるエリアと高ランクのタックルには制限があります。
detailed_descriptions.ko: **Voodoo Fishin’**은 근접 음성 채팅을 지원하는 1~4인용 creepy-cozy 온라인 협동 낚시 게임입니다. 그리고 늪지에는 으스스한 놀라움이 도사리고 있습니다. 친구들과 함께 늪지 깊숙한 곳으로 들어가 희귀한 물고기와 전설의 물고기를 찾아보세요. 더 깊이 들어갈수록, 점점 더 기묘한 일들이 벌어집니다. 함께 낚시하고, 함께 웃고, 잡은 물고기는 놓치지 마세요. 죽으면 늪이 여러분의 수확을 가져갑니다. (장착 중이던 모든 낚싯장비도 함께요.) 오싹하고 아기자기한 퍼펫 낚시 나만의 퍼펫 낚시꾼을 만들고 선착장으로 향하세요! 늪에서 살아남아라 처음엔 평온해 보입니다... 하지만 오래가진 않죠. 이 늪은 여러분을 사냥합니다. 잡은 물고기를 팔아라 살아서 돌아오기만 한다면, 생선 장수가 무게에 따라 값을 쳐줍니다. 낚싯장비를 업그레이드하라 미끼, 릴, 낚싯대를 업그레이드해 더 크고 더 희귀한 물고기를 노려보세요. 계속해서 돌아올 수 있다 이 늪은 기업 서버로 운영되지 않습니다. **Voodoo Fishin’**은 셀프 호스팅 방식이라, 한 번 들어오면 언제든 친구들과 다시 돌아올 수 있습니다. 서버 종료도 없고, “서비스 종료”도 없습니다. 여러분이 살아남을 수 있는 한, 이 늪은 계속 열려 있습니다. 데모 상세 정보 데모에서는 핵심 게임플레이 시스템을 모두 체험할 수 있지만, 세계 탐험 범위와 상위 등급 낚싯장비는 제한됩니다.

games.name: Voor De Kroon
games.short_description: Fight for control during the Friso-Hollandic Wars. Set in the medieval 13th century, the game features a strategy campaign and historical battles. Fight alongside your army in 3rd person battles and command your troops in this strategy-action game.

descriptions.en: Fight for control during the Friso-Hollandic Wars. Set in the medieval 13th century, the game features a strategy campaign and historical battles. Fight alongside your army in 3rd person battles and command your troops in this strategy-action game.

detailed_descriptions.en: Fight for control during the Friso-Hollandic Wars. Set in the medieval 13th century, the game features a strategy campaign and historical battles. Fight alongside your army in 3rd person battles and command your troops in this strategy-action game. Voor de kroon is a medieval wargame. The game uses Unreal Engine and Metahuman technology to make the historically researched characters come alive. Fight in medieval battles: participate in 13th century skirmishes or play intense siege battles. Conquer a historical recreation of the 13th century low countries. Manage your settlements and officers. Eliminate your enemies. Dive into rich customization options in the 'Warforge' editor which allow you to create your own factions, swords, castles, units and campaigns and share them in the Steam workshop. Solo developed with ♥ in The Netherlands

games.name: Vortica
games.short_description: Vortica is a 2D action roguelite set in a solar system overrun by hostile aliens. Suit up, loot up, and shoot up as you battle against enemy hordes, explore derelict outposts, and hunt giant bosses. Each mission gets you one step closer to returning to Earth and saving the human race.

descriptions.en: Vortica is a 2D action roguelite set in a solar system overrun by hostile aliens. Suit up, loot up, and shoot up as you battle against enemy hordes, explore derelict outposts, and hunt giant bosses. Each mission gets you one step closer to returning to Earth and saving the human race.

detailed_descriptions.en: Humanity has been exiled from Earth by ruthless invaders. We now cling to survival in derelict stations and outposts scattered throughout the solar system. As the last hope for mankind, you must navigate the remnants of civilization, uncover lost technologies, and fight for our future. Vortica is a 2D twin-stick shooter roguelite where you take on a variety of unique missions across the solar system. As one of humanity’s last survivors, you will brave hostile territories, rescue stranded civilians, and track down deadly alien threats, all while scavenging for the resources needed to stay alive. Endless hordes of different enemies, each requiring different strategies to overcome stands in your way. Dispose of wave after wave using everything from rusty automatic rifles to high powered plasma guns, or deploy automated sentry turrets to assist you. Massive bosses are also waiting for you across the solar system, you’ll need to combine cunning and force to overcome them. As soon as your mission is completed, you need to haul ass. Get in your Vortal before it’s too late! Find utility items like jumping boots, traps, and improvised explosives, or craft them yourself in your homebase. With over 100 items available, you can repel enemies, grow resources or light your way through dark powerless stations. There's a tool for everything! Unlock increasingly advanced gear and expand your carrying capacity as you progress. Before long, the creatures that looked unbeatable will be the ones fighting for their lives. Finding new characters also unlocks more options in your home base, such as better crafting or new objectives. Choose your own path and explore the solar system using Vortal technology to transport to a variety of locations. Rescue stranded civilians, eliminate deadly alien threats, and collect resources in roguelike raids. Every run is different , some stations are plunged into darkness by power failures, some are saturated with radiation, and some force you to fight through facilities without gravity. OTHER FEATURES Play solo or team up with a friend for Co-op! (Gamepad required) Multiple game modes: Adventure, Survival and Custom modes A cute robot vacuum buddy in your home base, and a cat! Team up for co-op runs, share strategies and setups, get the latest news, patch notes and updates on our Discord, look to the right for the invite link!

  • Find utility items like jumping boots, traps, and improvised explosives, or craft them yourself in your homebase. With over 100 items available, you can repel enemies, grow resources or light your way through dark powerless stations. There's a tool for everything!

  • Unlock increasingly advanced gear and expand your carrying capacity as you progress. Before long, the creatures that looked unbeatable will be the ones fighting for their lives. Finding new characters also unlocks more options in your home base, such as better crafting or new objectives.

games.name: Voyagers of Nera
games.short_description: Voyagers of Nera is a cooperative survival-crafting game where you must survive a magical ocean world brimming with lost spirits and deadly monsters. Sail to distant islands, build beautiful villages and surf across the waves with up to 10 players.

descriptions.en: Voyagers of Nera is a cooperative survival-crafting game where you must survive a magical ocean world brimming with lost spirits and deadly monsters. Sail to distant islands, build beautiful villages and surf across the waves with up to 10 players.
descriptions.ja: 『Voyagers of Nera』は、失われた精霊たちと危険なモンスターで満ちあふれる、魔法の海洋世界で生き抜いていく、協力型サバイバルクラフトゲームです。最大10人のプレイヤーと共に、遠くの島々へ航海し、美しい村を建設し、波の上をサーフィンしていきましょう。
descriptions.ko: Voyagers of Nera는 길 잃은 영혼들과 치명적인 괴물들이 득실거리는 신비로운 바다 세계에서 살아남아야 하는 협동 생존 제작 게임입니다. 최대 10명의 플레이어들이 모여 먼 섬으로 항해하고, 아름다운 마을을 건설하고, 파도를 가르며 서핑을 즐겨보세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: Voyagers of Nera is a cooperative survival-crafting game for up to 10 players set in a vast ocean full of ancient ruins and diverse biomes. Nera is a magical ocean world full of beauty, magic, and danger. You are an Echo, descendants of the long-extinct protectors of this world. It falls to you to sail across the seas, defeat the monstrous creatures of the Deep, and awaken the spirits before they fade away forever. DEVELOPMENT ROADMAP SET SAIL ACROSS THE SEAS As a solo player or a group, sail to distant islands or surf across the waves. Build your own boats from scratch by adding sails, decorations, cannons and magical stations. Dive beneath the surface to find rare resources and hidden treasure, but beware what lurks in the depths… SURVIVE A MAGICAL OCEAN WORLD Your journey will take you to fantastical biomes like an island archipelago formed around a fallen colossus or coral cliffs that tower to the sky. To survive, you’ll have to build mighty seaside bases, craft new weapons, and awaken powerful nature spirits as you battle monstrous creatures both above and below the waves. AWAKEN POWERFUL SPIRITS Lost spirits are scattered throughout the world, hiding from the monsters that prey on them. When you rescue them, they will help you in return by teaching you crafting recipes and new magical abilities. Each biome was once the home of a powerful Elder Spirit, but they are now scattered and lost. Find their lost shards and awaken them to inherit their incredible powers and restore the world of Nera. BUILD THE ULTIMATE ISLAND BASE Build growing, customizable island villages with an expressive construction system. Each base you build lets you refine resources, cook meals, and craft new gear - it also serves as a sanctuary for the spirits of the world. Build amenities to attract and protect them. In return, they will magically power your settlement, unlocking more powerful crafts. VOYAGE ALONE OR WITH FRIENDS Voyagers is a great solo experience and even better with friends! Play with up to 10 people on a server, add new players any time and contribute through different roles. Whether you like to adventure, craft, fight, or build, every choice helps your group progress. For multiplayer, you can host a game for others to join, set up your own dedicated server for free, or rent a server from a range of approved partners. LAUNCHING INTO EARLY ACCESS We believe that all great games need player feedback, and we’ve been playtesting every two weeks since mid 2025. Early Access is our chance to get feedback from a lot more players, which will help us make the game better and better. We’d love to hear your thoughts through our in-game survey, on Steam, and in our Discord. To everyone who’s already played, thank you so much for supporting us and helping us improve the game!
detailed_descriptions.ja: 『Voyagers of Nera』は、古代の遺跡と多様な生態環境が広がる大海原を舞台にした、最大10人のプレイヤーが協力してプレイする、サバイバルクラフトゲームです。 《ネラ》は美しく、そして神秘と危険に満ちた、魔法の海洋世界です。あなたは《エコー》と呼ばれる、この世界において遠い昔に絶滅した守護者たちの子孫です。大海原を航海し、深海の怪物を倒し、精霊たちが永遠に消え去ってしまう前にもう一度覚醒させること―― それがあなたの役目です。 開発ロードマップ 果てしない航海へ出発 ソロプレイヤーまたはグループとして、遠くの島々へ航海したり、波間をサーフィンしたりしましょう。帆、装飾、大砲、魔法のステーションを追加して、ゼロから自分の船を作りましょう。海面の下に広がる美しくも危険な世界に潜り、珍しい資源や隠された宝物を探してください。ただし、《深淵》に潜むものに注意して… 魔法の海の世界でサバイバル あなたの旅は、倒れた巨像の周りに形成された島々や、空に向かってそびえ立つ珊瑚の崖など、幻想的な生態環境へと続いていきます。生き残るためには、海辺に強固な基地を建設し、新しい武器を作成し、強力な自然の精霊たちを目覚めさせ、陸と海の両方に潜む怪物たちと戦わなければなりません。 強大な精霊の覚醒 失われた精霊たちは、彼らを捕食する魔物たちから身を隠すために、世界中に散らばっています。彼らを救出していけば、あなたの旅に役に立つ、クラフトのレシピや新しい魔法のアビリティを教えてもらうことができます。 多様な生態環境(バイオーム)は、かつては強大な《上古の精霊》たちが棲んでいましたが、現在ではみんな散り散りになって失われてしまっています。失われた欠片を見つけて彼らを目覚めさせ、驚異的な力を受け継ぎ、この《ネラ》の世界を蘇らせてください。 究極の基地を建設 奥の深い建設システムを活用して、カスタマイズ可能な島の村を構築し、成長させていきましょう。構築したそれぞれの基地では、リソースを精製し、食事を調理し、新しい装備をクラフトすることができます。また、基地はその世界の精霊たちの聖域《サンクチュアリ》としても機能します。彼らを惹きつけ、保護するための設備を構築していってください。そうすれば精霊たちは、あなたの居住地に魔法の力を与え、より強力なクラフトのロックを解除してくれす。 航海を仲間とも楽しもう 『Voyagers』は一人でも楽しめますが、友達と一緒にプレイするとさらに楽しめます！サーバー上で最大10人でプレイすることができる上、いつでも新しいプレイヤーを追加できます。それぞれがさまざまな役割を通じて貢献できるのです。冒険、クラフト、戦闘、建築など、どんなやり方でもグループ全体の攻略に役立ちます。 マルチプレイヤーの場合、他のプレイヤーが参加できるゲームをホストしたり、独自の専用サーバーを無料でセットアップしたり、あるいは承認済みパートナーのいずれかからサーバーをレンタルしたりできます。 アーリーアクセス開始 私たちは、すべての素晴らしいゲームには、プレイヤーからのフィードバックが必要不可欠だと信じており、2025年半ばから2週間ごとにプレイテストを行っています。アーリーアクセスは、より多くのプレイヤーからフィードバックを得るチャンスであり、ゲームをより良くしていくために役立つはずですゲーム内アンケート、Steam、Discordを通じて、ぜひ皆様のご意見をお聞かせください。すでにプレイしていただいた皆様には、そのサポートとゲーム改善へのご協力に、改めて心より感謝申し上げます。
detailed_descriptions.ko: Voyagers of Nera는 최대 10명의 플레이어들이 고대의 유적과 다양한 생물군계가 펼쳐지는 방대한 바다에서 함께 모험을 즐길 수 있는 협동 생존 제작 게임입니다. 네라는 아름다움, 마법, 위험이 공존하는 신비로운 바다 세계입니다. 당신은 오래전 멸종한 이 세계의 수호자들의 후예, 메아리입니다. 바다를 항해하고, 심해의 괴물들을 무찌르고, 정령들이 영원히 사라지기 전에 깨우는 것이 당신의 임무입니다. 개발 로드맵 바다를 항해하세요 솔로 플레이어 또는 그룹으로 먼 섬으로 항해하거나 파도를 가르며 나아가세요. 돛, 장식, 대포, 마법 스테이션을 추가하여 처음부터 자신만의 보트를 만드세요. 물속으로 잠수하면 희귀한 자원과 숨겨진 보물을 찾아낼 수 있지만, 깊은 물속에 도사리고 있는 존재를 조심해야 합니다... 신비로운 바다 세계에서 살아남으세요 이 세계를 여행하다 보면 쓰러진 거상 주위에 형성된 군도나 하늘까지 치솟은 산호 절벽처럼 환상적인 생물군계를 발견하게 될 것입니다. 이곳에서 살아남으려면 강력한 해변 기지를 건설하고, 새로운 무기를 만들고, 파도 위와 아래에 있는 괴물들과 싸우면서 강력한 자연 정령들을 깨워야 합니다. 강력한 정령들을 깨우세요 세상 곳곳에 흩어져 있는 길 잃은 정령들은 자신들을 노리는 괴물들을 피해 숨어 있습니다. 이들을 구출하면, 정령들은 보답으로 새로운 제작법과 마법 능력을 가르쳐 줄 것입니다. 각 생물군계는 한때 강력한 고대 정령의 보금자리였지만, 지금은 모두 뿔뿔이 흩어져 길을 잃었습니다. 길 잃은 정령들의 조각을 찾아 깨우고, 그들의 놀라운 힘을 이어받아 네라의 세계를 복원하세요. 최고의 섬 기지를 건설하세요 다양한 옵션을 제공하는 건축 시스템으로 섬마을을 확장하고 원하는 대로 꾸며 보세요. 이렇게 세운 각 기지에서는 자원을 정제하고, 음식을 만들고, 새로운 장비를 제작할 수도 있고, 이 세계 정령들을 위한 안식처도 되어 줄 것입니다. 정령들을 끌어들이고 보호하기 위한 편의시설을 만드세요. 그러면 그들은 당신의 정착지에 마법의 힘을 불어넣어 더 강력한 제작물을 만들 수 있게 도와줄 것입니다. 혼자서 또는 친구들과 함께 탐험하세요 Voyagers of Nera는 혼자서도 멋진 경험을 할 수 있지만, 친구와 함께하면 더욱 좋습니다! 한 서버에서 최대 10명이 함께 플레이할 수 있으며, 언제든지 새로운 플레이어를 초대하고 각자 다른 역할을 수행할 수 있습니다. 모험, 제작, 전투, 건설 등 어떤 것을 선호하든, 모든 선택이 팀의 성장을 도울 것입니다. 멀티플레이어 모드에서는 다른 플레이어가 참가할 수 있도록 게임을 직접 호스트하거나, 무료로 전용 서버를 설정하거나, 승인된 제휴사를 통해 서버를 임대할 수 있습니다. 앞서 해보기 출시 저희는 훌륭한 게임을 만들려면 플레이어의 피드백이 꼭 필요하다고 믿기 때문에, 2025년 중반부터 2주마다 플레이 테스트를 진행해 왔습니다. 앞서 해보기는 더 많은 플레이어로부터 피드백을 받을 수 있는 좋은 기회이며, 이를 통해 게임을 계속해서 발전시켜 나갈 것입니다. 게임 내 설문조사, Steam, Discord를 통해 다양한 의견을 들려주세요. 게임을 플레이하고 저희를 응원하고 게임 개선에 도움을 주신 모든 분들께, 진심으로 감사드립니다!

games.name: Vultures - Scavengers of Death
games.short_description: VULTURES is a tactical turn-based survival horror, inspired by 90's survival horror classics. As an operative, scavenge the infested metropolis for materials and information that could cure the infection plaguing the world.

descriptions.en: VULTURES is a tactical turn-based survival horror, inspired by 90's survival horror classics. As an operative, scavenge the infested metropolis for materials and information that could cure the infection plaguing the world.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 致敬90年代生存恐怖經典《惡靈古堡》。深入被封鎖的死城，面對令人窒息的孤立與嗜血的畸變怪物。拼湊散落破碎的真相，在資源極度匱乏的博弈中步步為營。在這裡，每一顆子彈都是奢侈的希望。當退路封死、彈盡糧絕，唯有最冷靜的大腦，才能在絕境中計算出一線生機。
descriptions.ja: 90年代サバイバルホラーの原点『バイオハザード』へのオマージュ。封鎖された死都を探索し、息詰まる孤立と血に飢えた変異体に立ち向かえ。砕け散った真実を拾い集め、極限の資源管理の中で一手一手を見極める。退路を失い、弾薬が尽きた時、冷静な思考だけが絶望の中に生路を導く。
descriptions.ko: 90년대 생존 호러의 명작 <레지던트 이블> 에 바치는 헌사입니다. 봉쇄된 죽음의 도시 깊숙이 들어가 숨 막히는 고립감 속에서 피에 굶주린 변이 괴물들과 맞섭니다. 극도로 부족한 자원 속에서 흩어진 단서들을 하나씩 맞추며, 냉정한 판단만이 절망 속에서 생존의 한 수를 계산해 냅니다.

detailed_descriptions.en: Salento Valley, post bio-hazard incident - As a VULTURE operative, your mission is to extract material to aid in finding a cure for the infection. Send Leopoldo and Amber on their select missions and prepare for turn-based tactical survival against infected mutants. Find the key to our salvation. Turn-based Tactical Extraction Survive and extract the target from missions across 2 agents: Leopoldo - A disciplined operative, guided by an unbreakable sense of duty and a strict personal code of justice. With his strength and ingenuity; move, push and jump over objects to control the environment. Amber - A tactical operative characterized by her analytical intelligence, agility, and ability to make precise decisions under pressure. Use her grappling gun to traverse the environment and control the position of enemies. Choose your tactics carefully - Resources are limited with unknowns around every corner. Sneak, disengage and prioritize your approach to every turn-based battle. Extracting with the target is your ultimate goal - Get out alive using every tool and method at your disposal. Scavenge a Ruined City Scavenge across mission based locations: Weapons - From pistols to rifles and knives to katana, find a variety of weapons to build out your arsenal. Resources - Ammo and health packs are limited but vital to your survival. Keys, codes and clues - Even doors and dying technology will be obstacles on the path to your target. Explore thoroughly to find everything you need to gain access. Market - Valuables collected during missions will grant you credits once you return. You can use those credits on the market to get upgrades for your weapons, new items and gear or unlock new cosmetics! Classic Survival Horror Inspired by some of the most foundational Survival Horror franchises like Resident Evil; Vultures embraces a retro PS1 aesthetic with mechanics that lead to a tense, horror filled exploration. Isolated as a single agent in the dark halls of the city, every choice could lead to a successful mission or death. Salento Valley - Ground Zero A once bustling metropolis, Salento Valley now lies as a desolate battleground in the wake of a bio-hazard disaster. An enigmatic client has hired the Vultures, a small group of mercenaries specialized in infiltration, to enter the quarantine zone and uncover the origin of the infection, hoping to find a cure. Now, you will face increasingly challenging odds as you make your way through the cities ruins. Horrifying mutants and abominations lay in wait for fresh blood like you.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 彈盡糧絕之時，真正的恐怖才剛剛開始。這是回合制賦予恐懼的全新定義——時間被凍結，但恐懼在蔓延。看著喪屍猙獰的獠牙在僅距一格的地方停下，聽著自己心跳的倒數計時，你必須強迫自己冷靜計算每一步的代價。在這場以命相搏的棋局裡，能讓你活到下一回合的戰術，就是唯一的標準答案。 殺戮不是終點，地圖本身才是最大的謎局。歡迎來到精心構築的箱庭迷宮。面對無法戰勝的屍潮，你可以製造聲響將它們引誘至空曠的A區，隨後悄聲穿過B門的陰影；或者利用複雜的隱秘捷徑，在怪物的眼皮底下完成極限搜刮。探索每一間上鎖的密室，打通每一條殊途同歸的道路，將這座死城變成你的狩獵場——記住，只要你還未逃出生天，絕望就永不落幕。 在這座死城裡，搜刮是活下去的唯一法則。 冒著被撕碎的風險深入黑暗角落，尋找昔日文明遺留的“貴重物品”。只要你能活著將它們帶回巢穴，就能利用換來的資訊點武裝自己：全面升級槍械火力，或是解鎖專屬的特工外觀。高風險意味著高回報，你的每一次貪婪，都將成為下一場屍潮中生還的底氣。 是生化洩露？還是另有隱情？深入被封鎖的薩倫托，從散落在角落的破碎檔案中，拼湊出Eugenesys那令人作嘔的真相。那座高聳入雲的巨塔裡究竟進行著什麼實驗？觸手遍布全城的秘密結社究竟獻祭了多少無辜者？當你凝視深淵時，小心——真正的怪物或許不只在螢幕裡，而是在人心中。
detailed_descriptions.ja: 弾薬が底を突いた瞬間、本当の恐怖が姿を現す。これはターン制が恐怖を再構築する体験だ——時間は止まるが、恐怖は静かに迫る。一マス先で立ち止まるゾンビの歪んだ牙を見据え、自らの心拍が刻むカウントダウンを聞きながら、あなたは一手ごとの代償を冷静に計算しなければならない。命を賭けたこの盤上で、次のターンまで生き残れる戦術だけが、唯一の正解となる。 殺すことが目的ではない。最大の謎は、マップそのものだ。精密に構築された箱庭型迷宮へようこそ。圧倒的な数のゾンビに直面した時、音を立てて彼らを開けたAエリアへ誘導し、その隙にBゲートの影を抜けるか。あるいは、複雑に入り組んだ隠し通路を使い、怪物の視線の下で極限の探索を行うか。施錠された密室を解き、別々に見える道を一本に繋ぎ、この死都を自らの狩場へ変えろ——覚えておけ、脱出するその瞬間まで、絶望は終わらない。 この死に閉ざされた街では、「漁る」ことこそが生き延びるための唯一のルールだ。 引き裂かれる危険を冒して闇の深淵へ踏み込み、崩壊した文明が遺した「貴重品」を探し出そう。命懸けでそれらをNESTへ持ち帰れば、交換した情報ポイントで自身を強化できる。銃器の性能を全面的にアップグレードするのか、それともエージェント専用スキンを解放するのかは自由だ。ハイリスクには、それに見合うリターンがある。その強欲のひとつひとつが、次なるゾンビの大群を生き抜く力となる。 それは生物災害か、それとも隠された真実か。封鎖されたサレントの奥へ踏み込み、街の片隅に散らばる断片的な記録から、Eugenesysの忌まわしい真相を組み上げていく。天を突くあの塔では、いったい何が行われていたのか。都市全域に触手を伸ばす秘密結社は、どれほどの無辜の命を捧げたのか。深淵を覗く時、気をつけろ——真の怪物は、画面の向こうではなく、人の心に潜んでいるのかもしれない。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 탄약이 바닥났을 때, 진정한 공포는 이제 시작됩니다. 이것은 턴제 시스템이 재정의한 공포입니다. 시간은 멈추지만, 공포는 계속 번져 갑니다. 단 한 칸 앞에서 멈춰 선 좀비의 송곳니와 심장 박동의 카운트다운 속에서, 당신은 매 한 수의 대가를 냉정하게 계산해야 합니다. 다음 턴까지 살아남게 하는 전술만이 유일한 정답입니다. 학살은 끝이 아닙니다. 진정한 수수께끼는 맵 그 자체입니다. 정교하게 설계된 샌드박스 미로에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 감당할 수 없는 시체 무리를 상대로, 소음을 이용해 A구역으로 유인한 뒤 B문의 그림자를 통과할 수도 있고, 복잡한 비밀 지름길을 활용해 괴물의 눈앞에서 극한의 수색을 감행할 수도 있습니다. 모든 잠긴 밀실을 탐색하고, 서로 다른 길을 하나로 연결해 이 죽음의 도시를 당신의 사냥터로 만드십시오. 탈출하지 못하는 한, 절망은 끝나지 않습니다. 이 죽음의 도시에서 살아남기 위한 유일한 법칙은 끝없이 수집하는 것입니다. 찢겨 죽을 위험을 감수하고 어두운 구석을 탐색하며, 오래전 문명이 남긴 ‘귀중품’을 찾아내십시오. 살아서 그것들을 NEST로 가져오기만 한다면, 교환한 정보 포인트를 사용해 무기의 화력을 강화하거나 요원 전용 외형을 해금할 수 있습니다. 위험이 클수록 보상 또한 커집니다. 당신의 모든 욕망은 다음 감염체 무리 속에서 살아남기 위한 힘이 되어 줄 것입니다. 생화학 유출입니까, 아니면 또 다른 음모입니까? 봉쇄된 살렌토 깊숙이 들어가 흩어진 기록을 수집하며 Eugenesys의 역겨운 진실을 밝혀 냅시다. 하늘을 찌를 듯한 거대한 탑에서는 어떤 실험이 진행되고 있었을까요? 도시 전역에 뻗은 비밀 결사는 얼마나 많은 무고한 희생을 바쳤을까요? 심연을 응시할 때는 주의하십시오. 진짜 괴물은 화면 속이 아니라 인간의 마음속에 있을지도 모릅니다.

games.name: Wall Street Raider
games.short_description: Wall Street Raider offers the deepest stock market simulations in gaming history. Control publicly traded corporations, futures, options, and even crypto. Whether you want to make billions in equities, short-sell overvalued stocks, or hedge risk using derivatives, the market is yours to conquer!

descriptions.en: Wall Street Raider offers the deepest stock market simulations in gaming history. Control publicly traded corporations, futures, options, and even crypto. Whether you want to make billions in equities, short-sell overvalued stocks, or hedge risk using derivatives, the market is yours to conquer!

detailed_descriptions.en: What is Wall $treet Raider? Wall Street Raider is the deepest stock market simulation in gaming history you've never heard of. It's been in active development since 1986. Originally a DOS classic, it evolved through the Windows era and is now being fully remastered for a new generation of Raiders. Take control of powerful corporations, trade futures and options, and dive into crypto. Build billion-dollar empires, short overhyped stocks, hedge with derivatives. The market is yours. Trading & Investment This isn't a simplified stock ticker with pretty graphs like most stock market games out there. Wall Street Raider models real financial instruments and tax implications with real depth. Buy, sell, and short stocks. Trade options i.e. calls, puts, and advanced spreads such as butterfly, condor, etc. Go long or short on Bitcoin and Ethereum physical coins or futures. Invest in corporate and government bonds. Use interest rate swaps to hedge your positions. You'll have every tool a real investor has. Banking, Real Estate & Debt Markets Expand into banking, lending, and real estate finance. Run a major bank. Take over the mortgage industry. Control the loan market. Borrow strategically, buy and sell bank loans, trade business and consumer loans, deal in prime and subprime mortgages, and set your bank's asset allocation. Manage capital reserves and loan distributions like an actual financial institution. Corporate Strategy, Mergers & Acquisitions You have full control over corporate strategy. Expand, acquire, restructure, or gut rival companies. Dominate entire industries through takeovers, stock maneuvers, and financial engineering. Execute hostile takeovers. Use greenmail. Conduct leveraged buyouts. Merge with competitors or spin off divisions to unlock hidden value. Split stocks, issue extraordinary dividends, call bonds, restructure operations, and elect yourself as CEO or let someone else run it. If it happens in a real boardroom, it happens here. Market Analytics & Financial Research You'll need to analyze global markets, research industries, and track competitors to stay ahead. Dig into earnings reports, cash flow projections, market share data, industry growth rates, and economic indicators. Access professional-level research reports. Use the "Who Owns What" tool to map out your competition. Study ETFs, their advisors, fees, and total assets. Information is power and power is money! Corporate Warfare & Legal Manipulation Not everything here is fair play. Finance is ruthless and sometimes you need to fight dirty. File harassing lawsuits to drain competitors through legal fees. Launch antitrust suits to break up rivals. Spread market rumors to create volatility. Execute liquidations for maximum profit. Hire the sharpest legal minds money can buy. The rules exist, but they're flexible if you know how to bend them. Startups, IPOs & Venture Capital Build the next tech giant, pharmaceutical leader, or energy powerhouse from scratch. Make capital contributions to promising ventures. Launch private stock offerings to raise money while keeping control, then take it all public when the time is right. Buy assets to grow your topline and invest in R&D to stay ahead of the pack and increase your margins! Your Empire, Your Way Own and manage multiple corporations across industries. Toggle autopilot for any company so you can focus where it matters. Buy and sell corporate assets, offload underperformers, acquire new opportunities. Rebrand companies and reinvent your empire as you see fit. Competitive & High-Stakes Finance How do you stack up against other financial masterminds? Wall Street Raider features competitive play against computer opponents and deep financial literacy mechanics so you can prove who truly dominates the market.

games.name: Wanderstop
games.short_description: From the creator of The Stanley Parable and The Beginner’s Guide comes Wanderstop, a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea.

descriptions.en: From the creator of The Stanley Parable and The Beginner’s Guide comes Wanderstop, a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea.

detailed_descriptions.en: Wanderstop is a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea. Playing as a fallen fighter named Alta, you’ll manage a tea shop within a magical forest and tend to the customers who pass through. But Alta does not want to be here. And if she gets her way, the tea shop will be nothing but a brief and painful memory. Wanderstop is a tea shop management ritual. Grow and harvest the ingredients needed for tea, and then mix them together in an unusual tea-making contraption. Along the way, speak with the many travelers who pass through the shop, learn their stories and make tea that’s just right for them. In your downtime, you might tidy up around the clearing, decorate the shop in your style, or just sit on a bench with a cup of tea and listen to your own thoughts. Maybe doing nothing at all is okay. The shop demands patience, it rejects those who have come only in the pursuit of growth unchecked. And that’s why Alta can’t be here. It’s why she’ll never make it. This isn’t who she is. No, she’s a fighter! Why would anyone insist on turning the world’s greatest championship warrior into a docile shopkeeper?! With everything she’s capable of?? No no no, she won’t, she won’t do it... she can’t… Wanderstop is a game from the team at Ivy Road, including Davey Wreden (creator of The Stanley Parable and The Beginner’s Guide), Karla Zimonja (co-creator of Gone Home and Tacoma) and Daniel “C418” Rosenfeld (the music of Minecraft).

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector
games.short_description: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game set in the grimdark universe of the 41st Millennium. Pick your force, develop your army, field mighty heroes and fight for victory using superior strategy, awesome abilities, and devastating weaponry.

descriptions.en: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game set in the grimdark universe of the 41st Millennium. Pick your force, develop your army, field mighty heroes and fight for victory using superior strategy, awesome abilities, and devastating weaponry.

detailed_descriptions.en: Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game set in the grimdark universe of the 41st Millennium. Pick your force, develop your army, field mighty heroes and fight for victory using superior strategy, awesome abilities, and devastating weaponry. Age of Crimson Dawn Experience an epic twenty mission single-player campaign that explores the aftermath of the Devasta-tion of Baal. Help Sergeant Carleon and his allies purge the Tyranid infestation on Baal Secundus, and preserve the honour of the noble Blood Angels. Skirmish Mode Fight across the surface of Baal on maps of your choosing in the Skirmish mode. Pick the faction you'll lead as well as the one you'll face. Completely customize your army list by selecting your units, heroes and their loadouts. It is available with three different types of Objective: Exterminatus, Conqueror and Strategic Command. Planetary Supremacy Mode Planetary Supremacy is a conquest-style skirmish campaign, introduced in a free update as part of our ever expanding plan for Battlesector, in which you, the player, decide the outcome. Take command of your favourite faction and conquer the planet in a series of procedurally generated skirmish battles. To achieve victory, capture more tiles, acquire strategic resources and expand your army. Then, bring destruction to your enemies in Skirmish battles. Daemonic Incursion Daemonic Incursion is a single-player mode that is available to all Battlesector players as part of a free update that was launched alongside the Sisters of Battle Faction Pack. In Daemonic Incursion, waves of Khornate daemons enter realspace to spill blood, collect skulls and overrun your forces. This is a last-stand mode, in which your objective is simple: SURVIVE! Forge Your Armies Command iconic units like the Sanguinary Priest, the Librarian Dreadnought, and the Hive Tyrant to annihilate your foes. Use over 60 abilities and 50 weapons to orchestrate your opponent’s bloody de-mise. Build Momentum Each faction has a unique Momentum system that can result in a Surged unit. Units that Surge are able to string together superhuman chains of actions, or use the opportunity to further upgrade their abili-ties. Call In Air Support Use Command Points to call in faction-specific air support abilities. Warhammer 40,000: Battlesector is a fast-paced turn-based strategy game set in the grimdark universe of the 41st Millennium. Pick your force, develop your army, field mighty heroes and fight for victory using superior strategy, awesome abilities, and devastating weaponry.

Age of Crimson Dawn

Experience an epic twenty mission single-player campaign that explores the aftermath of the Devasta-tion of Baal. Help Sergeant Carleon and his allies purge the Tyranid infestation on Baal Secundus, and preserve the honour of the noble Blood Angels.

Skirmish Mode

Fight across the surface of Baal on maps of your choosing in the Skirmish mode. Pick the faction you'll lead as well as the one you'll face. Completely customize your army list by selecting your units, heroes and their loadouts. It is available with three different types of Objective: Exterminatus, Conqueror and Strategic Command.

Planetary Supremacy Mode

Planetary Supremacy is a conquest-style skirmish campaign, introduced in a free update as part of our ever expanding plan for Battlesector, in which you, the player, decide the outcome.

Take command of your favourite faction and conquer the planet in a series of procedurally generated skirmish battles. To achieve victory, capture more tiles, acquire strategic resources and expand your army. Then, bring destruction to your enemies in Skirmish battles.

Daemonic Incursion

Daemonic Incursion is a single-player mode that is available to all Battlesector players as part of a free update that was launched alongside the Sisters of Battle Faction Pack. In Daemonic Incursion, waves of Khornate daemons enter realspace to spill blood, collect skulls and overrun your forces. This is a last-stand mode, in which your objective is simple: SURVIVE!

Forge Your Armies

Command iconic units like the Sanguinary Priest, the Librarian Dreadnought, and the Hive Tyrant to annihilate your foes. Use over 60 abilities and 50 weapons to orchestrate your opponent’s bloody de-mise.

Build Momentum

Each faction has a unique Momentum system that can result in a Surged unit. Units that Surge are able to string together superhuman chains of actions, or use the opportunity to further upgrade their abili-ties.

Call In Air Support

Use Command Points to call in faction-specific air support abilities. The Blood Angels Stormraven can obliterate xenos with a missile barrage, or deep strike a unit of veteran Assault Marines behind enemy lines. Meanwhile, the Tyranid Harpy can devastate the enemy defenses with its Sonic Screech, or scat-ter the battlefield with its deadly Spore Mines.

Face Your Friends On The Battlefield

With live and asynchronous multiplayer, and hotseat modes available, there’s no excuse not to take your friends to war.
