games.name: Wobbledogs
games.short_description: A 3D pet simulation where you raise your own personal hive of mutating dogs, physically simulated all the way down to their guts! Wobbledogs is a casual and chill sandbox for players of all ages who want to care for their very own virtual pets in a surprising, unique, and stress-free environment.

descriptions.en: A 3D pet simulation where you raise your own personal hive of mutating dogs, physically simulated all the way down to their guts! Wobbledogs is a casual and chill sandbox for players of all ages who want to care for their very own virtual pets in a surprising, unique, and stress-free environment.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 這是款3D寵物模擬遊戲，你可以飼養自己的突變小狗，遊戲實體模擬出小狗外觀，就連腸道也不放過！《Wobbledogs》是款老少咸宜的小品沙盒遊戲，玩家能在出乎意料、獨特又紓壓的環境飼養自己的虛擬寵物。
descriptions.ja: 変異を繰り返す自分だけの「犬」たちを育成しよう。犬の腸内環境さえも把握する、本格（？）派3Dペットシミュレーションゲーム！Wobbledogsは、カジュアルで気楽に楽しめる、全年齢対象のサンドボックスゲーム。驚きでいっぱいのユニークな環境で、自分だけのバーチャルペットのお世話をしよう。
descriptions.ko: 몸부터 위장까지 시뮬레이션하여 자신만의 돌연변이 개 군집을 기를 수 있는 3D 펫 시뮬레이션! Wobbledogs는 캐주얼하고 편안한 샌드박스 게임으로 가상의 반려동물을 꿈꿔 온 누구나 놀랍고 독특하며 스트레스 없는 환경에서 개를 키울 수 있죠.

detailed_descriptions.en: Wobbledogs is a 3D pet simulation where you raise your own personal hive of rapidly mutating dogs, physically simulated all the way down to their guts! It’s a casual and chill sandbox experience for players of all ages who want to care for their very own virtual pets in a surprising, unique, and stress-free environment. The dogs start out relatively normal, but mutate and behave in surprising ways as the game progresses and their evolutionary lines advance. Dogs have highly variable bodies controlled by a simulated genetics system. As they age, they periodically enter a pupal state and physically mutate. The foods they eat fill their guts with different flora, just like in the gif above. These flora influence the dogs' mutations, letting you craft and mold them to fit your own idea of canine (im)perfection! Dogs need a place to call home, and it’s up to you to create an appealing habitat to help them thrive. As you play, you'll gain access to more and more objects and decorations. String together rooms and decorate them however you’d like. Give your dogs a relaxing place to sleep, set up an maze, or even cultivate a garden. There are no built-in goals, so you can prioritize whatever you like the most! The dogs in this game are physically simulated, which adds a layer of uniqueness to almost every action they take. Two dogs with separate body structures will experience the world in different ways. They also have unique personality traits that influence the types of behaviors they tend to run and govern how they interact with other dogs and objects. Wobbledogs is meant to be enjoyable simply to passively observe, but it’s also rewarding to interact with the dogs directly, whether that’s petting them to relieve some stress, tossing a pup around to watch it tumble through the pen, or helping your canine companion get free after it wriggled itself into a particularly tight space. These dogs try their best, but sometimes they need a bit of extra help!
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《Wobbledogs》是款3D寵物模擬遊戲，你可以飼養自己快速突變的小狗，遊戲實體模擬出小狗外觀，就連腸道也不放過！這是款老少咸宜的小品沙盒遊戲，玩家能在出乎意料、獨特又紓壓的環境飼養自己的虛擬寵物。小狗一開始還算正常，但隨著遊戲進展會不斷演化，帶來出乎意料的突變和行為。 在模擬基因系統控制下，小狗會出現各式各樣的身體。成長過程中，小狗會定期化蛹，身體會也發生突變。牠們吃的食物會讓腸道出現不同菌種，如上方GIF所示。菌種會影響小狗突變，你可以照自己的意思打造出（不）完美的小狗！ 小狗需要有個家，你可以建造出適合牠們成長的美妙環境。你在遊戲過程中，會獲得更多道具和裝飾品。你可以隨心所欲連接和佈置各個房間，給小狗一個安心的地方睡覺、搭建迷宮或是栽種花園。遊戲沒有預設目標，所以你可以照自己的喜好遊玩！ 遊戲裡的小狗都經過實體模擬，所以牠們幾乎每個動作都很獨特。身體構造不同的小狗體驗世界的方式也會不同。牠們也會有獨特的性格，進而影響牠們的行為類型，以及牠們與其他小狗和道具的互動方式。 在《Wobbledogs》中，玩家就算只是靜靜觀察也很有樂趣，但直接與小狗互動也能帶來許多收穫：你可以摸摸狗狗，幫牠們紓壓；把幼犬拋來拋去，看牠在狗屋裡翻滾；或是在小狗卡進狹小空間時，幫助牠們重獲自由。小狗們都非常努力，但有時需要你助牠們一臂之力！
detailed_descriptions.ja: Wobbledogsで、変異を繰り返す自分だけの「犬」たちを育成しよう。犬の腸内環境さえも把握する、本格（？）派3Dペットシミュレーションゲーム！本作は、カジュアルで気楽に楽しめる、全年齢対象のサンドボックスゲーム。驚きでいっぱいのユニークな環境で、自分だけのバーチャルペットのお世話をしよう。犬たちは、始めこそ比較的「普通」な感じ。でも、ゲームが進むと変異を繰り返し、奇想天外な行動を取り始めます。革命的な進化の道筋を作るのは、あなたです！ 犬たちの体は、本作の遺伝子システムによって操作され、さまざまな変異を遂げます。成長の過程で定期的にサナギとなり、物理的に変身するのです。犬が何を食べるかによって、腸内フローラが上の動画のように変化します。犬の変異に影響する腸内フローラは、あなたが思い描く「理想の犬」の姿を実現するのに役立ちます。 犬たちは快適な家を必要としています。彼らが繫栄を遂げるために、その魅力的な我が家を作るのは、あなたの仕事です。ゲームを進めていくと、入手できるオブジェクトと装飾が増えていきます。複数の部屋をつなぎ合わせて、自由に飾りつけましょう。犬たちが安心して眠れるスペースを確保したり、迷路を作ったり、庭で植物を育てたりすることも可能です。目標は設定されていないので、自分の好きなことを優先しましょう！ 物理的にシミュレートされた犬たち。1匹1匹がそれぞれ独自のユニークな行動を見せます。体の作りが違う犬たち。世界の感じ方はそれぞれ違います。犬たちにはそれぞれ独自の性格があり、それによって行動も異なります。他の犬とどのように交流するか、オブジェクトにどんな行動を取るか、犬の性格によってアクションが変わってきます。 Wobbledogsは犬たちをのんびり観察して楽しむゲームですが、直接触れ合う楽しみもあります。犬を撫でてストレスを和らげたり、巣の中で仔犬をツンツンして転がしたり。サナギに姿を変えた後は、そこから外に出るための手助けもできます。もちろん犬たちも頑張りますが、ときには助けが必要です！
detailed_descriptions.ko: Wobbledogs는 몸부터 위장까지 시뮬레이션하여 자신만의 돌연변이 개 군집을 기를 수 있는 3D 펫 시뮬레이션 게임입니다! 이 캐주얼하고 편안한 샌드박스 게임에서는 가상의 반려동물을 꿈꿔 온 누구나 놀랍고 독특하며 스트레스 없는 환경에서 개를 키울 수 있죠. 처음 만나는 개들은 평범해 보이지만 게임이 진행됨에 따라 진화를 거치며 다양하게 변이하고 놀라운 방식으로 행동합니다. 개들은 시뮬레이션된 유전자 시스템의 제어 아래 가변성이 매우 높은 몸을 가지고 태어나고 성장하면서 주기적으로 번데기 상태에 들어가 신체적 변이를 겪는답니다. 개가 섭취하는 음식물은 위의 이미지처럼 다양한 식물군으로 개의 위장을 채우고, 이 식물군들은 개의 변이에 영향을 미칩니다. 따라서 이를 잘 활용하면 원하는 모습의 (불)완전한 개를 탄생시킬 수 있죠. 개에겐 집이라고 부를 장소가 필요하고 그 환경을 제공해 번성을 돕는 것은 플레이어의 몫입니다. 게임을 진행하다 보면 훨씬 많은 물건과 장식을 얻을 수 있습니다. 방과 방을 연결하고 마음에 드는 모습으로 꾸며 보세요. 개에게 편안한 잠자리를 마련해 주고 미로를 설치하거나 정원도 가꿔 보세요. 정해진 목표가 없으니 마음 가는 대로 플레이할 수 있습니다! 이 게임에서는 개가 보유한 특성이 물리적으로 구현되므로 그 행동 하나하나가 독특하게 다가옵니다. 신체 구조가 다른 두 마리의 개는 서로 다른 방식으로 세상을 경험하죠. 또한 개마다 가지고 있는 독특한 성격적 특성이 개의 행동 유형에 영향을 미치고 다른 개나 물건과 상호 작용하는 방식을 좌우합니다. Wobbledogs는 가만히 지켜보기만 해도 재미있지만, 개와 직접 상호 작용하며 얻는 즐거움도 무척 크답니다. 개를 쓰다듬으며 스트레스를 풀고 강아지를 가볍게 던져 우리 안에서 굴러다니는 모습을 지켜보거나 좁은 공간에 끼여 꼼지락대는 개를 자유롭게 풀어 줄 수도 있죠. Wobbledogs의 개들은 늘 최선을 다하지만 조금은 도움이 필요하답니다!

games.name: World War Z
games.short_description: World War Z is a heart-pounding coop third-person shooter for up to 4 players featuring massive swarms of hundreds of zombies, focused on fast-paced, gruesomely spectacular action.

descriptions.en: World War Z is a heart-pounding coop third-person shooter for up to 4 players featuring massive swarms of hundreds of zombies, focused on fast-paced, gruesomely spectacular action.
descriptions.zh-Hant: 《World War Z》是一款令人腎上腺素飆升的第三人稱合作射擊遊戲，一次最多可支援 4 名玩家。玩家必須對抗一批批數以百計的殭屍與快節奏的血腥行動。
descriptions.ja: World War Z is a heart-pounding coop third-person shooter for up to 4 players featuring massive swarms of hundreds of zombies, focused on fast-paced, gruesomely spectacular action.
descriptions.ko: World War Z is a heart-pounding coop third-person shooter for up to 4 players featuring massive swarms of hundreds of zombies, focused on fast-paced, gruesomely spectacular action.

detailed_descriptions.en: World War Z is a heart-pounding co-op third-person shooter for up to 4 players featuring swarms of hundreds of zombies that has now captivated over 25 million players. Based on the Paramount Pictures film, World War Z focuses on fast-paced gameplay while exploring new storylines from around the world. Humanity is on the brink of extinction. From New York to Moscow to Japan and Jerusalem, the undead apocalypse continues to spread. As the end looms, a hardened few band together to defeat the horde and outlive the dead. Battle swarms of hundreds of zombies The Swarm Engine™ seamlessly renders hordes of zombies in incredible firefights. Advanced gore systems offer gruesomely satisfying action. In-game Zombie Hordes behave like real crowds, getting stuck in narrow corridors and climbing on top of each other to reach players on higher levels. Hordes become increasingly more difficult to defeat and behave like single entity bosses as players progress through the game. Coop story-driven campaigns Survive around the world, as unique groups tell their stories of perseverance. Choose Your Class Level up to 8 unique classes – Gunslinger, Hellraiser, Slasher, Medic, Fixer, Exterminator, Dronemaster and the new Vanguard class in WWZ: Aftermath – each with their own unique perks and play styles. Deep Progression Grow stronger – unlock powerful weapon upgrades and level your character class to take on greater challenges. PVPVZ Fight other players for survival – several intense Player vs Player vs Zombies game modes complement the coop campaigns.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 《末日之戰》是一款令人心跳加速的第三人稱合作射擊遊戲，最多可支援4名玩家共同遊玩。遊戲中屍群數以百計，吸引的玩家已達2500萬之眾。《末日之戰》的靈感源自派拉蒙影業公司出品的影片，遊戲特色是快節奏的玩法，以及探索世界各地的全新故事情節。 人類瀕臨滅絕，從紐約、莫斯科、日本到耶路撒冷，不死的天災不斷蔓延。末日臨近之際，少數堅強的人們團結起來，擊敗屍潮，對抗死亡。 - 與成百上千的僵屍群作戰 Swarm Engine™可在激烈的槍戰中順暢渲染成群的僵屍，透過先進的斷肢系統呈現極具衝擊力的血腥動作。遊戲內的屍潮行動與真實人群無異，它們會擠在狹窄的走廊，互相攀爬，試圖接近位於高處的玩家。隨著遊戲的推進，屍群會越來越難以擊敗，並且會像單體Boss一樣行動。 - 故事驅動的合作戰役 在世界各地努力生存，瞭解獨特人物各自奮戰的故事。 - 選擇職業 升級8個專屬職業：槍手、叛逆者、劈砍者、醫療兵、修理師、殲滅者、無人機大師以及《末日之戰：劫後餘生》中新增的先鋒，每個職業都有自己獨特技能和遊戲玩法。 - 深度進階 不斷成長，解鎖強大的武器升級，提升角色職業，迎接更大的挑戰。 - PVPVZ 為了生存與其他玩家戰鬥：合作模式中新增了數種緊張刺激的玩家 vs 玩家 vs 僵屍遊戲模式。
detailed_descriptions.ja: World War Z is a heart-pounding co-op third-person shooter for up to 4 players featuring swarms of hundreds of zombies that has now captivated over 25 million players. Based on the Paramount Pictures film, World War Z focuses on fast-paced gameplay while exploring new storylines from around the world. Humanity is on the brink of extinction. From New York to Moscow to Japan and Jerusalem, the undead apocalypse continues to spread. As the end looms, a hardened few band together to defeat the horde and outlive the dead. Battle swarms of hundreds of zombies The Swarm Engine™ seamlessly renders hordes of zombies in incredible firefights. Advanced gore systems offer gruesomely satisfying action. In-game Zombie Hordes behave like real crowds, getting stuck in narrow corridors and climbing on top of each other to reach players on higher levels. Hordes become increasingly more difficult to defeat and behave like single entity bosses as players progress through the game. Coop story-driven campaigns Survive around the world, as unique groups tell their stories of perseverance. Choose Your Class Level up to 8 unique classes – Gunslinger, Hellraiser, Slasher, Medic, Fixer, Exterminator, Dronemaster and the new Vanguard class in WWZ: Aftermath – each with their own unique perks and play styles. Deep Progression Grow stronger – unlock powerful weapon upgrades and level your character class to take on greater challenges. PVPVZ Fight other players for survival – several intense Player vs Player vs Zombies game modes complement the coop campaigns.

games.name: World War Z: Aftermath Upgrade
games.short_description: This takes your standard edition of World War Z and any combination of individual DLC you might own, and upgrades you fully to World War Z: Aftermath.

descriptions.en: This takes your standard edition of World War Z and any combination of individual DLC you might own, and upgrades you fully to World War Z: Aftermath.

detailed_descriptions.en: World War Z: Aftermath is the ultimate co-op zombie shooter based on Paramount Pictures’ blockbuster film, and the next evolution of the original hit World War Z that has now captivated over 20 million players. Turn the tide of the zombie apocalypse across consoles and PC with full cross-play. Join up to three friends or play on your own with AI teammates against hordes of ravenous zombies in intense story episodes across new zombie-ravaged locations around the world: Rome, Vatican City and Russia’s Kamchatka peninsula. New Stories From a World at War All-new story episodes in Rome, Vatican City, and the Russian far east at Kamchatka. Play as both new and returning characters as you take the fight to the undead with a brutal new melee system, decimating zekes with unique moves, perks and dual-wield weapon options like the sickle and cleaver. Fend off new undead monstrosities, including swarms of flesh-hungry rats that will unleash total chaos on your team. The Next Generation of the Zombie Swarm Play in glorious 4K|60 FPS. Endure endless waves of increasingly difficult zombies in the new Horde Mode XL game mode, featuring hundreds more zombies on screen than ever before possible. Deep Progression and a New Perspective Experience a heart-pounding new perspective with Aftermath’s immersive new First-Person Mode option. Level up eight unique classes — the Gunslinger, Hellraiser, Slasher, Medic, Fixer, Exterminator, Dronemaster, and all-new Vanguard class — each with their own perks and playstyles. Customize your weapons to survive any challenge, and conquer new daily missions with special modifiers for bonus rewards.

games.name: WRC 8 FIA World Rally Championship
games.short_description: The most complete and authentic official WRC simulation yet. New physics for all surfaces, a completely redesigned career mode, dynamic weather conditions, 50 teams, 14 countries, 100 tracks, weekly challenges and an eSports mode…

descriptions.en: The most complete and authentic official WRC simulation yet. New physics for all surfaces, a completely redesigned career mode, dynamic weather conditions, 50 teams, 14 countries, 100 tracks, weekly challenges and an eSports mode…
descriptions.zh-Hant: 最完整和真實的WRC官方賽車模擬遊戲。賽道路面的全新物理機制、完全重新設計的職涯模式、動態天氣、50隻車隊、14個國家、100個賽道，每週挑戰和eSports模式……
descriptions.ja: 史上最高の完成度を誇る本格的な公式WRCシミュレーションゲーム。全路面で一新されたオフロード物理演算、完全に再設計されたキャリアモード、ダイナミックな天候、50チーム、14カ国での開催、100コース、ウィークリーチャレンジに eSports モード…
descriptions.ko: 역대 가장 완벽하고 정확한 공식 WRC 시뮬레이션. 모든 도로 표면에 적용되는 새로운 물리 엔진, 완전히 새로 디자인된 커리어 모드, 변화무쌍한 기상 조건, 50개 팀, 14개 국가, 100개 트랙, 주간 도전과 eSports 모드까지…

detailed_descriptions.en: The WRC championship is the most challenging motor racing competition in the world. With the new dynamic weather system, climatic conditions have true-to-life effects: rain and snowfall is now an important game feature as variable traction, different set-ups for each stage, tyre choice and shrewd use of the weather forecasting team all need to be considered. The single-player Career mode has been rebuilt from the ground up: calendar management, R&D to improve performance, staff recruitment and management (mechanics, engineers, medical and weather teams, finance manager, etc.). For multiplayer, weekly challenges and WRC eSports return, but the challenge and competition is now even stiffer. With 50 teams, 14 rallies and over 100 special stages in the 2019 season, WRC 8 has the deepest content ever included in an off-road racing game.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: WRC冠軍賽是世上最具挑戰的賽車比賽。 新的動態天氣系統讓氣候條件有了真正的影響：雨和雪現在能改變牽引力，對遊戲有重大影響。您必須在每個關卡考慮不同設置、輪胎選擇、另外聰明地使用天氣預報團隊。 單人職涯模式將從零開始：行事曆管理、進行研發提高表現、人員招聘和管理（技師、工程師、醫療和氣象團隊、財務經理……等等）。 在多人遊戲中，每週挑戰和WRC eSports回歸，但挑戰和競賽現在更加激烈。 WRC 8擁有2019賽季的50隻車隊、14種比賽和100多個特別賽道，提供了其他越野賽車遊戲無法比擬的內容。
detailed_descriptions.ja: WRC チャンピオンシップは世界でもっとも挑戦的なモーターレース大会です。 一新されたダイナミック天候システムでは、本物さながらの気象条件がお楽しみ頂けます。雨や雪、可変トラクション、各ステージごとのセットアップ、タイヤの選択、気象予報チームの賢い利用などがゲームを進める上でのカギを握ります。 シングルプレイのキャリアモードは、カレンダー管理、業績向上のための研究開発、スタッフの採用および管理（整備士、エンジニア、医療及び気象予報チーム、ファイナンスマネージャー等）などの要素をゼロから再構築しました。 マルチプレイモード、ウィークリーチャレンジ、WRC eSports が復活しました。しかし挑戦と競争はより激しさを増しました。 50 のチーム、14 のラリーコースに、2019 年度シーズンから選ばれた 100 を越すスペシャルステージにより、WRC 8 はオフロードレーシングゲームとして最も奥深く、史上最高の内容を提供します。
detailed_descriptions.ko: WRC 챔피언십은 전 세계에서 가장 어려운 모터스포츠 대회입니다. 새로운 역동적 기상 시스템으로 기후 조건은 현실적인 영향을 줍니다. 비와 눈은 이제 다양한 마찰력, 각 스테이지의 셋업, 타이어 선택과 마찬가지로 게임의 중요한 요소이며, 일기 예보 팀의 기민한 사용은 모두가 고려해야 할 사항입니다. 싱글플레이 커리어 모드는 처음부터 새로 설계되었습니다. 달력 관리, 성능 향상을 위한 연구개발, 스태프 고용과 관리(메카닉, 엔지니어, 의료 및 기상 팀, 재정 관리자 등). 멀티플레이에 주간 도전과제와 WRC eSports가 돌아왔지만, 도전과제와 대회는 더욱 어려워졌습니다. 2019시즌의 50개 팀, 14개 랠리, 100개 이상의 특별 스테이지와 함께하는 WRC 8은 오프로드 레이싱 게임 역사상 가장 풍부한 콘텐츠를 자랑합니다.

games.name: Wylde Flowers
games.short_description: Join Tara on a heartfelt journey to become a witch in Wylde Flowers. Farm by day, and cast spells by night as you craft your cottagecore life and bond with your coven. Come to know and love the fully voice acted characters of Fairhaven, as you unravel a local mystery.

descriptions.en: Join Tara on a heartfelt journey to become a witch in Wylde Flowers. Farm by day, and cast spells by night as you craft your cottagecore life and bond with your coven. Come to know and love the fully voice acted characters of Fairhaven, as you unravel a local mystery.

detailed_descriptions.en: Play as Tara (she/her), who has just moved to a cute rural island to help out her grandma and the family farm. Get to know a memorable cast of fully voiced characters with intriguing backstories — find friendship or even romance! Relax into your rural lifestyle as you tend crops, care for animals, fish, craft, and more throughout the day. By night, nurture your inner witch as you learn to fly your broomstick, brew potions, control the weather and seasons or even transform into a cat! Fairhaven awaits you. 🌸 A WITCHY TALE Savour an earnest and emotional story that blends farming with magic and personal discovery as Tara finds herself, and brings a town together. 🌸 FULLY VOICE ACTED DIALOGUE IN ENGLISH The characters in Wylde Flowers are brought to life with a cast including BAFTA award winning voice actors in over 18 hours of voice acting. 🌸 30 DIVERSE CHARACTERS From Natalia (she/her) the local Blacksmith, to Sophia (she/her) who runs the diner, each character in Fairhaven has an intricate backstory waiting for you to love and fall in love with. 🌸 SWEET ROMANCE Seven folks of Fairhaven are eligible to be wooed and romanced. From the local butcher Kim (they/them), to Amira (she/her), a flirty doctor. 🌸 FARMING & MAGIC Develop both domestic and magical crafts through cooking, fishing, farming, animal care, magical spells and potions. 🌸 LOTS TO ENJOY Explore and relax through 35-60+ hours of immersive gameplay. 🌸 BESPOKE SOUNDTRACK The music is closely entwined with the narrative and features a music score created with the help of a real orchestra, that responds to your choices.

descriptions.ja: YapYapとは、魔導師となり、ライバルの塔を荒らすために最大5人の友だちを手下として召喚する魔法協力型ホラーゲームだ。様々な呪文を唱え、塔を守る魔獣やモンスターを避けつつ破壊目標を達成せよ。
descriptions.ko: 최대 5명의 친구들과 함께 마법사에게 소환된 하수인이 되어 라이벌 마법사의 탑에 침입해 온갖 말썽을 벌이는 마법 테마의 협동 공포 게임입니다. 탑을 지키는 마법 생물과 괴물을 피해 다니면서, 다양한 주문으로 주어진 파괴 목표를 달성하세요.

detailed_descriptions.en: A magic-themed co-op horror game where you and up to 5 friends are minions summoned by a wizard to break into their rival's towers to cause mayhem. Try to fufill your vandalism target with an assortment of spells while avoiding magical beasts and monsters that protect the tower. VANDALIZE Break their piano, clog their toilets, pee on their rug - do anything in your power to ruin the archmage’s day. Every inconvenience you create gives you more points towards your vandalism target for the night. CAST UNIQUE SPELLS Find and use magic way beyond your understanding to push, pull, smash, launch, float, teleport, clone, confuse, disguise, fishify and more. Work together with your teammates to create a sandbox of chaos. USE YOUR VOICE Use your voice to cast wizardly incantations - enunciation matters so you better keep your voice steady no matter how dire the circumstances. ESCAPE THE TOWER You are not alone in the tower - there are all sorts of creatures patrolling the halls. Some are created to protect their study. Others are horrifying results of their magical experiments. There are even creatures of darkness unbeknownst to the archmage themselves. Stay quiet, cause distractions, hide and finally when all else fails - run.
detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 一款魔法主題的多人合作恐怖遊戲。在這裡，你將與至多五位好友一同化身由法師召喚的僕從，並潛入其對手的塔樓製造混亂。嘗試在躲避守護此地的魔獸與怪物的同時，運用各式法術完成破壞目標吧。 大肆破壞 砸毀鋼琴、堵塞馬桶、尿濕地毯——竭盡你所能地毀掉大法師的一天。你所進行的任何破壞都能讓你更加接近當晚的行動目標。 施放獨特法術 發掘並使用遠超你的理解的魔法以實現推動、拉扯、粉碎、發射、漂浮、傳送、複製、迷惑、偽裝、變魚等操作。與隊友一同創造一個滿是混亂的沙箱世界。 運用你的聲音 親自吟唱魔法咒語——發音十分重要，所以無論處境有多危急，都請務必保持聲線穩定。 逃離高塔 你並不是高塔中唯一的存在——各類生物正徘徊其間。它們有的是為了保護研究而被製造出來的，有的是魔法實驗的恐怖產物，除此之外，這裡甚至還存在著連大法師都未曾發覺的黑暗生物。 保持安靜，製造干擾，隱匿身形，當這一切都徒勞無功時——快跑。
detailed_descriptions.ja: YapYapとは、魔導師となり、ライバルの塔を荒らすために最大5人の友だちを手下として召喚する魔法協力型ホラーゲームだ。様々な呪文を唱え、塔を守る魔獣やモンスターを避けつつ破壊目標を達成せよ。 派手に荒らせ！ ピアノを壊せ。トイレを詰まらせろ。カーペットを汚せ。あらゆる手段で大魔導師の一日を台無しにしろ。引き起こした迷惑の数だけ、今夜の破壊目標に近づいていく。 独自の呪文を繰り出せ！ 理解を超えた魔法を見つけ出し、使いこなせ。押す、引く、潰す、打ち上げる、浮かせる、テレポートする、分身を生み出す、混乱させる、変装する、魚に変える――その可能性は無限大だ。仲間と協力し、混沌に満ちたサンドボックスを作り上げろ。 声を使え！ 魔導師っぽい呪文を声で唱えろ。発音は重要だ。どれほど危険な状況でも、声をぶれさせるな。 塔から逃げろ！ 塔には一人じゃない。様々な怪物が廊下を徘徊する。書斎を守る者もいれば、恐ろしい魔法実験の産物もいる。大魔導師ですら知らない闇の生き物も存在する。静かに身を潜め、気をそらし、隠れ、そして全てがうまくいかなくなったら――逃げろ。
detailed_descriptions.ko: 최대 5명의 친구들과 함께 마법사에게 소환된 하수인이 되어 라이벌 마법사의 탑에 침입해 온갖 말썽을 벌이는 마법 테마의 협동 공포 게임입니다. 탑을 지키는 마법 생물과 괴물을 피해 다니면서, 다양한 주문으로 주어진 파괴 목표를 달성하세요. 난장판을 만드세요 피아노를 부수고, 변기를 막아버리고, 카펫에 오줌을 싸세요! 대마법사의 하루를 엉망으로 만들기 위해 할 수 있는 건 뭐든지 하세요. 당신이 벌이는 모든 말썽은 그날 밤의 파괴 목표 점수로 누적됩니다. 독특한 주문들을 사용하세요 당신의 이해를 뛰어넘는 마법을 찾아 사용해 밀어내고, 끌어당기고, 부수고, 날려 보내고, 띄우고, 순간이동하고, 복제하고, 혼란시키고, 변장시키고, 심지어 물고기로 만들어 버리는 등, 온갖 일을 저지르세요. 팀원들과 힘을 합쳐 혼돈의 카오스를 만들어 보세요. 목소리를 사용하세요 당신의 목소리로 마법의 주문을 외우세요. 발음이 새면 주문도 새니까, 어떤 위기 속에서도 차분한 목소리를 유지하세요. 탑에서 탈출하세요 탑 안에서 당신은 절대 혼자가 아닙니다.복도에는 온갖 생명체들이 끊임없이 배회합니다. 연구실을 지키도록 만들어진 생물도 있고, 실패한 마법 실험이 만들어낸 기괴한 존재도 있습니다. 심지어 대마법사조차 눈치채지 못한 어둠의 생명체도 도사리고 있습니다. 숨을 죽이고, 주의를 분산시키고, 몸을 숨기세요. 그리고 더 이상 방법이 없다면 - 전력을 다해 도망치세요.

games.name: ZEPHON - The Platinum & The Infinite
games.short_description: 2 new leaders, 7 new units, 3 new operations, 3 new items, 2 new outposts, 5 new quests, 4 new mutators, 4 new tracks.

descriptions.en: 2 new leaders, 7 new units, 3 new operations, 3 new items, 2 new outposts, 5 new quests, 4 new mutators, 4 new tracks.

detailed_descriptions.en: NEW LEADERS PLATINUM SCION “Money can’t get you everything. But nothing else comes close.” Cyber Affinity: Anything shiny and tech-heavy catches the Scion’s eye. Start with Cyber units and gain early access to Cyber technologies. The Sure Thing: Even in the apocalypse, the Scion knows the art of the deal. Pay minerals to get a larger amount back, later. Economies of Scale: He may be superficial, but the Scion understands production lines. Unit cost is progressively reduced with each duplicate. Just Ship It: The Scion cares not for product testing or safety, only for a quick buck. Non-hero units are produced with a random debuff. Personal Visit (Elite): His handshake and a smile are almost as motivating as his mercurial mood. Spend influence to increase the output of all the buildings on a tile. INFINITE COUNT “Once more, we meet for the first time.” Voice Affinity: Stuck halfway into the Voice, the Count is closer to it, however unwillingly. Start with Voice units and gain early access to Voice technologies. Perfect Forever: Certain moments of death and horror seem to summon iterations of the Count. Spend influence to mark a unit which, when killed, spawns a Caitiff. Time Out of Joint: The Count can take followers with him on his temporal wanderings - though their health is sapped. Spend influence to restore the action points and movement of a unit at the cost of their hitpoints. Ageless Hunger: The Count’s presence is a constant drain on the lives of his people. Population growth rate is decreased, but killing enemies temporarily boosts growth. See As I See (Elite): Others can be subjected to the Count’s disoriented atemporal experience of the world. Spend influence to reduce enemy morale over a large area. NEW UNITS Rangers (Human, Tier 3): Biological infantry with short range weapons trained for ambushing from covered positions. Jaeger R-2 (Human, Tier 4): Large mechanical robot constructed for frontal assaults. Caitiffs (Voice, Tier 3): Biological melee monsters that hobble enemies, burn easily and return to life after death. Chosen of Throkos (Voice, Tier 4): Large biological worm that can tunnel and ruin enemy fortifications. Anashim Enforcers (Cyber, Tier 3): Bio-mech infantry that can adjust its function to many situations. Galgalim Orb (Cyber, Tier 4): Large mechanical orb that ignores zone of control and overwhelms enemies with its laser array or crushes them under its weight. Acrin Spawnrider (Acrin): Large biological flyer that defiles its enemies and bolsters the morale of its allies. NEW OPERATIONS Tactical Insertion (Human, Tier 5): Deploys Rangers on target tile. Sub Rosa Specialists (Tier 6) upgrade increases Ranger level. Vorodai's Bargain (Voice, Tier 5): Sacrifice own unit to gain influence. Willing Sacrifices (Tier 6) upgrade increases influence gain. Clone Wave (Cyber, Tier 5): Increases accumulated growth in target allied city. Accelerated Ligation (Tier 6) upgrade increases growth gain. NEW ITEMS Holo Decoy (Human, Uncommon): Grants cover damage reduction to target unit. Planar Phlebotomizer (Voice, Uncommon): Creates Bleed on target tile. Invasive Auditor (Cyber, Uncommon): Increases damage of target unit. NEW OUTPOSTS Reaver Depot: Provides influence and minerals, and every 20 turns spawns Reavers or Busters. Atmospheric Anchor: Provides energy and chips, and every 10 turns grants an ability that damages target enemy unit. NEW QUESTS The Martial Ethic (Early-game): Your troops are slipping into Karro’s cult-run cage fights to win “the Quakecaller,” a fault-shattering device—do you back a true champion, or shut the ring down? Storm of Storms (Mid-game): A fallen Acrin ship is gutted by Apolline’s scavengers—its stolen terraforming core now births a city-bound superstorm; will you break the weather, or bend it? City in the Clouds (Late-game): A disc-city punches your skyline, then vanishes into overcast—soldiers brawling on its rooftops as it fell; can you track the flying metropolis and claim its loyalties before it claims yours? Becoming Unbound (Infinite Count): A book falls—and time wrenches you loose; siphon seconds from your council to stand, then choose your thread—kings or poets—before the next pull chooses for you. Touch The Sky (Platinum Scion): Daed Phinnicus’s holomemo brands you a failson before the board; you counter with a vow to carve your face into the sun—can you turn humiliation into legacy? NEW MUTATORS Is Wisdom The Measure Of Worth? (Unrestricted): Doubled experience gain. What Am I, Truly? (Unrestricted): Doubled unit production speed. Did I Doom My Friends? (Infinite Count): Unsighted tiles become unexplored each turn. Was I The Best Person Alive Or What? (Platinum Scion): Accumulated resources compound at 10% per turn. NEW MUSIC Exploration: 4 minutes 58 seconds of enticing wondrous harmonies. Human (Mid-game): 5 minutes 33 seconds of hard rock militaristic beats. Cyber (Mid-game): 6 minutes 2 seconds of sharp methodical synths. Voice (Mid-game): 5 minutes 25 seconds of primal ominous melodies.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
NEW LEADERS

PLATINUM SCION

“Money can’t get you everything. But nothing else comes close.”

  • Cyber Affinity: Anything shiny and tech-heavy catches the Scion’s eye. Start with Cyber units and gain early access to Cyber technologies.

  • The Sure Thing: Even in the apocalypse, the Scion knows the art of the deal. Pay minerals to get a larger amount back, later.

  • Economies of Scale: He may be superficial, but the Scion understands production lines. Unit cost is progressively reduced with each duplicate.

  • Just Ship It: The Scion cares not for product testing or safety, only for a quick buck. Non-hero units are produced with a random debuff.

  • Personal Visit (Elite): His handshake and a smile are almost as motivating as his mercurial mood. Spend influence to increase the output of all the buildings on a tile.

INFINITE COUNT

“Once more, we meet for the first time.”

  • Voice Affinity: Stuck halfway into the Voice, the Count is closer to it, however unwillingly. Start with Voice units and gain early access to Voice technologies.

  • Perfect Forever: Certain moments of death and horror seem to summon iterations of the Count. Spend influence to mark a unit which, when killed, spawns a Caitiff.

  • Time Out of Joint: The Count can take followers with him on his temporal wanderings - though their health is sapped. Spend influence to restore the action points and movement of a unit at the cost of their hitpoints.

  • Ageless Hunger: The Count’s presence is a constant drain on the lives of his people. Population growth rate is decreased, but killing enemies temporarily boosts growth.

  • See As I See (Elite): Others can be subjected to the Count’s disoriented atemporal experience of the world. Spend influence to reduce enemy morale over a large area.

NEW UNITS

  • Rangers (Human, Tier 3): Biological infantry with short range weapons trained for ambushing from covered positions.

  • Jaeger R-2 (Human, Tier 4): Large mechanical robot constructed for frontal assaults.

  • Caitiffs (Voice, Tier 3): Biological melee monsters that hobble enemies, burn easily and return to life after death.

  • Chosen of Throkos (Voice, Tier 4): Large biological worm that can tunnel and ruin enemy fortifications.

  • Anashim Enforcers (Cyber, Tier 3): Bio-mech infantry that can adjust its function to many situations.

  • Galgalim Orb (Cyber, Tier 4): Large mechanical orb that ignores zone of control and overwhelms enemies with its laser array or crushes them under its weight.

  • Acrin Spawnrider (Acrin): Large biological flyer that defiles its enemies and bolsters the morale of its allies.

NEW OPERATIONS

  • Tactical Insertion (Human, Tier 5): Deploys Rangers on target tile. Sub Rosa Specialists (Tier 6) upgrade increases Ranger level.

  • Vorodai's Bargain (Voice, Tier 5): Sacrifice own unit to gain influence. Willing Sacrifices (Tier 6) upgrade increases influence gain.

  • Clone Wave (Cyber, Tier 5): Increases accumulated growth in target allied city. Accelerated Ligation (Tier 6) upgrade increases growth gain.

NEW ITEMS

  • Holo Decoy (Human, Uncommon): Grants cover damage reduction to target unit.

  • Planar Phlebotomizer (Voice, Uncommon): Creates Bleed on target tile.

  • Invasive Auditor (Cyber, Uncommon): Increases damage of target unit.

NEW OUTPOSTS

  • Reaver Depot: Provides influence and minerals, and every 20 turns spawns Reavers or Busters.

  • Atmospheric Anchor: Provides energy and chips, and every 10 turns grants an ability that damages target enemy unit.

NEW QUESTS

  • The Martial Ethic (Early-game): Your troops are slipping into Karro’s cult-run cage fights to win “the Quakecaller,” a fault-shattering device—do you back a true champion, or shut the ring down?

  • Storm of Storms (Mid-game): A fallen Acrin ship is gutted by Apolline’s scavengers—its stolen terraforming core now births a city-bound superstorm; will you break the weather, or bend it?

  • City in the Clouds (Late-game): A disc-city punches your skyline, then vanishes into overcast—soldiers brawling on its rooftops as it fell; can you track the flying metropolis and claim its loyalties before it claims yours?

  • Becoming Unbound (Infinite Count): A book falls—and time wrenches you loose; siphon seconds from your council to stand, then choose your thread—kings or poets—before the next pull chooses for you.

  • Touch The Sky (Platinum Scion): Daed Phinnicus’s holomemo brands you a failson before the board; you counter with a vow to carve your face into the sun—can you turn humiliation into legacy?

NEW MUTATORS

  • Is Wisdom The Measure Of Worth? (Unrestricted): Doubled experience gain.

  • What Am I, Truly? (Unrestricted): Doubled unit production speed.

  • Did I Doom My Friends? (Infinite Count): Unsighted tiles become unexplored each turn.

  • Was I The Best Person Alive Or What? (Platinum Scion): Accumulated resources compound at 10% per turn.

NEW MUSIC

  • Exploration: 4 minutes 58 seconds of enticing wondrous harmonies.

  • Human (Mid-game): 5 minutes 33 seconds of hard rock militaristic beats.

  • Cyber (Mid-game): 6 minutes 2 seconds of sharp methodical synths.

  • Voice (Mid-game): 5 minutes 25 seconds of primal ominous melodies.

games.short_description: 2 new leaders, 7 new units, 3 new operations, 3 new items, 2 new outposts, 5 new quests, 4 new mutators, 4 new tracks.

descriptions.en: 2 new leaders, 7 new units, 3 new operations, 3 new items, 2 new outposts, 5 new quests, 4 new mutators, 4 new tracks.

detailed_descriptions.en: NEW LEADERS TWISTED MOTHER “We take care of our own, here. I take care of the rest.” Voice Affinity : Though she isn’t aware of it, few have travelled deeper into the Voice than she has. Start with Voice units and gain early access to Voice technologies. Gifts of the Voice : When her burning smile is turned to you, you feel so very special. Spend influence to buff your units… at a cost. Tender Ministrations : Despite her afflictions, the Mother insists that all her children care for one another. Increased healing rate if adjacent to an allied unit. Abhorrent : Though her kindness is obvious, the Mother’s appearance and unreliable personality puts off independents. Gain less from trading pacts. Immaculate Delivery (Elite) : Her love envelops a target, passing it safely through the Bleed to another place. Spend influence to teleport units to allied units. HOLLOW WARLORD “I came, I conquered, I will again.” Human Affinity : The Warlord is a simple man, interested in conquest, not cursed magic or alien technology. Start with Human units and gain early access to Human technologies. We Who Are About To Die : The adventures of the Warlord and his soldiers are told and retold in the city streets—as long as the blood keeps flowing. Every turn that your units kill or die, your cities’ loyalty increases, but otherwise decreases. Tales of the Hunt : The tales of the Warlord’s endless campaign spread far and wide. Attacking gives influence. Restless : The sharp-toothed townsfolk will not stand for idle warriors—and will not feed them either. Units in cities and outposts have increased upkeep. Horde Mandate (Elite) : When the Warlord masses his forces for war they attack with vigor, eager to prove themselves to him. Spend influence to grant troops in a large area a bonus to attacks and movement. NEW UNITS Sharpshooters (Human, Tier 1): Biological infantry with anti-infantry sniper rifles as well as stealth and reconnaissance capabilities. Scramblers (Human, Tier 2): Bio-mech bikers that excel at weaving in and out of combat. Devotees of Throkos (Voice, Tier 1): Biological ranged monsters that are strong against wounded enemies. Amoetia's Devourer (Voice, Tier 2): Large biological creature that decays and has to consume its enemies or incapacitate itself for sustenance Cassiel Shredders (Cyber, Tier 1): Mechanical melee hover infantry that sustain their damage output at reduced group size. Ithuriel Harbinger (Cyber, Tier 2): Large mechanical robot with potent overheating cannons. Wastelander (Chieftess): Large mechanical transport that is heavily armed and empowers nearby allies. NEW OPERATIONS Enriched Alloys (Human, Tier 3): Increases ranged damage of target allied unit. Efficient Enrichment (Tier 4) upgrade reduces resource cost. Transubstantiation (Voice, Tier 3): Target allied unit restores hitpoints on attack. Metabole (Tier 4) upgrade increases restored hitpoints. Systemic Reset (Cyber, Tier 3): Removes temporary debuffs from target allied unit. Systemic Interference (Tier 4) upgrade allows the removal of temporary buffs from target enemy unit. NEW ITEMS Suicide Drones (Human, Common): Damages target enemy unit. Stolen Flesh (Voice, Common): Restores hitpoints each turn. ICAR Fluid Deflector (Cyber, Common): Grants evasion damage reduction. NEW OUTPOSTS Erebus Excavator: Provides minerals and chips, and has a chance to unearth an item each turn. Temple of Cr'la: Provides food and algae, and every 10 turns grants an ability that heals target allied unit. NEW QUESTS Message to the Stars (Early-game): You hear rumors of human spacecraft that left Earth before the war, but ZEPHON blocks you from sending any message out into space. Circus Cambion (Mid-game): A mysterious Ringmaster comes to town and cajoles you into helping him with a grand performance. Concordat Compromised (Late-game): The Concordat asks you for help–an agent has been kidnapped by a group calling themselves “The Constellation.” Impossible Conception (Twisted Mother): Driven by love and longing, you set out to rescue your lost husband and fulfill your shared dream of starting a family, no matter the cost. Reyndverra (Hollow Warlord): Haunted by idleness, you pursue a legendary reality-warping sword, facing rivals who test your resolve and your understanding of power. NEW MUTATORS Must We Suffer So? (Unrestricted): Start the game with Research Laboratory, Holo Theater, Habitation Block, Construction Yard and Engineer researched. Can Free Will Exist? (Unrestricted): Weapon damage is randomized by ±20%. Can Anything Redeem This Horror? (Twisted Mother): Purchasing units from NPCs is 50% cheaper. Can A Journey Be An End In Itself? (Hollow Warlord): Units have an additional action point. NEW MUSIC Exploration: 5 minutes 17 seconds of enticing wondrous harmonies. Human (Early-game): 5 minutes 39 seconds of hard rock militaristic beats. Cyber (Early-game): 7 minutes 2 seconds of sharp methodical synths. Voice (Early-game): 6 minutes 59 seconds of primal ominous melodies.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
NEW LEADERS

TWISTED MOTHER

“We take care of our own, here. I take care of the rest.”

  • Voice Affinity: Though she isn’t aware of it, few have travelled deeper into the Voice than she has. Start with Voice units and gain early access to Voice technologies.

  • Gifts of the Voice: When her burning smile is turned to you, you feel so very special. Spend influence to buff your units… at a cost.

  • Tender Ministrations: Despite her afflictions, the Mother insists that all her children care for one another. Increased healing rate if adjacent to an allied unit.

  • Abhorrent: Though her kindness is obvious, the Mother’s appearance and unreliable personality puts off independents. Gain less from trading pacts.

  • Immaculate Delivery (Elite): Her love envelops a target, passing it safely through the Bleed to another place. Spend influence to teleport units to allied units.

HOLLOW WARLORD

“I came, I conquered, I will again.”

  • Human Affinity: The Warlord is a simple man, interested in conquest, not cursed magic or alien technology. Start with Human units and gain early access to Human technologies.

  • We Who Are About To Die: The adventures of the Warlord and his soldiers are told and retold in the city streets—as long as the blood keeps flowing. Every turn that your units kill or die, your cities’ loyalty increases, but otherwise decreases.

  • Tales of the Hunt: The tales of the Warlord’s endless campaign spread far and wide. Attacking gives influence.

  • Restless: The sharp-toothed townsfolk will not stand for idle warriors—and will not feed them either. Units in cities and outposts have increased upkeep.

  • Horde Mandate (Elite): When the Warlord masses his forces for war they attack with vigor, eager to prove themselves to him. Spend influence to grant troops in a large area a bonus to attacks and movement.

NEW UNITS

  • Sharpshooters (Human, Tier 1): Biological infantry with anti-infantry sniper rifles as well as stealth and reconnaissance capabilities.

  • Scramblers (Human, Tier 2): Bio-mech bikers that excel at weaving in and out of combat.

  • Devotees of Throkos (Voice, Tier 1): Biological ranged monsters that are strong against wounded enemies.

  • Amoetia's Devourer (Voice, Tier 2): Large biological creature that decays and has to consume its enemies or incapacitate itself for sustenance

  • Cassiel Shredders (Cyber, Tier 1): Mechanical melee hover infantry that sustain their damage output at reduced group size.

  • Ithuriel Harbinger (Cyber, Tier 2): Large mechanical robot with potent overheating cannons.

  • Wastelander (Chieftess): Large mechanical transport that is heavily armed and empowers nearby allies.

NEW OPERATIONS

  • Enriched Alloys (Human, Tier 3): Increases ranged damage of target allied unit. Efficient Enrichment (Tier 4) upgrade reduces resource cost.

  • Transubstantiation (Voice, Tier 3): Target allied unit restores hitpoints on attack. Metabole (Tier 4) upgrade increases restored hitpoints.

  • Systemic Reset (Cyber, Tier 3): Removes temporary debuffs from target allied unit. Systemic Interference (Tier 4) upgrade allows the removal of temporary buffs from target enemy unit. 

NEW ITEMS

  • Suicide Drones (Human, Common): Damages target enemy unit.

  • Stolen Flesh (Voice, Common): Restores hitpoints each turn.

  • ICAR Fluid Deflector (Cyber, Common): Grants evasion damage reduction.

NEW OUTPOSTS

  • Erebus Excavator: Provides minerals and chips, and has a chance to unearth an item each turn.

  • Temple of Cr'la: Provides food and algae, and every 10 turns grants an ability that heals target allied unit.

NEW QUESTS

  • Message to the Stars (Early-game): You hear rumors of human spacecraft that left Earth before the war, but ZEPHON blocks you from sending any message out into space.

  • Circus Cambion (Mid-game): A mysterious Ringmaster comes to town and cajoles you into helping him with a grand performance.

  • Concordat Compromised (Late-game): The Concordat asks you for help–an agent has been kidnapped by a group calling themselves “The Constellation.”

  • Impossible Conception (Twisted Mother): Driven by love and longing, you set out to rescue your lost husband and fulfill your shared dream of starting a family, no matter the cost.

  • Reyndverra (Hollow Warlord): Haunted by idleness, you pursue a legendary reality-warping sword, facing rivals who test your resolve and your understanding of power.

NEW MUTATORS

  • Must We Suffer So? (Unrestricted): Start the game with Research Laboratory, Holo Theater, Habitation Block, Construction Yard and Engineer researched.

  • Can Free Will Exist? (Unrestricted): Weapon damage is randomized by ±20%.

  • Can Anything Redeem This Horror? (Twisted Mother): Purchasing units from NPCs is 50% cheaper.

  • Can A Journey Be An End In Itself? (Hollow Warlord): Units have an additional action point.

NEW MUSIC

  • Exploration: 5 minutes 17 seconds of enticing wondrous harmonies.

  • Human (Early-game): 5 minutes 39 seconds of hard rock militaristic beats.

  • Cyber (Early-game): 7 minutes 2 seconds of sharp methodical synths.

  • Voice (Early-game): 6 minutes 59 seconds of primal ominous melodies.

detailed_descriptions.zh-Hant: 进入游戏出现黑屏、崩溃问题解决方案： 1、下载并安装 K-Lite Codec Pack 解码器，解码器下载地址： 2、进入嗜血印根目录找到BloodySpell.exe,右键点属性，运行兼容模式，然后禁用全屏优化。 3、拔掉无线手柄接收器或关闭蓝牙 4、检查游戏完整性 5、升级显卡驱动 开场视频无法跳过解决方案： 给视频文件的名字后面加个1，视频文件在嗜血印根目录的BloodySpell_DataStreamingAssetsmovie里，原名是demoVideo40s 进入游戏出现点不动开始游戏按钮、UI显示错误等问题： 第一步：alt f4关掉游戏。 第二步：删除嗜血印根目录的Savesdir文件夹。 第三步：重新打开游戏并按照提示下载云存档。 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 《嗜血印》是一款武侠动作类角色扮演游戏，玩法上以核心向战斗为主体，并融合了众多战斗元素及系统与一身。 十年前，苏夜锦与妹妹小鲤拜于万法归宗门下修行武艺，自此远离江湖纷嚣，恬静闲逸。十年后，自称灵虚教的神秘组织入侵门派，随之天下大乱，将这对兄妹重新投入风雨飘摇的乱世之中。相依为命的妹妹被掳为人质，同门手足相继惨遭毒手......当嗜血咒印打开的那一刻，重识自我的苏夜锦，能否履行自己对所有人的承诺？而又是谁最后能扶厦将倾，拯救满目疮痍的世间于水火？ 战斗方面，本作以多武器切换为主要特点，并针对每种武器在攻速，威力及定位上的不同，设计出多种功能各异的技能，多样的技能连击，极大地提升游戏爽快度，优异的打击感和操控手感令其锦上添花。 关卡设计的亮点在于采取随机组合的形式，即玩家在死亡后重生所面对的场景、怪物、装备、机关道具的配置等均不同于之前，使游戏呈现出多样化的特征，增加关卡变数及游戏趣味性。 本作不乏创新地推出了“嗜血印”系统，即主角凭借体内的邪神诅咒使用特殊技能，实现暴走、子弹时间、怒吼破防、暗杀处决、反击回血等多种效果，其作用在于增强角色输出、辅助战斗以及简化战斗，对人物及武器属性进行加成，有的甚至能起到决定战局的作用。 该系统使战斗部分更灵活，更具选择性和多样性，同时也保证了战斗的流畅度及爽快感。除此以外，众多有趣的支线任务、多样的调查元素以及穿插其中的小游戏也从侧面大大拓展了游戏内容的饱满度和耐玩度。 我们希望看到十个玩家会有十种不同的闯关方式，如果敌人的威胁太大，可以利用嗜血印技能、暗杀处决、飞行道具、场景机关来消灭他们，最后请大家务必小心谨慎的在本游戏中生存下来吧。

games.name: 鬼谷八荒 Tale of Immortal

names.en: 鬼谷八荒 Tale of Immortal

games.short_description: Tale of Immortal is an open-world sandbox based on Chinese mythology and cultivation. You will grow to become immortal, conquer the beasts from the Classic of Mountains and Season, make your choices carefully and grasp your own destiny.

descriptions.en: Tale of Immortal is an open-world sandbox based on Chinese mythology and cultivation. You will grow to become immortal, conquer the beasts from the Classic of Mountains and Season, make your choices carefully and grasp your own destiny.

detailed_descriptions.en: Tale of Immortal is an open-world sandbox game based on Chinese mythology and cultivation. You will grow to become immortal, conquer the beasts from the Classic of Mountains and Season, make your choices carefully and grasp your own destiny. Step into the enchanting world of the Tale of Immortal, where cultivation is an art that requires more than just financial means and help from fellow cultivators. To truly master it, one must possess a deep understanding of the craft and have access to the right cultivation venues. But that's not all—the journey is fraught with danger, as you'll face unpredictable monsters, crisis-ridden mystic realms, insurmountable barriers, and brilliant treasures waiting to be discovered. As a novice cultivator in the Qi Refining stage, you'll set out from Yukong Village to cultivate your inner strength, defy the odds, and overcome adversity. With each breakthrough, you'll be able to rewrite your destiny and cleave through the thorns on your journey. Cross continents, witness the wonders of the world, and then ascend to Tian Yuan Mountain, where the ultimate enlightenment of the Way awaits. Embrace a fully-realized NPC world, where each character is a unique entity with their own friends, family, and life trajectory— completely independent of your progress. However, if you choose to meddle, you certainly can! The game is yours to shape as you wish. Collaborate with your beloved to save the day, seek revenge alone, or even become the enemy of all. The choice is yours to make. Master martial arts, teach NPCs the Taoist Mind, learn from seasoned gurus, and accept eager disciples. You can also take on the NPCs in the auction house and follow it up by drawing your sword or claiming your hard-earned spoils. As part of a group of immortal cultivators, you can either shine bright or cultivate in secrecy. It's all up to you and the path you choose to take. Are you ready to embark on a thrilling adventure? One where you might become the hero who saves the day and wins the heart of the love of your life? Or maybe you're looking to stir up some jealousy in your crush and have them fight for your affection? How about fulfilling a fifty-year-old promise or getting caught up in the struggle of a mysterious organization? Perhaps you'll uncover a long-forgotten treasure, only to have it snatched away by a cunning adversary? The possibilities are endless! But that's just the beginning! As you journey through this immersive world, apart from interacting with a rich cast of NPCs, you'll encounter a plethora of random events and side tasks that will keep you on your toes. Some might leave you feeling frustrated or hurt, while others could be just the thing to save you or make you stronger after facing danger head-on. Every decision you make will shape the narrative, leading to a unique and unforgettable story that's yours alone. Do you want to take your sect to new heights of power and glory? We've got the ultimate sect management gameplay that lets you experience the full range of sect life: from humble disciple to mighty sect master. Join a massive sect and work your way up from the bottom, or take on the challenge of leading a fallen sect back to prominence. As a Disciple, you'll complete sect missions, compete in sect tournaments, and fight for glory and resources for your sect. As an Elder, you'll be responsible for teaching and guiding your disciples, assigning tasks, and accelerating the sect's growth. The real power and responsibility, however, lie with the Sect Leader. You'll need to keep order in the sect, plan strategic attacks and defenses, and fight for precious resources like Spirit Mines. If you're ambitious enough, you can even conquer other sects and seize their exclusive "Rewrite Destiny" and manuals. Achieve your wildest ambitions and unify the world, as long as you have the strength and the drive to make it happen. To embark on an epic adventure, you need to hone your skills and become a true warrior. Start by building a solid foundation of cultivation. Your mind skills are crucial to success, so focus on cultivating a powerful mindset. From there, you can delve into martial and spiritual skills to take your abilities to the next level. As you explore, keep an eye out for opportunities to create edges with your motion and special skills. And don't forget to tap into your ultimate skills to save the day when necessary. There are a dozen of manuals to choose from, each with its own unique characteristics. Will you specialize in one of the twelve Spiritual Roots, or master them all? What school of martial arts will you establish? The choice is yours. There are treasures to be found in every corner of this world. From the Manual Pavilion to the mystic realms and beyond, you never know what you might discover. And with hundreds of rare and exotic monsters, fellow cultivators, ghosts, demons, and immortals to test your strength against, you'll never be bored. If you're up for a challenge, why not try your luck at the Immortal Tournament or the Master Rankings? Can you break through the barriers of the Nether Mountains? Will your school rise to the occasion and prove its worth? As you journey through this perilous world, your school will be put to the test. Sharpen your skills and harness the power of tools! At the start, you get to choose from three formidable weapons, each offering a distinct cultivation system. The Bagua Jade grants you the ability to revive yourself and your chosen ally, the Eye of Providence allows you to steal Beast Skills and gain unparalleled insights into the world, and the Mythical Gourd empowers you to capture a Boss and enlist it as your loyal sidekick: command it to fight by your side or to search for treasure on your behalf. And that's not all. Refine your own Artifacts and summon Artifact Spirits to fight by your side. These Spirits not only offer you companionship but also trigger exclusive adventures and provide invaluable assistance. Moreover, hone your skills in practicing Alchemy and Talismans, mastering the art of Geomancy and Feng Shui, and crafting a plethora of items to assist you in your explorations. Confuse your enemies, slay your foes, and emerge victorious every time! Our studio hopes that in this game, players will express the theme of "Always stick to your heart, dare to fight against difficulties; make choices carefully and grasp your own destiny."

Start by building a solid foundation of cultivation. Your mind skills are crucial to success, so focus on cultivating a powerful mindset. From there, you can delve into martial and spiritual skills to take your abilities to the next level. As you explore, keep an eye out for opportunities to create edges with your motion and special skills. And don't forget to tap into your ultimate skills to save the day when necessary.

There are a dozen of manuals to choose from, each with its own unique characteristics. Will you specialize in one of the twelve Spiritual Roots, or master them all? What school of martial arts will you establish? The choice is yours.

There are treasures to be found in every corner of this world. From the Manual Pavilion to the mystic realms and beyond, you never know what you might discover. And with hundreds of rare and exotic monsters, fellow cultivators, ghosts, demons, and immortals to test your strength against, you'll never be bored.

If you're up for a challenge, why not try your luck at the Immortal Tournament or the Master Rankings? Can you break through the barriers of the Nether Mountains? Will your school rise to the occasion and prove its worth? As you journey through this perilous world, your school will be put to the test.



Sharpen your skills and harness the power of tools!

At the start, you get to choose from three formidable weapons, each offering a distinct cultivation system. The Bagua Jade grants you the ability to revive yourself and your chosen ally, the Eye of Providence allows you to steal Beast Skills and gain unparalleled insights into the world, and the Mythical Gourd empowers you to capture a Boss and enlist it as your loyal sidekick: command it to fight by your side or to search for treasure on your behalf.

And that's not all. Refine your own Artifacts and summon Artifact Spirits to fight by your side. These Spirits not only offer you companionship but also trigger exclusive adventures and provide invaluable assistance.

Moreover, hone your skills in practicing Alchemy and Talismans, mastering the art of Geomancy and Feng Shui, and crafting a plethora of items to assist you in your explorations. Confuse your enemies, slay your foes, and emerge victorious every time!


Our studio hopes that in this game, players will express the theme of "Always stick to your heart, dare to fight against difficulties; make choices carefully and grasp your own destiny."
